sum: Slow earthquakes show downdip weakening (smaller, more frequent events with depth) and diverse moment-duration (M0-T) scaling laws, yet laboratory studies have produced contradictory trends due to coupled temperature, composition, and effective normal stress (σeff). Here, the authors conduct triaxial friction experiments on synthetic olivine-antigorite gouges at fixed temperature (500 °C) and σeff (50 MPa) to isolate compositional effects. Increasing antigorite promotes intergranular pressure solution (IPS) and distributed granular flow, yielding linear stress-drop-duration scaling (equivalent to M0 ∝ T) but smaller, more frequent events—opposing the natural downdip decrease in serpentinization. Synthesizing prior laboratory data, they establish a hierarchical framework: downdip reduction of σeff is the first-order control driving downdip weakening, while fault rock architectural maturity (fragment-to-shear-zone-width ratio, δ/w) acts as a second-order selector between low-maturity, fracture-dominated cubic scaling (M0 ∝ T³) and high-maturity, flow-dominated linear scaling (M0 ∝ T).
慢地震表现出倾向弱化特征及多样的矩-持续时间（M0-T）标度律。本文在固定温度（500 °C）和有效正应力（50 MPa）下对合成橄榄石-叶蛇纹石断层泥开展三轴摩擦实验，分离了矿物组分的影响。结果显示，增加叶蛇纹石促进颗粒间压溶（IPS）和分布式颗粒流，产生线性标度律（M0 ∝ T），但事件更小更频……

t: Triaxial saw-cut friction experiments on synthetic olivine-antigorite gouges at constant temperature and effective normal stress, combined with SEM microstructural/SPO analysis and cross-study scaling synthesis.
在恒温恒有效正应力下开展合成橄榄石-叶蛇纹石断层泥三轴摩擦实验，结合SEM微结构分析和跨研究标度综合。
11 hydrothermal friction tests on mixed olivine-antigorite powders (0–100 vol.% antigorite) at P = 150 MPa, Pp = 100 MPa (σeff = 50 MPa), T = 500 °C, and slip rates of 0.04–5 μm/s.
150 MPa围压、100 MPa孔隙压、500 °C及0.04–5 μm/s滑移速率下11组不同配比断层泥热液摩擦实验…

Increasing antigorite content decreases peak friction, shear stress drop (Δτ), and recurrence interval (Tr), while all slow stick-slip events follow a robust linear scaling (Δτ ~ td) independent of composition.
增加叶蛇纹石降低峰值摩擦、应力降和复发周期，所有慢粘滑事件遵循与组分无关的线性标度（Δτ ~ td）。
The experimental configuration imposes a fixed, predetermined rupture area defined by the forcing blocks, unlike natural faults or intact rock tests where rupture area evolves.
实验采用固定预设的锯切破裂面积，不同于天然断层或完整岩石破裂中破裂面积随事件演化的情况。

Unifies slow earthquake depth-dependence and moment-duration scaling diversity into a two-tiered hierarchy of first-order effective normal stress control and second-order architectural maturity selection.
将慢地震深度依赖性与标度律多样性统一到一级有效正应力控制和二级结构成熟度选择的两级层次框架中。

kc: Isolated the effect of antigorite content on slow stick-slip behavior at constant temperature (500 °C) and effective normal stress (50 MPa), precluding dehydration.
Resolved the laboratory-observation paradox by proving that downdip reduction of effective normal stress is the first-order control on slow earthquake downdip weakening.
Demonstrated that architectural maturity (δ/w) acts as a second-order selector between fracture-dominated cubic scaling (M0 ∝ T³) and IPS-facilitated flow-dominated linear scaling (M0 ∝ T).
在恒定温度（500 °C）和有效正应力（50 MPa）且避免脱水的条件下，独立量化了叶蛇纹石含量对慢粘滑行为的影响。
证明有效正应力随深度降低是慢地震倾向弱化的一级控制因素，解决了实验室与野外观测的悖论。
揭示断层岩结构成熟度（δ/w）作为二级选择器，调控破裂主导的立方标度律（M0 ∝ T³）与压溶辅助流动主导的线性标度律（M0 ∝ T）。

Microstructural and nanoscale characterization using FE-SEM backscattered electron (BSE) and secondary electron (SE) imaging, plus quantitative shape-preferred orientation (SPO) analysis.
Theoretical derivation equating laboratory linear stress-drop-duration scaling (Δτ ∝ td) under fixed rupture area to natural moment-duration scaling (M0 ∝ T).

理论推导固定破裂面积下实验室线性应力降-持续时间标度（Δτ ∝ td）与天然慢地震矩-持续时间标度（M0 ∝ T）的等价性。

Comparative synthesis with prior hydrothermal friction datasets on mature antigorite gouge (Okazaki & Katayama, 2015) and intact dehydrating antigorite rock (Shao et al., 2022).

与前人成熟叶蛇纹石断层泥（Okazaki & Katayama, 2015）及完整脱水叶蛇纹石岩石（Shao et al., 2022）热液摩擦实验数据的综合对比。
li: Experiments use a fixed, predetermined saw-cut rupture area (~20 mm diameter blocks) and ~1 mm gouge thickness, precluding natural rupture area growth during single events.
Synthetic gouges represent high-maturity ('unjammed', δ/w ≈ 0.04) end-members, while transitional and low-maturity ('jammed') regimes rely on synthesis with prior intact-rock experiments.
实验采用固定预设的锯切破裂面积（直径20 mm压块）和约1 mm厚断层泥，无法模拟单次事件中破裂面积的自然扩展。
合成断层泥仅代表高成熟度（δ/w ≈ 0.04）端元，低成熟度（卡阻态）及过渡态行为主要依赖与前人完整岩石实验的综合对比。

sum: This paper presents a sequential receiver function (RF) and coda autocorrelation (AC) H-κ phase-weighted stacking method to simultaneously constrain sedimentary and crystalline crustal properties. Traditional RF methods struggle in sedimentary basins due to strong sediment-related multiples that contaminate deeper crustal signals. By integrating AC data, which provides independent constraints on P- and S-wave reflection times, the new method suppresses sediment multiple interference. Synthetic tests and real-world applications to four broadband stations in the Bohai Bay Basin and Tarim Basin, China, demonstrate its robustness. The results reveal 2.0–10.0 km thick sedimentary layers with depth-decreasing Vp/Vs ratios, and distinct crustal thicknesses (28.0–32.0 km in Bohai Bay versus ~40 km in Tarim), demonstrating the method's capability to resolve complex layered continental crust.
本文提出了一种顺序接收函数（RF）与柯达自相关（AC）H-κ相位加权堆叠方法，用于同时约束沉积层和下伏结晶地壳性质。传统RF方法在沉积盆地中易受强沉积多次波干扰。该方法通过引入AC数据，为P波和S波反射时间提供独立约束，从而有效压制多次波。合成测试和中国渤海湾盆地及塔里木盆地4个宽频带台站的实际应用……

sum: This paper proposes a multi-scale spatiotemporal inversion filter (MSIF) method for dense GNSS networks to extract transient tectonic signals from noisy time series. The method combines multi-scale spatial decomposition of regional deformation fields with a variational Bayesian Independent Component Analysis-based inversion. Applied to the 2021 Ms 6.4 Yangbi earthquake, MSIF successfully identified pre-seismic deformation anomalies concentrated at an 11 km scale. Inversion results show that the foreshock and mainshock rupture zones experienced extensional and right-lateral strike-slip motion, releasing an equivalent Mw 5.5 moment. This suggests that pre-seismic aseismic slip facilitated subsequent seismic ruptures.
本文提出了一种基于密集GNSS网络的多尺度时空反演滤波（MSIF）方法，用于从高噪声时间序列中提取瞬态构造信号。该方法结合了区域形变场的多尺度空间分解与变分贝叶斯独立成分分析反演。应用于2021年云南漾濞Ms 6.4级地震，MSIF成功识别出集中在11公里空间尺度上的震前形变异常。反演表明前震和主震……

sum: This study investigates a deep Mw=4.2 earthquake occurring beneath the Moho in southern Tibet. By precisely constraining its location, depth, and source mechanism using regional and teleseismic waveforms, the authors demonstrate that seismicity can persist in the sub-Moho mantle lithosphere under temperatures previously thought to inhibit brittle failure. This finding provides critical constraints on the rheology, thermal state, and mechanical behavior of the colliding Indian plate beneath Tibet, suggesting that the brittle-ductile transition or thermal limits of mantle rocks under high strain rates or dehydration conditions may need revision.

sum: This study presents a multiscale structural and mineralogical investigation of mirror fault surfaces (MFS) hosted in Triassic dolostones along the Dinar Fault Zone (western Türkiye), responsible for the 1995 Mw 6.2 Dinar earthquake. Using optical microscopy, SEM, EBSD, and high-resolution TEM with EDS and electron diffraction, the authors examine fault rock microstructures from outcrop to nanoscale. They discover that deformed dolomite crystals at the MFS are systematically enveloped by randomly oriented Mg-rich calcite nanograins (<10 nm), vesicles, and amorphous alumosilicate material derived from minor phyllosilicates. These assemblages indicate thermal decomposition triggered by coseismic frictional heating at temperatures around 550°C. While identical nanostructures have been produced in high-velocity friction experiments, this work provides the first unequivocal field evidence of earthquake-induced dolomite decarbonation along a known, active seismogenic fault, demonstrating that moderate earthquakes (M 4–6) at shallow depths (1–3 km) can drive decarbonation.

t: Multiscale microscopy combining optical petrography, SEM/EDS, EBSD grain orientation mapping, and high-resolution TEM/SAED/EDS on ion-milled sections perpendicular and parallel to mirror fault surfaces.

Fault rock samples containing striated mirror fault surfaces collected from Triassic dolostones near Düzbel (~20 km north of Dinar) within the damage zone of the Dinar Fault Zone.

Field observations alone cannot easily detect carbonate thermal decomposition ('hidden earthquakes'), and post-seismic fluid circulation alters soluble decomposition products.
仅凭野外观察难以识别碳酸盐热分解（“隐蔽地震”），且震后流体循环会改造可溶性分解产物。
Provides the first unequivocal natural evidence of coseismic dolomite thermal decomposition associated with a mirror surface along a known active seismogenic fault.
首次在已知活动发震断层的镜面断层面上提供了同震白云石热分解的确凿天然证据。

Multiscale characterization (SEM, EBSD, HR-TEM) revealing Mg-rich calcite nanograins (<10 nm) and amorphous alumosilicate films coating deformed dolomite grains.
Energy balance modeling showing slips of 4–10 cm (equivalent to M 4–6 earthquakes) at 1–3 km depth are sufficient to trigger dolomite decarbonation.

tm.why: The paper investigates coseismic fault slip mechanics, frictional heating, mirror fault surfaces, and thermal decomposition in a carbonate fault zone.
It links nanoscale mineralogical decomposition products along slip surfaces directly to coseismic frictional heating and slip parameters of moderate-magnitude earthquakes.

sum: This study presents high-resolution seismic imaging of the seismogenic fault zone responsible for three earthquakes in Luxian, Sichuan Basin, China. Utilizing data recorded by dense linear arrays and active methane gas gun sources, the authors successfully constrain the geometry of the fault and identify prominent low-velocity zones associated with the seismogenic structures. The integration of dense passive seismic monitoring and controlled active sources provides critical structural constraints to understand the fault mechanics and potential induced seismicity mechanisms in this highly active shale gas development region.
本研究利用四川盆地泸县密集线性台阵和甲烷气枪主动源数据，对三次地震的致震断层进行了高分辨率地震成像。研究成功约束了断层几何结构，并识别出与致震构造相关的显著低速带。密集被动地震监测与受控主动源的结合，为理解该页岩气开发活跃区域的断层力学机制和诱发地震机制提供了关键的结构约束。

t: High-resolution seismic imaging and travel-time tomography using dense linear arrays and active methane gas gun sources.
利用密集线性台阵和甲烷气枪主动源进行高分辨率地震成像与旅行时断层成像。
Seismic data recorded by dense linear arrays in the Sichuan Basin, supplemented by active-source signals from methane sources.
四川盆地密集线性台阵记录的地震数据，以及甲烷源产生的主动源信号。
Detailed constraints on the geometry of the seismogenic fault and the identification of prominent low-velocity zones in the Luxian area.
详细约束了泸县地区致震断层的几何结构，并识别出显著的低速带。
Imaging resolution is primarily focused along the dense linear profiles, with limited 3D spatial coverage.

Combining dense linear passive arrays with environmentally friendly active methane sources to image active seismogenic faults in the Sichuan Basin.
结合密集线性被动台阵与环保型主动甲烷源，对四川盆地活动致震断层进行成像。

kc: Obtained high-resolution seismic images of the seismogenic fault zone in the Luxian area, Sichuan Basin.
Constrained the spatial distribution of low-velocity zones associated with the active fault structures.
Demonstrated the joint application of dense linear arrays and environmentally friendly methane gas gun sources for fine-scale fault imaging.
获得了四川盆地泸县地区致震断层带的高分辨率地震成像结果。

Active-source signals generated by environmental methane gas gun sources.

tm.why: The paper focuses on imaging seismogenic faults in the Sichuan Basin (Luxian), a region highly associated with shale gas extraction and induced seismicity.
The study performs high-resolution imaging of fault zones and low-velocity zones using dense linear arrays.

sum: This paper introduces a conjugate operator pair of time-space partial differential equations (PDEs) for wave-equation Kirchhoff modelling and migration. While full-wave Born modelling suffers from large errors under strong velocity contrasts and wide scattering angles, existing wave-equation Kirchhoff formulations rely on single-valued or angle-averaged approximations. Here, the proposed forward operator represents the full-wave Kirchhoff upward-propagating operator linking angle-dependent plane-wave reflectivity to common-shot reflection data, using a time-shot-dependent reflection angle evaluated on the fly via directionally decomposed Poynting vectors and reflector normals. Its exact adjoint is shown to be equivalent to angle-domain reverse time migration (RTM). Coupled with angle-domain smoothing regularization and low-rank Tucker tensor projection, the operators enable iterative linearized waveform inversion. Tests on a two-layer model, Marmousi-2, and marine streamer data show superior large-angle modelling accuracy (SNR 33.3 vs 8.51 for Born) and enhanced spatial resolution and AVA fidelity.
本文提出了一对用于波动方程基尔霍夫正演与偏移的时间-空间偏微分方程（PDE）共轭算子。传统Born正演在强速度对比和大散射角下误差较大，而现有全波基尔霍夫近似多忽略或平均角度变化。本文提出的正演算子将随角度变化的平面波反射率与共炮点反射数据直接关联，利用多方向Poynting矢量与反射面法向在时间推……

t: Formulates common-shot Kirchhoff modelling and angle-domain RTM as a conjugate pair of time-space PDEs with time-shot-dependent reflection angles evaluated on the fly via Poynting vectors, solved iteratively with Tucker tensor projection.
将共炮点基尔霍夫正演与角域RTM表述为时间-空间PDE共轭算子对，利用Poynting矢量实时计算反射角并结合Tucke…

Evaluated on a 2D two-layer model, the Marmousi-2 synthetic model (42 shots, 400 receivers), and a marine streamer field dataset (703 shots, 240 receivers) discretized with 10th-order spatial and 2nd-order temporal FD.
采用空间十阶、时间二阶有限差分，在双层模型、Marmousi-2合成数据（42炮）及海洋拖缆实测数据（703炮）上进行验…

Passed the dot-product test (0.99999 ± 3.5e-6); achieved SNR of 33.3 at 56° scattering angle vs 8.51 (Born) and 14.0 (angle-degraded Kirchhoff); improved Marmousi-2 reflectivity cross-correlation from 0.212–0.306 to 0.279–0.426.
点积测试达0.99999；56°散射角下信噪比达33.3（Born仅为8.51）；Marmousi-2反演反射率互相关系…

Multi-directional wavefield decomposition dominates computational cost (63.2% of runtime), and the single-scattering Kirchhoff operator cannot model refracted arrivals or overcome biases from noisy reflector-normal estimates.
多方向波场分解占总耗时63.2%，且单次散射算子无法模拟大偏移距折射波，并受反射面法向估计误差影响。

Bridges Born and Kirchhoff approximations via a time-domain PDE forward operator for angle-dependent plane-wave reflectivity whose exact adjoint is vector-based angle-domain RTM with on-the-fly time-dependent angles.
首次建立直接关联角度依赖平面波反射率的时间域PDE基尔霍夫正演算子，并证明其精确伴随即为矢量方向角域RTM。

kc: Formulated a time-space PDE representation of the common-shot Kirchhoff upward-propagating forward operator that accurately models primary reflections at large scattering angles and strong velocity contrasts.

Proved mathematically and numerically (via dot-product test) that the exact adjoint of this PDE Kirchhoff modelling operator is equivalent to vector-based angle-domain RTM with a time-shot-dependent reflection angle.
Implemented on-the-fly reflection angle evaluation using directionally decomposed Poynting vectors and structure-tensor reflector normals, avoiding memory storage of 4D angle fields.
Developed a regularized and Tucker-decomposition preconditioned linearized waveform inversion workflow that improves spatial resolution and AVA fidelity on synthetic and marine field datasets.
提出了共炮点基尔霍夫向上传播正演算子的时间-空间偏微分方程（PDE）表述，在强速度对比和大散射角下仍能精确模拟一次反射波。
从数学推导和数值点积测试上证明了该PDE基尔霍夫正演算子的精确伴随算子等价于采用随时间-炮点变化反射角的矢量方向角域逆时偏移（RTM）。
利用多方向分解Poynting矢量和结构张量反射面法向实现了反射角的实时计算，避免了在内存中存储高维角度场。

Second-order temporal and tenth-order spatial finite-difference (FD) wavefield extrapolation with dispersion-controlled optimal time-step selection

2D marine streamer field dataset (703 shots, 240 receivers, 20 Hz dominant frequency) evaluating prestack angle gathers, vertical wavenumber spectra, and AVA curves

li: Relies on the single-scattering acoustic approximation and cannot accurately model refracted waves at large offsets, surface-related multiples, or converted waves.

Reflector-normal estimation from migrated images can become biased if the initial migration image suffers from severe noise or migration velocity errors.

在稀疏观测系统和精细角度采样（1°）下，角道集存在照明缺失间隙，正则化反演只能部分恢复缺失的角度分量。

tm.why: The paper develops a conjugate operator pair of time-space PDEs for wave-equation Kirchhoff modelling and angle-domain reverse time migration to perform iterative linearized waveform inversion.

The work establishes the mathematical equivalence between the adjoint of the proposed Kirchhoff PDE operator and vector-based angle-domain RTM, solving the ill-posed linearized inverse problem with regularization and tensor-based projection.
The operators are formulated as time-domain acoustic wave-equation PDEs solved via high-order finite-difference schemes on GPUs with an error-controlled time-step selection strategy.

sum: This paper investigates the computational aspects of an unsupervised clustering technique based on the correlation integral (CI) method. The authors derive two key parameters from the CI equation: the scaling exponent (SE) and its double derivative (DD), which serve as effective attributes for automated seismic data interpretation. The workflow successfully highlights geological features such as channels, gas chimneys, faults, and progradation clinoforms. By decreasing the calculation stride, the new workflow dramatically increases the resolution of SE and DD images with only a marginal increase in computation time. For the first time, these 3D volumes are converted to SEG-Y format for integration with professional interpretation software.
本文研究了基于关联积分（CI）方法的无监督聚类技术的计算环节。作者从CI方程中导出了两个关键参数：缩放指数（SE）及其二阶导数（DD），作为自动地震数据解释的有效属性。该工作流成功突出了河道、气烟囱、断层和前积斜坡等地球物理特征。通过减小计算步长，新工作流在计算时间仅略微增加的情况下，显著提高了SE……

基于关联积分（CI）方法的无监督聚类技术，推导缩放指数（SE）和二阶导数（DD）作为地震属性。

sum: Performance-based seismic risk assessment requires realistic three-component ground-motion time histories conditioned on source, path, and site parameters. This paper introduces WaveFlowGMM, a two-stage probabilistic generative framework that separates low-dimensional amplitude scaling from high-dimensional waveform-shape synthesis. In the first stage, physics-informed symbolic learning (PISL) predicts component-wise median peak ground accelerations (PGA) and samples joint amplitudes using full between-event and within-event covariance matrices. In the second stage, a conditional U-Net trained with few-step AlphaFlow generates normalized three-component waveforms in a reconstructible sym8 wavelet-packet coefficient space, which are then rescaled by the sampled PGA. Evaluated on an event-level holdout split of 15,615 NGA-West2 records, WaveFlowGMM accurately reproduces empirical magnitude, distance, and site scaling, preserves cross-component PGA residual correlations (0.86–0.93), and achieves a 12.2 ms per-record generation time at 2 neural function evaluations—roughly 24 to 490 times faster than diffusion baselines.
基于性能的地震风险评估需要符合震源、路径和场地条件的三分量加速度时程。本文提出两阶段概率生成模型WaveFlowGMM，以峰值地面加速度（PGA）作为幅值与波形生成的接口。第一阶段利用物理启发符号学习（PISL）估计各分量PGA中位值及完整跨分量事件间/事件内协方差；第二阶段在可重构小波包系数空间中……

t: WaveFlowGMM factorizes conditional generation into a physics-informed symbolic learning (PISL) model with full random-effects covariance for three-component PGA, and a conditional U-Net trained via AlphaFlow in sym8 wavelet-packet space.
将生成解耦为PISL三分量PGA全协方差概率模型与小波包空间少步AlphaFlow条件U-Net。

15,615 screened NGA-West2 free-field shallow crustal three-component records from 358 earthquakes, split by event (85:15) into 12,472 training records (304 events) and 3,143 holdout records (54 events).

Generated waveforms reproduce empirical scaling with near-zero PGA/PSA residuals, preserve H1-H2 (0.934) and H-V (0.860) PGA residual correlations, and sample in 12.2 ms per record at 2 NFE.

kc: Proposes a two-stage probabilistic ground-motion generation framework (WaveFlowGMM) that decouples amplitude scaling from normalized waveform-shape generation via a three-component PGA interface.

在可重构8层sym8小波包系数空间中实现少步AlphaFlow生成，2步采样单条记录仅需12.2毫秒，比扩散模型基线快约24至490倍。

Random-effects residual decomposition (Abrahamson and Youngs) with full 3x3 between-event and within-event covariance matrices sampled via Cholesky factorization.
Eight-level sym8 wavelet-packet transform mapping 16,384-sample three-component normalized waveforms into compact 3x256x80 time-frequency coefficient arrays.
Conditional U-Net with multi-head self-attention, cross-attention over structured scenario/amplitude tokens, and AlphaFlow average-velocity training schedule.

Event-level 85:15 train-test split yielding 12,472 training records (304 events) and 3,143 holdout evaluation records (54 unseen events).
Comprehensive validation across 12 intensity measures, RotD50 distance/magnitude/VS30 median scaling curves against BSSA14/SBSA16, and NFE/backbone ablation against DDPM, DDIM, and EDM.
筛选NGA-West2数据库中358次浅源地壳地震的15,615条自由场三分量强震记录，重采样至100 Hz（16,384个采样点）。

sum: This study constructs a high-resolution earthquake catalog for the Klyuchevskoy Volcanic Group (KVG) in Kamchatka using 11 months of continuous data from the dense KISS temporary array and permanent stations (2015–2016). Applying the volcano-trained PhaseNet ('volpick'), PyOcto association, HypoInverse, and HypoDD relocation, the authors detect and relocate 11,213 events—a 14-fold increase over existing manual catalogs. Frequency Index (FI) analysis and HDBSCAN spatial clustering separate volcano-tectonic (VT) from long-period (LP) earthquakes and delineate vertically extended trans-crustal magma pathways beneath Klyuchevskoy, Plosky Tolbachik, and Ushkovsky volcanoes. LP events dominate the seismicity, span from the Moho (~30–50 km) to shallow depths, and exhibit frequency-magnitude distributions departing from the Gutenberg-Richter law (steeper decay and deficit of large events), reflecting fluid-pressure source physics. Furthermore, deep LP bursts precede shallow seismicity increases and volcanic unrest, illuminating upward magmatic pressure transfer.

sum: Modern deep-learning detectors identify massive numbers of small earthquakes, producing dense, overlapping arrival sequences that challenge existing phase associators, especially in heterogeneous velocity structures. This paper introduces HARPA, a framework for high-rate phase association and joint wave-speed estimation. HARPA represents observed and predicted arrival times at each station as probability distributions and matches them using the Wasserstein optimal-transport metric, avoiding combinatorial event-by-event matching during inversion. Unknown wave speeds are parameterized via an autoencoder latent space coupled to a coordinate-based travel-time neural field, and optimized alongside source locations and origin times using stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD). Tested on synthetic datasets, densified 2019 Ridgecrest data, and 2014 Iquique Chile data, HARPA matches state-of-the-art methods at low event rates and significantly outperforms them at high rates (up to 120 events/min) and across strong lateral velocity contrasts, while demonstrating preliminary passive-source tomography from unassociated arrivals.
现代深度学习检测器能识别大量微震，产生密集重叠的到时序列，给复杂波速结构下的震相关联带来挑战。本文提出HARPA框架，将台站观测与预测到时表示为概率分布，利用Wasserstein最优传输度量进行匹配，避免了反演中的组合搜索。该方法结合自编码器隐空间与坐标走时神经场参数化未知波速，并采用随机梯度朗之……

t: HARPA represents station arrival times as probability distributions, matching observed and predicted distributions via 2-Wasserstein optimal transport while jointly optimizing source parameters and travel-time neural field latent codes using SGLD.
将台站到时表示为概率分布，利用Wasserstein最优传输匹配分布，并通过SGLD联合优化震源与走时神经场隐编码。
Evaluated on 1-month 2014 Mw 8.2 Iquique Chile and 7-hour 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest PhaseNet picks, time-shifted high-rate Ridgecrest sequences, and 3D synthetic heterogeneous velocity models.

HARPA matches GaMMA and PyOcto at 0.3–3 epm, and achieves 91.3% (60 epm, 20 stations) and 72.0% (120 epm, 50 stations) association accuracy with <10% wave-speed error in complex random fields.

sum: This dataset publication presents recomputed earthquake magnitudes for several previously published QDG earthquake catalogs (Gong et al., 2022, 2023, 2026; Gong and Fan, 2022). The recalculations strictly follow the methodological formulation and parameters established by Fan et al. (2026). This contribution provides a more consistent and calibrated magnitude scale across these regional catalogs, enhancing their utility for subsequent statistical seismology and hazard analyses.

sum: This study maps the present-day 2-D crustal stress field and seismic moment release in the Greater Permian Basin, Texas, using induced seismicity from 2017 to 2025. The authors relocated 34,274 M≥1.0 earthquakes using a 3-D velocity model and compiled 1,591 focal mechanisms (836 from full-waveform moment tensor inversion and 755 from machine-learning-assisted HASH first-motion/amplitude inversion). Using a damped least-squares 2-D stress inversion on a 0.15° × 0.1° grid, they reveal an overall extensional regime with distinct subprovince heterogeneity: normal faulting with N-S to NE-SW S3 orientations in the Delaware Basin versus mixed normal and strike-slip faulting with NW-SE (~330°) S3 orientations in the Midland Basin. Seismic moment release is dominated by M≥4 events (79% of total) and correlates with basement-rooted faults. The novelty lies in high-resolution stress/moment mapping demonstrating that fluid injection releases pre-existing tectonic strain reservoirs rather than merely causing local compaction.

sum: Mid-mantle (660–2,000 km) seismic reflectors are commonly attributed to thermo-chemical heterogeneities or phase transitions, yet some observations remain unexplained. This study investigates the seismic detectability of deformation-induced anisotropic discontinuities caused by the pressure-dependent (100)[001] to (010)[100] slip transition in bridgmanite beneath subduction zones. The authors combine 3D geodynamic subduction modeling (ASPECT), polycrystal plasticity fabric calculations (VPSC), and global 3D spectral-element wavefield simulations (AxiSEM3D) down to 4 s period, analyzing SS precursors (SdS) via fourth-root vespagrams and back-projection. Results demonstrate that the bridgmanite fabric transition generates a detectable deeper reflector (~1,470 km) distinct from the shallower slab-mantle interface (~1,290 km). For flattened slabs, the anisotropic discontinuity consistently exhibits positive polarity across all azimuths, acting as an apparent slow layer. This mechanism successfully explains positive-polarity S1000S arrivals observed in real data from double-reflector systems beneath Alaska-Aleutians and Middle America.
本研究结合三维地球动力学自由俯冲模拟（ASPECT）、多晶塑性组构计算（VPSC）与全球谱元法全波形模拟（AxiSEM3D），利用阵列地震学方法（四次方根速度谱与反投影）评估了俯冲带下布里奇曼石(100)[001]/(010)[100]滑移系转变引起的各向异性间断面在SS前驱波（SdS）中的可探测性……

t: The authors couple 3D ASPECT free-subduction simulations with VPSC polycrystal plasticity for pressure-dependent bridgmanite fabrics, then compute 4-s global synthetic waveforms using AxiSEM3D and analyze SS precursors via fourth-root vespagrams.
耦合ASPECT三维自由俯冲模拟与VPSC多晶塑性模型，并用AxiSEM3D计算4秒全球合成波形与速度谱。

Synthetic seismograms are computed for a 3,000-receiver array (20° aperture, 110° epicentral distance) at 4 s period, alongside real teleseismic waveforms from CNSN (El Salvador event) and RESIF (Easter Island event).
3000个台站组成的合成阵列（110°震中距）4秒周期波形，及CNSN和RESIF台网的实际远震数据。

The bridgmanite fabric transition produces a detectable S1470S arrival with positive polarity across all azimuths (velocity contrast ~0.5%, ξ ~ 1.02), clearly separated from the shallower S1290S slab-interface reflection.
布里奇曼石组构转变产生全方向正极性的S1470S反射，与较浅的板片界面反射S1290S清晰分离。
Due to the computational cost of VPSC limiting spatial grid resolution, an ad hoc 25-km untextured bridgmanite layer was prescribed to enforce a sharp anisotropic discontinuity.
受VPSC计算网格分辨率限制，人为设定了25公里无织构层来强制产生尖锐的各向异性间断面。

First full-waveform forward modeling demonstrating that depth-dependent bridgmanite slip transitions beneath subducting slabs generate detectable mid-mantle SS precursors that explain deep double-reflector observations.
首次通过全波形正演证明俯冲带下布里奇曼石滑移转变可产生可观测的SS前驱波并解释深部双反射体。

kc: Coupled 3D geodynamic subduction models, VPSC bridgmanite fabric calculations, and 4-s global AxiSEM3D wavefield simulations to test mid-mantle anisotropic discontinuities.
Demonstrated that the (100)[001]/(010)[100] slip transition in bridgmanite produces detectable SdS reflections distinct from the slab-mantle interface.
Showed that horizontally flattened slabs generate positive-polarity reflections at the anisotropic discontinuity across all propagation azimuths.
Provided a physical explanation for enigmatic positive-polarity S1000S reflectors observed in double-reflector systems beneath Alaska-Aleutians and Middle America.
耦合三维地球动力学俯冲模拟、VPSC布里奇曼石组构计算与4秒周期全球AxiSEM3D全波形模拟，检验了中地幔各向异性间断面的可探测性。
证明布里奇曼石(100)[001]/(010)[100]滑移转变可产生与板片-地幔界面明显区分的SdS反射信号。
揭示水平展平的俯冲板片下方的各向异性间断面在所有传播方位角下均产生正极性反射。
为阿拉斯加-阿留申及中美洲下方双反射体系统中观测到的正极性S1000S反射震相提供了合理的物理机制解释。

Lagrangian particle tracking and Viscoplastic Self-Consistent (VPSC) modeling of pressure-dependent bridgmanite crystallographic preferred orientation (CPO).
Global 3D anisotropic full-waveform modeling down to 4 s minimum period using AxiSEM3D with Fourier expansion order 400.
Array seismology processing using fourth-root vespagram stacking, bootstrap resampling, and travel-time/slowness back-projection.

采用AxiSEM3D（傅里叶展开阶数400）进行最短周期达4秒的全球三维各向异性全波形模拟。

sum: This study evaluates the performance of regional 1D and 3D velocity models for seismic moment tensor (MT) estimation of the 2017 M6 Hojedk, Iran, earthquake sequence using the MTUQ software. By utilizing the 3D Middle East velocity model MEAD-M20, the authors demonstrate that for periods T ≥ 25–30 s and magnitudes Mw ≥ 4.5, 3D synthetics outperform 1D models by reducing waveform misfits, time shifts, and spurious non-double-couple components. Uncertainty analysis confirms that MT parameters, depth, and magnitude are more tightly constrained under the 3D model, validating its application for regional source characterization.

sum: Integrating distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) into conventional seismic workflows requires converting strain-rate measurements into geophone-equivalent particle velocity by inverting a gauge-length-dependent spatial-difference operator. Because this inversion is ill-conditioned and amplifies noise under low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), single-regularization methods struggle to balance noise attenuation with waveform preservation. This study proposes a regularized inverse reconstruction framework combining high-order Lp (HOLp) sparsity on second-order differences with overlapping group sparsity (OGS) on first-order differences, alongside a smooth data-domain reference constraint. The objective function is solved using the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), applying iteratively reweighted L1 minimization for HOLp and majorization–minimization for OGS. Tested on synthetic multilayered VSP data and field borehole data from the Groß Schönebeck geothermal site, the HOLp–OGS approach outperforms L1, L2, and f-k rescaling methods, achieving a correlation coefficient of 92.13% on field data while preserving weak reflections and correcting waveform polarity.
将分布式声学传感（DAS）融入常规地震流程需反演标距相关的空间差分算子，将应变率转换为检波器等效质点速度。针对低信噪比下反演病态及噪声放大问题，本文提出结合二阶差分高阶Lp（HOLp）与一阶差分重叠群稀疏（OGS）的双正则化反演框架，并引入平滑参考约束。通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM），结合迭代重加权……

t: The inverse problem is solved via ADMM, decoupling the objective into a least-squares trace update, an iteratively reweighted L1 scheme for the second-order HOLp penalty, and a majorization–minimization algorithm for the first-order OGS penalty.
采用ADMM框架解耦求解，分别利用最小二乘、迭代重加权L1（IRL1）和主化最小化（MM）算法求解速度道、二阶HOLp及…

Evaluated on 2D elastic synthetic records and borehole field data from the GrSk4 well at the Groß Schönebeck geothermal site, comparing 40 m gauge-length DAS data against co-located borehole geophone check-shots at four depths.
采用二维弹性波合成记录与德国Groß Schönebeck地热井GrSk4的40米标距DAS数据及4个深度的共址检波器校…

On noisy synthetic data (SNR = 2), HOLp–OGS achieves 95.86% CC and 0.0177 RMSE (SNR = 11.45 dB). On field data, it achieves 92.13% CC and 0.0826 RMSE at 0.0501 s/trace, outperforming L1, L2, and f-k rescaling.
在SNR=2合成数据上达到95.86%相关系数与0.0177均方根误差；实测数据达到92.13%相关系数与0.0826误…

Processing large-volume DAS datasets remains computationally challenging compared to f-k rescaling, and the forward operator omits the cos^2(theta) versus cos(theta) angular sensitivity difference between DAS and geophones.
海量DAS数据计算效率仍低于f-k方法，且未显式建模DAS与检波器在入射角灵敏度上的余弦平方与余弦差异。

Combines high-order Lp quasi-norm sparsity and overlapping group sparsity regularizations to jointly suppress incoherent noise and preserve weak, locally continuous seismic events during finite-gauge-length DAS-to-geophone inversion.
首次将高阶Lp拟范数与重叠群稀疏正则化结合用于有限标距DAS至检波器反演转换，兼顾随机噪声压制与弱连续同相轴保护。

kc: Formulates DAS-to-geophone conversion as a physics-guided inverse reconstruction problem that explicitly compensates for the finite gauge-length spatial averaging effect.
Introduces a dual regularization scheme combining high-order Lp (HOLp) sparsity on second-order temporal differences and overlapping group sparsity (OGS) on first-order differences.
Develops an ADMM optimization solver decoupling the objective into least-squares, iteratively reweighted L1 (IRL1), and majorization–minimization (MM) subproblems.
Validates the method on synthetic VSP data and field borehole records from the Groß Schönebeck geothermal site, outperforming L1, L2, and f-k conversion methods.
将DAS到检波器的数据转换构建为物理引导的反演重建问题，显式补偿有限标距的空间平均效应。
提出结合二阶差分高阶Lp（HOLp）稀疏性与一阶差分重叠群稀疏（OGS）的双重正则化策略。

sum: This study presents a new suite of top-heavy geodynamo simulations that vary the relative strengths of thermal and chemical driving to investigate core-mantle interactions. By comparing simulated magnetic signatures with observational field models spanning centuries to tens of thousands of years, the authors find that spatially-averaged measures of field morphology cannot robustly distinguish chemical driving levels or boundary heat flux heterogeneity. However, longitudinal variations in time-averaged inclination anomalies are readily matched by simulations with heterogeneous outer boundary thermal forcing. Elevated chemical driving reduces but does not erase these longitudinal structures, while promoting polar minima in the radial magnetic field. The results suggest that both strong heat flux heterogeneity and chemical driving in Earth's core lead to small but persistent departures from the geocentric axial dipole approximation.
本研究提出了一组新型的双重浮力（热与化学驱动）地磁发电机数值模拟，旨在探究核幔相互作用。通过将模拟的磁场特征与数万年尺度的观测磁场模型进行对比，研究发现空间平均的磁场形态指标无法有效区分化学驱动强度或边界热流的非均匀性。然而，时间平均磁偏角异常的经度变化特征与具有非均匀边界热流强迫的模拟高度吻合。增……

sum: This study investigates the dynamic propagation of a key inclined crack in a rock slope under seismic loading by combining an analytical fracture mechanics solution with a 50 g centrifuge shaking table test. The analytical model calculates stress intensity factors and time-dependent crack propagation rates induced by incident P and SV waves. Using a 1:50 scaled slope model subjected to six increasing amplitude stages of the El Centro earthquake record, surface deformation was monitored via particle image velocimetry (PIV) and embedded accelerometers. Both theoretical predictions and experiments confirm that larger seismic wave amplitudes accelerate crack growth. Crucially, while internal crack length grows progressively across stages, surface displacement exhibits strong hysteresis, remaining small (≤4.2 mm) until a sudden jump (20 mm) occurs in the final stage when the rock bridge (locked segment) is breached, providing critical insight for seismic landslide hazard assessment.
本研究结合断裂力学解析解与50g离心机振动台试验，探讨了地震荷载下岩质边坡内关键倾角裂纹的动态扩展行为。通过建立P波和SV波作用下的应力强度因子与裂纹扩展速率方程，对1:50缩尺边坡模型在六级递增幅值的El Centro地震波激励下的响应进行了预测与验证，并利用粒子图像测速（PIV）和加速度计监测位……

t: The authors derive an analytical fracture mechanics equation relating stress intensity factors and surface energy to the time-dependent propagation rate of an inclined slope crack under seismic waves, validated via 50 g centrifuge shaking table testing and PIV.
推导地震波下边坡倾角裂纹动态扩展的断裂力学解析解，并通过50g离心机振动台与PIV监测验证。

A 1:50 scaled slope model (870×200×300 mm, 45° slope) with a 190 mm inclined crack and 40 mm rock bridge was tested under 50 g centrifugal acceleration using six stages of El Centro seismic excitation (2.5 g to 25 g).
构建含190mm倾角裂纹与40mm岩桥的1:50缩尺边坡模型，施加六级递增El Centro波激励。

Analytical crack length grew progressively from 0.19 m to 0.2393 m across six stages, while PIV-measured maximum surface displacement showed hysteresis: 1.5 mm, 2.3 mm, and 4.2 mm in stages 3–5, jumping to 20 mm at failure in stage 6.

The model simplifies incident waves to fixed-angle plane P and SV waves, assumes a homogeneous slope, and lacks direct experimental tracking of internal crack tip propagation during shaking.
简化为平面P/SV波入射与均质模型，且试验无法实时直接测量内部裂纹扩展长度。

Unlike prior static or approximate fracture mechanics slope studies, this work derives a time-dependent dynamic crack propagation analytical solution under seismic waves and validates it with centrifuge shaking table testing.
提出考虑地震动时变响应的边坡倾角裂纹动态扩展解析解，并与离心机物理模拟相互印证。

sum: Cenozoic plate divergence across the West Antarctic Rift System (WARS) is critical for evaluating whether Pacific plate motion changes caused the ~47 Ma Hawaii–Emperor seamount chain bend. Previous kinematic models suffered from unconfirmed pre-bend Paleocene divergence or implied unrealistic collision in the Antarctic interior. This study utilizes high-resolution (~4 km half-wavelength) vertical gravity gradient data from the SWOT satellite mission to repick fracture zones, abyssal hills, and magnetic isochrons across the Tasman Sea, Macquarie Basin, Southeast Indian Ridge, and Pacific-Antarctic Ridge. Using Macquarie circuit summations, the updated models accurately replicate subglacial extensional basins in West Antarctica and place the Cenozoic rift onset at ~44–45 Ma, matching the oldest mid-Eocene rift magmatism. The models show no Paleocene intra-Antarctic divergence and yield a smooth, uneventful Pacific–Antarctic motion path across 47 Ma, implying the Hawaii–Emperor bend primarily reflects Hawaii hotspot migration relative to the mantle.
本研究利用SWOT卫星任务的高分辨率（约4 km半波长）重力垂直梯度（VGG）数据，重新拾取了塔斯曼海、麦夸里盆地、东南印度洋中脊和太平洋-南极洋中脊的断裂带、深海丘陵及磁异常等时线。通过麦夸里板块回路求和建立的高时间分辨率运动学模型，重现了西南极冰下伸展裂谷盆地的分布，并将新生代裂谷开启时间限定在……

t: Finite Euler rotations are estimated by matching conjugate magnetic isochrons and abyssal hills and fitting small circles to fracture zone flowlines picked from SWOT-VGG data, then combined via Macquarie circuit summations.
利用SWOT-VGG数据拾取共轭等时线、深海丘陵及断裂带小圆，反演欧拉旋转并进行麦夸里回路求和。

SWOT satellite radar altimeter vertical gravity gradient (VGG) imagery (~4 km half-wavelength resolution) combined with marine magnetic anomaly picks across the Tasman Sea, Macquarie Basin, Southeast Indian Ridge, and Pacific-Antarctic Ridge.
南大洋约4 km半波长分辨率的SWOT卫星重力垂直梯度数据及海洋磁异常倒转等时线拾取数据。

The models bracket the onset of Cenozoic West Antarctic Rift System divergence to ~44–45 Ma (between 47 and 42 Ma at 95% confidence), showing stable Pacific–West Antarctic plate velocity across the 47 Ma Hawaii–Emperor bend.

The Chron C8o (26 Ma) rotation pole is likely unreliable due to NNW-oriented intraplate strain and fracture zone reactivation within the diffuse Macquarie–Australia plate boundary zone.

Resolves the artificial West Antarctic collision predicted by earlier inversions, rejects Paleocene intra-Antarctic divergence, and demonstrates that Pacific–Antarctic motion was smooth during the 47 Ma Hawaii–Emperor bend.
消除了前人模型在西南极预测的虚假碰撞，排除了古新世扩张对夏威夷海山转折的贡献。

Interpretations of transpression/transtension in the easternmost West Antarctic Rift System (De Gerlache Gravity Anomaly and George VI Sound) remain uncertain due to sparse subglacial geophysical and structural data.

sum: This study analyzes the 16 July 2025 Mw 7.3 earthquake in the Shumagin segment of the Alaska Peninsula. Using AI-enhanced seismic detection and relocation, the authors construct an E-W trending, south-dipping curved fault model. Joint inversion of teleseismic waveforms and GNSS data reveals a predominantly sinistral strike-slip mechanism with rupture confined beneath the subduction interface. Together with the 2020 Mw 7.6 event, it forms a conjugate fault system. The study demonstrates that both events are driven by stress perturbations from along-strike and along-dip variations in megathrust coupling, combined with slab pull and plate bending.
本研究分析了2025年7月16日阿拉斯加半岛舒马金段发生的Mw 7.3地震。利用人工智能增强的地震检测与重定位技术，构建了东西走向、向南倾斜的弯曲发震断层模型。远震波形与GNSS数据的联合反演表明，该地震以左旋走滑机制为主，破裂主要局限在俯冲界面下方，属于板内地震。它与2020年Mw 7.6地震构成……

t: AI-enhanced seismic detection and relocation combined with joint inversion of teleseismic waveforms and GNSS data to resolve fault geometry and slip distribution.
结合人工智能增强的地震检测与重定位，以及远震波形和GNSS数据的联合反演。
Teleseismic waveforms and Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) data recorded during the 16 July 2025 Mw 7.3 Shumagin Islands earthquake sequence.
2025年7月16日阿拉斯加舒马金群岛Mw 7.3地震序列的远震波形与GNSS观测数据。
The Mw 7.3 event is a sinistral intraplate strike-slip rupture beneath the subduction interface, forming a conjugate system with the 2020 Mw 7.6 dextral event.
确定该地震为板内左旋走滑事件，并与2020年Mw 7.6地震构成了共轭断层系统。
The study is limited to the Shumagin segment, requiring further validation of the coupling-stress model in other regions like the Semidi segment.
研究结论主要基于舒马金段，其耦合-应力扰动模型在其他区域（如塞米迪段）仍需验证。
Demonstrating that conjugate intraplate strike-slip earthquakes are mechanically driven by stress perturbations from heterogeneous megathrust coupling combined with slab bending.
揭示了俯冲带非均匀耦合产生的应力扰动与板片弯曲共同触发板内共轭走滑地震的机制。

kc: Constructed a detailed east-west trending, south-dipping curved seismogenic fault model for the 2025 Mw 7.3 Shumagin earthquake.
Determined a predominantly sinistral strike-slip mechanism beneath the subduction interface using joint inversion of teleseismic and GNSS data.
Identified a conjugate fault system formed by the 2025 sinistral and the 2020 Mw 7.6 dextral strike-slip earthquakes.
Demonstrated that heterogeneous coupling along the subduction interface plays a critical role in generating intraplate strike-slip events.
构建了2025年舒马金Mw 7.3地震东西走向、向南倾斜的弯曲发震断层模型。
利用远震和GNSS数据联合反演，确定了俯冲界面下方以左旋走滑为主的破裂机制。
识别出2025年左旋走滑地震与2020年Mw 7.6右旋走滑地震构成了共轭断层系统。
论证了俯冲界面上的非均匀耦合在诱发板内走滑地震中起到的关键作用。
me: Artificial intelligence-enhanced seismic phase detection and earthquake relocation.
Joint inversion of teleseismic body waveforms and Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) data.
Stress perturbation modeling incorporating megathrust coupling heterogeneity, slab pull, and plate bending.
人工智能增强的地震震相检测与地震重定位技术。
远震体波波形与全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）数据的联合反演。
结合俯冲带耦合非均匀性、板片拉力和板片弯曲的应力扰动模拟。

Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) displacement data for constraining the coseismic slip distribution.
用于地震检测、重定位和滑动分布反演的区域及远震台网地震波形数据。
用于约束同震滑动分布的全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）位移数据。

Resolution of the slip distribution is constrained by the spatial coverage of available teleseismic and GNSS stations.

tm.why: The paper investigates the seismogenic fault orientation, rupture mechanism, and stress perturbations of the 2025 Mw 7.3 Shumagin Islands earthquake.
The study utilizes artificial intelligence-enhanced detection and relocation of the seismic sequence to construct the seismogenic fault model.
It analyzes the mechanical origin of the earthquake in relation to the heterogeneous coupling distribution on the Alaska subduction interface.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract and metadata from SRL, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar.

sum: Subsurface interpretations of Owens Valley, California, have largely relied on non-unique gravity data to infer the North Bishop Block (NBB), a ~100 km² block slumped from the White Mountains. Here, the authors use a 100-km fiber-optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) array near Bishop, CA, to image the NBB at high spatial resolution. They extract local Rayleigh-wave phase velocity dispersion curves via slant-stacking of one week of ambient noise cross-correlations and combine them with P-Ps delay times and P/Ps amplitude ratios from local earthquakes. Using a two-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) inference-mode joint inversion, they constrain a 1D layered shear-wave velocity structure along the cable. The results confirm the NBB top interface at 730 ± 270 m depth and reveal a previously unmapped deeper extension (1240 ± 340 m) to the south, demonstrating how DAS converted phases can resolve sharp subsurface boundaries without conventional three-component sensors.
本研究利用加州欧文斯谷毕晓普附近的分布式光纤声学传感（DAS）阵列，对推测由怀特山滑塌形成的北毕晓普块体（NBB）进行高分辨率成像。作者对一周连续背景噪声进行互相关与倾斜叠加提取瑞利波相速度频散曲线，并结合地方震P波与Ps转换波的到时差及相对振幅比，采用两步马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法联合反演……

t: A two-step MCMC Bayesian framework jointly inverts Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves (from ambient-noise slant stacking), P-Ps travel-time delays, and along-fiber P/Ps amplitude ratios for 1D layered shear-wave velocity profiles along the fiber.
采用两步MCMC框架，联合反演背景噪声瑞利波频散曲线、地方震P-Ps延迟时间及沿光纤振幅比。

Data come from the final 20–30 km of a 100 km DAS array in Owens Valley (10 m spacing, 100 m gauge length), combining one week of continuous ambient noise (channels 5999–9147) and local earthquake waveforms.
使用欧文斯谷100公里DAS阵列末段20–30公里の一周连续背景噪声（通道5999–9147）和地方震波形。
The North Bishop Block has an S-wave velocity of 2390 ± 40 m/s, with its top surface at 730 ± 270 m depth in its mapped region, deepening southward to 1240 ± 340 m over an unmapped section.
北毕晓普块体横波速度为2390±40 m/s，顶部深度730±270米，并向南加深至1240±340米的未测绘区。

Block thickness is poorly constrained by dispersion curves, and the simple STA/LTA picker and horizontally layered assumption ignore backazimuth variations from dipping structures and fail for below-noise arrivals.
频散对块体厚度约束弱；简单STA/LTA拾取和水平层假设忽略了倾斜界面反方位角效应与低信噪比震相。

Jointly inverts ambient-noise dispersion and standalone DAS earthquake P-to-Ps delay times and relative amplitudes—without co-located conventional seismometers—to image a sharp subsurface block and discover its deeper southern extension.
无需传统地震仪协同，首次将光纤背景噪声与Ps转换波到时和振幅比联合反演，揭示滑塌块体南延结构。

kc: Demonstrates joint Bayesian (MCMC) inversion of ambient noise Rayleigh wave dispersion curves, P-Ps delay times, and P/Ps relative amplitudes on a standalone DAS array.
Confirms the depth of the slumped North Bishop Block (730 ± 270 m) and discovers an unmapped deeper southern extension at 1240 ± 340 m depth.
Shows that P-to-Ps relative amplitude ratios projected onto fiber direction tightly constrain the internal velocity (Vs = 2390 ± 40 m/s) of the converting layer.
展示了在独立DAS阵列上联合瑞利波频散曲线、P-Ps走时差及相对振幅比进行贝叶斯（MCMC）反演的方法。
证实了北毕晓普滑塌块体的深度（730±270米），并发现其向南延伸的未测绘深部界面（1240±340米）。
证明了投影到光纤方向的P与Ps相对振幅比能够紧密约束转换层内部的波速（Vs = 2390±40 m/s）。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation (0.05–10 Hz) and local slant-stack beamforming to extract Rayleigh wave phase velocity dispersion curves.
Earthquake P-arrival picking with PhaseNet-DAS and Ps converted phase picking via spatially averaged (500 m) STA/LTA (1–8 Hz).
Forward modeling of dispersion curves (surf96), 1D plane-wave P-Ps delay times, and transmission-coefficient particle motions projected along the fiber.
Two-step Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) inversion using emcee, where a sparse (500 m step) global posterior acts as the prior for a dense (80 m step) inversion.
利用背景噪声互相关（0.05–10 Hz）及局部倾斜叠加波束形成提取瑞利波相速度频散曲线。
使用PhaseNet-DAS拾取地震P波初至，并通过500米空间平均的STA/LTA（1–8 Hz）拾取Ps转换波。
使用surf96正演频散曲线，并基于一维平面波近似和透射系数沿光纤方向投影正演P-Ps延迟时间与相对振幅比。
基于emcee的两步MCMC反演：先以500米步长稀疏反演构建全局速度先验分布，再以80米步长进行密集一维反演。
de: Final 20–30 km section (channels 5999 to 9147) of a 100 km dark fiber array from Mammoth Lakes to Bishop, CA (10 m spacing, 100 m gauge length, 100 Hz sampling).
One week of continuous ambient noise starting May 1, 2022, decimated to 25 Hz and cross-correlated at two-channel intervals.
Local earthquake waveforms recorded across the fiber exhibiting high-amplitude coherent Ps arrivals within ~0.5–0.8 s after direct P.
加州猛犸湖至毕晓普100公里暗光纤阵列末段20–30公里（通道5999至9147，道间距10米，标距100米，采样率100 Hz）。
2022年5月1日起连续一周的背景噪声数据，降采样至25 Hz并以两通道间隔进行互相关。
光纤记录的地方震波形，在直达P波后约0.5–0.8秒内呈现出高振幅的相干Ps转换震相。
li: Block thickness is poorly constrained by dispersion data alone (likelihood is flat for thicknesses ≤ 200 m) and had to be fixed at 200 m.
The 1D horizontal plane-wave assumption and simple STA/LTA picking cannot easily handle dipping interfaces, backazimuth variations, or low-SNR converted phases.
Intermediate valley-fill layers (layers 2 and 3) have large velocity and thickness uncertainties, and sharp jumps between fill layers are parameterization artifacts.
仅靠频散数据难以约束滑塌块体厚度（≤200米时似然度几乎相同），反演中只能固定为200米。
一维水平层状平面波假设和简单的STA/LTA拾取难以处理倾斜界面、反方位角变化或低信噪比转换波。
中间盆地沉积层（第2、3层）的速度和厚度不确定性较大，且沉积层间的速度突变属于参数化人为假象。

tm.why: The study uses a 100 km fiber-optic array (DAS) in Owens Valley to observe Ps converted phases and ambient noise for subsurface imaging.
The authors cross-correlate one week of continuous ambient noise recorded on the fiber to extract Rayleigh wave phase velocity dispersion curves.
The study images a sharp subsurface bedrock discontinuity (the North Bishop Block) using P-to-Ps delay times and relative amplitude ratios from local earthquakes.

sum: This study investigates the coseismic surface rupture zone widths (RZWs) of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo strike-slip earthquake in the Tibetan Plateau using high-resolution drone orthoimages. By measuring RZWs at 100 m intervals along the ~148 km rupture, the authors show that while local RZWs are influenced by fault geometry and soil conditions, macroscopic RZW distributions reflect dynamic rupture processes. West of the epicenter, RZWs increase with propagation distance due to growing off-fault energy dissipation. East of the epicenter, a distinct narrowing of the RZW indicates a supershear transition triggered by an extensional fault bend. The study highlights the potential of surface rupture widths to record earthquake dynamic rupture history.
本研究利用高分辨率无人机正射影像，对青藏高原2021年Mw 7.4玛多走滑地震约148公里地表破裂带进行了100米间隔的破裂带宽度（RZW）测量。结果表明，尽管局部破裂带宽度受断层几何复杂性和覆土条件影响，但宏观破裂带宽度分布反映了地震动力学破裂过程。震中以西，破裂带宽度随传播距离增加而变宽，与非断……

t: High-resolution drone photogrammetry and systematic measurement of surface rupture zone widths at 100 m intervals along the ~148 km strike-slip fault trace.
利用高分辨率无人机摄影测量，沿约148公里的走滑断层走向以100米间隔系统测量地表破裂带宽度。
High-resolution (4-8 cm per pixel) drone orthoimages covering the ~148 km surface rupture of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake in the Tibetan Plateau.
覆盖青藏高原2021年Mw 7.4玛多地震约148公里地表破裂带的高分辨率（4-8厘米/像素）无人机正射影像。
RZW increases with propagation distance in Segments 1-2, narrows significantly in Segment 3 due to a supershear transition, and widens in Segment 4 due to fault roughness and rupture termination.
破裂带宽度在第1-2段随传播距离增加，在第3段因超剪切转变显著变窄，在第4段因断层粗糙度增加而变宽。
Local surface RZWs are influenced by superficial soil conditions (thickness and fracture toughness) and local fault geometric complexities.
局部地表破裂带宽度易受表层土壤条件（厚度与断裂韧性）及局部断层几何复杂性的干扰。
Demonstrating that macroscopic coseismic surface rupture zone width distributions systematically record earthquake dynamic rupture history, including supershear transitions.
首次系统证明了宏观同震地表破裂带宽度分布能够有效记录地震动力学破裂过程及超剪切转变。

kc: Measured coseismic surface rupture zone widths (RZWs) at high resolution (100 m intervals) along the entire ~148 km rupture of the 2021 Maduo earthquake.
Demonstrated that macroscopic RZW distributions can be used to reconstruct earthquake dynamic rupture processes.
Identified a distinct narrowing of the RZW associated with a supershear rupture transition triggered by an extensional fault bend.
沿2021年玛多地震约148公里的完整破裂带，以100米间隔高精度测量了同震地表破裂带宽度（RZW）。
证明了宏观破裂带宽度分布可用于重建地震动力学破裂过程。
识别出由拉张断层弯曲触发的超剪切破裂转变所导致的破裂带宽度显著变窄特征。
me: High-resolution drone photogrammetry (4-8 cm per pixel orthoimages) for mapping surface ruptures.
Systematic measurement of surface rupture zone widths (RZWs) at 100 m intervals along the fault trace.
利用高分辨率无人机摄影测量（每像素4-8厘米的正射影像）进行地表破裂制图。
沿断层走向以100米为间隔系统测量地表破裂带宽度（RZW）。
de: High-resolution drone orthoimages covering Segments 1-4 (~148 km) of the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo earthquake rupture zone.
覆盖2021年Mw 7.4玛多地震破裂带第1至第4段（约148公里）的高分辨率无人机正射影像数据。
li: Local surface RZWs are highly sensitive to superficial soil conditions (thickness, fracture toughness) and local geometric complexities, which can obscure macroscopic dynamic signals.
局部地表破裂带宽度对表层土壤条件（厚度、断裂韧性）和局部几何复杂性高度敏感，这可能会掩盖宏观动力学信号。

tm.why: The paper investigates coseismic surface rupture zone widths to gain insights into earthquake dynamic rupture processes, including supershear transitions.
It analyzes how fault geometric complexities, stepovers, and bends influence surface rupture zone widths and off-fault damage.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study develops a three-dimensional, two-degree-of-freedom (2DOF) analytical model for the bounded rocking response of a free-standing rigid square column under bidirectional seismic excitation. Extending Housner's planar formulation, the column is kinematically constrained to rock without twisting or stepping out of its original footprint, representing a rocking bridge pier. Energy dissipation is modeled exclusively via instantaneous inelastic impacts across three transition mechanisms (consecutive corners along an edge, diagonally opposite corners, and opposite edges) using conservation of angular momentum. Numerical simulations reveal strong coupling and energy transfer between orthogonal rotations during impacts. A statistical comparison using 176 near-fault, pulse-like ground motions from the NGA-West2 database demonstrates that square columns consistently achieve higher overturning stability and lower peak rotations than equivalent-volume circular columns, owing to enhanced impact-induced damping.
本研究提出了双向地震激励下自立式刚性方柱有界摇摆响应的三维两自由度（2DOF）解析模型。该模型扩展了Housner平面理论，限制方柱仅在初始底面内摇摆且不发生扭转，适用于摇摆桥墩建模。能量耗散仅通过角动量守恒建立的三种瞬时非弹性碰撞机制（同边相邻角点、对角点及对边切换）引入。数值模拟揭示了正交旋转间……

t: Derives 3D 2DOF Lagrangian equations of motion using Tait-Bryan angles for a rigid square column under bounded rocking, paired with angular momentum conservation across three instantaneous corner/edge impact mechanisms.
利用欧拉角和拉格朗日方程推导有界摇摆刚性方柱的三维2DOF运动方程，并基于角动量守恒建立三种碰撞耗能机制。
Uses 176 two-dimensional near-fault, pulse-like ground motion records with pulse period Tp < 6 s from the NGA-West2 database, applied at randomized incident angles.
选用NGA-West2数据库中176条脉冲周期Tp<6s的双分量近断层脉冲型地震动，并以随机入射角加载。

Square columns consistently require higher normalized overturning accelerations than equal-volume circular columns across 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles, and exhibit a 21% lower peak rotation under the Northridge record.
方柱在25%、50%和75%分位数下的归一化倾覆加速度均高于等体积圆柱，在Northridge记录下峰值转角低21%。
The comparative circular column model neglects damping, and mechanical constraints preventing twist and step-out in the square column ignore friction and contact forces.
用于对比的圆柱模型忽略了阻尼，且方柱防扭转与防移位的机械约束仅作运动学处理，忽略了附加摩擦耗能。

Formulates the first 3D bounded-rocking analytical model of a square column constrained to its initial footprint without twisting, extending Housner's planar theory and impact damping to 3D bridge columns.
首次建立限制在初始底面内且无扭转的方柱三维有界摇摆解析模型，将Housner平面理论与碰撞阻尼推广至三维桥墩。

kc: Derived the full 3D Lagrangian equations of motion for a 2DOF bounded-rocking rigid square column constrained to its original footprint.
Formulated analytical post-impact velocity relations for three distinct 3D pivot transition mechanisms using angular momentum conservation.
Demonstrated via 176 pulse-like ground motions that square columns have superior overturning resistance compared to circular columns of equal volume.
推导了限制在初始底面内的两自由度有界摇摆刚性方柱的完整三维拉格朗日运动方程。
基于角动量守恒，建立了三种三维支点切换碰撞机制的碰后角速度解析关系。
通过176条脉冲型地震动统计分析，证明等体积方柱比圆柱具有更优异的抗倾覆稳定性。
me: Lagrangian mechanics using 1-2-3 Tait-Bryan Euler angles with zero twist to derive 3D coupled equations of motion.
Conservation of angular momentum about the new pivot point/edge to model instantaneous inelastic impact damping.
Event-driven numerical integration switching between rest, 2D edge rocking, and 3D corner rocking modes.
Statistical rocking spectra and percentile overturning acceleration analysis across randomized ground motion incidence angles.
采用无扭转的1-2-3 Tait-Bryan欧拉角和拉格朗日力学推导三维耦合运动方程。
利用关于新支点/边的角动量守恒建立瞬时非弹性碰撞阻尼模型。
采用事件驱动数值积分在静止、二维边摇摆和三维角点摇摆模式间切换。
结合随机地震动入射角进行摇摆谱及分位数倾覆加速度谱统计分析。
de: Free vibration numerical experiments testing off-diagonal and symmetric diagonal initial displacements.
Deterministic bidirectional time-history analyses using the 1989 Loma Prieta, 1995 Kobe, and 1994 Northridge records.
Parametric statistical study using 176 near-fault pulse-like ground motions (Tp < 6 s) from the NGA-West2 database.
测试非对角线和对称对角线初始位移的自由振动数值实验。
使用1989年Loma Prieta、1995年Kobe和1994年Northridge地震记录的确定性双向时程分析。
基于NGA-West2数据库176条近断层脉冲型地震动（Tp < 6 s）的参数化统计研究。
li: Mechanical constraints preventing stepping-out and twisting are treated purely kinematically, ignoring contact friction and additional energy dissipation.
The column and base are assumed perfectly rigid with no sliding or uplift flight phases.
The benchmark circular column model used for comparison is undamped, though prior studies suggest damping minimally affects its peak response.
防止走出底面和扭转的机械约束被纯运动学处理，忽略了接触摩擦和额外耗能。
假设柱体和基础完全刚性，且不发生滑动或腾空阶段。
用于对比的基准圆柱模型未包含阻尼（尽管已有研究表明阻尼对其峰值响应影响较小）。

tm.why: The paper develops an analytical structural dynamics model to evaluate the seismic overturning stability and response of rocking bridge columns subjected to 176 near-fault, pulse-like strong ground motion records.

sum: This study investigates the rupture segmentation and bounding mechanisms of the 8 December 2025 Mw 7.6 Aomori megathrust earthquake in the northern Japan Trench. Using dense GEONET GNSS coseismic and 1-month postseismic displacements, the authors perform 3D finite-element inversions incorporating realistic slab curvature, topography, and 3D elastic structure. The preferred curved-fault solution reveals a compact (~50 × 50 km) thrust rupture at 25–50 km depth (domain-C) with ~2.5 m peak slip near 35 km depth. The slip patch lies beneath the offshore Hidaka Basin and terminates northward at a sharp change in slab dip azimuth. It reactivated the deep asperity of the 1968 Mw 8.3 Tokachi-oki earthquake while sparing the shallower 1994 patch near the mantle-wedge corner. Flanked by microseismicity and slow earthquakes, and overlapping with early afterslip and aftershocks, the rupture demonstrates how structural and rheological factors jointly bound fast slip and mediate fast-to-slow slip transitions.
本文利用日本GEONET密集GNSS同震及震后1个月位移数据，结合三维有限元模型反演了2025年12月8日青森Mw 7.6级俯冲带大地震的同震滑动与余滑分布。结果表明，破裂集中于25–50 km深度的紧凑区域（约50×50 km），最大滑动量约2.5 m（约35 km深处）。该破裂位于日高海盆下方，……

t: The authors use the 3D finite-element code PyLith incorporating curved slab geometry, topography, and 3D elastic structure to invert horizontal GEONET GNSS displacements with Laplacian smoothing and rake constraints.
基于PyLith构建含地形、三维弹性结构和弯曲断层的有限元模型，结合拉普拉斯平滑反演GNSS水平位移。

Coseismic and 1-month postseismic displacement offsets derived from 30-s continuous coordinate time series at onshore GEONET GNSS stations, processed with GipsyX v2.3, supplemented by relocated foreshock and aftershock catalogs.
GEONET台网30秒采样GNSS时间序列提取的同震及震后1个月位移，以及主震前后重定位地震目录。
The preferred curved-fault inversion resolves a compact (~50 × 50 km) thrust slip patch at 25–50 km depth with ~2.5 m peak slip at ~35 km depth, achieving <2 mm horizontal RMS misfit.
反演获得25–50 km深度处约50×50 km的紧凑逆冲滑动区，35 km深处峰值滑动约2.5 m，拟合残差<2 mm…

Land-based GNSS stations have reduced sensitivity to shallow offshore slip (<20–25 km depth), requiring time-dependent and offshore seafloor geodetic constraints to validate shallow secondary features.
陆基GNSS对浅部近海（<25 km）分辨率有限，需结合海底大地测量验证浅部滑动特征。

First precise 3D geodetic source characterization of the 2025 Mw 7.6 Aomori domain-C earthquake, demonstrating joint structural-rheological bounding and co-located coseismic slip, afterslip, and aftershocks beneath a cold mantle wedge.
首次精细解析2025年青森C域大地震，揭示构造与流变双重边界及深部同震-余滑-余震空间重叠。

kc: Imaged a compact (~50 × 50 km) coseismic slip patch at 25–50 km depth with peak slip of ~2.5 m for the 2025 Mw 7.6 Aomori earthquake using 3D finite-element GNSS inversions.
Demonstrated selective reactivation of the deep 1968 Tokachi-oki asperity beneath the continental Moho (domain-C), decoupled from the shallower 1994 patch near the mantle-wedge corner.

Identified joint structural and rheological controls bounding rupture extent: the offshore Hidaka Basin, along-strike slab bending, updip mantle-wedge corner, and flanking slow-slip/microseismicity zones.
Revealed substantial spatial overlap among coseismic slip, 1-month afterslip, and linear streaks of early aftershocks within the main rupture zone.
利用三维有限元GNSS反演，揭示2025年青森Mw 7.6地震在25–50 km深度呈约50×50 km的紧凑同震滑动分布，峰值滑动约2.5 m。
证实该事件选择性重激活了大陆莫霍面下方1968年十胜冲地震的深部凹凸体（C域），而在地幔楔角附近停止，未触发1994年浅部凹凸体。
明确了控制破裂范围的构造与流变双重因素：近海日高盆地、沿走向板片弯曲、上倾地幔楔角以及周缘慢滑移和微震活跃带。
发现同震主滑动区与震后1个月余滑及早期条带状余震存在显著的空间重叠。
me: Processed 30-s kinematic GNSS time series from GEONET using GipsyX v2.3 with sidereal multipath reduction and common-mode error removal.
Constructed 3D heterogeneous finite-element models in PyLith v2.2.2 incorporating ETOPO 2022 relief, 3D elastic structure, and both curved and seismicity-derived planar megathrust geometries.

Inverted horizontal GNSS coseismic and 1-month postseismic offsets using Laplacian smoothing, L-curve regularization, and rake constraints (60°–120°), validated via vertical offsets and checkerboard tests.
Relocated foreshocks and early aftershocks within a 6-day window around the mainshock to evaluate fault geometry and postseismic deformation patterns.
使用GipsyX v2.3处理GEONET的30秒高频GNSS时间序列，消除多路径周期信号与共模误差以提取同震和震后位移。
在PyLith v2.2.2中建立包含ETOPO 2022地形、三维弹性结构以及曲面和平面断层几何的三维非均匀有限元模型。
采用拉普拉斯平滑、L曲线准则和滑动角约束（60°–120°）反演水平GNSS位移，并通过垂直位移和检测板测试进行验证。
对主震前后6天内的地震序列进行重定位，以约束断层平面几何并对比余震与余滑空间关系。
de: 30-s continuous GNSS coordinate time series from Japan's GEONET network spanning pre-event (~4 days 14 hr), post-event (~9 hr 45 min), and 1-month postseismic windows.
3D plate interface geometry model (Iwasaki et al., 2015) and ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second global relief data.
Seismic waveform data from NIED MOWLAS and S-net seafloor observatories for earthquake relocation, alongside compiled catalogs of background seismicity, repeating earthquakes, and tectonic tremor.
日本GEONET网络30秒连续GNSS坐标时间序列（涵盖震前约4天14小时、震后约9小时45分钟及震后1个月窗口）。
日本俯冲带三维板片界面几何模型（Iwasaki et al., 2015）与ETOPO 2022 15角秒地形水深数据。
用于地震重定位的NIED MOWLAS及S-net海底观测网地震数据，以及背景地震、重复地震和构造颤动目录。
li: Onshore GNSS stations have degraded resolution in the shallow offshore region (<25 km depth), creating ambiguity regarding shallow updip slip and complementary shallow afterslip.
Vertical GNSS observations exhibit lower signal-to-noise ratios and larger uncertainties, precluding their inclusion in the preferred inversion.
Static geodetic inversions cannot resolve coherent short-period seismic radiation or early sub-hour afterslip without teleseismic back-projection or seafloor geodetic data.
陆基GNSS对浅部近海区域（<25 km深度）分辨率显著下降，导致浅部上倾滑动及浅部余滑约束存在不确定性。
垂直向GNSS观测信噪比较低且不确定性较大，无法直接纳入首选反演模型。
静态大地测量反演无法分辨高频地震辐射特征及震后数小时内的极早期余滑，需结合远震反投影或海底大地测量。

tm.why: The paper inverts coseismic GNSS displacements to image the slip distribution and rupture segmentation mechanisms of the 2025 Mw 7.6 Aomori megathrust earthquake.
The study analyzes how rheological transitions, repeating earthquakes, tectonic tremor, and co-located afterslip bound the fast rupture and control fast-to-slow slip transitions.
It links megathrust rupture limits directly to upper-plate forearc basin architecture, local slab bending, the continental Moho, and the cold mantle wedge corner.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§4), all 3 main figures, and references.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution (0.02° x 0.02°) probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the Palghar district in Maharashtra, India, which has experienced frequent earthquake swarms since November 2018. The analysis accounts for the non-uniform spatial distribution of earthquake probability within seismic source zones and utilizes a data-driven approach to select and weight Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs). The resulting hazard maps for Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) and Pseudo Spectral Acceleration (PSA) at 0.2 s and 1.0 s (for 10% and 2% probability of exceedance in 50 years) show significant spatial variations and improvements over previous regional models, providing critical inputs for earthquake-resistant design.
本研究针对印度马哈拉施特拉邦帕尔哈尔地区自2018年11月以来频繁发生的地震活动，开展了0.02°高分辨率概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）。该研究考虑了地震源区内地震发生概率的空间非均匀分布，并采用数据驱动方法筛选和加权地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）。计算得到了50年超越概率10%和2%条件下的峰值加……

t: Probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) incorporating spatially non-uniform seismicity and data-driven selection of Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).
结合空间非均匀地震活动性与数据驱动地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）筛选的概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）。
Regional earthquake catalog data for the Palghar district, Maharashtra, India, focusing on the swarm activity since November 2018.
印度马哈拉施特拉邦帕尔哈尔地区的区域地震目录数据，重点关注2018年11月以来的群震活动。
High-resolution hazard maps of PGA and PSA (0.2 s, 1.0 s) for 10% and 2% PoE in 50 years, finding a PGA of 0.15 g for DBE at the local atomic power plant.
获得了50年超越概率10%和2%的高分辨率PGA和PSA图，确定当地核电站在DBE条件下的PGA为0.15 g。
The study's reliance on historical and recent swarm catalog completeness to characterize long-term non-uniform seismicity rates.
研究依赖于历史和近期群震目录的完整性来表征长期的非均匀地震活动率。
First high-resolution (0.02° grid) PSHA for Palghar incorporating both spatially non-uniform source probabilities and data-driven GMPE selection.
首次在帕尔哈尔地区开展结合空间非均匀震源概率和数据驱动GMPE筛选的0.02°高分辨率PSHA。

kc: Developed a high-resolution (0.02° x 0.02°) probabilistic seismic hazard map for the seismically active Palghar district in India.
Incorporated spatially non-uniform earthquake probability distributions within defined seismic source zones.
Implemented a data-driven selection and weighting scheme for Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).
为印度地震活跃的帕尔哈尔地区编制了0.02°高分辨率概率地震危险性图。
在定义的地震源区内引入了空间非均匀的地震概率分布。
实现了数据驱动的地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）筛选与加权方案。
me: Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment (PSHA) formulation.
Spatially non-uniform seismicity modeling (smooth gridded seismicity approach).
Data-driven selection and log-likelihood testing of Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).
概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）框架。
空间非均匀地震活动性建模（平滑网格化地震活动性方法）。
地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）的数据驱动筛选与对数似然检验。
de: Historical and instrumental earthquake catalog data for the Palghar region and surrounding areas since November 2018.
Ground motion prediction equations (GMPEs) applicable to the Indian shield region.
2018年11月以来帕尔哈尔及周边地区的历史与仪器记录地震目录数据。
适用于印度地盾区域的地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）。
li: The assessment is highly dependent on the completeness and accuracy of the local earthquake catalog, which has seen a sudden surge in swarm activity since 2018.
该评估高度依赖于当地地震目录的完整性和准确性，而该地区自2018年以来群震活动突然激增。

tm.why: The paper presents a probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the Palghar district, mapping PGA and PSA values.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Semantic Scholar, Crossref, and Google search results.

sum: This study calibrates the four-parameter seismic design response spectrum for China using 452 near-fault strong ground motion records (Mw 6.7–9.1) with Chinese seismic intensities of 7 to 10+. To improve parameter fitting efficiency and stability over standard methods, a Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm with a novel hybrid mutation operator and self-adaptive control parameters is applied, minimizing the root-mean-square error. The calibrated parameters—characteristic period (Tg), platform value (βmax), and attenuation index (γ)—are evaluated across site classes (Vs30) and compared with the Chinese Code for Seismic Design of Buildings (CSDB2010) and GMPEs (ASK14, Zhao2016). Results demonstrate that average Tg for rock and hard soil sites (Class I and II) is larger than CSDB2010 values and increases significantly with intensity (from 0.56 s at intensity 7 to 0.81 s at intensity 10+). Furthermore, average γ values (1.22–1.43) consistently exceed the CSDB2010 value of 0.9.
本研究选取6次大震（Mw 6.7–9.1）的452条中国地震烈度7度及以上的近断层强震动记录，采用引入新型混合变异算子和自适应控制参数的差分进化算法（DE），以均方根误差最小化标定中国抗震设计反应谱的四项特征参数。通过分析参数随场地剪切波速（Vs30）和烈度的变化并与《建筑抗震设计规范》（CSDB2……

t: Calibrates the four parameters (T0, βmax, Tg, γ) of the normalized seismic design response spectrum by minimizing the root-mean-square error using a Differential Evolution algorithm with a hybrid mutation operator and self-adaptive control parameters F and CR.
采用含混合变异算子与自适应F、CR参数的差分进化算法，以RMSE最小化标定四参数设计反应谱。

452 three-component near-fault strong-motion records (rupture distance < 150 km, Chinese seismic intensity ≥ VII, Mw 6.7–9.1) from six major earthquakes sourced from PEER, KiK-net, K-net, and IEM networks.
选用PEER、KiK-net、K-net和IEM台网6次大震（Mw 6.7–9.1）共452条近场高烈度记录。

Mean Tg increases from 0.56 s (intensity 7) and 0.57 s (intensity 8) to 0.71 s (intensity 9) and 0.81 s (intensity 10+), exceeding CSDB2010 values for Class I/II sites; mean γ (1.22–1.43) also exceeds the code value of 0.9.
平均Tg由7度0.56s增至10+度0.81s，I、II类场地Tg及各烈度平均γ（1.22–1.43）均大于规范值。
Only includes records from earthquakes with Mw > 6.5; applying these calibrated Tg values to small-magnitude near-field earthquakes may overestimate the actual characteristic period.
仅包含Mw>6.5地震记录，直接用于小震近场设计可能会高估实际特征周期Tg。

Combines a hybrid-mutation self-adaptive Differential Evolution algorithm with high-intensity (≥ VII) near-fault strong-motion data to quantify how Chinese design spectrum parameters vary with seismic intensity and Vs30.
结合自适应混合变异差分进化算法与7度以上强震记录，揭示设计谱参数随烈度与Vs30的变化规律。

kc: Applied a Differential Evolution algorithm with a hybrid mutation operator and self-adaptive parameters to calibrate 4-parameter seismic design response spectra, achieving faster convergence and lower RMSE than standard DE.

Demonstrated that the site characteristic period (Tg) increases with Chinese seismic intensity (mean Tg rises from 0.56 s at intensity 7 to 0.81 s at intensity 10+) and exceeds CSDB2010 specifications for Class I and II sites.
Showed that the calibrated attenuation index (γ) across intensities 7 to 10+ (mean 1.22–1.43) is consistently higher than the 0.9 value in CSDB2010, with greater dispersion at higher intensities.
Compared calibrated spectra against ASK14 and Zhao2016 GMPEs, showing closer alignment with recorded long-period spectral trends for Mw > 6.5 events.
应用带混合变异算子和自适应控制参数的差分进化算法标定四参数抗震设计反应谱，相比标准DE算法收敛更快且均方根误差更低。
证明场地特征周期（Tg）随中国地震烈度增加而增大（均值从7度的0.56s增至10+度的0.81s），且在I类和II类场地上高于CSDB2010规范值。
揭示7至10+度标定谱的衰减指数（γ）均值（1.22–1.43）始终高于CSDB2010规范值0.9，且高烈度下离散性更大。
将标定反应谱与ASK14和Zhao2016地震动预测方程（GMPE）进行对比，表明标定谱能更好拟合Mw > 6.5事件记录谱的趋势。
me: Instrumental Chinese seismic intensity (Ichina) calculation from three-component synthesized PGA and PGV following GB/T 17742-2020.
Four-parameter standardized amplification factor design spectrum model parameterized by T0, βmax, Tg, and γ.
Differential Evolution (DE) optimization with a novel hybrid mutation operator and self-adaptive scaling factor (F) and crossover rate (CR) minimizing RMSE between recorded and calibrated spectra.
基于GB/T 17742-2020标准，利用三分量合成PGA和PGV计算中国仪器地震烈度（Ichina）。
采用包含第一拐角周期T0、平台值βmax、特征周期Tg和衰减指数γ的四参数标准放大系数设计谱模型。
利用具有新型混合变异算子及自适应缩放因子（F）和交叉率（CR）的差分进化（DE）算法，以记录谱与标定谱的均方根误差（RMSE）为目标函数进行全局寻优。
de: 452 three-component near-field strong-motion records (rupture distance < 150 km, SNR > 3, known Vs30) from 6 major earthquakes: 1994 Northridge (Mw 6.7), 1995 Kobe (Mw 6.9), 1999 Chi-Chi (Mw 7.6), 2008 Wenchuan (Mw 7.9), 2011 Tohoku (Mw 9.1), and 2023 Turkey (Mw 7.7).

Data sourced from PEER, KiK-net, K-net, and IEM networks, filtered to retain stations with Chinese seismic intensity ≥ VII (51 records at intensity 7, 80 at intensity 8, 61 at intensity 9, and 34 at intensity ≥ 10).
Statistical comparison of calibrated parameters (Tg, βmax, γ) against Vs30 site classes (I, II, III, IV), CSDB2010 code provisions, and ASK14/Zhao2016 GMPEs.
来自6次大地震（1994 Northridge、1995 Kobe、1999集集、2008汶川、2011日本东北、2023土耳其，Mw 6.7–9.1）的452条三分量近场强震记录（断层距<150 km，信噪比>3，具备Vs30数据）。
数据源自PEER、KiK-net、K-net和IEM台网，筛选中国地震烈度≥7度的记录（7度51条、8度80条、9度61条、≥10度34条）。
将标定参数（Tg、βmax、γ）按Vs30场地类别（I–IV类）和烈度进行统计分布分析，并与CSDB2010规范及ASK14、Zhao2016模型进行对比。
li: Dataset only includes strong-motion records from moderate-to-large earthquakes (Mw > 6.5) and excludes small-magnitude earthquakes that can also generate high near-field intensities.
Direct application of the calibrated Tg values to near-field areas of small-magnitude earthquakes may overestimate the actual characteristic period due to smaller source rupture dimensions.
数据集仅包含Mw > 6.5的中强震及大震强震动记录，未涵盖近场同样可能产生高烈度地震动的小震级事件。
由于小震震源破裂尺度较小、长周期成分较少，直接将本研究标定的Tg值应用于小震近场抗震设计可能会高估实际特征周期。

tm.why: The paper focuses on calibrating seismic design response spectra using strong ground motion records with Chinese seismic intensity 7 and above, comparing results against building codes and GMPEs.

A differential evolution optimization algorithm with a hybrid mutation operator is used to fit and invert for the four characteristic parameters of the standardized amplification factor design spectrum.

ev.notes: Full 22-page article-in-press PDF analyzed, including abstract, equations (1)–(17), Table 1, and Figures 1–12.

sum: Evaluating soil-structure interaction (SSI) and radiation damping during forced seismic vibration is complicated by continuous energy input. This study introduces an energy-based methodology that analyzes the post-excitation free-vibration decay phase in a 3D finite-element model of a Type-5 double-curvature concrete arch dam coupled with a Lagrangian reservoir. Three foundation strategies (massive-fixed M1, massless M2, and massive-viscous M3) are tested across three rock stiffness classes under broadband (1940 El Centro) and pulse-like (1992 Erzincan) earthquakes. Combining the dominant FFT frequency with logarithmic regression of total mechanical energy decay yields the energy decay coefficient, effective damping ratio, and energy half-life. Viscous boundaries (M3) increase the energy decay coefficient by 18–51% over massless models, yielding field-consistent effective damping ratios of 7.77–10.72% and dissipating residual energy ~30% faster. Furthermore, radiation damping is shown to depend jointly on foundation impedance and earthquake temporal-frequency characteristics.
本研究提出一种基于自由振动阶段机械能衰减的三维拱坝土-结构相互作用（SSI）评估方法，以克服强迫振动阶段难以分离辐射阻尼的局限。基于ANSYS建立Type-5双曲拱坝-库水-地基三维有限元模型，对比了固定边界有质量地基（M1）、无质量地基（M2）和粘性边界地基（M3）在三种岩体刚度及两条对比鲜明的地……

t: Post-excitation free-vibration mechanical energy decay is fitted via logarithmic regression to extract the energy decay coefficient, which is combined with FFT dominant crest displacement frequency to compute effective damping ratio and energy half-life.
对震后自由振动阶段总机械能进行对数回归提取衰减系数，结合FFT主频计算有效阻尼比和能量半衰期。

A 3D finite-element model of the benchmark Type-5 double-curvature arch dam (H = 120 m) across three foundation rock stiffness classes (C1–C3) subjected to 1940 El Centro and 1992 Erzincan earthquake records.
建立Type-5双曲拱坝（高120m）三维有限元模型，考虑三种地基刚度（C1–C3）和两条地震记录。

Incorporating viscous boundaries (M3) yielded field-consistent effective damping ratios of 7.77%–10.72%, increased the energy decay coefficient by 18%–51% over the massless model, and dissipated post-excitation energy ~30% faster.
粘性边界（M3）有效阻尼比达7.77%–10.72%，能量衰减系数比无质量模型高18%–51%，耗散快30%。

The model assumes linear elastic materials, frequency-independent Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer dashpots, uniform base excitation, and a fixed 2.0 s free-vibration window without full-scale dam record validation.
假设线弹性材料与频无关阻尼器，采用一致基底输入和固定2秒自由振动窗口。

Isolates radiation damping in 3D SSI models by evaluating mechanical energy decay and energy half-life exclusively during the post-earthquake free-vibration phase rather than the forced-vibration phase.
利用大震激励后的自由振动机械能衰减与半衰期指标，将辐射阻尼与强迫振动输入彻底解耦。

kc: Proposes a free-vibration mechanical energy decay framework (energy decay coefficient, effective damping ratio, energy half-life) to isolate radiation damping from forced seismic input.

Demonstrates that Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer viscous boundaries (M3) achieve field-consistent effective damping ratios (7.77%–10.72%) and 30% faster post-shaking energy dissipation than fixed or massless foundations.
Reveals that massless foundation models (M2) artificially suppress base accelerations (to ~0.50 m/s²) and inflate crest-to-base amplification ratios up to 62.93.

Shows that viscous boundary radiation damping increases with foundation softening under broadband excitation (El Centro) but decreases under pulse-like near-fault excitation (Erzincan) due to instantaneous absorption limits.
提出基于自由振动机械能衰减的评估框架（能量衰减系数、有效阻尼比、能量半衰期），将辐射阻尼与强迫地震输入解耦。
证实Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer粘性边界（M3）可获得与实测一致的有效阻尼比（7.77%–10.72%），震后能量耗散速度比固定或无质量地基快30%。
揭示无质量地基模型（M2）人为压低坝基加速度（至约0.50 m/s²），导致坝顶与坝基加速度放大系数虚高至62.93。
发现在宽频地震（El Centro）下地基软化会增强粘性边界辐射阻尼，但在脉冲型近断层地震（Erzincan）下因瞬时吸收能力受限反而降低。
me: 3D finite-element transient dynamic modeling in ANSYS using SOLID185 solid elements and displacement-based Lagrangian compressible acoustic fluid elements (FLUID80).

Comparison of three SSI boundary strategies: massive foundation with rigid boundaries (M1), massless foundation with rigid boundaries (M2), and massive foundation with Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer viscous dashpots (M3).
Logarithmic regression of total mechanical energy (kinetic plus elastic strain energy) during a 2.0 s post-earthquake free-vibration window combined with FFT of crest displacements.
基于ANSYS的三维有限元瞬态动力建模，结构采用SOLID185实体单元，库水采用基于位移格式的Lagrange可压缩声学流体单元（FLUID80）。
对比三种SSI边界策略：刚性边界有质量地基（M1）、刚性边界无质量地基（M2）以及带Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer粘性阻尼器的有质量地基（M3）。
对震后2.0秒自由振动窗口内的总机械能（动能加弹性应变能）进行对数回归，并结合坝顶位移快速傅里叶变换（FFT）提取主频。
de: Benchmark 3D Type-5 double-curvature concrete arch dam (H = 120 m, crest length = 320 m, reservoir length = 3H = 360 m) validated against Sevim (2011).

Parametric matrix of 18 simulations across 3 foundation strategies (M1, M2, M3), 3 rock stiffness classes (C1: 50 GPa, C2: 21 GPa, C3: 8 GPa), and 2 ground motions (1940 El Centro N-S broadband and 1992 Erzincan E-W pulse-like).
标准Type-5三维双曲混凝土拱坝模型（坝高120 m，弧长320 m，库长3H=360 m），并与Sevim (2011)结果进行验证。
包含18组模拟的参数矩阵：涵盖3种地基策略（M1、M2、M3）、3种基岩刚度等级（C1: 50 GPa, C2: 21 GPa, C3: 8 GPa）以及2条地震动记录（1940 El Centro宽频远场和1992 Erzincan脉冲型近场）。
li: Assumes linear elastic material properties for the concrete dam and foundation rock, omitting nonlinear damping mechanisms such as concrete cracking or joint sliding.
Employs frequency-independent Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer dashpot coefficients and uniform base excitation, which can under-absorb high instantaneous energy fluxes during near-fault velocity pulses.
Relies on a fixed 2.0 s free-vibration monitoring window and lacks direct calibration against instrumented full-scale arch dam recordings.
假设大坝混凝土和基岩为线弹性材料，未考虑混凝土开裂或横缝滑移等非线性阻尼机制。
