tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamic response, damping, and soil-structure interaction of a 3D concrete arch dam subjected to strong ground motion records (1940 El Centro and 1992 Erzincan).

It evaluates 3D finite-element modeling strategies and Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer viscous absorbing boundary conditions for outward seismic wave propagation and radiation damping in a semi-infinite foundation.

ev.notes: Full 35-page accepted manuscript PDF analyzed, including all mathematical formulations, 11 figures, and 9 tables.

sum: Seismic observations of the 410-km discontinuity show variations in sharpness and depth that equilibrium thermodynamics alone cannot explain. This study couples a grain-scale, interface-controlled olivine-to-wadsleyite growth model to 2D compressible mantle flow simulations in ASPECT, testing kinetic parameters across seven orders of magnitude and varying viscosity contrasts. Results reveal a strong thermal asymmetry: hot mantle plumes consistently produce sharp (2–3 km) discontinuities regardless of kinetics, whereas cold subducting slabs exhibit three distinct kinetic regimes: (1) quasi-equilibrium with narrow, uplifted 410s; (2) intermediate kinetics with broadened, depressed 410s and metastable olivine wedges; and (3) ultra-sluggish kinetics causing complete slab stagnation and paradoxically re-sharpened, deeply depressed (up to 100 km) 410s. Furthermore, stronger slabs sink sub-horizontally and slowly, allowing fuller reaction completion than weaker, rapidly sinking slabs. Thus, 410 seismic structure in subduction zones provides a powerful probe of upper mantle reaction kinetics and rheology.
本研究将晶粒尺度界面控制的橄榄石-瓦兹利石相变生长模型与ASPECT二维可压缩地幔对流模拟耦合，跨越7个数量级测试了反应动力学参数与黏度对比度。结果表明冷热环境存在显著不对称性：热地幔柱始终产生2-3 km的尖锐410间断面；而冷俯冲板片呈现三种动力学体制：（1）准平衡态（窄且抬升）、（2）中间态（……

t: Couples a grain-scale, interface-controlled olivine-wadsleyite kinetic growth rate law to 2D compressible mantle convection in ASPECT using the projected density approximation and operator splitting with adaptive Runge-Kutta subcycling.
在ASPECT中结合投影密度近似与算子分裂法，将界面控制的相变动力学与二维可压缩地幔对流耦合。
2D numerical experiments in a 900 x 600 km domain with ±500 K thermal anomalies (slabs and plumes), varying kinetic prefactors Z (3.0e0–7.0e7 K^-1 s^-1) and rheological parameter B (2–10).
在900×600 km域内模拟±500 K板片与地幔柱异常，跨越7个数量级扫描动力学因子Z及流变参数B。
Plumes maintain 2–9 km 410 widths (~24 km uplift) across most kinetics; slabs show three regimes, with widespread 410 penetration requiring reaction rates X_dot >= 0.07 Ma^-1.
地幔柱保持2-9 km尖锐410界面；板片呈现三种体制，穿透410需反应速率不低于0.07 Ma^-1。
Assumes pure Mg2SiO4 composition, saturated nucleation, 2D geometry, uniform background viscosity without 660-km phase changes, and omits dynamic pressure in Gibbs free energy calculations.
假设纯镁橄榄石成分、瞬时形核饱和与二维几何，忽略了应变弱化、660相变及自由能中的动态压力。

First systematic quantification of how interface-controlled phase kinetics and rheological strength jointly control 410 discontinuity width and displacement in fully compressible mantle flow simulations.
首次在可压缩地幔对流模拟中系统量化反应动力学与流变强度对410间断面宽度和深度的联合控制。

kc: Coupled an interface-controlled olivine-wadsleyite kinetic growth model with compressible mantle convection in ASPECT using the projected density approximation and operator splitting.
Identified three distinct kinetic regimes governing 410-km discontinuity structure and slab dynamics in cold subduction zones across seven orders of magnitude in kinetic prefactor.

Demonstrated that rheological strength counterintuitively modulates metastability: stronger slabs descend sub-horizontally and slowly, promoting fuller transformation than weaker, vertically sinking slabs.
利用投影密度近似和算子分裂，在ASPECT中将界面控制的橄榄石-瓦兹利石相变动力学模型与可压缩地幔对流相耦合。

Grain-scale, interface-controlled phase transformation kinetics (Cahn/Hosoya formulation) integrated via first-order operator splitting and SUNDIALS ARKODE adaptive subcycling.
Thermodynamic reference profiles computed with Perple_X and BurnMan using Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2022) equations of state.
使用ASPECT v3.0.0结合投影密度近似（PDA）进行二维可压缩有限元地球动力学模拟。
采用一阶算子分裂和SUNDIALS ARKODE自适应子步积分，求解晶粒尺度界面控制的相变动力学方程。
基于Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2022)状态方程，使用Perple_X和BurnMan计算绝热参考热力学剖面。

Systematic parameter sweep varying kinetic prefactor Z from 3.0e0 to 7.0e7 K^-1 s^-1 (representing 50–5000 ppm OH and 1–10 mm grain size) and rheological activation factor B from 2 to 10.
在900×600 km计算域内进行100 Ma演化的二维数值实验，分别模拟下沉板片（-500 K异常）和上升地幔柱（+500 K异常）。

li: Neglects nucleation kinetics by assuming instantaneous site saturation, and omits dynamic pressure perturbations from the Gibbs free energy driving force to prevent numerical oscillations.
Uses a simplified monomineralic pure-Mg (Mg2SiO4) composition without Fe-Mg partitioning, explicit water thermodynamics, or 520/660 km phase transitions.
Restricted to 2D geometry and simple temperature-dependent Arrhenius viscosity, omitting grain-size reduction, strain localization, and plastic yielding.
假设形核位置瞬时饱和从而忽略了形核动力学，并在吉布斯自由能计算中省略了动态压力项以抑制数值振荡。
采用简化的单矿物纯镁端元（Mg2SiO4）成分，未包含Fe-Mg分配、水对相边界的显式热力学效应以及520/660 km相变。
局限于二维几何模型和简单的温度依赖型阿伦尼乌斯黏度，未考虑粒径减小、应变局部化和塑性变形过程。

tm.why: The paper conducts compressible geodynamic simulations of mantle plumes and subducting slabs interacting with the 410-km phase transition using ASPECT.
The paper quantifies the depth displacement and width of the 410-km seismic discontinuity and directly discusses implications for detectability using receiver functions and SS/PP precursors.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF provided and analyzed, including governing equations, parameter ranges, all 8 figures, and discussion sections.

sum: Reconstructing 2D subsurface shear-wave velocity (Vs) models from surface-based seismic methods often suffers from limited depth penetration and non-uniqueness when using a single observable. This paper introduces 2D SuPPSALA, a passive seismic profiling technique for linear arrays using either 3C nodes or cabled vertical and transverse geophones. The workflow extracts effective Rayleigh- and Love-wave dispersion curves across moving subarrays via Extended Spatial AutoCorrelation (ESAC) and pairs them with station-specific Horizontal-to-Vertical or Transverse-to-Vertical Spectral Ratios (HVSR/TVSR). A Pareto-based Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm jointly inverts these complementary observables to construct robust 2D Vs sections. Applied to a 30-m profile in a perilagoon environment in northeastern Italy and a 2.1-km nodal array in Switzerland, the method resolves sharp lateral transitions between soft peat channels (Vs < 100 m/s) and stiff sandy palaeodunes (Vs > 300 m/s), validated by independent electromagnetic conductivity surveys.
针对地表地震方法重建二维剪切波速度（Vs）结构时深度受限及多解性问题，本文提出2D SuPPSALA被动源多分量线性台阵成像技术。该方法利用三分量节点或垂直与切向有线检波器，通过扩展空间自相关（ESAC）提取移动子台阵的瑞利波与勒夫波有效频散曲线，并与单台水平/垂直或切向/垂直谱比（HVSR/TVS……

t: Jointly inverts moving-subarray ESAC effective dispersion curves and local HVSR/TVSR spectral ratios at each station using a Pareto-based Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm to assemble a 2D shear-wave velocity section.
利用帕累托多目标进化算法，在各测点联合反演移动子台阵ESAC有效频散与单台HVSR/TVSR谱比以构建二维Vs剖面。

A 30-m cabled profile in northeastern Italy using 21 vertical and 21 transverse 4.5-Hz geophones (1.5-m spacing, 20-min passive recording at 250 Hz), validated with 3-offset 10-kHz electromagnetic conductivity data.
意大利东北部30米有线剖面（21对垂直与切向4.5 Hz检波器，间距1.5米，采集20分钟），配以10 kHz电磁电导率…

The 2D Vs model clearly resolves a shallow low-velocity peat-filled channel (Vs < 100 m/s, ~2.5 Hz spectral ratio peak from a 14-m deep contrast) transitioning abruptly to stiff sandy palaeodunes (Vs > 300 m/s).
二维Vs模型清晰分辨出左侧低速泥炭古河道（Vs < 100 m/s，14米深界面产生2.5 Hz峰值）向右侧高速砂质古沙…

Surface-wave analysis cannot reliably constrain Vp, nearby directional noise sources can affect dispersion, and sequential Z/T cabled recording requires stationary background microtremors and calm wind.

Pairs localized moving-subarray passive dispersion with station-specific HVSR/TVSR in a unified 2D joint inversion, achieving deeper penetration and sharper lateral resolution than roll-along MASW or refraction.
将移动子台阵被动源频散与单台谱比结合进行二维联合反演，相比主动源滚动排列兼具更大探测深度与更高横向分辨率。

Demonstrates that Transverse-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (TVSR) is an effective proxy for full 3C HVSR while enabling simultaneous Love-wave dispersion extraction.
Validates the method on a strongly heterogeneous perilagoon site in Italy with independent electromagnetic data and demonstrates scalability on a 2.1-km nodal profile in Switzerland.

Station-specific computation of Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) or Transverse-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (TVSR) down to low frequencies.
Pareto-based Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (MOEA) for heuristic joint inversion of local dispersion and spectral ratio curves without requiring a starting model.
对移动子台阵（通常6–9道）应用扩展空间自相关（ESAC），提取瑞利波和勒夫波的二维有效频散曲线。
计算单台延伸至低频段的水平/垂直谱比（HVSR）或切向/垂直谱比（TVSR）。

Multi-offset electromagnetic (EM) conductivity survey (10 kHz, receiver offsets of 148, 282, and 449 cm) along the same 30-m Italian profile for validation.
Kilometer-scale passive dataset (~2100 m profile) north of Zurich (Switzerland) recorded by 24 3C seismic nodes.

沿同一30米意大利测线开展的多偏移距电磁（EM）电导率测量（10 kHz，收发距148、282和449 cm）用于结果验证。

Strong nearby directional anthropogenic noise sources can bias ESAC dispersion and spectral ratios unless the array is properly oriented or filtered.

The paper reconstructs 2D subsurface shear-wave velocity profiles by inverting Rayleigh and Love wave dispersion curves from moving subarrays.

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional electrical resistivity model of the North China Craton (NCC) using a magnetotelluric (MT) array. By applying thermodynamic and petrophysical equations, the authors estimate temperature and melt fraction to investigate lithospheric destruction. The model reveals two distinct low-resistivity anomaly systems separated by the resistive Taihang Uplift. The Western Block's localized anomalies are attributed to partial melting, water, and carbon dioxide, influenced by Cenozoic far-field effects of the Tibetan Plateau uplift. Conversely, the Eastern Block's anomalies are driven by Mesozoic Paleo-Pacific subduction and retreat, with the Tanlu Fault Zone acting as a melt conduit. This demonstrates that the NCC underwent a heterogeneous, multi-stage destruction process.
本研究利用大地电磁（MT）阵列构建了华北克拉通（NCC）的三维电阻率模型，并结合物理化学方程定量估算了温度和熔体体积分数。结果显示，被高阻太行隆起分隔的东、西部陆块呈现出不同的低阻异常特征。西部陆块的局部低阻异常由部分熔融、水和二氧化碳共同导致，受新生代青藏高原隆升的远场旋转效应控制；东部陆块的异常……

t: 3D magnetotelluric array inversion combined with Nernst-Einstein, Arrhenius equations, and Hashin-Shtrikman bounds to estimate temperature and melt fraction.
结合Nernst-Einstein、Arrhenius方程和Hashin-Shtrikman界限的三维大地电磁阵列反演，…
Magnetotelluric array data covering the Western Block, Trans-North China Orogen, and Eastern Block of the North China Craton.
覆盖华北克拉通西部陆块、中部造山带和东部陆块的大地电磁阵列数据。
Discovery of two distinct low-resistivity anomaly systems separated by the Taihang Uplift, indicating localized Cenozoic melting in the west and subduction-driven Mesozoic melting in the east.
发现被太行隆起分隔的两个独立低阻异常系统，表明西部存在局部新生代熔融，东部存在俯冲驱动的中生代熔融。
Potential non-uniqueness in distinguishing the relative contributions of partial melt, water, and carbon dioxide to the observed low-resistivity anomalies.
在区分部分熔融、水和二氧化碳对低阻异常的贡献时存在潜在的多解性。
Providing quantitative electrical evidence for a heterogeneous, multi-stage destruction process of the North China Craton driven by different tectonic regimes.
为不同构造体制驱动的华北克拉通非均匀、多阶段破坏过程提供了定量的电性证据。

sum: This study evaluates the performance of the Earthquake Point-Source Integrated Code (EPIC) algorithm, used in the ShakeAlert system, for earthquake early warning (EEW) in Alaska's complex tectonic environment. Using a dataset of 530 moderate-to-large earthquakes (M 4.5–8.2, depths 1–212 km), the authors conducted simulated real-time replays. EPIC successfully detected 345 events, showing high reliability in high station density areas like Southcentral Alaska. However, a major performance gap was identified for deep earthquakes (>100 km), where initial magnitudes were underestimated by an average of 0.71 units (compared to 0.18 for shallow events). This error stems from EPIC's fixed 8 km depth assumption, which distorts station distance calculations. The study highlights the need for a hypocenter depth correction factor and establishes a baseline for expanding EEW to Alaska.

Waveforms and metadata from 530 moderate-to-large Alaska earthquakes (M 4.5 to 8.2, depths 1 to 212 km) spanning various tectonic regimes.

sum: This Zenodo dataset contains local earthquake focal mechanism solutions for Macquarie Island, compiled by Yingbo Li and Nicholas Rawlinson. The data includes parameters such as longitude, latitude, depth, strike, dip, rake, magnitude, and event ID, with a separate file (MT-macq-lq.txt) designated for lower-quality focal mechanisms. It serves as a valuable resource for studying the active tectonics, stress field, and fault mechanics of the Macquarie Ridge Complex.
该Zenodo数据集提供了麦夸里岛（Macquarie Island）本地地震的震源机制解。数据由Yingbo Li和Nicholas Rawlinson整理，包含经纬度、深度、走向、倾角、滑动角、震级和事件ID等参数，并专门用一个文件存储较低质量的震源机制。该数据集为研究麦夸里脊复杂的活动构造、应……

t: Focal mechanism determination providing strike, dip, and rake parameters for local earthquakes.
确定本地地震的走向、倾角和滑动角等震源机制参数。
Text files containing earthquake locations, depths, magnitudes, and focal mechanism parameters.
包含地震位置、深度、震级和震源机制参数的文本文件。
A compiled catalog of local earthquake focal mechanisms for Macquarie Island, categorized by quality.
编译了麦夸里岛本地地震震源机制目录，并按质量进行了分类。
Lack of detailed methodological documentation within the Zenodo repository metadata.
Zenodo仓库元数据中缺乏详细的方法学文档。
First dedicated local focal mechanism dataset publicly released for Macquarie Island.
首次公开发布的针对麦夸里岛的专用本地震源机制数据集。

kc: Provides a localized dataset of earthquake focal mechanisms for Macquarie Island.
Distinguishes between high-quality and lower-quality focal mechanism solutions.
提供了麦夸里岛本地地震震源机制的本地化数据集。
区分了高质量和较低质量的震源机制解。
me: Focal mechanism determination (strike, dip, rake) from local earthquake recordings.
利用本地地震记录确定震源机制解（走向、倾角、滑动角）。
de: Text files containing event locations, depths, nodal plane parameters (strike, dip, rake), and magnitudes.
包含事件位置、深度、节面参数（走向、倾角、滑动角）和震级的文本文件。
li: No detailed description of the seismic network or inversion algorithm is provided in the dataset metadata itself.
Some focal mechanisms are flagged as lower quality.
数据集元数据本身未提供地震台网或反演算法的详细描述。
部分震源机制解被标记为较低质量。

tm.why: The dataset contains earthquake focal mechanisms (strike, dip, rake), which describe earthquake source parameters.
The dataset provides a catalog of local earthquake locations, depths, magnitudes, and focal mechanisms.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the Zenodo repository metadata and abstract as no PDF was available.

sum: Understanding how deep transcrustal magma transport links to surface volcanic unrest remains a major challenge. Using dense broadband and nodal seismic arrays (LaMa and TANGO) at the Laguna del Maule volcanic complex in Chile, this study integrates 3.7 Hz P-receiver function Common Conversion Point (CCP) imaging, a deep-learning earthquake catalog (LOC-FLOW), and GPS vertical deformation data. Receiver functions delineate two distinct low-velocity magma storage zones in the upper (~3–16 km) and lower (~28–50 km) crust. These reservoirs are connected by a vertical conduit of mid-crustal seismicity (12–30 km depth) comprising newly identified Andean deep long-period (DLP) earthquakes and a pronounced one-day volcano-tectonic (VT) swarm on February 14, 2018. Piecewise regression of GPS data shows surface uplift accelerated ~3 months after the swarm, yielding an upper-crustal hydraulic diffusivity of ~20 m²/s and demonstrating that volcanic unrest originates deep within the crust months before shallow pressurization.
本研究利用智利Laguna del Maule火山区的密集宽频带和节点地震台阵（LaMa和TANGO），结合3.7 Hz高频P波接收函数共转换点（CCP）叠加成像、基于深度学习的地震目录构建流程（LOC-FLOW）及GPS垂直形变数据，揭示了跨地壳岩浆通道结构与火山动荡的联系。接收函数清晰刻画了上地……

t: The authors combine deep-learning earthquake detection and relocation (LOC-FLOW: PhaseNet, REAL, VELEST, HypoDD), frequency-index classification, Bayesian focal mechanisms (MTfit), 3.7 Hz P-receiver function CCP stacking, and BIC-based piecewise GPS regression.
结合深度学习地震检测重定位、频率指数分类、贝叶斯震源机制、3.7Hz接收函数CCP叠加及GPS分段回归。

Seismic data from the LaMa broadband network (2015–2018; 3,860 events) and TANGO nodal/broadband arrays (2022–2024; 499 events), alongside vertical GPS displacement records (2012–2020) from station MAU2 at Laguna del Maule.
使用LaMa（3860个事件）和TANGO（499个事件）地震台阵波形及MAU2站2012-2020年GPS垂直位移数据…

Receiver functions image upper (~3–16 km) and lower (~28–50 km) crustal magma reservoirs connected by 12–30 km deep VT and DLP seismicity. A 21–26 km VT swarm preceded GPS uplift acceleration by ~81±10 days, yielding ~20 m²/s hydraulic diffusivity.
成像了上下地壳岩浆储层及其中间12-30km的VT/DLP地震通道；21-26km震群领先地表加速隆升约81天，水力扩散…

Exact partial melt percentages and velocity reductions cannot be uniquely determined from receiver functions alone, and hydraulic diffusivity estimates rely on simplified fluid pathway assumptions without accounting for sub-reservoir complexity.
仅靠接收函数无法精确量化熔融比例与波速降幅，且水力扩散率估算依赖于单一流体通道等简化假设。

First direct geophysical link between seismically imaged lower-to-upper crustal magma reservoirs, well-constrained Andean DLP/VT mid-crustal seismicity, and delayed surface uplift acceleration, demonstrating bottom-up transcrustal volcanic unrest.
首次在安第斯山脉精确定位DLP地震，并将上下地壳储层成像、中地壳震群与滞后3个月的地表隆升加速直接关联。

kc: Imaged a transcrustal magmatic system beneath Laguna del Maule featuring an upper crustal low-velocity zone (~3–16 km bsl) and a lower crustal MASH-like reservoir (~28–50 km bsl) using 3.7 Hz P-receiver functions.

Detected and relocated 4,359 earthquakes using deep learning, providing the first well-constrained observations of deep long-period (DLP) seismicity in the Andes alongside a mid-crustal VT swarm at 21–26 km depth.
Identified a ~3-month lag (~81±10 days) between the February 2018 mid-crustal VT swarm and an acceleration in GPS surface uplift, estimating an upper-crustal hydraulic diffusivity of ~20 m²/s.
利用3.7 Hz高频P波接收函数成像了Laguna del Maule下方的跨地壳岩浆系统，识别出上地壳（~3–16 km）和下地壳（~28–50 km）两个低速岩浆储层。
利用深度学习检测并重定位了4359次地震，首次在安第斯山脉精确约束了深源长周期（DLP）地震，并捕获了21–26 km深度的单日火山构造（VT）震群。
发现2018年2月中地壳VT震群领先GPS地表隆升加速约3个月（~81±10天），据此估算上地壳储层的水力扩散率约为20 m²/s。
me: Deep-learning earthquake detection and relocation workflow (LOC-FLOW: PhaseNet picking, REAL association, VELEST 1D velocity/hypocenter inversion, and HypoDD double-difference relocation).

Frequency Index (FI) spectral classification (comparing 1–5 Hz and 10–20 Hz bands with station attenuation corrections) and Bayesian moment-tensor inversion (MTfit) using P-wave first-motion polarities.
High-frequency (3.7 Hz Gaussian filter) iterative time-domain P-receiver function deconvolution and distance-weighted bootstrap Common Conversion Point (CCP) depth stacking.
Piecewise linear regression with Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) breakpoint selection on GPS vertical displacement time series to estimate change points and hydraulic diffusivity.
基于深度学习的地震检测与重定位流程（LOC-FLOW：PhaseNet震相拾取、REAL事件关联、VELEST一维速度模型与震源联合反演及HypoDD双差重定位）。
引入台站衰减校正的频率指数（FI，对比1–5 Hz与10–20 Hz频段）频谱分类，以及利用P波初动极性的贝叶斯矩张量反演（MTfit）。
高频（3.7 Hz高斯滤波）时间域迭代反褶积P波接收函数计算，以及距离加权自助法共转换点（CCP）深度迁移叠加。
利用基于贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）的分段线性回归方法检测GPS垂直位移时间序列变点，并据此估算水力扩散率。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms from the LaMa broadband network (Jan 2015 – Apr 2018, yielding 3,860 cataloged events) and the TANGO broadband and 5-Hz nodal array with ~2 km spacing (2022–2024, active nodes Jan–May 2023, yielding 499 events).
Three-component teleseismic waveforms recorded by the LaMa and TANGO networks used for high-frequency P-receiver function calculation.
Continuous vertical GPS displacement time series (2012–2020) from station MAU2 located at the southwestern edge of Maule Lake.
LaMa宽频带台网（2015年1月至2018年4月，获取3860个事件）以及TANGO宽频带与~2 km间距5 Hz节点台阵（2022–2024年，节点于2023年1–5月运行，获取499个事件）的连续波形数据。
LaMa和TANGO台网记录的三分量远震波形数据，用于计算高频P波接收函数。
位于Maule湖西南缘MAU2站点的连续GPS垂直位移时间序列数据（2012–2020年）。
li: The TANGO nodal array was situated north of the volcanic field, resulting in poor azimuthal coverage, fewer well-constrained earthquakes, and higher location uncertainties compared to the LaMa network.

Receiver functions alone cannot uniquely resolve exact partial melt percentages or absolute shear-wave velocity reductions, and suffer from lateral smearing where station coverage is sparse (e.g., southern extent of D1 and D3).

Focal mechanisms could not be obtained for DLP events due to emergent P-wave polarities, and hydraulic diffusivity estimation relies on simplified assumptions of constant viscosity, compressibility, and direct fluid pathways.
TANGO节点台阵位于火山区以北，方位角覆盖较差，导致相比LaMa台网其精定位地震数量较少且定位不确定性较高。
单独使用接收函数无法精确量化部分熔融百分比或绝对波速降幅，且在台站覆盖稀疏的边缘区域（如D1和D3南侧）存在横向涂抹效应。
由于DLP事件的P波初动极性呈涌现型而无法求取震源机制解；水力扩散率估算依赖于粘度、压缩率恒定及单一流体通道等简化假设。

tm.why: The paper investigates transcrustal magma ascent, volcanic unrest, deep long-period earthquakes, and volcano-tectonic swarms beneath the Laguna del Maule volcanic complex.
High-frequency (3.7 Hz) P-receiver functions and common conversion point stacking are used to image upper and lower crustal magma reservoirs and the Moho.
The authors build high-precision earthquake catalogs using the deep-learning-based LOC-FLOW workflow (PhaseNet, REAL, VELEST, and HypoDD).

ev.notes: Full 30-page article-in-press PDF used, including main text, methods, figure captions (pp. 16–17), and figures 1–6 (pp. 25–30).

sum: Although Phase 1 and 2 of the temporary WA Array (130 stations each, 40 km spacing) reveal pervasive E–W to NE–SW seismic anisotropy across Western Australia, individual temporary and permanent stations yield very few SKS and PKS (XKS) splitting measurements. Using SplitLab rotation-correlation analysis on Phase 2 stations alongside AxiSEM/Instaseis synthetic waveform modeling, this study demonstrates that radiated XKS (SV-polarized) energy reaches a minimum when the source-receiver raypath aligns with an earthquake focal mechanism nodal plane. Because teleseismic XKS events recorded in Western Australia predominantly originate from the South American and Aleutian subduction zones—where trench-parallel thrust and normal fault strikes closely match the great-circle raypath azimuths—the resulting XKS amplitudes are severely diminished across 15–40% of azimuths. Consequently, low XKS measurement productivity does not imply apparent isotropy or weak mantle anisotropy, highlighting source radiation patterns as a critical factor in global shear-wave splitting studies.
本研究利用西澳台阵二期130个流动台站及固定台站数据，结合SplitLab旋转相关法与AxiSEM/Instaseis合成地震图模拟，探讨了西澳地区虽存在广泛的E–W至NE–SW向地震各向异性，但单台XKS（SKS和PKS）横波分裂有效测量极少的原因。研究发现，当震源至台站的大圆路径与震源机制节面走……

t: Calculates XKS splitting parameters via the rotation correlation method in SplitLab (0.04–0.125 Hz) and simulates azimuthal SKS amplitude variations using AxiSEM/Instaseis broadband synthetics with synthetic splitting operators.
使用SplitLab旋转相关法计算XKS分裂参数，并利用AxiSEM/Instaseis合成地震图模拟方位角振幅变化。
Teleseismic SKS (87°–130°) and PKS (130°–150°) waveforms (Mb > 5.75) from 130 temporary WA Array Phase 2 stations (2024–2025), plus permanent AU/S1 and temporary OA/1K stations.
2024至2025年西澳台阵二期130个流动台站及固定台站记录的Mb>5.75远震SKS与PKS波形。
Phase 2 stations yielded 48 splits and 146 nulls; permanent station KMBL yielded 23 splits (2%) over 21 years. Nodal plane alignment reduces XKS amplitudes across 15–40% of azimuths.
二期仅获48个分裂和146个空结果；节面与射线对齐会在15%–40%的方位角内显著削弱XKS能量。
Short one-year deployment per array phase and restricted XKS distance ranges limit backazimuthal coverage, while synthetic tests assume simplified double-couple mechanisms.
单期一年部署时长与XKS震中距限制了反方位角覆盖，且合成测试采用简化震源机制。
Identifies alignment between great-circle raypaths and subduction earthquake nodal planes as the primary cause of sparse XKS measurements in Western Australia, refuting apparent isotropy.
揭示大圆路径与俯冲带震源节面重合是西澳XKS测量稀缺的主因，驳斥了视各向同性假说。

kc: Reports XKS shear-wave splitting results from Phase 2 of the WA Array (130 stations), confirming coherent E–W to NE–SW lithospheric anisotropy across southwestern Australia despite yielding only 48 splits and 146 nulls.

Demonstrates via theoretical SV radiation patterns and AxiSEM/Instaseis synthetics that XKS radial amplitudes drop below typical SNR thresholds across 15% (strike-slip) to 40% (thrust) of azimuths when raypaths align with nodal planes.

Resolves the long-standing paradox of low XKS splitting productivity in Western Australia by showing that dominant source regions (South America and Aleutians) feature fault strikes aligned with great-circle paths to WA.
报告了西澳台阵二期（130个台站）的XKS横波分裂结果，仅获得48个分裂和146个空结果，但证实了西澳西南部存在一致的E–W至NE–SW向岩石圈各向异性。
通过理论SV辐射花样和AxiSEM/Instaseis合成地震图证明，当射线路径与节面平行时，走滑断层约15%、逆冲断层约40%方位角内的XKS径向振幅会降至信噪比阈值以下。
揭示了西澳长期缺乏XKS分裂测量的真正原因：主要震源区（南美和阿留申俯冲带）的断层走向与通往西澳的大圆路径高度重合。
me: Shear-wave splitting parameter estimation (fast orientation φ and delay time δt) for SKS and PKS phases using the rotation correlation (RC) method in SplitLab, bandpass filtered at 0.04–0.125 Hz.
Theoretical 3D SV and SH radiation pattern modeling for double-couple thrust, normal, and strike-slip focal mechanisms based on Boore and Boatwright (1984).
Broadband synthetic seismogram computation using Instaseis and Syngine (from AxiSEM Green's function databases) combined with synthetic splitting operators to evaluate azimuthal XKS amplitude decay.
对0.04–0.125 Hz带通滤波后的SKS和PKS震相，使用SplitLab中的旋转相关（RC）法计算横波分裂参数（快波方向φ和延迟时间δt）。
基于Boore和Boatwright (1984)方程，构建双力偶逆冲、正断层和走滑震源机制的三维SV和SH理论辐射花样。
利用基于AxiSEM格林函数数据库的Instaseis和Syngine计算宽频带合成地震图，并施加合成分裂算子以评估不同方位角下的XKS振幅衰减。
de: Teleseismic waveforms (Mb > 5.75, epicentral distances 87°–130° for SKS and 130°–150° for PKS) recorded between March 2024 and March 2025 across 130 temporary stations of WA Array Phase 2, supplemented by AU, S1, OA, and 1K networks.

Long-term permanent station analysis (e.g., 21 years at AU station KMBL with 1,154 candidate events) and waveform comparisons between WA stations (MORW, KMBL) and eastern Australian stations (EIDS, RIV) for South American and Aleutian events.
Synthetic azimuthal sweep experiments (0°–360° at 95° epicentral distance) for idealized thrust and strike-slip faults and real event mechanisms with synthetic splitting applied.
2024年3月至2025年3月西澳台阵二期130个流动台站及AU、S1、OA、1K台网记录的远震波形（Mb > 5.75，SKS震中距87°–130°，PKS震中距130°–150°）。
固定台站长期数据分析（如运行21年的KMBL台站1,154个事件），以及针对南美和阿留申地震的西澳台站（MORW、KMBL）与东澳台站（EIDS、RIV）实测波形对比。
在95°固定震中距下对理想逆冲、走滑断层及实际震源机制进行0°–360°方位角扫描并叠加各向异性分裂算子的合成测试。
li: Each phase of the temporary WA Array is deployed for only about one year, restricting the available backazimuthal event coverage.
Available events in WA are heavily biased toward null measurements (3:1 null-to-split ratio in Phase 2) because dominant event backazimuths align closely with the fast or slow anisotropic axes.
Synthetic radiation pattern sensitivity analyses rely primarily on idealized pure dip-slip or strike-slip double-couple mechanisms and noise-free isotropic Earth models.
西澳流动台阵每期部署时间仅约一年，限制了可用地震事件的反方位角覆盖范围。
西澳可用事件的反方位角常与各向异性快轴或慢轴重合，导致结果严重偏向空测量（二期空结果与分裂结果之比达3:1）。
合成辐射花样敏感性分析主要基于理想化的纯倾滑或纯走滑双力偶机制以及无噪声各向同性地球模型。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates shear-wave splitting of SKS and PKS (XKS) phases across Western Australia to characterize upper mantle and lithospheric anisotropy.
The splitting measurements reveal large-scale coherent E-W to NE-SW anisotropic fabrics beneath Western Australia related to ancient lithospheric deformation.
The core hypothesis evaluates how earthquake focal mechanisms and 3D SV/SH source radiation patterns control the radiated XKS energy along source-receiver raypaths.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 20-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (including 9 figures and 2 tables) and metadata.

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of implementing a network-based Earthquake Early Warning System (EEWS) at the Northeastern Italy Thrust Faults Observatory (NITRO). Using the probabilistic algorithm PRESTo, the authors perform extensive numerical simulations incorporating real station latencies measured over six months, alongside offline replays of the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone earthquake. They find that the current network configuration results in a blind zone radius exceeding 18–25 km, which covers about half of the historically damaged sites. Consequently, actionable lead times are limited for local events, though the system remains highly valuable for rapid post-event information and situational awareness.
本研究评估了意大利东北部逆冲断裂观测站（NITRO）部署网络化地震预警系统（EEWS）的可行性。作者利用概率性预警算法PRESTo，结合六个月实测的台站数据传输延迟进行数值模拟，并对2024年Mw 4.1级Preone地震进行了离线回放。结果表明，当前台网配置下的盲区半径超过18-25公里，覆盖了约……

t: Probabilistic and evolutionary earthquake early warning simulation using the PRESTo algorithm combined with real station latencies.
结合实际台站延迟，利用PRESTo算法进行概率与渐进式地震预警数值模拟。
Six months of real latency measurements from NITRO accelerometric stations and waveforms of the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone earthquake.
NITRO强震台站六个月的实际延迟测量数据及2024年Mw 4.1级Preone地震波形。
Expected blind zone radius exceeds 18-25 km, meaning about half of historically damaged sites would fall within the blind zone.
预期盲区半径超过18-25公里，意味着约有一半的历史受灾点将处于盲区内。
Large blind zones and limited actionable lead times restrict the system's effectiveness for local events.
较大的盲区和有限的实际可用预警时间限制了该系统对本地地震的减灾效果。
First comprehensive feasibility study of EEW at NITRO incorporating long-term empirical latency measurements and real earthquake replays.
首次结合长期实测延迟和真实地震回放，对NITRO观测站进行全面的地震预警可行性评估。

kc: Evaluated EEW feasibility at the NITRO near-fault observatory using real latency data and simulations.
Quantified blind zone radius (>18-25 km) and actionable lead times for different end-user scenarios.
Validated simulation results using offline replays of the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone earthquake.
利用实际延迟数据和数值模拟，系统评估了NITRO近断层观测站的地震预警可行性。
定量给出了盲区半径（>18-25公里）以及不同用户场景下的实际可用预警时间。
通过2024年Mw 4.1级Preone地震的离线回放验证了模拟结果。
me: Numerical simulations of EEW performance using the PRESTo (PRobabilistic and Evolutionary early warning SysTem) algorithm.
Measurement of real-world station-specific data transmission latencies over a six-month period.
Offline replay of the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone earthquake waveforms.
使用PRESTo（概率与渐进式早期预警系统）算法进行地震预警性能的数值模拟。
对台站特有的实际数据传输延迟进行了为期六个月的连续测量。
对2024年Mw 4.1级Preone地震的波形进行了离线回放分析。
de: Six months of real latency measurements from accelerometric stations in the NITRO virtual network.
Waveform data from the 2024 Mw 4.1 Preone, Italy, earthquake.
Historical macroseismic observations used to constrain scenario-based simulations.
NITRO虚拟网络中强震动台站为期六个月的实际数据传输延迟测量数据。
2024年意大利Mw 4.1级Preone地震的波形数据。
用于约束情景模拟的历史宏观地震烈度观测数据。
li: Large blind zones (18-25 km) limit the usefulness of early warnings for sites closest to the epicenter.
Actionable lead times are highly dependent on user type and may be insufficient for complex industrial shutdowns.
较大的盲区（18-25公里）限制了震中附近区域获得有效预警的能力。
实际可用的预警时间高度依赖于用户类型，对于复杂的工业停机可能不足。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the feasibility and performance of an earthquake early warning system to mitigate seismic hazard.
It analyzes real-time earthquake detection, alert timeliness, and source parameter estimation using the PRESTo algorithm.

ev.notes: Analysis based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study utilizes two underwater distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays—an 11 km cable in the Foziling reservoir and a 20 km offshore seafloor cable near Yantai—to characterize ship-associated wavefields and their interaction with background surface gravity waves (SGW). The authors identify mechanical, propeller-related, and 2–10 Hz hydrodynamic noise. Frequency-wavenumber analysis reveals energy enhancements at specific frequency bands (0.09–1.25 Hz in the reservoir, 1.3–1.6 Hz offshore) when ships cross the cables. These enhancements are attributed to second-order nonlinear interactions between ship-driven hydrodynamic forcing and background SGW, depending on their relative propagation directions. This work provides new insights into waveway transportation dynamics and underwater DAS wavefield complexity.

sum: The sporadic splitting of the 520-km mantle discontinuity into a secondary reflector near 560 km beneath slabs and plumes requires a 2–4% shear-wave impedance contrast, which standard silicate phase-transition models cannot explain given davemaoite's low shear velocity. This study conducts high pressure-temperature multi-anvil experiments (20 GPa, 1200–1600 °C) on mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB) glasses mixed with 10 and 50 wt.% CaCO3 at varying Fe contents (XFe = 0.19 and 0.45). Results reveal that carbonate addition drives Ca-Mg exchange between carbonate and silicate phases, transferring Ca into garnet and dramatically increasing davemaoite (CaSiO3) exsolution, especially under Fe-rich conditions. This process yields 12–33(2) vol.% davemaoite near 560 km depth, generating a modeled shear-wave impedance contrast of 2.0–4.0(2)% that matches seismic observations. The findings establish a direct mineralogical link between deep carbon cycling, chemical stratification, and mantle transition zone seismic discontinuities.

sum: This study analyzes four months of continuous seismic data from two stations near the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence using hierarchical clustering on deep scattering coefficients. To mitigate strong class imbalance from anthropogenic noise, the authors introduce three refinement strategies, including defining latent-space geometry using nighttime data. The unsupervised single-station approach successfully detects several localized, swarm-like seismic episodes preceding the Mw 6.4 foreshock on July 4, 2019. These weak events are absent from the standard reference catalog, suggesting localized, possibly off-fault seismicity. The work demonstrates that unsupervised single-station analysis can effectively complement traditional network-based earthquake catalogs for detecting weak seismicity.

sum: This paper investigates the impact of elevated sea levels on global seismicity. By analyzing global earthquake catalogs and sea-level data, the study aims to understand how ocean loading and unloading processes influence stress changes along coastal and submarine fault zones. The research addresses a critical gap in environmental seismology, exploring whether climate-induced sea-level rise could modulate tectonic activity and alter seismic hazards on a global scale.

sum: Subvolcanic magmatic brine lenses are promising targets for both geothermal energy and critical metals, yet distinguishing them geophysically from partial melt and hydrothermal clay caps is challenging. This study applies a nonlinear 3D joint inversion of 7,112 P- and 1,376 S-wave arrival times and hypocenters from 1,039 local volcano-tectonic events at Soufrière Hills Volcano, Montserrat. Using finite-frequency Fresnel volume kernels, cross-gradient structural constraints, and direct sparse solvers for full resolution matrix evaluation, the authors derive the first compatible VP, VS, and VP/VS models of the island. They identify a pronounced high VP/VS (≳2) anomaly at 1.8–2.5 km depth beneath the volcanic edifice that correlates with elevated VP (~4 km/s) and active brittle seismicity, pointing to a hypersaline magmatic brine lens rather than melt. Shallower high VP/VS zones match known geothermal clay caps, while a deeper anomaly (>4 km) marks the top of the andesitic magma reservoir.

sum: This computational study investigates the effect of off-fault Mohr-Coulomb plasticity on the propagation speed of elongated, width-limited strike-slip earthquake ruptures. Using a 2.5D (width-averaged) modeling approach, the authors show that off-fault inelastic deformation prevents rupture acceleration to theoretical limits, instead stabilizing steady pulse-like ruptures at speeds between 6.5% and 99% of the Rayleigh wave speed. A systematic parametric study characterizes how these steady speeds depend on initial fault stress, proximity to plastic failure, and seismogenic zone width. The findings demonstrate that off-fault plasticity is a viable mechanism for explaining realistic earthquake rupture velocities (including slow tsunami earthquakes) on planar faults with homogeneous stress, while providing insights into pulse width, peak slip velocity, and inelastic zone width.
本研究利用2.5维建模探讨了断层外莫尔-库仑塑性对有限宽度走滑地震破裂速度的影响。结果表明，断层外非弹性变形限制了破裂加速，使稳定脉冲状破裂速度保持在雷利波速的6.5%至99%之间，符合实际地震及海啸地震的观测。该模型揭示了破裂速度对初始应力和发震宽度的依赖性，证明断层外塑性是解释现实破裂速度的有效……

sum: This study addresses the inconsistency between seismic and tsunami hazard assessments by systematically quantifying epistemic uncertainties in ground-motion simulations derived from kinematic rupture models. Using the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake in Chile as a test case, the authors evaluate the impact of kinematic rupture parameters (rupture velocity, rise-time, hypocenter location) and 1D velocity models on simulated ground motions at eight stations. They find that adopting depth-dependent rupture velocities (0.3 Vs in the shallow domain <10 km, and 0.5 Vs at depths >15 km) significantly reduces bias and root mean square error. Rupture velocity is identified as the primary parameter controlling ground-motion variability, with regional velocity models providing a better fit to observations in the 0.5–3 Hz frequency band. This work establishes a physically consistent source representation for future integrated seismic-tsunami hazard assessments.
本研究量化了运动学破裂模型地面运动模拟中的认知不确定性。以2015年智利Mw 8.3地震为例，评估了破裂速度和上升时间等参数的影响。结果表明，采用随深度变化的破裂速度（浅部0.3Vs，深部0.5Vs）能显著降低模拟偏差，破裂速度是控制地面运动变率的关键。该工作为地震-海啸联合灾害评估奠定了物理一致的……

sum: This paper presents a novel prestack migration method for visco-acoustic VTI media by integrating the De Wolf renormalization scattering series approximation. To overcome the limitations of the classical Born approximation under strong forward accumulative effects, the authors renormalize the Born series and establish its integral representation for visco-acoustic VTI media. Using a thin-slab approximation, they divide the velocity model into background and perturbation parameters, constructing dual-domain (frequency-wavenumber and frequency-space) screen migration operators. Tests on the synthetic Overthrust and Hess models demonstrate that the proposed operator effectively compensates for amplitude attenuation and corrects anisotropic effects, yielding migration images with higher signal-to-noise ratio and resolution compared to conventional methods.

sum: Uncertainties in the thermoelastic properties and phase transitions of CaSiO₃ davemaoite have hindered linking seismic observations to lower-mantle mineralogy. Here, the authors combine Brillouin spectroscopy with resistively heated diamond anvil cell experiments to measure shear-wave velocities of davemaoite up to 80 GPa and 973 K. They constrain the tetragonal-to-cubic transition boundary to 533(11) K at 0 GPa with a Clapeyron slope of 2.4(4) K/GPa, showing cubic davemaoite is stable below 900 K across the entire lower mantle and ruling out transition-related softening in LLSVPs. Fitting a third-order Eulerian finite-strain equation of state reveals a small shear modulus pressure derivative (G₀' = 1.44), leading to 13.7–16.7% slower Vs than PREM along a mantle geotherm. Because compensating for even 7 vol.% davemaoite requires an implausible ~20 vol.% increase in bridgmanite in the deep mantle, davemaoite is likely depleted in the ambient mantle and concentrated in LLSVPs via magma-ocean differentiation.
本研究结合布里渊光谱与电阻加热金刚石压腔技术，测量了高达80 GPa和973 K下CaSiO₃毛河光矿的横波速度。实验确定其四方-立方相变边界在整个下地幔均低于900 K，排除了相变软化导致大型低剪切波速省（LLSVPs）异常的假说。热弹性拟合表明立方相毛河光矿的剪切模量压力导数较小（G₀'=1.4……

sum: This dataset contains a high-resolution relocated seismicity catalog of 25,227 earthquakes in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo (CSK) volcanic region of the Aegean Sea, spanning January 2024 to April 2025. Accompanying a Science Advances publication, the catalog was constructed using waveform cross-correlation to achieve precise hypocentral locations. The spatial-temporal evolution of these events reveals a cascading sequence of magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting facilitated by elastic stress transfer. This dataset provides critical observational constraints on the interaction between magmatic systems and tectonic faults in active volcanic arcs.

sum: Subduction zones commonly experience oblique convergence, yet how trench-parallel strain partitions between megathrust slip and upper-plate faulting remains unclear. Combining global slab geometry (Slab2), plate motions (GSRM), and 10,383 earthquake focal mechanisms (GCMT, 1976–2020), the authors demonstrate that ~68% of megathrust earthquakes (~82% of M7+ events) slip less obliquely than plate convergence, but rarely purely normal to the trench (averaging 10°–30°). To explain this, they formulate an analytical tectonic work-minimization model linking slab dip, effective shear resistance ratio (R) between the megathrust and upper-plate strike-slip faults, and slip obliquity. The model predicts a dip-dependent upper bound and an optimal slip obliquity that match global observations across 14 subduction margins and correlate with b-value stress proxies. This framework revises classical threshold views of strain partitioning and demonstrates that end-member assumptions can bias earthquake recurrence interval estimates by tens of percent.
针对俯冲带斜交汇聚应变如何在巨型逆冲断层与上盘走滑断层间分配的问题，本文结合Slab2俯冲几何、GSRM板块运动和GCMT震源机制（10,383个事件），发现约68%的逆冲地震（约82%的M7+事件）滑动斜交角小于板块汇聚角，但也极少垂直海沟（平均10°–30°）。作者建立了构造功最小化解析模型，证……

t: The authors formulate an analytic tectonic work-minimization model comparing mechanical work on coupled megathrust and upper-plate strike-slip faults to derive a dip-dependent slip obliquity limit and optimal slip angle.
建立耦合巨型逆冲与上盘走滑断层的构造功最小化解析模型，推导受倾角控制的滑动斜交上限与最优角。
The study combines the GCMT earthquake catalog (1976–2020; 10,383 filtered interface thrust events across 14 margins), Slab2 subduction geometry, and GSRM v2.1 plate motion models.
结合GCMT地震目录（1976-2020年14个俯冲带10,383个事件）、Slab2几何模型与GSRM板块运动模型。

Across 14 margins, ~68% of 10,383 megathrust earthquakes (~81.7% of M7+ and 81.8% of M8+) slip less obliquely than plate convergence, with segment-averaged slip obliquities of 10°–30° following dip-dependent work-minimization predictions.
14个俯冲带中约68%的逆冲地震（81.7%的M7+事件）滑动斜交角小于汇聚角，均值10°-30°且符合倾角预测。
The model assumes identical brittle-ductile transition depths for both faults, geometric area scaling with dip, and omits dynamic rupture complexity and local stress heterogeneities.
假设两断层脆韧性转换深度相同且面积按倾角缩放，忽略了动态破裂复杂性与局部异质性。

Revises classical threshold strain-partitioning models by establishing a quantitative work-minimization framework showing that slab dip and fault resistance ratio jointly limit megathrust slip obliquity.
修正了传统临界角模型，提出功最小化定量框架，揭示俯冲倾角与阻力比共同限制滑动斜交角。

kc: Demonstrates globally that megathrust earthquakes consistently slip less obliquely than plate convergence (68% of all events, 82% of M7+), but rarely trench-normal (typically 10°–30°).

Develops an analytical work-minimization model predicting a slab-dip-dependent upper bound (beta_rb = 2*arctan(sin(phi)/R)) and optimal direction (alpha_o = arcsin(sin(phi)/R)) for megathrust slip obliquity.
Estimates population-level effective shear resistance ratios (R#) across 14 global subduction zones, showing first-order consistency with independent b-value differential stress proxies.

Illustrates how common end-member slip assumptions (purely orthogonal or unpartitioned) can bias megathrust slip-deficit and earthquake recurrence estimates by tens of percent (e.g., up to 33% in Cascadia).
揭示了全球巨型逆冲地震的滑动斜交角普遍小于板块汇聚角（占全部事件的68%，M7+事件的82%），但极少完全垂直于海沟（通常为10°–30°）。
建立了构造功最小化解析模型，预测了受控于俯冲板片倾角和断层阻力比的巨型逆冲滑动斜交上限与最优滑动方向。
估算了全球14个俯冲带的群体有效剪切阻力比（R#），并与基于地震b值独立推导的差应力比展现出一阶一致性。
阐明了传统的端元滑动假设（完全正交或完全不分配）会导致巨型逆冲断层滑动亏损和复发周期估算产生数十个百分点的偏差（如Cascadia可达33%）。
me: Kinematic slip vector and obliquity analysis combining GCMT focal mechanisms, Slab2 interface geometry, and GSRM v2.1 geodetic plate motion models with dip projection corrections.
Analytical tectonic work-minimization modeling of coupled megathrust and upper-plate strike-slip fault systems for both discrete end-members and continuous partial partitioning.
Grid-search optimization in normalized resistance-ratio space (R_alpha, R_beta) to estimate population-level effective fault strength ratios (R#) and 90% confidence intervals.

Independent differential stress ratio estimation using Gutenberg-Richter b-values (via Aki's maximum-likelihood method and Scholz's stress relation) with bootstrap and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
结合GCMT震源机制、Slab2断层几何与GSRM v2.1板块运动模型，进行包含倾角投影校正的运动学滑动矢量与斜交角分析。
针对耦合的巨型逆冲断层与上盘走滑断层系统，建立离散端元及连续部分应变分配的构造功最小化解析模型。
在归一化阻力比空间（R_alpha, R_beta）中利用网格搜索优化，估算群体水平的断层有效强度比（R#）及90%置信区间。
基于Gutenberg-Richter b值（结合Aki最大似然法与Scholz应力关系）及Bootstrap和蒙特卡洛不确定性传播，独立估算断层差应力比。

1976至2020年全球矩心矩张量（GCMT）地震目录（共56,830个事件，Mw >= 4.3），筛选出14个俯冲带浅部（<70 km）的10,383个板间逆冲地震事件。
Slab2全球俯冲带几何模型（包含深度、倾角、走向、厚度及深度不确定性）。

li: The analytical model assumes brittle-ductile transition depths and along-strike extents are identical for both megathrust and upper-plate strike-slip faults (A_S = A_T * sin(phi)).
Dynamic rupture complexities, aseismic deformation, fluid effects, and local structural heterogeneities (such as subducting seamounts) are not explicitly modeled.
The effective resistance ratio R# is a space- and time-averaged population parameter and cannot be interpreted as an instantaneous physical stress ratio for individual earthquakes.
解析模型假设巨型逆冲断层与上盘走滑断层的脆韧性转换深度及沿走向延伸长度相同（A_S = A_T * sin(phi)）。
未显式模拟动态破裂复杂性、无震形变、流体效应以及局部构造非均质性（如俯冲海山）。
有效阻力比R#是时空平均的群体参数，不能直接解释为单个地震的瞬时物理应力比。

The study analyzes slip vectors and focal mechanisms of over 10,000 global megathrust earthquakes to establish dip-dependent slip obliquity limits.
It links subduction slab geometry (dip) and oblique plate convergence to long-term forearc sliver deformation and terrane translation.

sum: This study generalizes the source correlation function in seismic interferometry to incorporate finite temporal and spatial correlations. Analytically evaluating their effects on cross-correlation waveforms, the authors show that finite temporal correlation induces frequency-dependent phase shifts and amplitude modifications. Notably, a parallel time shift (PTS) occurs at low frequencies, shifting both positive- and negative-lag waveforms in the same direction. Conversely, finite spatial correlation does not cause phase delays but attenuates and alters the amplitude structure. These findings provide a theoretical framework for interpreting seismic interferometry measurements under realistic, correlated noise source conditions.
本研究将地震干涉中的震源相关函数推广到有限时空相关性。解析评估表明，有限时间相关性会引起频变相位偏移和振幅修改，尤其在低频处产生使正负延迟波形同向移动的平行时间偏移（PTS）。相反，有限空间相关性不产生相位延迟，主要衰减并改变振幅结构。该成果为实际噪声源条件下的干涉测量提供了理论基础。

t: Analytical generalization of the seismic interferometry source correlation function to incorporate finite temporal and spatial correlations, evaluating their mathematical effects on cross-correlation waveforms.
解析推广地震干涉测量震源相关函数，引入有限时空相关性并评估其对互相关波形的影响。
Theoretical formulation and analytical modeling of wavefields under correlated source fluctuations; no physical seismic datasets were utilized.
相关震源扰动下波场的理论公式与解析模拟，未利用实际地震数据集。

Finite temporal correlation causes frequency-dependent phase shifts and low-frequency parallel time shifts (PTS), while finite spatial correlation primarily attenuates and modifies cross-correlation amplitudes.
有限时间相关引起频变相位偏移和低频平行时间偏移，而有限空间相关主要衰减和改变振幅。
The analysis is purely analytical and theoretical, lacking application to complex 3D heterogeneous media or real-world ambient noise data.
分析纯属理论与解析，缺乏在复杂三维非均匀介质或实际环境噪声数据中的应用。
First analytical formulation of seismic interferometry that simultaneously accounts for both finite temporal and spatial source correlations, identifying the parallel time shift effect.
首次同时考虑有限时间和空间震源相关性的地震干涉解析公式，并发现了平行时间偏移效应。

kc: Generalizes the seismic interferometry source correlation function to include both finite temporal and spatial correlations.
Discovers that finite temporal correlation causes frequency-dependent phase shifts and parallel time shifts (PTS) at low frequencies.
Demonstrates that finite spatial correlation primarily attenuates and modifies the amplitude structure without directly causing phase delays.
将地震干涉测量震源相关函数推广到包含有限时间和空间相关性的情况。
发现有限时间相关性会导致频变相位偏移，并在低频处引起平行时间偏移（PTS）。
证明了有限空间相关性主要衰减和修改振幅结构，而不直接引起相位延迟。

Mathematical modeling of wave propagation and cross-correlation under finite temporal and spatial source correlations.

sum: Conventional full-waveform inversion (FWI) in the acquisition domain entangles propagation and scattering effects, causing velocity-reflectivity crosstalk, poor Hessian conditioning, and cycle skipping. This paper presents a theoretical framework for elastic FWI in anisotropic media formulated directly in the Local-Angle-Domain (LAD) phase space, parameterized by spatial position, directional (illumination) angles, opening (scattering) angles, and local time lag via Local Directional Projection (LDP) signals. Because velocity perturbations dominate wide opening angles and low directional wavenumbers while impedance perturbations concentrate at small opening angles around specular directions, their phase-space sensitivity kernels are largely disjoint. The author derives a five-term composite objective function—incorporating opening-angle flattening, directional focusing, reflector-normal alignment, and total-variation regularizations—along with adjoint-state gradients and Gauss-Newton Hessians. Analytic and numerical benchmarks demonstrate that LAD-FWI drives the Hessian toward a block-diagonal structure, removes the velocity-depth condition number trade-off, and widens the basin of attraction against cycle skipping.
传统采集域全波形反演（FWI）将传播与散射效应混杂，导致速度与反射率串扰、海森矩阵病态及周期跳跃。本文提出了各向异性弹性介质中的局部角度域（LAD）相空间全波形反演理论框架，利用空间位置、传播方向角、散射张角及局部方向投影（LDP）时间延迟进行参数化。由于速度扰动集中在大张角和低波数区，而波阻抗扰动……

t: Formulates elastic FWI in an 8D Local-Angle-Domain phase space using Local Directional Projection signals, optimizing a five-term composite objective (flattening, focusing, alignment, and TV regularizations) via implicit adjoint-state gradients and Gauss-Newton Hessians.
利用局部方向投影信号在8维局部角度域相空间构建弹性FWI，通过隐式伴随梯度和高斯-牛顿海森算子优化五项复合目标。

Evaluated using three synthetic benchmarks in Appendix F: an analytic point diffractor in a constant-gradient medium, a 15° dipping planar reflector, and a 2D complex structural model with faulted stratigraphy and a salt body.
通过三个合成基准进行验证：常梯度介质中的解析点绕射体、15°倾斜反射界面，以及含断层和盐丘的二维复杂构造模型。
The LAD flatness objective remains quasi-convex over a ±15% velocity error range (vs. ±3% for data-domain FWI) and reduces the velocity-depth condition number from 269–20,000 down to exactly 1.
LAD拉平目标在±15%速度误差范围内保持准凸性，并将速度-深度条件数从数据域的269–20,000精确降低至1。

The study is purely theoretical and benchmark-based without field-data inversion examples, and its Born-linearized imaging operator cannot model multiply scattered events, which enter as coherent noise.
缺乏实际地震数据的反演测试；且玻恩线性化算子无法模拟多次散射波，使其作为相干噪声干扰反演。
Elevates Local-Angle-Domain phase space from an imaging diagnostic to the primary FWI domain, exploiting disjoint wavenumber supports of velocity and impedance to block-diagonalize the Hessian.
首次将局部角度域相空间直接作为FWI反演域，利用速度与阻抗的波数支撑分离特性实现海森矩阵块对角化。

kc: Formulates anisotropic elastic FWI directly in an 8D Local-Angle-Domain (LAD) and Local Directional Projection (LDP) phase-space-time representation.
Demonstrates that velocity and scalar log-impedance sensitivities occupy largely disjoint regions of phase space, driving the Gauss-Newton Hessian toward a block-diagonal form.
Derives a five-term composite objective function combining semblance flattening, directional focusing, data- vs. model-driven reflector normal alignment, and anisotropic TV regularization.
Establishes a resolution-driven phase-space continuation strategy and a five-criteria soft-gating scheme to discriminate multiply scattered energy under Born linearization.
在8维局部角度域（LAD）与局部方向投影（LDP）相空间-时间表征中直接构建了各向异性弹性全波形反演框架。
证明了速度与标量对数波阻抗的灵敏度在相空间占据基本分离的区域，使高斯-牛顿海森矩阵趋于块对角结构。
推导了结合相似性拉平、方向聚焦、数据与模型法向对齐以及各向异性全变分正则化的五项复合目标函数。
建立了基于分辨率驱动的相空间延拓策略，以及在玻恩线性化下识别压制多次散射能量的五准则软门控方案。
me: Local-Angle-Domain (LAD) wavefield decomposition into orthogonal directional (illumination) and opening (scattering) wavenumber vectors.
Local Directional Projection (LDP) wave-packet time signals to prevent wide-angle wavelet stretching.
Implicit adjoint-state gradient and Gauss-Newton Hessian derivations for a 5-term phase-space objective functional.
EigenRay/EigenWave finite-frequency beam specialization for explicit, sparse Gauss-Newton Hessian block assembly.
将波场分解为正交的方向（照明）波数矢量和张角（散射）波数矢量的局部角度域（LAD）分解法。
利用局部方向投影（LDP）波包时间信号消除大角度子波拉伸畸变。
针对五项相空间复合目标函数的隐式伴随状态梯度与高斯-牛顿海森算子推导。
利用EigenRay/EigenWave有限频射线束方法实现显式、稀疏的高斯-牛顿海森矩阵块组装。
de: Analytic Benchmark 1: Point diffractor at 2 km depth in a constant-velocity-gradient medium (V0 = 1.8 km/s, g = 0.6 s^-1) with offsets up to ±8 km.
Analytic Benchmark 2: Planar reflector dipping at 15° in a constant-gradient medium to test specularity, velocity-depth conditioning, and resolution.
Numerical Benchmark 3: 2D complex structural velocity model with 5 layers, a normal fault, and a high-velocity salt body (V = 4500 m/s) using 10 Hz Ricker wavelets.
解析基准测试1：常速度梯度介质（V0 = 1.8 km/s, g = 0.6 s^-1）中2 km深度的点绕射体，偏移距达±8 km。
解析基准测试2：常梯度介质中倾角15°的倾斜反射界面，用于测试镜面反射特性、速度-深度条件数及分辨率。
数值基准测试3：包含5个地层、正断层和高速盐丘（V = 4500 m/s）的二维复杂构造速度模型，采用10 Hz雷克子波合成数据。
li: The paper focuses on theoretical formulation and analytic/ray-based benchmarks, lacking full numerical inversion examples on 3D field datasets.
Under the Born single-scattering linearization, multiply scattered energy (surface and internal multiples) is not modeled and acts as coherent noise requiring gating.
The 7D/8D phase-space representation introduces substantial computational and storage overheads, requiring separation into reduced directional and opening-angle projections.
本文侧重于理论推导和解析/射线基准测试，缺乏在三维实际野外观测数据上的完整数值反演实例。
在玻恩单次散射线性化假设下，多次散射能量（自由表面和层间多次波）未被正演模拟，会作为相干噪声干扰反演，需额外门控压制。
7维/8维相空间表征带来了显著的计算与存储开销，需要将其分解降维为方向角和张角两个投影子集。

tm.why: The paper derives a generalized phase-space objective function, adjoint-state gradients, and Gauss-Newton Hessian operators for elastic full-waveform inversion.
The framework is explicitly formulated for anisotropic elastic media (e.g., TTI/VTI) to estimate anisotropic velocity parameters alongside impedance.
It provides rigorous mathematical analyses of Fréchet sensitivity kernels, Hessian block-diagonalization, model resolution matrices, and conditioning in phase space.

ev.notes: Full 80-page PDF (including main text Sections 1–12 and Appendices A–F) was analyzed in detail.

sum: While divergent boundaries and subducted spreading centers open slab windows that reorganize upper-mantle flow, their connection to deeper mantle convection remains poorly constrained. This study analyzes 20 years of teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions (42,746 waveforms from 469 events across 429 stations) in western Canada using 3D velocity-corrected common-conversion-point stacking and Kriging interpolation. Results reveal coherent downward deflections of both the 410 km (up to +16 km) and 660 km (up to +12 km) discontinuities across the Northern Cordilleran Slab Window, contrasting sharply with upward deflections beneath the adjacent craton. This double depression is attributed to a positive-Clapeyron-slope majorite-garnet to bridgmanite transition at 660 km, indicating mantle transition zone temperature anomalies of +100–300 K. Combined with 12 global tomographic models and Monte Carlo whole-mantle geotherm modeling (+150–200 K warmer lower mantle), the findings provide novel evidence that fossil slab windows act as conduits for lower-mantle heat supporting Cordilleran uplift.
本文利用加拿大西部429个台站20年的远震P-S接收函数数据（469个事件、42,746条波形），通过三维速度校正共转换点（CCP）叠加和克里金插值，反演了410和660公里地幔间断面地形。研究发现北科迪勒拉板片窗下方存在显著的d410（达+16 km）和d660（达+12 km）同步下凹，与相邻克……

t: Time-domain iterative deconvolution generates 42,746 P-to-S receiver functions, which are back-projected into a 3D grid using AK135 refined by regional model CAP22 for Common Conversion Point stacking, bootstrap uncertainty analysis, and Ordinary Kriging interpolation.
通过时域迭代反褶积计算42,746条接收函数，结合CAP22三维速度模型校正进行CCP叠加、自助法重采样与克里金插值。

Teleseismic waveforms from 429 broadband stations across 13 networks in western Canada, comprising 469 earthquakes (M 5.5–8, epicentral distances 30°–90°, SNR ≥ 2) recorded between 2003 and 2020 from NSF SAGE.
采用加拿大西部13个台网429个台站记录的2003–2020年间469个远震事件（M 5.5–8，震中距30°–90°）…

Both d410 and d660 show downward deflections up to +16 km and +12 km beneath the western Cordillera slab window, corresponding to +100–300 K MTZ temperature anomalies and +150–200 K warmer lower-mantle geotherms.
板片窗下方d410和d660分别下凹达+16 km和+12 km，指示转换带升温100–300 K，下地幔地温偏高150…

One-dimensional Monte Carlo geotherms neglect 3D non-adiabatic mantle convection, compositional effects and incomplete 3D velocity corrections may affect estimates, and seismic data alone cannot establish a causal geodynamic mechanism.
一维地温模型忽略了三维非绝热对流和成分效应，且仅凭地震观测无法确立直接的因果动力学机制。

First seismic constraints on the Cordilleran mantle transition zone demonstrating that a fossil slab window acts as a deep conduit linking lower-mantle heat supply to upper-mantle buoyancy and surface uplift.
首次通过转换带成像证明古板片窗可作为深部通道，将下地幔热源与上地幔浮力及造山带隆升直接联系起来。

kc: High-resolution topographic maps of the 410 km and 660 km discontinuities and mantle transition zone (MTZ) thickness across the Canadian Cordillera and adjacent craton.

Observation of coherent double depressions of d410 (~10–16 km) and d660 (~8–12 km) beneath the Northern Cordilleran Slab Window, interpreted via the positive Clapeyron slope of the post-garnet transition.

Quantitative thermal constraints showing +100–300 K anomalies in the MTZ and +150–200 K warmer lower mantle from joint analysis of discontinuity depths, 12 global tomography models, and Monte Carlo geotherms.
构建了横跨加拿大科迪勒拉造山带及邻近克拉通的410公里与660公里间断面深度及地幔转换带（MTZ）厚度的高分辨率分布图。
在北科迪勒拉板片窗下方观测到d410（约10–16 km）和d660（约8–12 km）的协同下凹，并用后石榴石相变的正克拉伯龙斜率进行了解释。
联合间断面深度、12个全球层析成像模型和蒙特卡洛地温模拟，定量约束了地幔转换带+100–300 K的温度异常以及比全球平均高150–200 K的下地幔热状态。
me: Time-domain iterative deconvolution (100 iterations, 0.02–0.25 Hz Butterworth filter) to compute teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions.
3D Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking corrected with the regional CAP22 P-wave velocity model, using 50-time bootstrap resampling and Ordinary Kriging interpolation.

Thermal anomaly estimation using mineral physics Clapeyron slopes (olivine-wadsleyite and majorite-bridgmanite), seismic velocity-to-temperature sensitivity coefficients across 12 tomography models, and 1D Monte Carlo whole-mantle geotherm modeling.
采用时域迭代反褶积方法（100次迭代，0.02–0.25 Hz巴特沃斯滤波）计算远震P-S接收函数。
结合区域CAP22纵波速度模型进行三维射线路径校正与共转换点（CCP）叠加，并采用50次自助法（bootstrap）重采样和普通克里金插值。
利用矿物物理克拉伯龙斜率（橄榄石-瓦兹利石和镁铁榴石-布里奇曼石）、12个层析成像模型的波速-温度经验敏感度系数以及一维蒙特卡洛全地幔地温模拟估算温度异常。
de: 42,746 high-quality teleseismic P-wave receiver functions recorded at 429 broadband seismic stations across 13 FDSN networks in western Canada from 469 earthquakes (Mw 5.5–8.0, 2003–2020, epicentral distance 30°–90°).
12 independent global seismic velocity models (with DETOX-P01 as the preferred reference and CAP22 for 3D raypath corrections).
2003至2020年间加拿大西部13个台网共429个宽频带地震台站记录的469次远震（震级5.5–8.0，震中距30°–90°）生成的42,746条高质量P波接收函数。
12个独立的全球地震波速层析成像模型（以DETOX-P01作为首选对比模型，以CAP22用于三维射线路径校正）。
li: Positive correlation between d410 and d660 depths could partially reflect incomplete correction of 3D seismic velocity variations.
Temperature conversions neglect compositional effects and suffer from the limited deep resolution of teleseismic tomography models.
1D Monte Carlo geotherm parameterization does not capture the 3D, non-adiabatic nature of mantle convection, and a direct causal mechanism cannot be established from seismic observations alone.
d410和d660深度之间的正相关可能部分反映了三维地震波速横向变化校正的不完全。
温度换算未考虑地幔成分变化的影响，且受限于深部层析成像模型有限的分辨率。
一维蒙特卡洛地温参数化未能完全刻画地幔对流的三维非绝热特性，仅凭现有观测无法确立直接的动力学因果机制。

tm.why: The core analysis relies on 20 years of teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions and 3D common-conversion-point (CCP) stacking to map the 410 and 660 km mantle discontinuities.
The study investigates mantle transition zone topography, thermal anomalies, and whole-mantle geotherms to link slab-window tectonism to lower-mantle heat supply and Cordilleran uplift.

sum: This study integrates petrological analyses (olivine chemical zoning and Fe-Mg diffusion chronometry), geochemical measurements (bulk plume SO2 flux via FLAME-DOAS), and geophysical monitoring (volcanic tremor RMS amplitude and 3D source centroid locations from 19 broadband stations) to investigate contrasting eruptive styles at Mt. Etna's South East Crater between March 2022 and August 2023. The period encompassed two prolonged effusive phases (May–June 2022 and November 2022–February 2023) and two paroxysmal lava fountains (May and August 2023). Results show that May 2022 effusions were driven by volatile-rich magma ascending to shallow depths (<2 km), whereas November 2022 effusions resulted from deeper recharges passively remobilizing degassed residual melts. Conversely, the 2023 paroxysmal eruptions were triggered by rapid ascent of primitive, volatile-rich magmas (Fo80–86) from deep reservoirs (>9 km). Linking crystal diffusion timescales with real-time geophysical and geochemical signals successfully resolves the interplay between deep and shallow magmatic plumbing.
本研究综合岩石学（橄榄石化学分带与Fe-Mg扩散年代学）、地球化学（FLAME-DOAS测量的SO2通量）和地球物理监测（19个宽频带台站的火山颤动RMS振幅及三维源质心定位），研究了2022年3月至2023年8月埃特纳火山东南火山口截然不同的喷发动力学。研究期包含两次溢流相和2023年两次猛烈熔岩……

t: 1D finite-difference Fe-Mg diffusion modeling of zoned olivines is integrated with FLAME-DOAS SO2 flux measurements, 5-minute seismic RMS amplitudes (0.5–2.5 Hz), and 3D volcanic tremor source locations via amplitude-decay grid search.
将分带橄榄石一维有限差分Fe-Mg扩散模拟与DOAS的SO2通量、地震RMS振幅及基于振幅衰减网格搜索的三维颤动源定位相…

36 olivine crystals (25 modeled) from SEC lavas and tephra (May 2022–August 2023), continuous seismic recordings from 19 broadband INGV stations (including ESPC), and daily SO2 fluxes from 9 FLAME-DOAS spectrometers.
2022年5月至2023年8月SEC熔岩和火山碎屑中的36颗橄榄石晶体、19个宽频带台站地震记录及9台DOAS光谱仪日均…

Olivine cores cluster into Fo72–73, Fo75–78, and Fo80–83. Effusive lavas record 8–10 month and 1–2 month residence times; 2023 paroxysms emitted Fo82–83 crystals with 3–8 month timescales, correlating with tremor peaks up to 7×10^-6 m/s and SO2 up to 11,400 t/d.
橄榄石核部分为三组；溢流熔岩记录8-10个月和1-2个月滞留时间，2023猛烈喷发含Fo82-83晶体（3-8个月），与…
Slow Fe-Mg interdiffusion in olivine cannot resolve rapid magma ascent occurring over hours to days, and UV spectroscopy cannot measure nighttime syn-eruptive SO2 emissions (e.g., 13 August 2023).
橄榄石Fe-Mg扩散较慢无法分辨数小时至数天的快速岩浆上升，且紫外光谱无法测量夜间喷发的SO2排放。

Links petrological Fe-Mg diffusion chronometry with continuous volcanic tremor location/amplitude and SO2 flux to decipher the transition from long-lived effusive phases to paroxysmal lava fountaining at Mt. Etna during 2022–2023.
将橄榄石扩散年代学与火山颤动定位/振幅及SO2通量结合，解析了2022-2023年埃特纳火山从溢流向猛烈喷泉转换的机制。

kc: Reconstructed the timeline of magma intrusion and remobilization at Mt. Etna during 2022–2023 using 1D Fe-Mg diffusion modeling on 25 zoned olivine crystals.
Demonstrated strong temporal correlation between petrologically derived magma recharge episodes, volcanic tremor amplitude/source depth variations, and plume SO2 flux.

Distinguished mechanisms driving effusive eruptions (shallow storage replenishment and passive degassed melt remobilization) versus paroxysmal lava fountains (rapid ascent of deep Fo80–86 volatile-rich magma from >9 km).
利用25颗分带橄榄石晶体的一维Fe-Mg扩散模拟，重建了2022-2023年埃特纳火山岩浆侵入和活化的时间线。
证实了岩石学推导的岩浆补给事件与火山颤动振幅/震源深度变化及羽流SO2通量之间存在很强的时间相关性。
区分了驱动溢流喷发（浅部储层补给和被动脱气熔体活化）与猛烈熔岩喷泉（来自>9 km深部Fo80-86富挥发分岩浆的快速上升）的不同机制。
me: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM-EDS/WDS) and conoscopic optical microscopy to measure core-to-rim olivine Fo compositional profiles and crystallographic orientations.
1D finite-difference modeling of anisotropy-corrected Fe-Mg diffusion in olivine under isothermal and non-isothermal incremental step conditions to estimate magma residence timescales.
Volcanic tremor characterization using 5-minute RMS amplitudes (0.5–2.5 Hz) at station ESPC and 3D source centroid location via spatial amplitude decay grid search across 19 seismic stations.
Daylight bulk plume SO2 mass emission rate retrieval using the 9-station FLAME-DOAS ultraviolet scanning spectrometer network.
利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM-EDS/WDS）和锥光光学显微镜测量橄榄石核部到边缘的Fo成分剖面及结晶学取向。
在等温和非等温增量步长条件下，对橄榄石中各向异性校正的Fe-Mg扩散进行一维有限差分模拟，以估算岩浆滞留时间尺度。
利用ESPC台站5分钟时间窗的RMS振幅（0.5-2.5 Hz）表征火山颤动，并通过19个地震台站的空间振幅衰减网格搜索确定三维颤动源质心位置。
利用由9个台站组成的FLAME-DOAS紫外扫描光谱仪网络反演日间羽流SO2质量排放率。
de: 36 olivine crystals analyzed (25 modeled for diffusion) from quenched lava and tephra samples erupted at the South East Crater between May 2022 and August 2023.
Continuous seismic waveforms from 45 broadband 3-component INGV stations (100 Hz sampling), utilizing ESPC for tremor RMS amplitude and 19 stations (1–9 km from summit) for source location.
Daily averaged plume SO2 flux time series from 9 FLAME-DOAS ultraviolet scanning spectrometers located ~14 km from the summit craters.
采集自2022年5月至2023年8月东南火山口喷发的淬火熔岩和火山碎屑样品中的36颗橄榄石晶体（其中25颗用于扩散模拟）。
来自45个INGV宽频带三分量台站（100 Hz采样率）的连续地震波形，使用ESPC台站计算颤动RMS振幅，并使用距离山顶1-9 km的19个台站进行震源定位。
来自距离山顶火山口约14 km的9台FLAME-DOAS紫外扫描光谱仪的日均羽流SO2通量时间序列。
li: Fe-Mg interdiffusion in olivine is relatively slow and cannot resolve very rapid pre-eruptive magma mixing or ascent occurring over hours to a few days.
The FLAME-DOAS ultraviolet spectroscopy network requires daylight, preventing the detection of syn-eruptive SO2 emissions during the nighttime 13–14 August 2023 lava fountain.
Diffusion timescales represent maximum estimates because the modeling assumes observed zoning profiles originated solely by diffusion.
橄榄石中的Fe-Mg互扩散相对较慢，无法分辨在数小时至数天内发生的极快速喷发前岩浆混合或上升过程。
FLAME-DOAS紫外光谱网络需要日光条件，导致无法探测2023年8月13-14日夜间熔岩喷泉喷发同期的SO2排放。
扩散时间尺度代表最大估计值，因为模型假设观测到的分带剖面完全由扩散作用产生。

tm.why: The paper tracks magma dynamics at Mt. Etna using volcanic tremor amplitude and source location integrated with SO2 flux and olivine crystal chemistry.

sum: This Zenodo archive provides the complete set of model input files, geometry files, frictional parameters, and simulated event catalogues (including event time, magnitude, and location) required to reproduce the results of the study 'Single Fault Earthquake Cycle Complexity' by Sun and Becker (2026). The simulations were conducted using the quasi-dynamic boundary element code HBI. This dataset enables researchers to explore the frictional and geometric controls on earthquake cycle complexity and recurrence statistics.
该Zenodo归档提供了重现Sun和Becker（2026）发表的《单断层地震周期复杂性》研究所需的完整模型输入文件、几何文件、摩擦参数和模拟地震事件目录（包括时间、震级和位置）。模拟采用准动态边界元代码HBI进行。该数据集使研究人员能够深入探索摩擦和几何参数对地震周期复杂性及复发统计规律的控制作用……

t: Quasi-dynamic boundary element modeling of single-fault earthquake cycles using the HBI code.
使用HBI代码对单断层地震周期进行准动态边界元模拟。
Synthetic event catalogues containing event times, magnitudes, and locations, along with geometry and frictional parameter files.
包含事件时间、震级和位置的合成事件目录，以及几何和摩擦参数文件。
A comprehensive dataset mapping model parameters to earthquake cycle complexity and recurrence statistics.

The dataset is entirely synthetic and limited by the quasi-dynamic physical approximations of the HBI code.
数据集完全是合成的，受限于HBI代码的准动态物理近似。
Provides a fully reproducible suite of single-fault earthquake cycle simulations with varying frictional and geometric parameters.
提供了一套完全可重现的、具有不同摩擦和几何参数的单断层地震周期模拟数据。

Includes simulated event catalogues detailing event times, magnitudes, and locations.
Offers a summary spreadsheet mapping models to specific figures and recurrence statistics.
提供了配套论文中所有模型的完整几何和摩擦参数文件。

sum: This study investigates temporal variations in P-wave velocity within Earth's liquid outer core from 1977 to 1995 using short-period PKP and PP waves generated by French Polynesian underground nuclear tests and recorded at station BRVK in Kazakhstan. Using AxiSEM synthetics and SPECFEM adjoint finite-frequency sensitivity kernels, the author identifies a previously unrecognized first-arriving PKP phase at ~141.6° distance as an internal reflection caused by the outer-core velocity gradient, naming it PKrKP. Multi-taper double-differential traveltime measurements (PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP) across 112 event pairs eliminate clock and origin-time errors. Least-squares inversions with temporal smoothing reveal that outer-core PKP traveltimes were 0.1–0.15 s faster during 1982–1983 and 1988–1990, and 0.15–0.2 s slower in 1995 relative to 1977. These rapid 2–5 year fluctuations over a >700 km lateral region provide novel observational evidence of vigorous mixing of light elements or suspended solids in the shallow outer core.
本研究利用哈萨克斯坦BRVK台站记录的1977–1995年法属波利尼西亚地下核试验激发的短周期PKP和PP波，探测地球液态外核P波速度的时间变化。通过AxiSEM合成地震图和SPECFEM伴随有限频灵敏度核计算，作者首次将约141.6°震中距处的初至PKP震相识别为外核速度梯度引起的内反射波，命名为……

t: Computes SPECFEM adjoint finite-frequency sensitivity kernels to identify the PKrKP phase, measures multi-taper PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP double-differential traveltimes at 0.8 Hz, and applies temporally smoothed least-squares linear inversions to solve for outer-core traveltime evolution.
计算SPECFEM伴随有限频灵敏度核识别PKrKP震相，用多窗谱法测0.8Hz双差走时，经时间平滑最小二乘反演外核走时演…

Short-period digital seismograms (0.3–1 Hz) at station BRVK in Kazakhstan from 23 underground nuclear tests at Mururoa (1977–1995), forming 112 pairs with epicentral distance differences <0.05° and 19 pairs separated by <2 km.
哈萨克斯坦BRVK台记录的1977-1995年23次Mururoa地下核试验短周期波形，组成112对震中距差<0.05°…
Relative to 1977, PKrKP outer-core traveltimes were ~0.1 s faster in 1982–1983, 0.15–0.2 s faster in 1988–1990, and 0.15–0.2 s slower in 1995, consistent across both PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP inversions.
Observations between 1990 and 1995 are sparsely constrained due to a 1992–1994 testing hiatus, and traveltimes cannot uniquely separate anomaly amplitude from thickness in the outer core.
1992-1994年暂停核试验导致1990-1995年间约束较弱；走时数据无法唯一区分异常体速度幅度与厚度。

Discovers the finite-frequency internal outer-core reflection phase PKrKP and uses pinpoint nuclear test sources to avoid earthquake mislocation errors, revealing rapid 2–5 year outer-core velocity changes.
发现外核有限频内反射新震相PKrKP，并利用高定位精度核试验源消除地震定位误差，揭示外核2-5年尺度的快速变化。

kc: Identifies a previously unrecognized seismic phase (PKrKP) arising from finite-frequency internal reflection within the mid-outer core velocity gradient.
Establishes a high-precision time series of outer-core P-wave traveltime perturbations from 1977 to 1995 using nuclear test double-differential traveltimes.
Demonstrates rapid 0.1–0.2 s traveltime changes over 2–5 year timescales across a >700 km region in the shallow outer core, indicating vigorous fluid mixing.
识别出一种此前未被认识的、由外核中部速度梯度引起的有限频内反射震相（PKrKP）。
利用核试验双差走时建立了1977至1995年间外核P波走时扰动的高精度时间序列。
证实浅部外核在大于700公里区域内存在2–5年尺度、0.1–0.2秒的快速走时变化，表明外核流体混合剧烈。
me: Finite-frequency traveltime sensitivity kernel computation using the SPECFEM adjoint method and 1-D high-frequency synthetic waveform modeling via AxiSEM.
Multi-taper cross-spectral differential traveltime measurements at 0.8 Hz (1.25 s period) using three 1.5-pi Slepian tapers to form PKrKP-PP and PKiKP-PP double differences.
Regularized least-squares linear inversion with temporal smoothing to reconstruct year-by-year outer-core P-wave traveltime anomalies.
使用SPECFEM伴随方法计算有限频走时灵敏度核，并通过AxiSEM进行一维高频合成波形模拟。
在0.8 Hz（周期1.25秒）处使用三个1.5-pi Slepian窗进行多窗谱差分走时测量，构建PKrKP-PP和PKiKP-PP双差走时。
采用带时间平滑正则化的最小二乘线性反演，重建逐年外核P波走时异常。
de: Digital vertical seismograms recorded at station BRVK (Kazakhstan) from 23 qualified underground nuclear explosions at Mururoa (French Polynesia) between 1977 and 1995.
Two event-pair datasets: 112 pairs with differential epicentral distances < 0.05° (plus a 55-pair subset < 0.02°) and 19 pairs with catalog separation distances < 2 km.
3-D SPECFEM numerical wave propagation experiments testing the diffractional effects of cylindrical crustal P-wave anomalies (radii 3 to 30 km) on overlapping PP Fresnel zones.
哈萨克斯坦BRVK台站记录的1977至1995年间法属波利尼西亚Mururoa试验场23次合格地下核爆炸的数字地震记录。
两个事件对数据集：震中距差小于0.05°的112对事件（含小于0.02°的55对子集），以及目录间距小于2公里的19对事件。
三维SPECFEM数值波传播实验，测试不同半径（3至30公里）圆柱状地壳P波高速异常对重叠PP波菲涅尔带的衍射效应。
li: Temporal variations between 1990 and 1995 are less well constrained due to a reduced number of qualified events and a testing hiatus from 1992 to 1994.
Traveltime observations cannot uniquely resolve the trade-off between the velocity perturbation amplitude and the depth thickness of the outer-core anomaly.
Station clock timing discrepancies around 1995 (during transition to GPS clocks) corrupt absolute PP traveltimes, requiring strict reliance on double-differential measurements.
由于合格事件数量减少以及1992–1994年间的核试验暂停，1990至1995年间的走时变化约束较弱。
走时观测无法唯一确定外核异常体的速度扰动幅度与深度厚度之间的折衷关系。
1995年前后台站向GPS时钟过渡导致的钟差影响了PP波绝对走时，必须依赖双差走时测量来消除。

tm.why: The paper measures double-differential travel times of body waves (PKrKP, PKiKP, PP) and applies least-squares linear inversions to resolve temporal P-wave velocity perturbations in the outer core.
The author uses the SPECFEM adjoint method to compute finite-frequency traveltime sensitivity kernels to identify a new outer-core phase (PKrKP) and analyze wave diffraction.
The study investigates deep Earth structure and dynamics, specifically transient P-wave velocity variations and vigorous convective mixing in the Earth's liquid outer core.
