sum: The authors develop a fully coupled structural and thermal evolution model for super-Earth exoplanets (1-10 Earth masses) within the PROTEUS framework. They find that in volatile-poor super-Earths, the silicate interior contracts by approximately 10% of its molten radius during cooling and crystallization, a process driven by the thinning silicate shell and largely independent of planet mass. Conversely, in volatile-rich super-Earths (at and above 5 Earth masses), thick outgassed atmospheres act as thermal blankets, throttling surface heat loss and maintaining a deep magma ocean, which limits contraction to about half of the volatile-poor value. This work highlights how mantle contraction and atmospheric coupling shape the transit radii of low-mass exoplanets.
本文在PROTEUS框架下开发了超级地球结构与热演化的全耦合模型。研究表明，在贫挥发分的1-10倍地球质量超级地球中，硅酸盐内部在冷却结晶过程中会收缩约10%，这由硅酸盐壳变薄驱动。相反，富挥发分的超级地球（≥5倍地球质量）因厚大气层阻碍表面散热而维持深层岩浆洋，使收缩量减半。该发现提示地幔收缩显著……

t: A fully coupled structural and thermal evolution model for super-Earths within the PROTEUS framework, integrating interior structure, mantle energetics, and volatile outgassing.
在PROTEUS框架下，整合内部结构、地幔能量学和挥发分外排气的超级地球全耦合结构与热演化模型。
Numerical simulations of volatile-poor and volatile-rich super-Earths ranging from 1 to 10 Earth masses.
对1至10倍地球质量的贫挥发分和富挥发分超级地球进行数值模拟。
Silicate interiors of volatile-poor super-Earths contract by ~10% during crystallization, whereas volatile-rich planets (≥5 Earth masses) experience throttled cooling, limiting contraction to ~5%.
贫挥发分超级地球的硅酸盐内部在结晶时收缩约10%，而富挥发分行星（≥5倍地球质量）的冷却受阻，收缩限制在约5%。
The study is limited to 1D coupled thermal-structural evolution models, which may simplify 3D mantle convection and heterogeneous crystallization processes.
研究局限于一维耦合热-结构演化模型，可能简化了三维地幔对流和非均匀结晶过程。
First to demonstrate that mantle contraction alone significantly shapes the low-mass exoplanet transit population through coupled interior-atmosphere evolution.
首次证明地幔收缩本身通过耦合的内部-大气演化显著塑造了低质量系外行星的凌日观测群体。

kc: Developed a fully coupled structural and thermal evolution model for super-Earths within the PROTEUS framework.
Demonstrated that volatile-poor super-Earths contract by ~10% of their molten radius during crystallization.
Showed that thick outgassed atmospheres on volatile-rich super-Earths (≥5 Earth masses) can prevent solidification and limit contraction.
在PROTEUS框架下开发了超级地球结构与热演化的全耦合模型。
证明了贫挥发分超级地球在结晶过程中其熔融半径会收缩约10%。
表明富含挥发分的超级地球（≥5倍地球质量）上厚厚的外排气层会阻止固化并限制收缩。
me: Coupled interior structure, mantle energetics, and volatile outgassing modeling within the PROTEUS framework.
在PROTEUS框架内进行内部结构、地幔能量学和挥发分外排气的耦合模拟。
de: Numerical simulations of 1 to 10 Earth-mass planets with varying volatile contents and atmospheric couplings.
对1至10倍地球质量、具有不同挥发分含量和大气耦合的行星进行数值模拟。
li: The model's reliance on simplified 1D thermal and structural evolution assumptions for complex multi-phase planetary interiors.
该模型对复杂多相行星内部采用了简化的一维热与结构演化假设。

tm.why: The paper models the structural and thermal evolution of super-Earth exoplanet interiors, focusing on planetary geophysics.
It investigates the cooling, crystallization, and contraction of the silicate mantle in super-Earths.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata of the paper, as no PDF was available.

sum: Subtle linear depressions on low-relief carbonate platforms are often misinterpreted as fluvial or tectonic landforms. This study investigates five kilometre-scale, shallow (<9 m deep), sediment-filled trenches on the Nullarbor Plain, southern Australia, by integrating digital elevation model morphometrics, electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), passive seismic Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) profiling, drone photogrammetry, sedimentology, and U-Th dating. Results show that the trenches lack integrated drainage and instead overlie vertically extensive (>30–70 m) low-resistivity zones and reduced seismic velocity zones indicative of fractured rock and sediment infill above collapsed deep cave conduits. Coastal cliff exposures and collapse dolines like Clay Dam Cave directly confirm sagging strata and subsurface voids beneath the trenches. A west-to-east transition from discontinuous dolines to continuous trenches reflects carbonate thickness variations (250 m to 110 m). This establishes diagnostic criteria for recognizing subdued cave-collapse systems on Earth and rocky planetary surfaces like Mars and Titan.
低起伏碳酸盐台地上的微弱线性洼地常被误认为河流或构造地貌。本研究结合地形形态计量学、电阻率层析成像（ERT）、被动源地震水平与垂直谱比法（HVSR）、无人机摄影测量、沉积学和铀系测年，研究了澳大利亚南部纳拉伯平原上五条公里级、浅层（<9米）、沉积物充填的沟槽。结果表明这些沟槽缺乏完整水系，位于垂向延……

t: The authors integrate DEM morphometrics, 2D Wenner-array electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), passive seismic HVSR ambient-noise profiling, UAV photogrammetry, XRD mineralogy, and U-Th dating to characterize subsurface structures beneath linear surface trenches.
综合DEM形态测量、二维温纳装置电阻率层析成像、被动源地震HVSR、无人机摄影测量与铀系测年分析沟槽下方结构。

Data comprise TanDEM-X DEMs, drone imagery, borehole logs, 2D ERT profiles, 20-minute 3-component Tromino ambient-noise recordings, cave sediment samples, and coastal cliff observations across five Nullarbor Plain trench systems.
包含纳拉伯平原五条沟槽系统的TanDEM-X地形、钻孔、二维ERT剖面、三分量环境噪声记录及洞穴沉积物样品。

Five NNW-SSE trenches (7–28 km long, 100–500 m wide, <9 m deep) overlie low-resistivity zones (>30–70 m deep) and depressed seismic boundaries, confirming upward-propagating collapse above deep caves rather than fluvial incision.
五条长7-28公里、深<9米的沟槽下方存在深达30-70米以上的低阻带与低速带，证实其源于深部洞穴向上坍塌。
Dry, insulated ground limits ERT effectiveness unless measured after rainfall, and frequent strong winds introduce high-frequency (>25 Hz) noise into passive seismic HVSR data.
干燥地表限制ERT接地需雨后测量，且强风易在HVSR数据中引入>25 Hz高频噪声。

Establishes the first comprehensive geophysical and geomorphic diagnostic criteria for recognizing subdued, sediment-filled deep cave-collapse trenches on arid terrestrial carbonate platforms and rocky planetary surfaces.
首次建立干旱碳酸盐台地隐伏深部洞穴坍塌沟槽的地球物理与地貌诊断标准，可作为行星类比。

kc: Demonstrates that kilometre-scale shallow linear trenches on the Nullarbor Plain are surface expressions of upward-propagating deep cave collapse rather than palaeo-fluvial channels.
Combines 2D Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) and passive seismic HVSR with cave records and cliff exposures to image vertically extensive collapse and sediment-infill zones.
Establishes a chronological developmental framework linking carbonate thickness (decreasing from ~250 m in the west to ~110 m in the east) to the maturity of surface trench expression.
Provides transferable diagnostic criteria for identifying hidden subsurface void systems and subdued karst or volcanic collapse features on Mars and Titan.
证明纳拉伯平原上公里级的浅层线性沟槽是深部洞穴向上坍塌的地表表现，而非古河道。
结合二维电阻率层析成像（ERT）、被动源地震HVSR、洞穴记录与悬崖露头，对垂向延伸的坍塌和沉积充填带进行了成像。
建立了连接碳酸盐岩厚度（从西部约250米减薄至东部约110米）与地表沟槽发育成熟度的年代学演化框架。
提出了可推广的诊断标准，用于识别地球以及火星、泰坦等行星表面隐伏的地下空洞系统和微弱坍塌地貌。
me: Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) using a 100-electrode Wenner array and RES2DINV least-squares inversion to image subsurface resistivity down to 30–70 m.

Passive seismic Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) using ambient noise (0.1–20 Hz) and active refraction dispersion curves to constrain shear-wave velocities (340–350 m/s) and bedrock depth (>30–40 m).
Morphometric analysis of TanDEM-X digital elevation models enhanced with Relief Visualization Toolbox and high-resolution UAV photogrammetry.
Laser granulometry, X-ray diffraction (XRD) with Rietveld refinement, and U-Th radiometric dating of calcreted cave sediments.
利用100电极温纳装置开展电阻率层析成像（ERT），并通过RES2DINV最小二乘反演对30-70米深度的地下电阻率结构成像。
利用环境噪声（0.1-20 Hz）开展被动源地震水平与垂直谱比法（HVSR）测量，并结合折射地震频散曲线约束剪切波速度（340-350 m/s）及基岩深度（>30-40 m）。
基于TanDEM-X数字高程模型与眩光可视化工具箱（RVT）开展地貌形态分析，并结合高分辨率无人机摄影测量。
对洞穴钙结沉积物进行激光粒度分析、X射线衍射（XRD）Rietveld精修矿物定量分析以及铀钍（U-Th）同位素测年。
de: TanDEM-X (0.4 and 1.0 arcsec) DEMs, satellite imagery, and drone photogrammetry over five major trench systems (Abrakurrie, Wombat, Koonalda, Yangoonabie, Yalata) on the Nullarbor Plain.
2D ERT field profiles collected in October 2022 and October 2024 following rainfall events to ensure low contact resistance.
3-component ambient noise recordings (20-min windows at 128 Hz sampling rate) using a Tromino ENGY 3G seismometer across trenches.
Sediment samples for grain size and XRD mineralogy from Abrakurrie and Wombat trenches/caves, plus two calcrete samples from Clay Dam Cave for U-Th dating.
覆盖纳拉伯平原五个主要沟槽系统（Abrakurrie、Wombat、Koonalda、Yangoonabie、Yalata）的TanDEM-X数字高程模型、卫星影像与无人机摄影测量数据。
于2022年10月和2024年10月降雨后采集的二维ERT野外剖面数据（降雨保证了低接地电阻）。
使用Tromino ENGY 3G地震仪横跨沟槽采集的三分量环境噪声记录（采样率128 Hz，时长20分钟）。
采自Abrakurrie和Wombat沟槽及洞穴的粒度与XRD矿物分析沉积物样品，以及采自Clay Dam洞穴用于U-Th测年的两个钙结层样品。
li: ERT depth of exploration is limited to ~30–70 m and dry, well-insulated ground on the Nullarbor Plain requires measurements after rare rainfall events to achieve low contact resistance.
Strong winds on the Nullarbor Plain introduce high-frequency (>25 Hz) noise into passive seismic HVSR measurements, requiring careful weather selection and data windowing.
ERT探测深度受限于约30–70米，且纳拉伯平原地表干燥绝缘，必须在罕见降雨后测量以降低接地电阻。
纳拉伯平原的强风会在被动源地震HVSR测量中引入高频（>25 Hz）噪声，需避开大风天气并剔除噪声音段。

tm.why: The study uses passive seismic profiling (HVSR) and electrical resistivity tomography to characterize shallow karst cave-collapse features on Earth as an environmental and planetary analogue.
The paper employs passive seismic Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) measurements of ambient noise to estimate depth to bedrock and velocity contrasts beneath collapsed cave trenches.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including main text, Methods, Table 1, and Figures 1-4.

sum: Reliable microseismic event localization is essential for tracking subsurface fracture evolution, yet progressive rock damage alters seismic velocities and biases locations that assume static models. This study investigates the impact of P-wave velocity evolution on acoustic emission (AE) localization during a triaxial compression test on Berea sandstone. The authors introduce an optimized double-difference (DD) relocation workflow (using NLLoc and HypoDD) that partitions the AE catalog into pre-failure, failure, and post-failure stages, incorporating real-time active-pulsing P-wave velocity updates for each stage. The relocated AE distributions are validated against 3D fracture surfaces segmented from post-failure X-ray micro-CT images using a U-Net deep learning model. Incorporating dynamic velocities increases located events by 15.7% in absolute location and relocates ~90% of the catalog in DD with a 70% RMS residual reduction, eliminating artificial central clustering and closely matching the true fracture geometry.
本研究探讨了砂岩三轴压缩实验中P波速度演化对声发射（AE）定位的影响。作者提出了一种优化的双差（DD）重定位方法，根据应力演化和实时脉冲测量的P波速度，将AE目录划分为破裂前、破裂和破裂后三个阶段分别进行定位，并利用U-Net分割的X射线显微CT三维裂缝表面进行验证。结果表明，动态速度模型使绝对定位……

t: The authors combine probabilistic absolute location (NLLoc) and double-difference relocation (HypoDD) segmented into three mechanical deformation stages (pre-failure, failure, post-failure), assigning stage-specific P-wave velocities measured during loading, and validate against U-Net-segmented 3D micro-CT fracture surfaces.
结合NLLoc概率绝对定位和按变形阶段分段并赋予实测时变P波速度的HypoDD双差重定位，并与U-Net分割的CT裂缝表…

Acoustic emission waveforms (6,573 events, 49,212 P-wave picks) recorded by 10 piezoelectric sensors, axial P-wave velocities, and post-failure X-ray micro-CT images (57 μm voxel size) from a triaxial compression test on Berea sandstone at 5 MPa confining pressure.
5 MPa围压下Berea砂岩三轴压缩实验的10通道AE波形（6573个事件）、轴向波速及57微米分辨率CT图像。

Incorporating dynamic P-wave velocities increased located absolute events by 15.7% (from 1,303 to 1,507), while stage-optimized DD relocated ~90% of the catalog (~1,600 events) with ~70% RMS residual reduction and <0.1 mm uncertainty, aligning closely with CT fracture geometry.
动态波速使绝对定位事件增加15.7%，分阶段优化DD重定位了约90%的事件，残差降低约70%，与CT裂缝高度吻合。

The stage-updated velocity model is homogeneous and measured solely along the axial direction, neglecting 3D spatial velocity heterogeneities and stress-induced radial anisotropy during damage localization.
速度模型在空间上均匀且仅测量轴向波速，忽略了三维速度非均匀性和径向应力诱导各向异性。

First explicit quantification and validation against high-resolution micro-CT of how incorporating stage-dependent dynamic velocity updates into double-difference relocation resolves systematic AE location biases during rock fracture.
首次結合高分辨率CT定量验证了将分阶段动态波速融入双差定位以消除岩石破裂声发射定位偏差的方法。

kc: Developed a stage-dependent double-difference (DD) relocation workflow that incorporates real-time P-wave velocity changes across pre-failure, failure, and post-failure deformation stages.
Demonstrated that conventional static-velocity DD relocation causes artificial clustering and up to 4 mm systematic spatial shifts in laboratory AE catalogs.
Validated relocated 3D AE distributions against high-resolution X-ray micro-CT fracture geometries segmented using a U-Net convolutional neural network.
开发了分阶段双差（DD）重定位工作流，在破裂前、破裂和破裂后变形阶段纳入实时P波速度变化。
证明了传统的静态速度DD重定位会导致实验室声发射目录出现人为聚集和高达4毫米的系统性空间偏移。
利用U-Net卷积神经网络分割的高分辨率X射线显微CT裂缝几何形态，验证了重定位后的三维声发射分布。
me: Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) with manual refinement for picking 49,212 P-wave arrival times from trigger-based AE waveforms.
Non-linear probabilistic absolute event location using NonLinLoc (NLLoc) with static and 3-stage time-varying P-wave velocities plus station corrections.
Relative relocation using HypoDD combining catalog delay times (pairs <10 mm) and waveform cross-correlation delay times (pairs <5 mm, Cf >= 0.8) segmented by mechanical deformation stages.
2D U-Net convolutional neural network trained on 64x64 patches (achieving >0.98 Dice coefficient) to segment post-failure X-ray micro-CT slices into 3D fracture meshes.
结合赤池信息准则（AIC）与人工精修，从触发式声发射波形中拾取了49,212个P波初至时间。
使用NonLinLoc（NLLoc）结合静态和三阶段时变P波速度模型及台站校正，进行非线性概率绝对事件定位。
利用HypoDD结合目录走时差（间距<10 mm）和波形互相关走时差（间距<5 mm，相关系数≥0.8），按力学变形阶段分段进行相对重定位。
在64×64图像块上训练2D U-Net卷积神经网络（Dice系数>0.98），将破裂后X射线显微CT切片分割并重建为三维裂缝网格。
de: Conventional triaxial compression test on a cylindrical Berea sandstone specimen (25.4 mm diameter, 50.8 mm length) at 5 MPa confining pressure and 1.03e-5 s^-1 axial strain rate.

Continuous passive AE monitoring at 10 MHz sampling rate using 10 PZT-5A piezoelectric transducers (2 on endcaps, 8 in a helicoidal sleeve pattern), yielding 6,573 detected events and ~1,800 well-constrained locations.
Active ultrasonic pulsing between piston/endcap transducers to track axial P-wave velocity evolution (ranging from 3.0 to 4.25 km/s) during loading.
Post-failure X-ray micro-CT scan using a Zeiss Xradia 520 Versa at 140 keV with a 57 micrometer voxel resolution.
在5 MPa围压和1.03×10⁻⁵ s⁻¹轴向应变率下，对圆柱形Berea砂岩样品（直径25.4 mm，长50.8 mm）进行常规三轴压缩实验。
使用10个PZT-5A压电换能器（2个在端盖，8个呈螺旋状分布在套筒上）以10 MHz采样率进行连续被动AE监测，检测到6,573个事件并获得约1,800个高质量定位结果。
通过活塞/端盖换能器之间的主动超声脉冲测量，跟踪加载过程中的轴向P波速度演化（在3.0至4.25 km/s之间变化）。
使用Zeiss Xradia 520 Versa在140 keV下对破裂后样品进行X射线显微CT扫描，体素分辨率为57微米。
li: The dynamic velocity model uses homogeneous, stage-averaged 1D velocity values per stage and cannot capture complex 3D spatial velocity heterogeneities across the fault zone.
Active P-wave velocity measurements are only taken along the axial direction between endcaps, neglecting stress- and damage-induced seismic anisotropy along radial paths.
Velocity updates are discretized into three broad mechanical stages rather than tracked continuously in real time.
动态速度模型在每个阶段采用均匀的阶段平均速度值，无法捕捉断层带周围复杂的三维空间速度非均匀性。
主动P波速度测量仅在端盖之间沿轴向进行，忽略了径向路径上由应力和损伤引起的地震各向异性。
速度更新被离散化为三个宏观力学阶段，而非连续的实时速度跟踪。

tm.why: The core focus of the paper is improving acoustic emission (lab-scale microseismicity) event localization using a stage-dependent double-difference (DD) relocation algorithm.
The paper investigates rock deformation, microcrack coalescence, and fracture network evolution during triaxial compression tests on Berea sandstone.
The methodology is directly motivated by and framed for tracking fracture evolution in subsurface reservoir operations like CO2 storage and Enhanced Geothermal Systems.

ev.notes: Full text PDF (18 pages) including all figures, equations, experimental parameters, and references was analyzed.

sum: Accurate forecasting of maximum aftershock magnitudes is vital for post-earthquake risk assessment, yet traditional empirical laws like Båth's law overlook mainshock source physics. This study constructs a global mainshock-aftershock dataset (1976–2024) by merging and unifying magnitudes (to Ms) across the GCMT, NEIC, ISC, and ISC-GEM catalogs, extracting 4,154 sequences with largest aftershocks within 24 hours. Using mainshock magnitude, depth, radiated energy, apparent stress, focal mechanism angles, and foreshock count, the authors train Bayesian-optimized LGBM, XGBoost, SVM, Random Forest, and stacking ensemble models under both mixed-magnitude and magnitude-stratified schemes. On the mixed test set, Bayesian-optimized XGBoost achieves R² = 0.65 and 46.45% accuracy within a ±0.3 magnitude threshold, substantially outperforming Båth's law (R² = 0.55, 38.15%). SHAP interpretability analysis reveals that while mainshock magnitude and radiated energy dominate predictions, fault dip becomes increasingly important for large earthquakes (6 ≤ M < 9).
准确预测最大余震震级对震后风险评估至关重要。本研究整合1976–2024年GCMT、NEIC及ISC等全球地震目录并统一为面波震级（Ms），构建了4154个24小时内发生最大余震的序列数据集。结合主震震级、深度、辐射能量、视应力、震源机制解及前震频次，利用贝叶斯优化训练了LGBM、XGBoost、S……

t: Bayesian-optimized LGBM, XGBoost, SVM, Random Forest, and a linear-regression stacking ensemble trained with K-fold cross-validation, interpreted via SHAP values to predict 24-h maximum aftershock magnitudes from mainshock source parameters.
采用K折交叉验证与贝叶斯优化训练LGBM、XGBoost、SVM、RF及Stacking集成模型，结合SHAP分析预测主…
4,154 shallow mainshock-aftershock sequences (M ≥ 4.0, depth ≤ 70 km, 0.6 ≤ ΔM < 2.4) with 24-h maximum aftershocks from unified GCMT, NEIC, ISC, and ISC-GEM catalogs (1976–2024).
整合1976–2024年GCMT、NEIC、ISC及ISC-GEM目录并统一为Ms震级，提取4,154个24小时内含最大…

On the mixed dataset, Bayesian-optimized XGBoost achieved R² = 0.65 and 46.45% accuracy (BORF reached 48.62%) at a ±0.3 threshold, outperforming Båth's law (R² = 0.55, 38.15% accuracy). For 7 ≤ M < 9, BOSVM reduced MAPE to 8.03%.
混合测试集上BOXGBoost取得R²=0.65，±0.3阈值准确率达46.45%（BORF达48.62%），显著优于巴…

Mainshock identification is post hoc, preventing direct real-time deployment; furthermore, empirical conversion to Ms introduces saturation bias for M ≥ 7.5 and ignores regional tectonic b-value variations.
主震识别具有事后性，无法直接用于实时预测；震级统一为Ms在大震时存在饱和效应且未考虑区域b值差异。

Integrates mainshock physical source parameters (focal mechanism angles, apparent stress, radiated energy) into Bayesian-optimized ML ensembles with magnitude-stratified SHAP attribution to forecast 24-h maximum aftershock magnitudes.
将主震震源机制解与视应力等物理参数融入贝叶斯优化集成学习，并按震级分层开展SHAP物理归因解释。

kc: Developed Bayesian-optimized ML and stacking ensemble models (LGBM, XGBoost, SVM, RF) that outperform Båth's law in predicting maximum 24-h aftershock magnitudes.
Constructed a magnitude-unified (Ms) global catalog of 4,154 shallow mainshock-aftershock sequences (1976–2024) combining GCMT, NEIC, ISC, and ISC-GEM datasets.
Performed SHAP feature attribution across stratified magnitude intervals, showing that mainshock magnitude and radiated energy dominate globally while fault dip importance increases for M ≥ 6.
开发了经贝叶斯优化的机器学习与Stacking集成模型（LGBM、XGBoost、SVM、RF），在预测24小时内最大余震震级方面显著优于巴特定律。
整合GCMT、NEIC、ISC和ISC-GEM数据集，构建了包含4154个浅源主-余震序列（1976–2024年）且震级统一为Ms的全球目录。
在分震级区间进行了SHAP特征归因分析，证明主震震级和辐射能量在全局占主导地位，而断层倾角的重要性在M≥6时显著增加。
me: Catalog data cleaning, empirical magnitude conversion to unified Ms, and adaptive magnitude-dependent spatiotemporal window declustering.
Bayesian hyperparameter optimization with K-fold cross-validation for LGBM, XGBoost, SVM, and Random Forest regressors, plus linear-regression stacking.
Model evaluation across mixed and magnitude-stratified datasets using MSE, MAE, MAPE, R², and error threshold accuracy, paired with SHAP interpretability analysis.
地震目录数据清洗、经验公式转换统一为面波震级Ms，以及自适应震级相关的时空窗去丛集方法。
结合K折交叉验证与贝叶斯超参数优化训练LGBM、XGBoost、SVM和随机森林回归模型，并采用线性回归元学习器进行Stacking集成。
使用MSE、MAE、MAPE、R²和误差阈值准确率在混合和分震级数据集上评估模型，并结合SHAP值进行特征可解释性分析。
de: Global earthquake catalogs from January 1976 to August/December 2024: GCMT (66,485 records), NEIC (1,425,594 records), ISC (462,267 records), and ISC-GEM (54,144 records).
Filtered dataset of 46,697 independent shallow mainshocks (M ≥ 4.0, depth ≤ 70 km), yielding 4,154 classical mainshock-aftershock sequences (0.6 ≤ ΔM < 2.4) with maximum aftershocks within 24 hours.
Comparison of mixed-magnitude training versus stratified training across four intervals: 4 ≤ M < 5, 5 ≤ M < 6, 6 ≤ M < 7, and 7 ≤ M < 9.
筛选出46,697个独立浅源主震（M≥4.0，深度≤70 km），提取出4,154个在24小时内发生最大余震的典型主-余震序列（0.6 ≤ ΔM < 2.4）。
对比全数据混合震级训练与四个震级区间（4≤M<5、5≤M<6、6≤M<7、7≤M<9）的分层训练实验。
li: Mainshock identification is inherently retrospective (post hoc) and relies on pre-identified sequence labels, preventing direct real-time operational deployment without probabilistic mainshock estimation.
Sequence filtering (0.6 ≤ ΔM ≤ 2.4) and spatiotemporal heterogeneity in global catalog completeness (Mc) and short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI) may bias small-mainshock sequences.
Converting all magnitudes to Ms introduces empirical uncertainty and saturation bias for M ≥ 7.5, and regional tectonic variations (a- and b-values) are not explicitly modeled.
主震识别本质上是事后（回顾性）的，依赖于预先识别的序列标签，若不结合实时主震概率估计则无法直接用于实时业务化部署。
序列筛选条件（0.6 ≤ ΔM ≤ 2.4）以及全球目录完备性震级（Mc）的时空异质性和短期余震不完备性（STAI）可能对小主震序列产生偏差。
将所有震级转换为Ms会引入经验转换不确定性以及M≥7.5时的震级饱和偏差，且未显式建模区域构造背景差异（如a值和b值）。

tm.why: The paper develops and optimizes LGBM, XGBoost, SVM, Random Forest, and stacking ensemble models to predict maximum aftershock magnitudes.
The study extensively cleans, unifies magnitude scales, and declusters global earthquake catalogs (GCMT, NEIC, ISC, ISC-GEM) to construct mainshock-aftershock sequence datasets.
Forecasting the maximum aftershock magnitude within 24 hours of a strong mainshock directly supports post-earthquake emergency response and aftershock hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 27-page PDF including main text, figures, tables, and supplementary material.

sum: The subsurface geometry of the Palu-Koro Fault System in central Sulawesi, Indonesia, remains poorly constrained, impacting stress transfer and seismic hazard assessments. This study applies Bayesian moment tensor inversion (Bayes-ISOLA) using regional BMKG three-component waveforms and a 1D CRUST1.0 velocity model to determine focal mechanisms and uncertainties for 19 earthquakes (Mw ≥ 3.8) from the August 18, 2012 Mw 6.3 Palu earthquake sequence. The results refine the geometry of the Saluki segment to a strike of 345.2°±3.87°, a dip of 83°±4.5°, and a rake of 7.33°±5.52°. Static Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling shows that updating the dip from the generalized 90° to 83° reduces maximum Coulomb stress by ~300 kPa (3 bar) while inducing stress polarity reversals on 12 of 54 subfaults. Furthermore, the 2012 stress perturbation did not reach the northern Makassar Strait segment, indicating additional stress sources drove the 2018 Mw 7.5 rupture.
本研究针对印尼中苏拉威西帕卢-科罗断层系地下几何形态约束不足的问题，利用BMKG区域台网三分量波形和CRUST1.0速度模型，对2012年Mw6.3帕卢地震序列的19个事件（Mw≥3.8）进行贝叶斯矩张量反演。研究将Saluki段几何参数更新为走向345.2°±3.87°、倾角83°±4.5°、滑动……

t: Bayesian centroid moment tensor inversion (Bayes-ISOLA) using a hybrid grid search, least-squares fitting, and pre-event noise covariance matrix, followed by static Coulomb stress modeling in Coulomb 3.3.
采用Bayes-ISOLA进行贝叶斯矩张量反演，并利用Coulomb 3.3计算静态库仑破裂应力变化。
Three-component regional seismic waveforms from 11 BMKG stations for 19 events (Mw ≥ 3.8) in the 2012 Palu sequence, filtered at 0.01–0.1 Hz using a 1D CRUST1.0 velocity model.
BMKG 11个区域台站记录的2012年帕卢序列19个事件（Mw≥3.8）0.01-0.1 Hz波形及CRUST1.0模…
The Saluki segment geometry was updated to strike 345.2°±3.87°, dip 83°±4.5°, and rake 7.33°±5.52°, causing a ~300 kPa decrease in maximum Coulomb stress and polarity reversals in 12 of 54 subfaults.
更新Saluki段倾角为83°±4.5°，使最大库仑应力降低约300 kPa，54个子断层中12个极性反转。
Limited number of high-quality focal mechanisms, absence of near-field InSAR/GPS geodetic data for validation, use of empirical uniform slip, and assumption of a homogeneous elastic crust.
高质量震源机制数量有限，缺乏近场大地测量验证，且采用均匀滑动与均匀弹性地壳假设。

First probabilistic refinement of the Saluki segment subsurface dip (83°±4.5°) from the 2012 Palu sequence using Bayesian CMT inversion and systematic assessment of its impact on subfault ΔCFS polarities.
首次利用贝叶斯反演约束2012年帕卢序列Saluki段倾角，并量化其对子断层库仑应力极性的影响。

kc: Determined 19 new centroid moment tensor solutions and posterior uncertainty distributions (Mw 3.8–6.3) for the 2012 Palu earthquake sequence using Bayesian inversion.
Updated the subsurface geometry of the Saluki segment of the Palu-Koro Fault to strike 345.2°±3.87°, dip 83°±4.5°, and rake 7.33°±5.52°.
Demonstrated that adjusting the Saluki segment dip from 90° to 83° reduces peak Coulomb stress by ~300 kPa (3 bar) and triggers stress polarity reversals in 12 of 54 subfaults.
Showed that stress transfer from the 2012 Mw 6.3 mainshock was confined south of -0.9°N and was insufficient on its own to initiate the 2018 Mw 7.5 Makassar Strait rupture.
利用贝叶斯反演获得了2012年帕卢地震序列19个事件（Mw 3.8–6.3）的质心矩张量解及后验不确定性分布。
将帕卢-科罗断层Saluki段的地下几何参数更新为走向345.2°±3.87°、倾角83°±4.5°、滑动角7.33°±5.52°。
证明将Saluki段倾角从90°修正为83°会使最大库仑应力降低约300 kPa（3 bar），并导致54个子断层中的12个发生极性反转。
揭示2012年Mw 6.3主震的库仑应力传递局限于南纬0.9°以南，不足以单独触发2018年Mw 7.5望加锡海峡段破裂。
me: Bayesian centroid moment tensor inversion using the Bayes-ISOLA workflow (hybrid spatial-temporal grid search and least-squares waveform fitting with a pre-event noise data covariance matrix).
Synthetic seismogram and Green's function computation via the discrete wavenumber method using a 1D regional average of the CRUST1.0 velocity model.

Statistical estimation of fault plane strike, dip, and rake using median and mean analyses of posterior probability density functions filtered by quality criteria (VR > 40%, DC > 60%, uncertainty ≤ 25°).
Static Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling using Coulomb 3.3 and Wells & Coppersmith (1994) empirical scaling relations.
采用Bayes-ISOLA工作流进行贝叶斯质心矩张量反演（结合时空网格搜索、最小二乘波形拟合及震前噪声数据协方差矩阵）。
基于CRUST1.0一维区域平均速度模型，利用离散波数法计算格林函数和理论地震图。
通过质量控制标准（VR > 40%，DC > 60%，不确定度 ≤ 25°）筛选后验概率密度函数，统计估算断层面走向、倾角和滑动角。
结合Wells & Coppersmith (1994)经验标度律，使用Coulomb 3.3软件进行静态库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）模拟。
de: Three-component regional broadband waveforms from 11 stations operated by BMKG (Indonesian Agency for Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics) filtered between 0.01 and 0.1 Hz.
19 earthquake events with Mw ≥ 3.8 from the August–December 2012 Palu earthquake sequence.
Sensitivity experiments in Coulomb 3.3 varying receiver fault dip (90°, 83°, 78.5°) and rake (-20° to 20°) across 54 subfaults on the Saluki segment.
印尼气象、气候和地球物理局（BMKG）11个区域台站记录的三分量波形数据（滤波频带0.01–0.1 Hz）。
2012年8月至12月帕卢地震序列中Mw ≥ 3.8的19个地震事件。
在Coulomb 3.3中针对Saluki段54个子断层开展接收断层倾角（90°、83°、78.5°）和滑动角（-20°至20°）的参数敏感性实验。
li: Relies on a limited number of high-quality focal mechanism solutions due to regional station sparsity and data availability constraints.
Lacks dense near-field geodetic data (e.g., InSAR or GPS) for independent validation of the 2012 subsurface fault geometry and slip distribution.
Uses a uniform slip model derived from empirical scaling relations rather than a heterogeneous finite-fault slip inversion, and assumes a homogeneous isotropic elastic crust.
受限于区域台站稀疏和数据可用性，高质量震源机制解的数量有限。
缺乏高密度近场大地测量数据（如InSAR或GPS）来独立验证2012年地下断层几何形态和滑动分布。
采用基于经验关系的均匀滑动模型而非非均匀有限断层反演，且假设地壳为均匀弹性介质。

tm.why: The paper performs centroid moment tensor inversions for 19 events in the 2012 Mw 6.3 Palu earthquake sequence to determine focal mechanisms and source orientations.
The study uses Bayesian ISOLA moment tensor inversion to derive 10-dimensional posterior probability density functions and quantify uncertainties in strike, dip, and rake.
The revised fault geometry is used to model static Coulomb failure stress transfer (ΔCFS) across subfaults of the Palu-Koro Fault System and evaluate earthquake triggering.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 31-page PDF (including main text, 14 figures, 6 tables, and 19 supplementary inversion figures S1–S19).

sum: Learning-based exploration seismic processing suffers from poor reproducibility due to private datasets and scarce public code (only 25 of 368 surveyed papers release code). To address this, the authors introduce SPBench, an open multi-task benchmark covering random noise attenuation, trace interpolation, ground-roll suppression, multiple suppression, deblending, and first-arrival picking. SPBench standardizes 10 synthetic and field datasets across 43 settings and reproduces 24 supervised deep-learning baselines (495 model-setting evaluations over three seeds). It also introduces two domain-aware diagnostics: signal-component-resolved evaluation (SCoRE), which partitions SNR by frequency and local energy, and a reference-free ridge-curvature score (RC_norm) for first-arrival picking continuity. Results reveal that synthetic rankings do not reliably predict field rankings (Kendall tau from 0.24 to 0.73), ranking stability degrades more under coherent ground roll than random noise, and RC_norm correlates strongly (0.881) with MAE rankings on field surveys without requiring reference labels.
针对深度学习勘探地震处理缺乏开源代码与统一数据的问题，本文提出多任务基准SPBench，涵盖随机噪声衰减、道插值、面波压制、多次波压制、混采分离和初至拾取6项任务。作者在10个合成与实际数据集、43种标准设置下复现了24种监督学习方法（共495组评估），并提出分频分能量的信号分量解析评估（SCoRE……

t: Standardizes 24 supervised deep-learning architectures across six seismic processing tasks under shared splits, adding frequency/energy-partitioned SNR (SCoRE) and a reference-free offset-time ridge curvature metric (RC_norm) for first-arrival picking.
在统一划分下复现24种监督深度学习架构，提出分频/分能量信噪比（SCoRE）与无参考初至脊曲率指标（RC_norm）。

Ten synthetic and field datasets across 43 standardized settings covering interpolation, denoising, ground-roll suppression, multiple attenuation, deblending, and first-arrival picking (SEG C3, Mobil AVO, SEAM, HardPicks), totaling 495 3-seed evaluations.
涵盖6项任务、10个合成与实际数据集（SEG C3、Mobil AVO、SEAM、HardPicks）及43种设置，共4…

Synthetic-to-field ranking correlations vary widely by task (Kendall tau = 0.24–0.73); rankings reorder under strong coherent ground roll (tau = 0.42); RC_norm correlates strongly with supervised MAE rankings on field surveys (mean tau = 0.881).
合成与实际数据排名相关性因任务而异（τ=0.24–0.73）；强面波下排名重排（τ=0.42）；RC_norm与MAE排…
Limited to supervised deep learning on 2D gathers (excluding classical flows, foundation models, and 3D volumes), and RC_norm is blind to global systematic time shifts.
仅限二维道集监督学习（未含传统方法、大模型及三维数据），且RC_norm对全局固定时移不敏感。
First unified multi-task exploration seismic processing benchmark with open synthetic/field datasets, 24 reproduced baselines, and domain-aware diagnostics (SCoRE and reference-free RC_norm).
首个统一的多任务勘探地震处理基准，开源配对数据集、24种复现基线及领域诊断指标SCoRE与RC_norm。

kc: Surveyed 368 supervised seismic-processing deep-learning papers (2018–2026), revealing that over 70% rely on private data and only 6.8% (25 papers) provide public code.

Released SPBench with 10 open datasets (including new synthetic datasets for ground-roll, multiples, and deblending), 43 settings, 24 reproduced supervised baselines, and >1,000 trained parameter sets.

Proposed two domain-aware evaluation diagnostics: SCoRE (frequency-binned FB-FRE and energy-binned EB-FE) for waveform reconstruction and reference-free ridge curvature (RC_norm) for first-arrival picking.

Demonstrated empirically that synthetic rankings poorly predict field rankings, model rankings reorder under strong coherent ground roll, and RC_norm tracks supervised MAE rankings (mean Kendall tau = 0.881).
调研了368篇地震处理深度学习论文（2018–2026），揭示超70%依赖私有数据且仅6.8%（25篇）开源代码。
发布SPBench基准，包含10个公开数据集（含新建的面波、多次波和混采合成集）、43种设置、24种复现基线及超1000套模型参数。
提出两种领域感知诊断指标：用于重构的分频（FB-FRE）与分能量（EB-FE）评估指标SCoRE，以及用于初至拾取的无参考脊曲率指标RC_norm。
实证表明合成数据排名难以预测实际数据表现，强相干面波会导致模型排名重排，且RC_norm与有监督MAE排名高度一致（平均Kendall相关系数0.881）。
me: Standardized supervised training and evaluation pipeline across 24 architectures (U-Net, ResUNet, DnCNN, Attention U-Net, Swin-Transformer networks, GANs, diffusion models, physics-constrained CNNs).
Acoustic and isotropic elastic wave-equation forward modeling (including mirror source/receiver method on SEAM and SEG C3 models) to generate paired clean/degraded synthetic datasets.
Signal-component-resolved evaluation (SCoRE) computing partition SNR across four adaptive RFFT frequency subbands (FB-FRE) and four Gaussian-smoothed local reference-energy percentile bins (EB-FE).
Reference-free ridge-curvature score (RC_norm) measuring discrete second-derivative slope changes of median-binned predicted first arrivals in source-receiver offset-time coordinates.
构建涵盖24种网络架构（U-Net、ResUNet、DnCNN、Attention U-Net、Swin-Transformer、GAN、扩散模型、物理约束CNN等）的标准化监督训练与评估流程。
利用声波与各向同性弹性波方程正演模拟（含基于SEAM和SEG C3模型的镜像震源/检波器法）生成配对的合成数据集。
信号分量解析评估（SCoRE）：在四个自适应RFFT频带（FB-FRE）和四个高斯平滑局部参考能量百分位区间（EB-FE）内分别计算分区信噪比。
无参考脊曲率评分（RC_norm）：在炮检距-时间坐标系中计算中值分箱后预测初至走时脊的离散二阶导数斜率变化。
de: 10 datasets across 6 tasks and 43 settings, evaluated over 3 random seeds (495 model-setting configurations, >1,000 runs).

SEG C3 synthetic (45 shots, 201x201 grid) and Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine 2D field dataset (1,001 shots) for trace interpolation (random, uniform, continuous masks) and random noise attenuation (Gaussian/Poisson at -5, 0, 5 dB).

Newly created SPBench datasets: acoustic/elastic ground-roll dataset (synthetic 5 amplitude levels + companion field set), SEAM-based marine surface-related multiples dataset, and 3D acoustic + Mobil AVO semi-synthetic deblending datasets.
HardPicks hardrock 3D seismic reflection surveys (Brunswick, Halfmile, Lalor) for first-arrival picking evaluation.
涵盖6项任务、10个数据集和43种实验设置，每个配置使用3个随机种子独立训练评估（共495组配置，超1000次运行）。
基于SEG C3合成数据（45炮）与Mobil AVO北海二维海上实际数据（1001炮）开展道插值（随机、均匀、连续缺失）与随机噪声衰减（-5、0、5 dB高斯/泊松噪声）实验。
新建SPBench专属数据集：声弹性正演面波数据集（5个合成振幅等级及配套实际数据）、基于SEAM模型的海上自由表面多次波数据集、以及三维合成与Mobil AVO半合成混采分离数据集。
使用HardPicks硬岩三维反射地震勘探数据集（Brunswick、Halfmile、Lalor工区）开展初至拾取评估。
li: SPBench currently focuses only on supervised deep learning over 2D seismic gathers, excluding classical signal-processing flows, self/unsupervised methods, foundation models, and 3D volume processing.
The reference-free picking metric RC_norm is invariant to global constant time shifts, meaning a smooth curve consistently tracking the wrong seismic phase can still score well.
Field ground-roll reference labels rely on expert processing and field deblending uses semi-synthetic blending on Mobil AVO records rather than true simultaneous-source field acquisition.
目前仅针对二维地震道集上的有监督深度学习方法，尚未涵盖传统处理流程、自监督/无监督方法、基础大模型及三维数据体处理。
无参考拾取指标RC_norm对全局固定时间偏移不敏感，若平滑拾取曲线系统性地追踪了错误同相轴仍会获得高分。
实际面波压制参考标签依赖专家处理结果，且实际混采分离采用Mobil AVO半合成混叠而非真实野外同时激发采集数据。

tm.why: The paper introduces a comprehensive multi-task benchmark evaluating 24 supervised deep-learning methods across six exploration seismic processing tasks.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 36-page manuscript PDF including main text and Appendices A–H.

sum: This study uses 3D coupled earthquake-atmosphere simulations—linking SPECFEM3D dynamic rupture modeling with the compressible nonlinear Navier-Stokes atmospheric model MAGIC—to investigate how earthquake source dynamics shape acoustic waves (AWs) at 100–300 km altitude. The authors explore strike-slip subshear versus supershear ruptures (Mw 7.1), normal versus thrust faulting, von Karman slip heterogeneity, and low-scaled-energy tsunami earthquakes (Mw 6.5). Results show that supershear ruptures excite earlier (~12–20 s) and ~20% stronger thermospheric AWs via Mach waves. Normal faults produce ~50% weaker N-waves than thrust faults because initial surface subsidence generates leading negative-phase waves that merge nonlinearly with trailing shocks. Small-scale (<10 km) fault heterogeneity affects lower-atmosphere AWs (<100 km) but is smoothed out in the thermosphere. Tsunami earthquakes generate 20%–50% smaller thermospheric AW amplitudes than typical thrust events of identical Mw, confirming that radiated seismic energy (ER) rather than moment magnitude primarily governs upper-atmospheric AW amplitudes.
本研究结合SPECFEM3D动力破裂模拟与非线性可压缩大气模型MAGIC，开展三维固体地球-大气耦合数值模拟，探究震源参数对100–300 km热层声波（AW）的影响。通过对比亚剪切与超剪切破裂、正断层与逆断层、非均匀滑动及海啸地震，发现超剪切破裂产生的声波到时更早且振幅高约20%；正断层因非线性冲……

t: Vertical ground velocities from 3D SPECFEM3D spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations drive the bottom boundary of MAGIC, which solves 3D compressible nonlinear Navier-Stokes equations to model acoustic wave and shock N-wave propagation up to 300 km altitude.
将SPECFEM3D三维动力破裂的地表垂直速度耦合至MAGIC底部边界，求解三维可压缩非线性Navier-Stokes方…

Eight 3D coupled earthquake-atmosphere simulation scenarios spanning Mw 7.1 subshear/supershear strike-slip and Mw 6.5 normal, homogeneous/heterogeneous thrust, and tsunami earthquakes, supplemented by historical GNSS vTEC perturbation observations.
8组涵盖Mw 7.1亚/超剪切走滑及Mw 6.5正断层、均匀/非均匀逆断层和海啸地震的三维耦合模拟，辅以全球历史GNSS…

Supershear ruptures produce ~12–20 s earlier and ~20% stronger thermospheric AWs; normal faults yield <50% of thrust AW amplitudes (52.6 vs 114 m/s); tsunami earthquakes produce 20%–50% smaller amplitudes than comparable thrust events.
超剪切热层声波早到12–20秒且振幅强20%；正断层振幅不足逆断层一半（52.6对114 m/s）；海啸地震振幅比普通逆…
The study simulates only neutral atmospheric fluid dynamics without horizontal winds, ionospheric plasma coupling, or geomagnetic field effects, and uses bounded computational domains.
仅模拟无背景风的中性大气响应，未显式包含电离层等离子体耦合和地磁场效应，且计算域范围有限。
First systematic 3D coupled dynamic-rupture and nonlinear atmospheric modeling of supershear, normal-faulting, heterogeneous-slip, and dynamically consistent low-scaled-energy tsunami earthquakes.
首次对超剪切破裂、正断层、非均匀滑动及符合低标度能量特征的海啸地震开展三维动力破裂-非线性大气耦合模拟。

kc: Performed 3D coupled dynamic rupture (SPECFEM3D) and nonlinear compressible atmospheric (MAGIC) simulations across diverse rupture regimes including supershear, normal faulting, heterogeneous slip, and tsunami earthquakes.
Demonstrated that supershear strike-slip ruptures generate thermospheric acoustic waves arriving ~12–20 s earlier with ~20% larger amplitudes and longer N-wave periods than subshear ruptures.
Revealed that normal-faulting earthquakes produce thermospheric N-wave amplitudes less than half those of equivalent thrust earthquakes due to nonlinear shock merging of leading rarefaction phases.
Showed that small-scale (<10 km) fault slip heterogeneity imprints on lower-atmosphere (<100 km) waveforms but becomes largely indistinguishable at thermospheric (150–300 km) altitudes.

Constructed a dynamic tsunami earthquake model matching observed scaled energy (ER/M0 = 1.7e-6) and showed it yields 20%–50% smaller thermospheric AW amplitudes than regular thrust earthquakes, confirming radiated energy (ER) governs AW strength.
开展了涵盖超剪切、正断层、非均匀滑动和海啸地震的三维动力破裂（SPECFEM3D）与非线性可压缩大气（MAGIC）耦合数值模拟。
证明超剪切走滑破裂产生的热层声波比亚剪切破裂早到约12–20秒，振幅大20%且N波周期更长。
揭示了由于前导稀疏相位的非线性激波合并，正断层地震产生的热层N波振幅不足同规模逆断层的一半。
表明小尺度（<10 km）断层滑动非均匀性会影响低层大气（<100 km）波形，但在热层高度（150–300 km）几乎无法区分。
构建了符合观测标度能量（ER/M0 = 1.7e-6）的海啸地震动力学模型，发现其热层声波振幅比普通逆断层小20%–50%，证实辐射能量主导声波强度。
me: 3D spontaneous dynamic rupture and seismic wave propagation modeling in a homogeneous elastic half-space using SPECFEM3D with linear slip-weakening friction.
One-way seismic-acoustic coupling at the solid-air interface using vertical surface velocity fields from SPECFEM3D as the bottom boundary condition for MAGIC.
3D simulation of compressible, nonlinear Navier-Stokes equations using MAGIC with NRLMSISE-00 empirical atmospheric profiles up to 300 km altitude.
Spatial random field modeling of dynamic friction coefficients using von Karman autocorrelation functions with varying correlation lengths to simulate heterogeneous fault ruptures.
使用SPECFEM3D和线性滑动弱化摩擦准则在三维均匀弹性半空间中进行自发动力破裂与地震波传播模拟。
以SPECFEM3D计算的自由表面垂直速度场作为MAGIC底部边界条件，实现固-气界面的单向地震-声波耦合。
结合NRLMSISE-00经验大气剖面，利用MAGIC求解三维可压缩非线性Navier-Stokes方程，模拟高达300 km的声波传播与激波演化。
采用不同相关长度的von Karman自相关函数构建动态摩擦系数的空间随机场，以模拟非均匀断层破裂过程。
de: Eight primary 3D coupled simulation scenarios (selected from >160 dynamic rupture trial runs): Mw 7.1 strike-slip subshear (Sim #1) and supershear (Sim #2); Mw 6.5 normal (Sim #3), homogeneous thrust (Sim #4, #8), heterogeneous thrust (Sim #5, #6), and tsunami earthquake (Sim #7).

Compilation of observed GNSS vertical Total Electron Content (vTEC) perturbation amplitudes versus energy magnitude (Me) and moment magnitude (Mw) for global thrust, strike-slip, and normal earthquakes (including the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar supershear event).
从160余次动力破裂试算中优选8组三维耦合模拟场景：Mw 7.1走滑亚剪切（Sim #1）与超剪切（Sim #2）；Mw 6.5正断层（Sim #3）、均匀逆断层（Sim #4, #8）、非均匀逆断层（Sim #5, #6）及海啸地震（Sim #7）。
汇编全球逆断层、走滑和正断层地震（含2025年缅甸Mw 7.7超剪切地震）的GNSS垂直总电子含量（vTEC）扰动振幅与能量震级（Me）和矩震级（Mw）观测对比数据集。
li: Simulations focus exclusively on neutral atmospheric wave dynamics (vertical fluid velocity W) and do not explicitly model ionospheric plasma coupling or geomagnetic field geometry effects.
Atmospheric background profiles are time-invariant and exclude horizontal background winds and local surface topography.
Restricted computational domain sizes limit the evaluation of long-range Mach and Rayleigh wave acoustic signatures and prevent simulating larger (Mw > 7.5) megathrust events.
模拟仅关注中性大气波动动力学（垂直流体速度W），未显式模拟电离层等离子体耦合或地磁场几何效应。
大气背景剖面假设为不随时间变化，且忽略了水平背景风场和局部地表地形的影响。
有限的计算域尺寸限制了对远场马赫波和瑞利波声学特征的评估，且未模拟更大震级（Mw > 7.5）的巨型逆冲地震。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates how dynamic rupture parameters—such as supershear vs subshear rupture speeds, normal vs thrust mechanisms, slip heterogeneity, and tsunami earthquake characteristics—influence coseismic acoustic wave signatures.
The authors perform 3D coupled solid-Earth and compressible nonlinear atmospheric simulations combining SPECFEM3D and MAGIC to model seismic-to-acoustic wave propagation.
The study focuses on solid-Earth-atmosphere coupling, nonlinear infrasound/acoustic shock N-wave evolution in the thermosphere, and connections to ionospheric GNSS-TEC observations.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF analyzed in detail, including all equations, 2 tables, and 12 figures.

sum: This study presents a controlled diagnostic benchmark of three parameterizations in 2D acoustic full-waveform inversion (FWI) under a strict 1,500 shot-model gradient budget using the SWEEP solver: direct grid inversion with total variation (Grid+TV), an adapted sinusoidal coordinate network (SIREN), and a frozen VAE image generator with a full-grid residual. Evaluated on three synthetic targets (rescaled Marmousi, CurveVel, CurveFault) with direct 10 Hz and 2-to-10 Hz continuation schedules, results show conditional rankings rather than universal superiority. With continuation, the generative-residual model achieves the lowest velocity RMSE on Marmousi and CurveFault, whereas Grid+TV wins on CurveVel. Crucially, Grid+TV predicts held-out 10 Hz shots better on all three targets. SIREN degrades the initial background across all tests, and continuation worsens its accuracy on two targets. Furthermore, an equal-budget variational inference extension fails both recovery and interval coverage, motivating rigorous multi-metric auditing of neural FWI.
本研究在固定1500次正演梯度预算下，使用SWEEP算子对比了二维声学全波形反演（FWI）的三种参数化方法：带全变分正则化的网格反演（Grid+TV）、自适应正弦坐标网络（SIREN）以及结合全网格残差的冻结VAE图像生成器。基于三个合成模型（重缩放Marmousi、CurveVel、CurveFa……

t: Compares Grid+TV, an adapted SIREN coordinate network, and a frozen VAE generator plus full-grid residual in 2D acoustic FWI using a shared SWEEP solver and 1,500 shot-model gradients.
基于共享SWEEP算子与1500次梯度预算，对比二维声学FWI中的Grid+TV、SIREN及冻结VAE加全网格残差方法…
Three 2D synthetic velocity models (rescaled Marmousi2, CurveVel-a01, CurveFault-a01) on a 690x690 m grid with 5 surface sources (3 training, 2 held-out) and 70 receivers at 2 and 10 Hz.
690×690m网格上的三个二维合成模型（Marmousi2、CurveVel、CurveFault），含3个训练炮和2…
With continuation, generative-residual achieves velocity RMSEs of 218.7, 108.0, and 341.9 m/s versus 232.5, 100.3, and 412.9 m/s for Grid+TV, though Grid+TV bests all on held-out shots.
延拓下生成残差模型速度RMSE为218.7、108.0和341.9 m/s，两项优于Grid+TV，但后者未见炮预测全面…
Limited to 2D constant-density acoustics, inverse-crime discretization, privileged truth-smoothed backgrounds, one sample per family, and non-identifiable generator/residual decomposition.
局限于二维常密度声学反演犯罪设定、真值平滑背景、单样本测试及生成与残差分量不可唯一识别。

Demonstrates structure-dependent failure modes of neural priors, decoupled model vs. predictive rankings, non-monotonic SIREN continuation degradation, and VI coverage failure under strict PDE budgets.
严格量化神经FWI的结构依赖失效模式、速度恢复与波形泛化的背离、SIREN延拓退化及变分推断覆盖率失效。

kc: Establishes a strictly controlled 2D acoustic FWI benchmark sharing a frozen SWEEP propagator, initialization, and a 1,500 shot-model gradient budget.
Demonstrates that velocity recovery rankings are structure-dependent and disagree with held-out shot waveform prediction accuracy.
Shows that frequency continuation worsens adapted SIREN reconstructions on two of three targets, increasing spatial roughness rather than producing overly smooth failures.
Reveals that full-grid residuals dominate high-wavenumber layering in generative-residual FWI and that an equal-budget mean-field variational extension severely fails coverage.
建立了严格受控的二维声学FWI基准测试，共享冻结的SWEEP传播算子、初始模型及1500次炮-模型梯度计算预算。
证明了速度模型恢复排名具有结构依赖性，且与留出炮集的波形预测精度排名不一致。
发现在三个目标中的两个上，频率延拓反而恶化了SIREN重建结果并增加了空间粗糙度，而非陷入过度平滑局部极值。
揭示了生成-残差联合反演中全网格残差主导了高频层状结构重建，且等预算平均场变分推断在模型恢复与区间覆盖率上严重失效。
me: Shared 2D constant-density acoustic finite-difference forward and adjoint engine (SWEEP with fourth-order stencil, CPML absorption, and exact halo boundary padding VJP correction).
Direct grid parameterization regularized with smoothed isotropic total variation (Grid+TV).
Implicit neural representation using a four-layer sinusoidal coordinate network (SIREN) with logistic physical bounds anchoring.
Hybrid parameterization combining a frozen 128-D latent VAE decoder (pretrained on generic non-seismic images) with an explicitly regularized full-grid residual.
Equal-budget mean-field Gaussian variational inference (VI-8) using reparameterized Monte Carlo gradients with antithetic sampling.
共享二维常密度声学有限差分正演与伴随引擎（基于SWEEP，采用四阶空间差分格式、CPML吸收边界及精确的边界填充向量-雅可比积修正）。
结合平滑各向同性全变分（TV）正则化的直接网格参数化反演（Grid+TV）。
采用四层正弦激活坐标网络（SIREN）并结合逻辑斯蒂物理边界锚定的隐式神经表征。
将非地震通用图像预训练的128维潜空间冻结VAE解码器与带高斯先验的全网格残差相结合的混合参数化方法。
采用对偶采样重参数化蒙特卡洛梯度的等预算平均场高斯变分推断（VI-8）。
de: Three 2D synthetic velocity models mapped to a 690 m x 690 m domain (101 x 161 grid): rescaled Marmousi2 region, OpenFWI curvevel_a_01, and curvefault_a_01.
Synthetic surface acquisition with 5 Ricker wavelet sources (3 training shots, 2 held-out diagnostic shots) and 70 receivers at 2 Hz and 10 Hz with 3% Gaussian noise.
Comparison of direct 10 Hz inversion (1,500 gradients) versus 2-to-10 Hz continuation (500 gradients at 2 Hz, 1,000 at 10 Hz).
Post-exposure sensitivity sweep over five TV regularization weights and spectral/component attribution diagnostics.
重映射至690 m × 690 m计算域（101 × 161网格）的三个二维合成速度模型：重缩放Marmousi2局部模型、OpenFWI的curvevel_a_01与curvefault_a_01。
地表合成观测系统：包含5个Ricker子波震源（3个训练炮，2个留出验证炮）和70个检波器，分别合成含3%高斯噪声的2 Hz与10 Hz数据。
对比直接10 Hz反演（1500次梯度计算）与2→10 Hz频率延拓反演（2 Hz阶段500次梯度，10 Hz阶段1000次梯度）。
针对五个TV正则化权重的敏感性扫描实验，以及波数谱和生成器/残差分量归因诊断实验。
li: Restricted to 2D constant-density acoustic physics in an inverse-crime setting with a single random seed and one exposed sample per structural family.
Initial background models are constructed by Gaussian smoothing of the true velocity fields, representing privileged synthetic initialization.
Full-grid residual degrees of freedom make the decomposition between the frozen generator and residual non-identifiable from waveforms alone.
Computational matching controls only PDE-gradient evaluations, not wall-clock time, parameter count, or network pretraining/background-fitting overhead.
局限于二维常密度声学近似与“反演犯罪”（正反演使用相同离散网格）设定，每个构造家族仅测试了一个公开样本和单一随机种子。
初始背景模型通过对真实速度场进行高斯平滑获得，属于先验特权初始化。
全网格残差自由度导致仅凭波形数据无法唯一区分冻结生成器与残差项的独立贡献。
计算成本对齐仅控制了PDE梯度计算次数，未对齐实际运行时间、参数量及网络预训练与背景拟合的额外开销。

tm.why: The paper systematically evaluates different model parameterizations and priors in 2D acoustic full-waveform inversion.
It audits implicit neural representations (SIREN) and pretrained variational autoencoder generative priors for seismic velocity inversion.
It includes an equal-budget mean-field variational inference extension to evaluate posterior approximation and empirical interval coverage.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF analyzed, including main text, 3 tables, 17 figures, and Appendices A through F.

sum: This paper introduces DiffClassNet, a novel deep learning framework based on denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) for geophysical classification. By leveraging the multi-scale feature-learning properties of diffusion models, DiffClassNet extracts and aggregates features across multiple noise levels during the denoising process. This allows the model to learn hierarchical representations where different timesteps capture complementary signal characteristics, such as high-frequency onset patterns and broader energy distributions. The framework is evaluated on two seismic classification tasks in Texas: discriminating between natural earthquakes and quarry blasts, and identifying causal factors of induced seismicity (hydraulic fracturing vs. shallow/deep saltwater disposal) in the Delaware Basin. DiffClassNet achieves competitive performance compared to established baselines, demonstrating that diffusion-based learning offers a powerful and interpretable approach for seismic source classification.
本文提出基于去噪扩散模型的地球物理分类框架DiffClassNet。该方法在去噪中聚合多尺度特征，捕获从高频起震到宽频能量分布的互补信号。框架在德克萨斯州两个任务上进行了评估：区分天然地震与爆破，以及识别特拉华盆地诱发地震成因（压裂与废水回注）。结果表明，该模型分类性能优异且具可解释性，为地震分类提……

t: DiffClassNet extracts and aggregates hierarchical features across multiple noise levels of a denoising diffusion probabilistic model to perform multi-scale seismic classification.
DiffClassNet利用去噪扩散概率模型在多个噪声水平下提取并聚合分层特征进行多尺度地震分类。
Seismic waveform datasets from Texas, including natural earthquakes, quarry blasts, and induced seismicity events associated with hydraulic fracturing and saltwater disposal in the Delaware Basin.
德克萨斯州的地震波形数据集，包含天然地震、爆破以及特拉华盆地与压裂和废水回注相关的诱发地震。
DiffClassNet achieves competitive classification performance relative to established baselines, demonstrating improved interpretability and preservation of complementary class-relevant structures.
DiffClassNet在分类任务中达到了与现有基准相当的性能，并展现出更好的可解释性和特征结构保留。
The framework's computational efficiency may be limited by the iterative denoising process inherent to diffusion models.
该框架的计算效率可能受到扩散模型固有的迭代去噪过程的限制。
First application of denoising diffusion probabilistic models for multi-scale feature extraction and classification of seismic sources and induced seismicity causes.
首次将去噪扩散概率模型应用于地震源及诱发地震成因的多尺度特征提取与分类。

kc: Developed DiffClassNet, a novel diffusion-based deep learning framework for multi-scale geophysical classification.
Demonstrated successful discrimination between natural earthquakes and quarry blasts in Texas.
Identified causal factors of induced seismicity (hydraulic fracturing vs. saltwater disposal) in the Delaware Basin.
开发了DiffClassNet，一种用于多尺度地球物理分类的新型扩散深度学习框架。
成功实现了德克萨斯州天然地震与采石场爆破的有效区分。
实现了特拉华盆地诱发地震成因（水力压裂与废水回注）的识别。
me: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) for feature extraction.
Multi-scale feature aggregation across different diffusion timesteps.
Supervised classification using hierarchical latent representations.
使用去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）进行特征提取。
跨不同扩散时间步的多尺度特征聚合。
利用分层潜在表示进行监督分类。
de: Seismic waveform dataset from Texas for natural earthquake vs. quarry blast discrimination.
Seismic dataset from the Delaware Basin for induced seismicity causal-factor classification (hydraulic fracturing, shallow/deep saltwater disposal).
用于区分天然地震与采石场爆破的德克萨斯州地震波形数据集。
用于特拉华盆地诱发地震成因分类（水力压裂、浅层/深层废水回注）的地震数据集。
li: Computational overhead associated with the multi-step denoising process in diffusion models.
Dependence on high-quality labeled training datasets for supervised classification.
扩散模型中多步去噪过程带来的计算开销较大。
监督分类高度依赖高质量的有标注训练数据集。

tm.why: The paper introduces DiffClassNet, a diffusion-based deep learning framework for seismic classification.
The model is applied to identify causal factors of induced seismicity in the Delaware Basin.
The model is used to discriminate between natural earthquakes and quarry blasts.

ev.notes: Analyzed the paper based on the official abstract and metadata from Crossref.

sum: This study investigates the spatial and temporal distribution of local seismic shear-wave splitting parameters in the source region of the 2015 Nepal Gorkha Mw 7.8 earthquake using 11 months of aftershock waveforms from 41 NAMASTE network stations. Applying the automated MFAST V2.2 algorithm to events within a 45° shear-wave window, the authors obtain 1,329 valid splitting pairs across 28 stations. Results indicate a layered upper-crustal anisotropy where time delays increase with depth up to 15 km. Time delays and fast-direction dispersion decrease from north to south, reflecting higher stress accumulation north of the Main Boundary Thrust. Along strike from west to east, dominant fast polarizations alternate abruptly across eight sub-areas between WNW (Main Himalayan Thrust strike) and NNE (intersecting blind faults), attributed to fluid migration from Indian lithospheric tearing. Violent temporal fluctuations in time delays over one year indicate incomplete coseismic stress release and continuous post-seismic adjustment.
本研究利用NAMASTE台网41个台站记录的11个月余震波形，结合MFAST V2.2自动测量方法，获取了2015年尼泊尔Gorkha Mw7.8地震震源区28个台站的1329对有效近震剪切波分裂参数。结果表明：震源区上地壳呈分层各向异性，15 km以浅慢波延迟时间随深度增加；慢波延迟和快波偏振离散……

t: The authors screened relocated aftershocks within a 45° cone beneath stations and used the MFAST V2.2 program (combining the Silver & Chan 1991 algorithm and Teanby et al. 2004 cluster analysis) to automatically measure shear-wave splitting parameters.
筛选台站下方45°锥体内的重定位余震，利用MFAST V2.2程序（结合SC91算法与聚类分析）自动测量剪切波分裂参数。

Continuous 100 Hz waveforms recorded from July 2015 to April 2016 at 41 stations (30 broadband, 11 short-period) of the NAMASTE network, paired with 12,669 relocated aftershocks from the LOC-FLOW workflow.
NAMASTE台网41个台站2015年7月至2016年4月的100 Hz连续波形，结合LOC-FLOW获得的12669个…

1,329 valid splitting pairs from 28 stations show station-mean time delays of 1.22–3.19 ms/km decreasing southward, depth-increasing delays down to 15 km, eight-segment west-to-east fast-direction alternations, and strong temporal fluctuations for one year.
28个台站获1329对有效结果，平均延迟1.22–3.19 ms/km且向南递减，15 km以浅随深度增加，快波方向呈东…
Sparse valid measurements in the southern block (only 8 pairs) prevented quantitative statistical analysis there, and instrument failures caused waveform anomalies at stations A010, A070, and A180.
南部区块有效结果极少（仅8对）无法定量统计，且A010、A070和A180台站因仪器故障无有效结果。

First comprehensive spatiotemporal analysis of local upper-crustal shear-wave splitting across the 2015 Gorkha aftershock zone, linking 8-zone along-strike fast-axis segmentation to Indian slab tearing and blind fault fluid migration.
首次系统揭示Gorkha震源区上地壳剪切波分裂时空特征，将快波方向东西向8段突变与印度板片撕裂及隐伏断层流体迁移相联系。

kc: Obtained 1,329 pairs of local shear-wave splitting measurements across 28 stations in the 2015 Gorkha Mw 7.8 earthquake source region.
Identified a layered anisotropic structure in the upper crust where normalized time delays increase with depth down to 15 km and decrease below 15 km.

Revealed an eight-segment west-to-east alternation in fast polarization directions controlled by the Main Himalayan Thrust and intersecting NNE-striking blind faults, linked to Indian slab tearing and fluid upwelling.
Demonstrated north-to-south decreasing time delays and persistent 1-year post-seismic temporal fluctuations, indicating incomplete stress release and ongoing seismic hazard.
在2015年Gorkha Mw 7.8地震震源区28个台站获得了1329对有效近震剪切波分裂测量结果。
揭示了上地壳分层各向异性结构，慢波延迟时间在15 km以浅随深度增加，15 km以深减小。
发现了余震区自西向东8个分区的快波方向交替变化特征，受主喜马拉雅逆冲断层与NNE向隐伏断层共同控制，并与印度板片撕裂及深部流体上涌相关。
证实慢波延迟由北向南递减且在震后近一年内剧烈波动，表明同震应力未完全释放，震源区仍具较高地震危险性。
me: Screened relocated aftershocks (from LOC-FLOW workflow) using a 45° incidence cone to avoid free-surface S-wave total reflection contamination.
Applied the automated MFAST V2.2 package combining the Silver and Chan (1991) covariance eigenvalue minimization algorithm with Teanby et al. (2004) cluster analysis.
Filtered waveforms using 14 preset bandpass filters (between 0.5–15 Hz and 1–45 Hz), retaining filters yielding S-wave SNR > 3 with maximum bandwidth.
Verified compatibility between broadband and short-period seismometers before and after instrument response removal, normalizing time delays by ray path length using a 1-D velocity model.
基于LOC-FLOW高精度重定位目录，筛选台站下方45°入射角锥体内的余震事件以避免自由表面全反射干扰。
采用MFAST V2.2自动计算程序，结合SC91协方差矩阵最小特征值法与Teanby聚类分析方法自动优选时间窗。
使用14组预设带通滤波器处理波形，筛选信噪比大于3且频带最宽的滤波器进行分裂参数测量。
验证了宽频带与短周期地震仪在去仪器响应前后结果的一致性，并利用一维速度模型将延迟时间归一化为单位路径长度（ms/km）。
de: Continuous 100 Hz waveform data from 41 stations (30 broadband, 11 short-period) of the temporary NAMASTE network (IRIS) recorded from July 2015 to April 2016.
High-precision relocated catalog of 12,669 Gorkha aftershocks (depths mainly 6–15 km) generated by Kuang and Li (2025) using LOC-FLOW and hypoDD.
收集了IRIS提供的NAMASTE临时台网41个台站（30个宽频带、11个短周期）2015年7月至2016年4月期间100 Hz采样率的连续波形数据。
采用了Kuang和Li（2025）通过LOC-FLOW和hypoDD获得的12669个Gorkha余震高精度重定位目录（深度主要集中在6–15 km）。
li: Very few valid measurements (only 8 pairs) were obtained in the southern block (SR) and far southern stations due to sparse aftershock activity, precluding quantitative statistical analysis there.
Instrument failures and waveform anomalies at several stations in the dense aftershock zone (e.g., A010, A070, A180) prevented obtaining valid splitting measurements at those locations.
南部区块（SR）及更南端台站因余震稀少仅获得8对有效结果，无法在该区域开展定量统计分析。

sum: This study analyzes a relocated machine learning-generated aftershock catalog of the 2017 Mw 8.2 Tehuantepec, Mexico earthquake, the largest recorded normal-faulting event in Mexico. Using data from temporary and permanent stations, the authors show that the rupture initiated 100 km offshore, ran northwest for 90 km, and then jumped 10 km inland across the trench-perpendicular Tehuantepec Ridge, continuing for another 60 km. Finite fault inversions support a two-plane normal fault model offset at the ridge. Moment tensor analysis reveals complex aftershocks before the ridge, whereas post-ridge aftershocks are exclusively thrust mechanisms, suggesting stress accommodation after normal-slip over-slip. A separate N-S trending divergent region at the rupture's end suggests a plate boundary between the Caribbean and North American plates.
本研究分析了2017年墨西哥特万特佩克Mw 8.2地震的重定位机器学习余震目录。研究表明，破裂在离岸100公里处激发，向西北延伸90公里，随后跨越特万特佩克海脊向陆地跃迁10公里，并继续延伸60公里。有限断层反演表明双平面正断层模型最符合滑移特征。震源机制解显示，海脊前余震极其复杂，而海脊后余震全为……

sum: Researchers commonly apply hard signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) thresholds to discard weak seismic waveforms before training deep learning models, assuming clearer waveforms yield better learning. This study tests that assumption across manual-label phase picking (PnSn v3 on CREDIT-X1local) and ambient-noise surface-wave dispersion estimation (DispNet v2.3 on SeisDispFusion-NCF). Using matched-budget controls, strict SNR screening provided no consistent benefit on unfiltered phase-picking tests under fine-tuning, scratch initialization, or distance-matched controls. In dispersion, strict screening increased error at 5 epochs, beat an equal-sized random subset at 15 epochs, but showed no mean MAE advantage (0.0406 vs 0.0405 km/s) over training on all 29,788 eligible paths at fixed compute. Furthermore, in two-day continuous monitoring (SeismicX-Cont with REAL association), event recovery depended heavily on whether S-wave SNR was measured on horizontal or vertical components. The authors propose a six-step audit for proxy-based data curation.
地震深度学习常通过信噪比（SNR）硬阈值剔除弱信号记录，假设更清晰的波形能提升训练效果。本文在震相拾取（CREDIT-X1local，PnSn v3）和背景噪声面波频散提取（SeisDispFusion-NCF，DispNet v2.3）任务中检验了该假设。在相同样本量预算下，严格SNR筛选在微调、……

t: A matched-budget curation framework compares models trained on hard-SNR-screened subsets against equal-count random samples and full-available training pools at fixed parameter update budgets, cross-evaluating on both unfiltered and SNR-selected held-out test sets.
提出等预算数据筛选评估框架，在固定计算更新下对比严格SNR子集、等量随机子集与全量数据，并在双测试域交叉评估。

Experiments use 61,429 manual-label phase-picking records from CREDIT-X1local, 33,098 ambient-noise cross-correlation station-pair paths from SeisDispFusion-NCF, and two days of continuous PnSn v3 picker streams from SeismicX-Cont against 2,340 catalog events.
使用CREDIT-X1local的61,429条人工震相记录、SeisDispFusion-NCF的33,098条互相关…

Strict SNR screening gave no consistent broad-test phase-picking gain. Retaining all 29,788 dispersion paths reduced unfiltered-test MAE by 3.0% over 9,929 random paths at 585 updates, matching strict-SNR unfiltered MAE (0.04052 vs 0.04060 km/s).
SNR筛选未带来一致的震相拾取增益；保留全部29,788条频散路径降低3.0%误差，与严格SNR在未过滤测试集上表现相当…

Directly tests whether hard SNR screening improves seismic deep learning by separating sample selection from data quantity under fixed compute, introducing a reusable six-step audit for proxy-based data curation.

kc: Demonstrates that hard SNR screening of training data gives no consistent broad-test benefit for seismic phase picking, even when controlling for source-station distance and phase composition.

Shows that in ambient-noise dispersion, retaining all 29,788 eligible paths at fixed compute reduces unfiltered-test MAE by 3.0% compared to random subsampling, eliminating the broad-test advantage of strict SNR screening.
Distinguishes training data curation from post-inference monitoring control, showing that horizontal vs. vertical S-wave SNR definitions strongly alter REAL catalog-event recovery (+0.106 recall).

sum: Simultaneous-source seismic acquisition requires deblending, which conventionally depends on random firing time delays (time dithering) to create incoherency in cross-sorted domains. To eliminate this dependency and enable real-time quality control during acquisition, this study proposes a novel iterative inversion framework operating directly in the common-shot gather (CSG) domain. The method integrates a 2-D synchrosqueezed curvelet transform (SSCT) and the Radon transform into a direct-subtraction loop. First, SSCT projects data into a 4-D phase space where greedy clustering isolates coherent target signals based on propagation directions. Once SSCT iterations saturate, the Radon transform acts as a secondary filter in the intercept-slowness domain to attenuate low-frequency and near-offset residual interference while preserving primary amplitudes. Tested on synthetic data and two marine towed-streamer datasets (including zero-delay and narrow-dither worst cases), the framework achieves up to 23.93 dB SNR, substantially outperforming conventional curvelet ISTA and allowing massive parallelization across CSGs.
针对同时激发地震采集的混叠噪声分离难题，本文提出一种直接在共炮点道集（CSG）域运行的双约束迭代反演方法，摆脱了对随机激发延迟（时间抖动）的依赖。该方法在直接相减框架中结合了二维同步压缩曲波变换（SSCT）与Radon变换：首先利用SSCT将记录映射至四维相空间，通过贪婪聚类分离不同传播方向的相干波……

t: A direct-subtraction iterative framework in the CSG domain combining 2-D synchrosqueezed curvelet transform (SSCT) 4-D phase-space greedy clustering with secondary intercept-slowness Radon transform filtering to separate coherent blended wavefields.
在CSG域采用直接相减迭代框架，结合二维同步压缩曲波四维相空间聚类与Radon变换次级滤波。

Evaluated on a synthetic multilayer model, a 2D marine towed-streamer dataset (256 traces, 4 ms sampling) with zero delay, and a 3D marine streamer volume (350x347 traces, 8 ms sampling) with narrow time dithering.
测试了多层合成数据、零延迟256道二维海洋拖缆数据及窄时间抖动350×347道三维海洋拖缆数据。
Achieves 22.16 dB SNR on zero-delay blended 2D marine data; on narrow-dither 3D marine data, reaches 23.93 dB SNR in CSG (vs 12.95 dB for curvelet ISTA) and 20.21 dB in CCG (vs 14.65 dB).
零延迟实测数据信噪比达22.16 dB；三维窄抖动数据CSG域达23.93 dB（传统方法仅12.95 dB）。

SSCT clustering struggles when dip angle differences are very small at curved near-offsets, and coarse-scale isotropic curvelet bases lack directional selectivity, causing low-frequency residuals without Radon filtering.
近偏移距大曲率或倾角相近时SSCT分离受限，且最粗尺度曲波各向同性易导致低频残余。

Bypasses reliance on randomized firing time delays by operating directly in the CSG domain via joint SSCT-Radon constraints, enabling real-time single-source quality monitoring and independent parallel processing.
摆脱对随机激发延迟的依赖，直接在CSG域分离相干混叠信号，支持实时质控与大规模并行处理。

kc: Proposes a direct-subtraction iterative deblending framework operating purely in the common-shot gather (CSG) domain, eliminating reliance on random firing time dithers.
Combines 2-D synchrosqueezed curvelet transform (SSCT) phase-space clustering with Radon transform filtering to overcome curvelet low-frequency isotropic limitations.
Demonstrates superior signal preservation and up to ~11 dB SNR improvement over conventional curvelet ISTA on marine towed-streamer data under narrow time-dithering constraints.
提出了一种完全在共炮点道集（CSG）域运行的直接相减迭代去混叠框架，消除了对随机激发时间抖动的依赖。
将二维同步压缩曲波变换（SSCT）相空间聚类与Radon变换滤波相结合，克服了曲波变换在低频尺度缺乏方向选择性的固有局限。
在窄时间抖动约束的海洋拖缆数据上展示了优异的保幅能力，信噪比相比传统曲波ISTA提升高达约11 dB。
me: Direct-subtraction iterative deblending formulation in the CSG domain instead of pseudo-deblended cross-sorted domains.
2-D synchrosqueezed curvelet transform (SSCT) mapping curvelet coefficients to 4-D space-wavenumber-frequency phase space via instantaneous frequency vectors.
Greedy energy-based clustering with angular thresholds in 4-D phase space to partition intersecting coherent wavefields.
Linear Radon transform thresholding in the intercept-slowness (tau-p) domain as a secondary stage to suppress residual low-frequency and near-offset interference.
采用共炮点道集（CSG）域直接相减迭代去混叠公式，替代非CSG域伪去混叠迭代框架。
利用二维同步压缩曲波变换（SSCT），通过瞬时频率向量将曲波系数重分配至四维空间-波数-频率相空间。
在四维相空间实施基于角度阈值的贪婪能量聚类算法，分离交叉传播的相干波场分量。
引入线性Radon变换在截距-慢度（τ-p）域进行阈值滤波，作为次级约束压制低频与近偏移距残余干扰。
de: Synthetic multilayer geological model comparing intermediate SSCT saturation and final SSCT-Radon separation in time-space, tau-p, and f-k domains.
First field experiment: denoised and resampled 2D marine towed-streamer gather (256 traces, 512 samples at 4 ms) numerically blended with zero firing time delay.

Second field experiment: raw 3D marine towed-streamer volume (350 inline x 347 crossline traces, 1120 samples at 8 ms) blended with a narrowly restricted random time-dithering margin, benchmarked against curvelet ISTA.
多层地质模型合成数据实验，在时空域、τ-p域和f-k域对比SSCT饱和阶段与SSCT-Radon最终分离效果。

第二组实测数据实验：350×347道、8 ms采样的原始三维海洋拖缆数据，在极窄随机时间抖动下与传统曲波ISTA进行对比基准测试。
li: SSCT-based clustering struggles when overlapping events have very small dip angle differences or high curvature at near offsets, reducing transform sparsity.
At the coarsest scale (lowest frequencies), curvelet basis functions are isotropic low-pass elements lacking directional selectivity, causing low-frequency leakage if used without Radon constraints.
当交叉事件倾角差异极小或近偏移距反射曲率较大时，SSCT稀疏性下降，聚类难以准确分离干扰。
曲波基函数在最粗尺度（最低频）表现为各向同性低通滤波器，缺乏方向选择性，单独使用会导致低频能量泄漏。

tm.why: The paper formulates simultaneous-source wavefield separation as an iterative inversion scheme using joint sparse constraints from synchrosqueezed curvelet and Radon transforms.
The method directly addresses simultaneous-source seismic acquisition and real-time quality control on marine towed-streamer field datasets.

sum: This Zenodo dataset supports the development of near-complete 3D deformation mapping using Sentinel-1 extended burst overlap interferometry (EBOI). It contains two primary packages: `dataset_QML.zip`, which includes standard (BOI) and EBOI products over Queen Maud Land (Antarctica) to capture ice velocity/deformation; and `dataset_tur.zip`, which contains unwrapped interferograms, BOI, EBOI, and pixel offsets, alongside 3D decomposition inversion results for the 2023 Kahramanmaraş (Türkiye) earthquake sequence. The dataset demonstrates the utility of EBOI in improving azimuth displacement measurements, enabling high-precision 3D displacement field reconstruction for both cryospheric and tectonic applications.

me: Burst Overlap Interferometry (BOI) and Extended Burst Overlap Interferometry (EBOI) using Sentinel-1 TOPS mode data.
3D displacement decomposition inversion combining range/azimuth pixel offsets, unwrapped interferograms, and BOI/EBOI measurements.
利用Sentinel-1 TOPS模式数据的爆发重叠干涉测量（BOI）和扩展爆发重叠干涉测量（EBOI）技术。
结合距离向/方位向像素偏移、解缠干涉图以及BOI/EBOI测量值的三维位移分解反演方法。
de: Sentinel-1 SAR data over Queen Maud Land (relative orbit 2, ascending track, March 6–7, 2026).
Sentinel-1 SAR data from four overlapping frames (014A, 021D, 116A, 123D) covering the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye earthquake sequence.
南极毛德皇后地上的Sentinel-1 SAR数据（相对轨道2，升轨，2026年3月6日至7日）。
覆盖2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列的四个重叠帧（014A、021D、116A、123D）的Sentinel-1 SAR数据。

BOI data for Queen Maud Land are downsampled to 0.001x0.001 degree resolution.
该数据集仅限于毛德皇后地和土耳其地震的特定空间轨道和时间窗口。
毛德皇后地的BOI数据被降采样至0.001x0.001度分辨率。

tm.why: The dataset contains coseismic deformation products and 3D decomposition inversion results for the 2023 Türkiye earthquake sequence.
The dataset includes burst overlap interferograms over Queen Maud Land, Antarctica, capturing ice-sheet deformation.
