sum: This paper presents the operational dataset and infrastructure of the ICDP Eger project, which establishes a multi-parameter geodynamic laboratory in the West Bohemia/Vogtland region. The project aims to study earthquake swarms, crustal fluid flow, mantle degassing (CO2 and He), and the deep biosphere. The setup includes five boreholes (S1-S4, F3) equipped with high-frequency 3D seismic arrays, broadband seismometers, and real-time fluid monitoring systems. The dataset supports high-resolution, near-source observations of seismicity and fluid-fault interactions, as well as microbial and paleoclimate studies in maar structures.
本文介绍了ICDP Eger项目的运行数据集与基础设施。该项目在西波希米亚/福格特兰地球动力学区建立了深部多参数观测实验室，旨在研究地震群、地壳流体运移、幔源气体（CO2和He）释放及深部生物圈。观测系统由Nový Kostel地震活动区周边的5口钻孔（S1-S4, F3）组成，配备了高频三维地震台……

t: Multi-parameter borehole monitoring combining high-frequency 3D seismic arrays, broadband seismometers, and continuous real-time fluid monitoring at depth.
结合高频三维地震台阵、宽频带地震仪和深部连续实时流体监测的多参数钻孔监测方法。
Operational drilling and monitoring datasets from five boreholes (S1-S4, F3) targeting the active Nový Kostel seismogenic zone and Hartoušov mofette field.
针对活跃的Nový Kostel地震带和Hartoušov喷气孔区的五口钻孔（S1-S4, F3）的运行钻探与监测数据集…
Establishment of the ICDP Eger geodynamic laboratory, completing drilling of five monitoring boreholes and initiating pilot-phase fluid and seismic monitoring.
建立了ICDP Eger地球动力学实验室，完成了五口监测井的钻探，并启动了试点阶段的流体和地震监测。
Full seismic instrumentation is completed only in borehole S1, with others still in preparation or pilot phase.
目前仅在S1钻孔中完成了完整的地震仪器部署，其余仍处于准备或试点阶段。
First comprehensive, near-source, multi-parameter deep laboratory combining high-frequency 3D seismic arrays with real-time fluid and deep biosphere monitoring in the Eger Rift.
首次在Eger裂谷建立将高频三维地震台阵与实时流体及深部生物圈监测相结合的近源多参数深部实验室。

kc: Establishes a comprehensive multi-parameter deep laboratory in the active West Bohemia/Vogtland earthquake swarm region.
Deploys high-frequency 3D seismic arrays and broadband seismometers in shallow boreholes near the Nový Kostel seismogenic zone.
Integrates real-time fluid monitoring (CO2, He) and deep biosphere sampling to study fluid-driven earthquake mechanisms.
在活跃的西波希米亚/福格特兰地震群区域建立了综合的多参数深部实验室。
在Nový Kostel地震带附近的浅孔中部署了高频三维地震台阵和宽频带地震仪。
整合了实时流体监测（CO2、He）与深部生物圈采样，以研究流体驱动的地震机制。
me: Borehole drilling and instrumentation with 3D seismic arrays (vertical geophone chains and surface arrays).
Continuous real-time fluid monitoring at depth in the Hartoušov mofette field.
Microbial activity analysis and paleoclimate reconstruction from maar sediment cores.
钻孔钻探及三维地震台阵（垂直检波器链和地面台阵）仪器部署。
深部连续实时流体监测（Hartoušov喷气孔区）。
利用玛洱湖沉积岩心进行微生物活动分析和古气候重建。
de: Operational drilling data and seismic/fluid monitoring datasets from five boreholes (S1, S2, S3, S4, F3) in the Eger Rift.
来自Eger裂谷5口监测井（S1、S2、S3、S4、F3）的运行钻探数据以及地震和流体监测数据集。
li: Seismic instrumentation is still in preparation for several boreholes (S2, S3, S4), and fluid monitoring is in a pilot phase.
部分钻孔（S2、S3、S4）的地震仪器部署仍在准备中，且流体监测尚处于试点阶段。

tm.why: The paper describes the deployment of shallow borehole 3D seismic arrays and broadband seismometers for high-frequency monitoring.
The project monitors mantle-derived CO2 degassing, mofette fields, and maar volcanoes to study magmatic fluids.
The geodynamic laboratory targets crustal fluid flow and earthquake swarms in the Eger Rift.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the official ICDP Eger project abstract and metadata from OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study uses finite-element numerical modeling to investigate how wedge subduction—the final stage of oceanic subduction—affects the dynamic modes of subsequent terrane-continent collision (TCC) versus continental-terrane subduction (CTS). Using the Paleo-Tethys Ocean closure as a natural laboratory, the authors systematically test the effects of initial wedge subduction angle, convergence rate, plate configuration, and continental terrane strength. They find that low subduction angles, fast convergence, and strong terranes promote TCC, whereas steep angles, slow convergence, and weak terranes favor CTS. These modeling results explain the observed east-west structural variations along the Paleo-Tethys suture zone, where the western/central segments likely underwent CTS and the eastern segment underwent TCC. This work provides a new geodynamic framework for understanding structural diversity in suture zones.
本研究利用有限元模拟探讨了楔形俯冲对地体-大陆碰撞（TCC）与大陆-地体俯冲（CTS）模式的影响。以古特提斯洋闭合为背景，发现低俯冲角、快速收敛和强地体有利于TCC模式，而陡俯冲角、慢速收敛和弱地体促进CTS模式。该结果解释了古特提斯缝合带东西段的结构差异，为理解全球缝合带多样性提供了新动力学视角。

t: 2D finite-element numerical modeling of lithospheric deformation to simulate the transition from oceanic wedge subduction to terrane-continent collision.
用于模拟从大洋楔形俯冲到地体-大陆碰撞转变的二维岩石圈变形有限元数值模拟。
Synthetic geodynamic model runs with varying physical parameters, qualitatively compared against geological and tomographic observations of the Paleo-Tethys suture zone.
改变物理参数的合成地球动力学模型运行，并与古特提斯缝合带的地质和断层成像观测进行定性对比。
Low wedge angles, fast convergence, and strong terranes favor terrane-continent collision (TCC), while steep angles, slow convergence, and weak terranes favor continental-terrane subduction (CTS).
低楔形角、快速收敛和强地体有利于地体-大陆碰撞（TCC），而陡角度、慢速收敛和弱地体则有利于大陆-地体俯冲（CTS）。
The 2D geometry simplifies complex 3D tectonic features such as oblique subduction and lateral slab tear during the Paleo-Tethys closure.
二维几何结构简化了复杂的三维构造特征，如古特提斯闭合期间的斜向俯冲和板块横向撕裂。
Systematically demonstrates the overlooked role of pre-collision wedge subduction geometry and dynamics in controlling the subsequent style of continental collision.
系统地论证了碰撞前楔形俯冲几何形状和动力学在控制随后大陆碰撞样式中被忽视的作用。

kc: Established a quantitative link between pre-collisional wedge subduction parameters and subsequent continental collision modes (TCC vs. CTS).
Explained the structural diversity and east-west segment variations of the Paleo-Tethys suture zone using geodynamic modeling.
建立了碰撞前楔形俯冲参数与随后大陆碰撞模式（TCC与CTS）之间的定量联系。
利用地球动力学模拟解释了古特提斯缝合带东西段的结构多样性与差异。
me: 2D finite-element geodynamic modeling of lithospheric deformation and subduction processes.
岩石圈变形与俯冲过程的二维有限元地球动力学数值模拟。
de: Synthetic numerical experiments varying wedge subduction angle, convergence rate, plate polarity, and terrane strength, compared with Paleo-Tethys geological and tomographic observations.
改变楔形俯冲角度、收敛速率、板块极性和地体强度的合成数值实验，并与古特提斯地质及断层成像观测进行对比。
li: The study relies on simplified 2D finite-element models which may not capture 3D toroidal flow or oblique subduction effects.
研究依赖于简化的二维有限元模型，可能无法捕捉三维环流或斜向俯冲效应。

tm.why: The paper uses finite-element geodynamic modeling to investigate the lithospheric deformation and collision modes of terranes and continents.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the GJI abstract and metadata.

sum: The origin of mid-mantle seismic discontinuities (660–2000 km) beneath subduction zones remains enigmatic. This study couples 2D thermo-mechanical subduction modeling (ASPECT) with viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) polycrystalline plasticity calculations incorporating recently constrained pressure-dependent slip transitions in bridgmanite. As slab-driven flow deforms the surrounding lower mantle, a gradual transition in the dominant bridgmanite slip system from (100)[001] to (010)[100] near 40 GPa (~1000 km) creates a localized minimum in total anisotropy, manifesting as an anisotropic discontinuity that deepens to ~1400 km beneath the slab. Anisotropic reflection coefficients and 3D global full-waveform simulations (AxiSEM3D) processed via vespagram array stacking show that underside shear-wave reflections (SdS) exceed global detectability thresholds, without requiring thermo-chemical contrasts. Furthermore, the pressure-dependent fabric reconciles radially anisotropic tomography (ξ) and source-side shear-wave splitting patterns observed beneath regions like Western Java.
俯冲带下方中地幔地震间断面（1000 km附近）的成因尚不明确。本研究将二维热-力学俯冲数值模拟（ASPECT）与粘塑性自洽（VPSC）织构演化计算相结合，引入了布里奇曼石随压力变化的滑移系转换机制。研究发现，板片驱动的地幔流使布里奇曼石在约40 GPa（~1000 km）处发生主滑移系由(100)……

t: Couples 2D thermo-mechanical subduction models (ASPECT) with pressure-dependent viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) bridgmanite fabric calculations, anisotropic reflection analysis (ATRAK), and 3D global spectral-element waveform simulations (AxiSEM3D).
耦合二维热-力学俯冲模拟（ASPECT）、压力依赖的布里奇曼石VPSC织构计算与三维全波形模拟（AxiSEM3D）。

Uses experimentally constrained pressure-dependent bridgmanite slip systems up to 50 GPa, synthetic 3000-station array waveforms from AxiSEM3D, and comparisons with SGLOBE-Rani tomography and Western Java shear-wave splitting.
采用高达50 GPa的布里奇曼石滑移实验约束、3000台站合成台阵波形，以及SGLOBE-Rani模型和西爪哇横波分裂数…

Slip transition at 40 GPa produces an anisotropic discontinuity deepening from ~1000 to ~1400 km with reflection coefficients up to ~0.02 and a detectable synthetic SdS/SS amplitude ratio of 0.0084 at 112°.
40 GPa处的滑移转变产生1000–1400 km深的各向异性间断面，反射系数达0.02，112°震中距处SdS/SS…
Discontinuity sharpness is limited by finite Lagrangian tracer density and mesh resolution, while modeled shear-wave splitting delay times underestimate observed values.
间断面锐度受限于示踪粒子密度和网格分辨率，且模拟的横波分裂延迟时间低于实际观测值。

Proposes a purely strain-induced mineral physics mechanism—pressure-dependent slip transitions in bridgmanite—to explain mid-mantle seismic discontinuities without requiring thermo-chemical boundaries.
提出纯应变诱导的布里奇曼石压力依赖滑移转换机制，无需热-化学边界即可解释中地幔间断面。

kc: Demonstrates that pressure-induced slip transitions in bridgmanite from (100)[001] to (010)[100] around 40 GPa generate a mid-mantle anisotropic discontinuity between 1000 and 1400 km depth beneath subducting slabs.

Verifies via anisotropic reflection coefficients and 3D AxiSEM3D full-waveform simulations that the strain-induced discontinuity produces detectable SS precursors (SdS/SS amplitude ratio ~0.0084) in array vespagrams.
Reconciles lower-mantle radial anisotropy patterns (ξ) and source-side shear wave splitting fast polarization directions observed beneath the Western Java subduction zone.
证明了布里奇曼石在40 GPa附近从(100)[001]到(010)[100]的压力诱导滑移转变可在俯冲板片下方1000–1400 km深度产生中地幔各向异性间断面。
通过各向异性反射系数和三维AxiSEM3D全波形模拟验证了该应变诱导间断面在台阵慢度谱中可产生可探测的SS前驱波（SdS/SS振幅比达0.0084）。
成功调和并解释了西爪哇俯冲带下方观测到的下地幔径向各向异性分布特征（ξ）以及震源侧横波分裂快波偏振方向。
me: 2D thermo-chemical free-subduction finite-element modeling using ASPECT with adaptive mesh refinement.
Lagrangian tracer advection coupled with Visco-Plastic Self-Consistent (VPSC) polycrystalline texture evolution using pressure-dependent critically resolved shear stresses (CRSS) for bridgmanite.
Polycrystal elastic tensor homogenization (Voigt-Reuss-Hill) and calculation of azimuthally varying reflection coefficients (REFVEC/ATRAK) and effective shear wave splitting (MSAT).
3D global spectral-element full-waveform simulations using AxiSEM3D followed by 4th-root stacking and slowness vespagram array analysis.
利用开源有限元软件ASPECT开展自适应网格加密的二维热-化学自由俯冲数值模拟。
结合拉格朗日示踪粒子追踪与引入压力依赖临界分切应力（CRSS）的粘塑性自洽（VPSC）多晶织构演化计算。
采用Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均计算多晶弹性张量，并利用REFVEC/ATRAK计算方位角相关的各向异性反射系数及利用MSAT计算有效横波分裂。
使用AxiSEM3D开展全球尺度三维谱元法全波形合成，结合四次方根叠加与慢度谱（vespagram）台阵分析检验可探测性。
de: Two 2D geodynamic subduction scenarios: a deeply flattened slab near 1000 km depth and a shallowly stagnating slab near 660 km depth.
Experimentally constrained pressure-dependent bridgmanite deformation fabrics from laser-heated diamond anvil cell experiments up to 50 GPa.
Synthetic seismic array dataset of 3000 stations (minimum period 4 s) simulated with AxiSEM3D for purely anisotropic versus isotropic harzburgitic slab models.
Comparison against global radially anisotropic tomography model SGLOBE-Rani and published source-side shear wave splitting measurements beneath Western Java and Honshu.
两类二维地球动力学俯冲模型：在1000 km附近深部平坦化的板片模型与在660 km附近浅部滞留的板片模型。
基于激光加热金刚石压腔实验约束的高达50 GPa的压力依赖布里奇曼石变形组构数据。
利用AxiSEM3D在3000个台站组成的合成地震台阵上模拟的最短周期4 s的三维合成波形（对比纯各向异性模型与各向同性方辉橄榄岩板片模型）。
与全球径向各向异性层析成像模型SGLOBE-Rani及西爪哇、本州俯冲带已发表的震源侧横波分裂观测数据进行对比验证。
li: VPSC modeling does not incorporate dynamic recrystallization, and strain partitioning between phases is omitted.
Spatial sharpness of the modeled anisotropic discontinuity is limited by the finite number of Lagrangian tracers and geodynamic mesh resolution.

Modeled shear-wave splitting delay times are underestimated compared to observations, likely due to neglecting secondary anisotropic phases (akimotoite, phase D), shape-preferred orientation (SPO), or complex receiver-side anisotropy.
VPSC模拟未包含动态重结晶过程，且忽略了不同矿物相之间的应变分配。
模拟的各向异性间断面空间锐度受限于拉格朗日示踪粒子数量以及地球动力学网格分辨率。
模拟的横波分裂延迟时间低于实际观测值，可能是由于忽略了次要各向异性矿物（秋本石、D相）、形状优选取向（SPO）或复杂的台站侧各向异性偏差。

tm.why: The paper models crystallographic preferred orientation (CPO) of bridgmanite, radial anisotropy, and shear-wave splitting in the lower mantle.
The study couples 2D thermo-mechanical subduction models in ASPECT with mantle mineral physics to explain mid-mantle structures around 1000–1400 km depth.
The authors perform 3D global full-waveform simulations using AxiSEM3D and synthetic array processing to evaluate SS precursor detectability.

ev.notes: Full 14-page article PDF (Nature Communications, 2026) including all main text, methods, and 6 figures was analyzed directly.

sum: This study identifies and characterizes 'repeated burst' (rb) sequences, a subtype of repeating earthquakes in North Chile. Unlike single-asperity repeaters, rb-sequences consist of short, dense event clusters that recur after long quiescent intervals. Using high-precision relative relocation, waveform similarity subclustering, and empirical moment-to-slip scaling, the authors analyze 19 rb-families (focusing on three in detail). They show that these sequences represent multi-asperity systems where closely spaced velocity-weakening patches fail in rapid succession. This behavior is driven by mechanical coupling via postseismic creep and elevated stressing rates within a creeping, velocity-strengthening fault zone. The study provides observational evidence of earthquake synchronization on small spatial and temporal scales, offering new insights into fault-zone properties and interaction.
本研究识别并表征了智利北部重复地震的一种新子类型——“重复爆发”（rb）序列。与单微凸体重复地震不同，rb序列表现为在较长静止期后发生的高密度短时群震。研究利用高精度相对重定位、波形相似性子聚类和经验矩-滑动标度关系，详细分析了19个rb家族中的3个。结果表明，rb序列反映了多微凸体系统，即在蠕变的……

t: High-precision relative relocation, waveform-similarity subclustering, and empirical moment-to-slip scaling to characterize repeating earthquake clusters.
利用高精度相对重定位、波形相似性子聚类和经验矩-滑动标度关系表征重复地震序列。
Seismic waveform data from North Chile, identifying 19 repeated burst families and analyzing three in extensive detail.
智利北部的地震波形数据，识别出19个重复爆发家族并对其中3个进行了详细分析。
Repeated burst sequences represent multi-asperity systems where closely spaced patches fail in rapid succession, driven by postseismic creep.
重复爆发序列代表多微凸体系统，紧密相邻的微凸体在震后蠕变驱动下发生快速连续破裂。
Detailed analysis is restricted to three families in North Chile, and relies on empirical scaling assumptions.
详细分析仅限于智利北部的三个家族，且依赖于经验标度假设。
Defines and characterizes 'repeated burst' sequences as a signature of synchronized multi-asperity recurrence rather than single-asperity failure.
首次将“重复爆发”序列定义并表征为多微凸体同步复发而非单微凸体破裂的特征。

kc: Identified and defined 'repeated burst' (rb) sequences as a distinct subtype of repeating earthquakes.
Demonstrated that rb-sequences represent multi-asperity systems rather than single-asperity repeaters.
Proposed a physical model where mechanical coupling via postseismic creep drives synchronized recurrence of adjacent patches.
识别并定义了“重复爆发”（rb）序列，作为重复地震的一种独特子类型。
证明了rb序列代表多微凸体系统，而非传统的单微凸体重复地震。
提出了一个物理模型，即通过震后蠕变进行的机械耦合驱动了相邻微凸体的同步复发。
me: High-precision relative relocation of earthquake clusters.
Waveform similarity subclustering to group events.
Empirical moment-to-slip scaling to estimate slip behavior.
地震震群的高精度相对重定位。
用于事件分组的波形相似性子聚类。
用于估算滑动行为的经验矩-滑动标度关系。
de: Seismic waveform data from North Chile capturing repeating earthquake sequences.
Detailed analysis of 19 identified rb-families, with 3 analyzed in extensive detail.
捕获了重复地震序列的智利北部地震波形数据。
对识别出的19个rb家族进行了详细分析，其中3个进行了深入剖析。
li: Detailed analysis is limited to a small number of families (3 out of 19) in a specific region (North Chile).
Relies on empirical scaling relations which may have inherent uncertainties.
详细分析仅限于特定区域（智利北部）的少数家族（19个中的3个）。
依赖于可能存在固有不确定性的经验标度关系。

tm.why: The paper investigates the recurrence, synchronization, and multi-asperity rupture dynamics of repeating earthquake sequences.
It models how aseismic creep and mechanical coupling drive synchronized earthquake bursts on faults.
It identifies and characterizes a specific subtype of repeating earthquakes using relocation and clustering.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: Template matching typically requires historical earthquake waveforms, limiting its utility in newly monitored or aseismic areas such as greenfield geothermal or CO2 storage sites. This study introduces a modified matched-filter routine using 2,975 synthetic templates generated from a 1D velocity model (via Pyrocko/QSEIS) spanning a 3D spatial grid and five elementary double-couple focal mechanisms. To overcome arrival-time inaccuracies inherent to 1D models, the authors implement a 0.5 s sliding-window similarity time-smearing algorithm in ObsPy. Tested on one day of continuous 8-station WEBNET data from West Bohemia (Czechia), the routine (threshold 0.4) detected 264 real local events with zero false alarms and completeness magnitude Mc = -0.1. Although outperformed in Mc by an amplitude-based detector-locator (PEPiN, Mc = -0.5) and an Artificial Neural Network (Mc = -0.7), the synthetic template approach uniquely delivers robust epicentral locations (~1.2 km error) and reliable focal mechanism estimates via similarity-weighted moment tensor combinations.
传统模板匹配依赖历史地震波形，难以用于新建台网或无震区监测。本文提出一种改进的匹配滤波流程，利用一维速度模型和五种基本双力偶震源机制在三维空间网格生成2975个合成模板，并在ObsPy中引入0.5秒滑动窗口相似度时间平滑算法以克服一维模型走时误差。在捷克西波希米亚WEBNET台网8个台站的单日连续数……

t: Modified matched-filter detection in ObsPy using 2,975 Pyrocko/QSEIS synthetic templates across a 3D spatial grid and five elementary focal mechanisms, applying a 0.5 s sliding-window maximum ('time-smearing') to cross-correlation traces to accommodate 1D velocity model travel-time errors.
基于三维空间网格和五种基本震源机制生成2975个合成模板，对互相关序列应用0.5秒滑动窗口最大值平滑以克服一维模型走时误…

One day (18 May 2018) of continuous 250 Hz broadband seismic data from 8 WEBNET stations in West Bohemia, Czechia, alongside 2,975 synthetic templates (1-10 Hz) generated from a 1D regional velocity model.
捷克西波希米亚WEBNET台网8个台站2018年5月18日的连续宽频带数据，以及一维速度模型生成的2975个合成模板。

At cross-correlation threshold 0.4, the method detected 264 real local events with zero false alarms (Mc = -0.1), achieving average epicentral differences of 1.2 km compared to PEPiN and reliable strike-slip focal mechanism estimates inside the network.
阈值0.4下零误报检测出264个真实地方震（Mc=-0.1），与PEPiN平均震中差1.2 km，并可靠估计台网内走滑震…
It does not outperform PEPiN (Mc = -0.5) or ANN (Mc = -0.7) in completeness magnitude, has poorly constrained depth estimates, and produces false alarms when the threshold is lowered to 0.35.
完备震级不及PEPiN和ANN，震源深度约束较差，且阈值降至0.35时会产生误报。

Combines a 1D-model synthetic template grid of five elementary focal mechanisms with similarity time-smearing to simultaneously detect, locate, and estimate focal mechanisms without prior earthquake catalogs.
结合五种基本震源机制合成模板与相似度时间平滑，无需先验目录即可同时检测、定位并估计震源机制。

kc: Developed a modified matched-filter routine in ObsPy incorporating a 0.5 s sliding-window maximum ('time-smearing') on cross-correlation traces to handle travel-time errors from 1D velocity models.
Demonstrated that a grid of 2,975 synthetic templates using five elementary double-couple focal mechanisms can detect local seismicity (Mc = -0.1 at xc = 0.4) with zero false detections.
Formulated a similarity-weighted linear combination of elementary moment tensors to automatically estimate focal mechanisms directly from template detections.
Benchmarked synthetic template matching against established operational detectors (PEPiN and ANN) on the West Bohemia WEBNET dataset.
在ObsPy中开发了改进的匹配滤波程序，对互相关序列引入0.5秒滑动窗口最大值（时间平滑），以消除一维速度模型引起的走时误差。
证明了结合五种基本双力偶震源机制的2975个合成模板网格能够零误报地检测地方微震（阈值为0.4时Mc = -0.1）。
提出了基于相似度加权的基本矩张量线性组合方法，直接从模板检测结果中自动估计震源机制。
在西波希米亚WEBNET数据集上，将合成模板匹配与现有业务化检测方法（PEPiN和人工神经网络）进行了系统对比基准测试。
me: Synthetic waveform generation (1-10 Hz) using Pyrocko and the QSEIS viscoelastic layered half-space backend with a 1D regional velocity model.
Template grid construction spanning 6 x 16 km horizontally and 7-11 km in depth (1 km spacing) with 5 elementary double-couple focal mechanisms per node.
Single combined P+S window cross-correlation with a 0.5 s sliding-window local maximum smearing function to accommodate up to 0.43 s relative arrival-time errors.
Focal mechanism reconstruction by linear combination of the five elementary moment tensors weighted by detection similarity scores.
基于一维区域速度模型，利用Pyrocko和QSEIS粘弹性层状半空间后端生成1-10 Hz合成地震波形。
构建水平跨度6×16 km、深度7-11 km（间距1 km）的模板网格，每个节点配置5种基本双力偶震源机制。
采用单一P+S联合窗口互相关，并结合0.5秒滑动窗口局部最大值平滑函数，以容忍高达0.43秒的相对走时误差。
利用检测相似度得分作为权重，对五个基本矩张量进行线性组合以重构事件震源机制。
de: Continuous 250 Hz broadband waveform data from an 8-station subset of the WEBNET network in West Bohemia, Czechia, recorded on 18 May 2018.
2,975 synthetic templates generated from the 1D isotropic velocity model of Málek et al. (2005) / Vavryčuk et al. (2022).
Comparative evaluation against 507 events from the automated polarization-based detector PEPiN, 724 detections from an Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and 7 manually derived moment tensors.
捷克西波希米亚WEBNET台网8个宽频带台站子集于2018年5月18日记录的250 Hz连续波形数据。
基于Málek等（2005）和Vavryčuk等（2022）的一维各向同性速度模型生成的2975个合成模板。
与基于极化的自动检测器PEPiN（507个事件）、人工神经网络ANN（724次检测）以及7个人工反演的矩张量解进行对比评估。
li: Higher magnitude of completeness (Mc = -0.1 at xc = 0.4; Mc = -0.3 at xc = 0.35) compared to PEPiN (Mc = -0.5) and ANN (Mc = -0.7).
Lowering the cross-correlation threshold to 0.35 introduces false detections (36 noise/uncertain triggers and 11 distant/LFE events), including false alarms with interpreted ML > 0.7.
Poor vertical (depth) resolution due to the 0.5 s similarity time-smearing window and limited sensitivity of detection similarity to depth variations.
Inaccurate focal mechanism estimates and degraded location accuracy for events located outside the perimeter of the seismic network (Southern cluster).
完备震级（xc=0.4时Mc=-0.1；xc=0.35时Mc=-0.3）高于PEPiN（Mc=-0.5）和人工神经网络（Mc=-0.7）。
将互相关阈值降至0.35会引入误报（36个噪声/不确定触发和11个远震/低频事件），甚至包含解释震级ML>0.7的虚假事件。
受0.5秒相似度时间平滑窗口限制，震源深度分辨率较差，检测相似度对深度变化不敏感。
对于台网外围（南部丛集）的地震事件，定位精度下降且震源机制解释结果不可靠。

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates a synthetic template matching routine for detecting, locating, and cataloging local microseismicity.
The method uses a grid of five elementary double-couple focal mechanisms to simultaneously estimate focal mechanisms of detected events via moment tensor linear combinations.
The methodology is specifically designed and framed as a monitoring framework for potential induced seismicity in previously aseismic regions (e.g., geothermal, CO2 storage).

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF analyzed, including all methodology sections, equations, quantitative results, and 10 figures.

sum: Existing probabilistic fault displacement hazard analysis (PFDHA) models rely on aggregate principal displacement, implicitly assuming infinite structural widths that intersect all overlapping rupture strands simultaneously. This study introduces a rupture-level PFDHA framework calibrated using 75 surface-rupturing earthquakes from the Fault Displacement Hazard Initiative (FDHI) database. Using event and segment coordinate systems, individual overlapping rupture strands are reconstructed via linear displacement interpolation. The framework statistically models three components: (1) number of overlapping ruptures using a magnitude- and curvature-dependent Hurdle model, (2) displacement partitioning among strands using symmetric Dirichlet and Beta distributions that conserve the aggregate displacement budget, and (3) strike-normal strand locations relative to three alternative fault-trace definitions using Student's t and mixture distributions. Applied to IAEA benchmark scenarios, the framework demonstrates that aggregate metrics provide overly conservative upper bounds, whereas explicitly modeling finite structural footprints and discrete strand intersections yields realistic, infrastructure-specific displacement hazard estimates.
现有概率断层位移危险性分析（PFDHA）通常采用总主位移指标，隐含假设工程结构同时跨越所有重叠破裂带。本研究基于FDHI数据库中75次地表破裂地震数据，提出了一种破裂带尺度的PFDHA新框架。通过事件与分段坐标系重建单条主破裂带，该框架对三个核心要素进行概率建模：（1）依赖震级和断层曲率的重叠破裂数……

t: Decomposes aggregate principal displacement into discrete rupture demands using a Bernoulli-Poisson Hurdle model for strand count, Beta/Dirichlet distributions for slip partitioning, and Student's t models for strike-normal location.
利用Hurdle模型、Beta/Dirichlet分布和Student's t分布，将总主位移分解为单条破裂带的离散位移…

Uses the standardized FDHI database of 75 surface-rupturing earthquakes (1872–2019), containing over 40,000 displacement measurements at ~28,000 sites and 91,051 rupture lines derived from 763,691 vertices.
采用FDHI数据库的75次地表破裂地震（1872–2019），含超4万个位移测量值和91,051条破裂线。

Across IAEA benchmark cases, aggregate displacement models yield conservative upper-bound hazard estimates, whereas single- and multi-rupture formulations reduce hazard by accounting for finite structural spans and strand intersection probabilities.
IAEA基准测试表明总位移模型给出保守上限，而单破裂和多破裂模型通过考虑结构有限跨度降低了危险性估计。

Limited normal and reverse faulting observations introduce epistemic uncertainty, and trade-offs between parameters k4 and lambda prevent reliable identification of upper confidence bounds in the SCS distance model.
正逆断层数据有限带来认知不确定性，且SCS距离模型中参数k4与λ存在折衷导致置信上限难以唯一约束。

Reformulates principal fault displacement hazard from an aggregate metric into a physically consistent rupture-level representation that conserves total slip budget while explicitly incorporating rupture curvature and finite structural footprints.
将主断层位移危险性从总位移指标重构为守恒总位移预算的破裂带尺度表征，显式纳入断层曲率与结构有限尺寸。

kc: Reconstructs individual overlapping principal rupture profiles from the FDHI database using Event and Segment Coordinate Systems with linear interpolation.
Formulates a generalized rupture-level PFDHA equation integrating strand multiplicity, displacement budget partitioning, and spatial intersection probability.
Develops empirical Hurdle, Beta/Dirichlet, and Student's t mixture models capturing dependencies on magnitude, fault style, curvature, and normalized slip.
Demonstrates on IAEA benchmark cases that aggregate displacement models overestimate hazard for finite-width structures compared to single- and multi-rupture formulations.
利用事件和分段坐标系及线性插值方法，从FDHI数据库中重建了单条重叠主破裂带的位移剖面。
建立了通用的破裂带尺度PFDHA方程，融合了破裂带数量、总位移预算分配及空间相交概率。
构建了经验Hurdle模型、Beta/Dirichlet模型和Student's t混合分布模型，量化了震级、断层类型、曲率和归一化位移的影响。
通过IAEA基准算例证明，与单破裂和多破裂模型相比，传统总位移模型高估了有限宽度工程结构的断层位移危险性。
me: Generalized Coordinate System (GC2) transformation into Event (ECS) and Segment Coordinate Systems (SCS) with along-strike linear slip interpolation.
Bernoulli-Poisson Hurdle regression for modeling the number of overlapping principal rupture strands as a function of magnitude and fault curvature.
Constrained Beta and symmetric Dirichlet distributions for partitioning aggregate displacement across multiple overlapping strands.
Student's t and two-component Student's t mixture distributions for modeling strike-normal distances to SCS, random, and maximum-displacement fault traces.
Maximum likelihood estimation with event-level inverse-observation weighting and Wilks' profile-likelihood confidence intervals.
基于广义坐标系（GC2）转换的事件坐标系（ECS）和分段坐标系（SCS）构建，以及沿走向的线性位移插值。
以震级和断层曲率为预测变量的Bernoulli-Poisson Hurdle回归模型，用于预测重叠主破裂带数量。
满足总位移守恒约束的Beta分布与对称Dirichlet分布，用于模拟多条重叠破裂带间的位移分配比例。
采用Student's t分布及双分量Student's t混合分布，模拟相对于SCS迹线、随机迹线和最大位移迹线的垂直断层距离。
结合事件级观测数量逆权重与Wilks剖面似然置信区间的最大似然参数估计。
de: Fault Displacement Hazard Initiative (FDHI) database comprising 75 historical surface-rupturing earthquakes (1872–2019) with over 40,000 displacement measurements and 91,051 rupture lines.
Evaluation on four IAEA PFDHA benchmark scenarios: Kumamoto Case 2 and Case 3 (strike-slip), Norcia Case 1 (normal), and Le Teil Case 2 (reverse).
断层位移危险性计划（FDHI）数据库，包含1872至2019年间75次历史地表破裂地震、超过40,000个位移测量值和91,051条破裂线。
在四个IAEA PFDHA基准算例上进行评估：熊本地震算例2和算例3（走滑）、诺尔恰地震算例1（正断层）以及勒泰伊地震算例2（逆断层）。
li: Limited observational data for normal and reverse faulting events introduces higher epistemic uncertainty requiring grouped regressions and logic-tree weighting.
Upper profile-likelihood confidence bounds for parameters k4 and lambda in the SCS distance model are weakly identifiable due to parameter trade-offs.
Accuracy of inferring future surface rupture trace definitions from pre-earthquake geological observations remains unquantified and distributed ruptures are not yet decomposed.
正断层和逆断层地震事件观测数据相对有限，引入了较高的认知不确定性，需采用分组回归和逻辑树加权。
SCS距离模型中参数k4和λ之间存在强烈折衷，导致其剖面似然置信区间上限难以仅靠数据唯一确定。
利用震前地质观测推断未来地表破裂迹线的精度尚待量化，且框架尚未扩展至分布式次生破裂。

tm.why: The paper develops a new probabilistic fault displacement hazard analysis (PFDHA) framework for engineering structures crossing active faults.
The study reconstructs and statistically characterizes surface fault rupture geometries, strand counts, curvature, and displacement partitioning across 75 earthquakes.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 51-page manuscript PDF including all mathematical formulations, 19 figures, and 9 tables.

sum: This paper presents a novel prestack diffraction separation workflow to isolate weak diffractions from strong reflections, facilitating high-resolution imaging of small-scale subsurface discontinuities like fractures and karst caves. The method first applies normal moveout (NMO) to enhance kinematic differences between diffracted and reflected waves. It then utilizes a quantum mechanical framework based on the Schrödinger equation to construct data-adaptive wave functions. Unlike fixed-basis transforms, these adaptive wave functions effectively capture the amplitude and frequency characteristics of both wave types. Reflections are reconstructed using their corresponding wave functions and subtracted from the shot gathers to isolate diffractions. Synthetic tests demonstrate successful detection of 5-m karst caves and faults, while application to the Nankai dataset confirms its capability to extract fracture-related diffractions under complex geological conditions.
本文提出基于薛定谔方程自适应变换的叠前衍射波分离方法。方法先用NMO增强反射与衍射波的运动学差异，再在量子力学框架下构建自适应波函数表征其特征，最后重构并扣除反射波以提取衍射波。合成与南海数据测试表明，该方法能有效识别5米级溶洞与断层，并在复杂地质下成功提取裂缝相关的微弱衍射波，实现高分辨率成像。

t: An adaptive transform based on the Schrödinger equation constructs data-adaptive wave functions to characterize and separate diffracted and reflected components in NMO-corrected shot gathers.
基于薛定谔方程自适应变换构建自适应波函数，以表征并分离NMO校正后的衍射与反射分量。
Synthetic datasets modeling 5-m karst caves and faults, along with the field Nankai dataset featuring complex geological fractures.
包含5米级溶洞与断层的合成数据集，以及具有复杂地质裂缝的南海实际地震数据集。
Successful isolation of weak diffractions, enabling the detection of 5-m karst caves and faults, and characterization of fractures in the Nankai dataset.
成功分离微弱衍射波，实现了对5米级溶洞和断层的检测，以及南海数据中裂缝特征的刻画。
Potential sensitivity to NMO velocity accuracy and lack of detailed discussion on 3D computational efficiency.
对NMO速度准确性可能存在敏感性，且缺乏对三维计算效率的详细讨论。
Using a quantum mechanical Schrödinger framework to build data-adaptive wave functions instead of fixed-basis transforms for seismic diffraction separation.
利用薛定谔方程框架构建数据自适应波函数，而非传统固定基变换进行衍射波分离。

kc: Developed a novel prestack diffraction separation workflow based on a Schrödinger equation-based adaptive transform.
Introduced data-adaptive wave functions within a quantum mechanical framework to characterize seismic data without relying on fixed bases.
Demonstrated the method's capability to detect 5-m karst caves and faults in synthetic tests and extract fracture-related diffractions in the Nankai dataset.
开发了一种基于薛定谔方程自适应变换的叠前衍射波分离新工作流。
引入了量子力学框架下的数据自适应波函数，无需依赖固定基即可有效表征地震数据。
通过合成测试证明了该方法检测5米级溶洞和断层的能力，并在南海数据集中成功提取了与裂缝相关的衍射波。
me: Normal moveout (NMO) correction to enhance kinematic differences between reflections and diffractions.
Schrödinger equation-based adaptive transform to construct data-adaptive wave functions.
Wavefield reconstruction of reflections and subsequent subtraction from shot gathers to isolate diffractions.
动校正（NMO）处理，用以增强反射波与衍射波之间的运动学差异。
基于薛定谔方程的自适应变换，用于构建数据自适应波函数。
反射波场的重构，并从炮记录中扣除以分离出衍射波。
de: Synthetic seismic data testing for 5-m karst caves and faults with identical throw.
Field application using the Nankai seismic dataset under complex geological conditions.
针对5米级岩溶发育区和相同落差断层的合成地震数据测试。
复杂地质条件下的南海（Nankai）实际地震数据集应用。
li: The method relies on NMO correction, which may be sensitive to velocity model accuracy in complex media.
Computational cost associated with solving the Schrödinger equation-based adaptive transform for large 3D datasets is not fully detailed.
该方法依赖于动校正（NMO），在复杂介质中可能对速度模型的准确性较为敏感。
在大规模三维数据集上求解基于薛定谔方程的自适应变换所带来的计算成本尚未详细阐明。

tm.why: The paper focuses on prestack diffraction separation to image small-scale subsurface discontinuities such as fractures and karst caves.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and metadata.

sum: This paper presents a user-guided sequential parameter-estimation workflow to estimate anisotropic parameters in vertically transversely isotropic (VTI) media. Addressing the strong coupling between background velocity and anisotropic parameters in long-offset seismic data, the authors replace conventional low-order or fourth-order nonhyperbolic moveout approximations with a high-accuracy traveltime operator. This operator is integrated with a semi-automatic moveout-flattening and parameter-selection procedure. Using an objective-function-based grid search, the workflow estimates moveout parameters to recover Thomsen parameters eta and delta. Numerical tests on undulating layered models and applications to marine field reflection data demonstrate that this approach provides robust and efficient initial models for anisotropic seismic imaging and velocity model building.
本文提出一种用户引导的顺序参数估计工作流，用于估算VTI介质各向异性参数。针对长偏移距数据中速度与参数强耦合问题，该方法采用高精度走时算子代替传统低阶动校正近似，结合半自动动校正拉平与网格搜索。数值模拟和海洋实际数据应用表明，该方法能有效提高Thomsen参数估算可靠性，为各向异性成像提供稳健的初始……

t: A sequential parameter-estimation workflow integrating a high-accuracy long-offset traveltime operator with a semi-automatic moveout-flattening and grid-search procedure.
结合高精度长偏移距走时算子与半自动动校正拉平及网格搜索的顺序参数估计工作流。
Synthetic undulating layered VTI models and marine field reflection seismic data.
起伏分层VTI合成模型以及海洋实际反射地震数据。
Improved reliability and robustness in estimating Thomsen anisotropic parameters, providing high-quality initial models for velocity building.
提高了Thomsen各向异性参数估算的可靠性，为速度建模提供了高质量的初始模型。
Requires manual user guidance to define target events, offset windows, and initial parameter ranges.
需要人工引导来定义目标事件、偏移窗口和初始参数范围。
Replacing conventional low-order approximations with a high-accuracy traveltime operator within a semi-automatic, decoupled sequential estimation framework.
在半自动、解耦的顺序估计框架中，用高精度走时算子替代了传统的低阶近似。

kc: Developed a user-guided sequential parameter-estimation workflow using a high-accuracy traveltime operator for long-offset seismic data.
Decoupled background velocity and anisotropic parameters using a semi-automatic moveout-flattening and grid-search procedure.
Demonstrated improved reliability and robustness in estimating Thomsen parameters on synthetic and marine field data.
开发了一种用户引导的顺序参数估计工作流，利用高精度走时算子处理长偏移距地震数据。
通过半自动动校正拉平和网格搜索程序，实现了背景速度与各向异性参数的解耦。
在合成模型和海洋实际数据上验证了该方法在估算Thomsen参数时的高可靠性与稳健性。
me: High-accuracy traveltime operator for long-offset nonhyperbolic moveout.
Two-step parameter-decoupling strategy.
Objective-function-based grid search for parameter selection.
Semi-automatic moveout-flattening.
适用于长偏移距非双曲线动校正的高精度走时算子。
两步参数解耦策略。
基于目标函数的网格搜索参数选择。
半自动动校正拉平技术。
de: Numerical experiments on undulating layered VTI models.
Application to marine field reflection seismic data.
起伏分层VTI模型的数值模拟实验。
海洋实际反射地震数据的应用。
li: Requires manual user guidance to specify target reflection events, zero-offset times, offset windows, and candidate parameter ranges.
Relies on a grid-search approach which can be computationally expensive if search ranges are large.
需要用户引导以指定目标反射事件、零偏移时间、偏移窗口及候选参数范围。
依赖网格搜索方法，若搜索范围过大可能会带来较高的计算成本。

tm.why: The paper focuses on estimating Thomsen anisotropic parameters in vertically transversely isotropic (VTI) media using traveltime approximations.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates mantle wedge seismic anisotropy in NE Japan by modeling olivine-enstatite crystal preferred orientation (CPO) using a 3-D thermomechanical flow model and forward-calculating local shear wave splitting (SWS). Contrasting trench-normal subduction in Tohoku (quasi-2-D E-W flow) with oblique subduction in Hokkaido (complex 3-D flow), the authors compare synthetic SWS parameters with 3,263 local intraslab S-wave splitting measurements. For vertical propagation, model-predicted location-averaged fast directions match station-averaged observations well (E-W in Tohoku, N-S in Hokkaido), demonstrating that local SWS primarily reflects shallow inflowing mantle wedge CPO. However, the model significantly overestimates delay times in both regions. Furthermore, incorporating realistic incidence angles and backazimuths for individual event-station pairs fails to explain the wide directional spread observed at individual stations, highlighting the influence of unmodeled crustal anisotropy, 3-D raypaths, and CPO over-saturation.
本研究利用日本东北俯冲带三维热力学地幔流模型，采用D-Rex计算橄榄石晶格优选方位（CPO）并正演合成地方震剪切波分裂（SWS）参数，与3263条板内地震观测对比。结果显示，模型预测的位置平均快波方向与台站平均观测高度一致（东北地区呈东西向，北海道呈南北向），证实地方S波分裂主要反映地幔楔浅部流入方……

t: The authors compute 3-D olivine-enstatite CPO evolution along mantle wedge streamlines using modified D-Rex, then forward-calculate 0.5 Hz Gaussian wavelet SWS through 5-km layered vertical columns using MSAT and Silver & Chan (1991) eigenvalue minimization.
用改进D-Rex沿三维流线计算橄榄石-顽火辉石CPO演化，再用MSAT和特征值最小化法正演5 km层状柱体0.5 Hz子…

A revised subset of 3,263 local intraslab S-wave splitting measurements (incidence angle ≤30°) across 352 stations from Nakajima & Hasegawa (2004) and Nakajima et al. (2006), focusing on six forearc, arc, and backarc stations.
筛选自N&H04和N06的352个台站3263条板内地方震S波分裂数据（入射角≤30°），重点对比6个弧前、岛弧和弧后代…

Model-predicted location-averaged fast directions match station averages (E-W in Tohoku, N-S in Hokkaido), but predicted average delay times (up to ~0.6 s in Tohoku, ~0.4 s in Hokkaido) overestimate observations (mostly 0.05–0.3 s) and miss single-event scatter.
预测位置平均快波方向与观测一致（东北呈东西向，北海道呈南北向），但高估了延迟时间（预测达0.4–0.6 s，观测多为0.…
The model neglects overriding crust and slab anisotropy, assumes only A-type olivine CPO, and uses 1-D horizontally infinite columns with straight raypaths rather than true 3-D paths.
忽略了上覆地壳与板片各向异性，仅假设A型橄榄石，且采用平层无限宽一维柱体和直线射线简化假设。

First quantitative forward modeling and direct station/event-pair comparison of 3-D mantle wedge CPO and local SWS across contrasting normal (Tohoku) and oblique (Hokkaido) subduction zones in NE Japan.
首次定量正演日本东北正向与斜向俯冲三维地幔楔CPO所致地方震SWS，并与台站及单事件观测直接对比。

kc: Quantitatively assessed the contribution of 3-D mantle wedge flow and olivine A-type CPO to local shear wave splitting in NE Japan (Tohoku and Hokkaido).
Demonstrated that station-averaged fast directions reflect the upper inflowing mantle wedge CPO, yielding E-W directions in trench-normal Tohoku and N-S in oblique Hokkaido.
Showed that 1-D column forward SWS models significantly overestimate delay times and cannot explain event-to-event fast direction scatter even when accounting for incidence angle and backazimuth.
定量评估了日本东北（东北地区与北海道）三维地幔楔流及A型橄榄石CPO对地方震剪切波分裂的贡献。
证明台站平均快波方向主要受控于地幔楔上部流入层的CPO，在正向俯冲的东北呈东西向，在斜向俯冲的北海道呈南北向。
揭示了一维柱状正演模型会显著高估延迟时间，且即使纳入入射角和反方位角也无法解释单事件快波方向的宽泛分布。
me: 3-D backward/downstream streamline tracking and mineral aggregate (70% A-type olivine, 30% enstatite) CPO evolution using modified D-Rex code.
Forward modeling of 0.5 Hz Gaussian wavelet shear wave splitting through 5-km layered anisotropic columns using MSAT and Silver & Chan (1991) eigenvalue minimization.
Sensitivity testing across a full 0–90° range of initial polarizations (1° intervals) as well as observed non-vertical incidence angles and backazimuths.
基于三维流场利用改进的D-Rex程序进行流线追踪，计算矿物集合体（70% A型橄榄石、30%顽火辉石）的CPO与完整弹性张量演化。
利用MSAT工具包和0.5 Hz高斯子波，通过5 km厚水平分层柱状模型正演SWS，并用Silver & Chan (1991)特征值最小化法提取分裂参数。
在0–90°全初始偏振角范围（步长1°）内开展敏感性计算，并针对典型事件-台站对引入实测入射角与反方位角。
de: 3-D thermomechanical subduction zone mantle flow velocity field for NE Japan from Wada et al. (2015).
Filtered subset of 3,263 local intraslab S-wave splitting measurements across 352 stations (incidence angle ≤30°) compiled from Nakajima & Hasegawa (2004) and Nakajima et al. (2006).
Detailed comparisons at six representative forearc, arc, and backarc stations: HMK, JAH, FUT in Tohoku and N.TRSH, N.STNH, N.OKEH in Hokkaido.
Wada et al. (2015) 建立的日本东北俯冲带三维热-力学地幔楔流场模型。
引自Nakajima & Hasegawa (2004) 和 Nakajima et al. (2006) 的352个台站共3263条板内地方震S波分裂观测数据（筛选入射角≤30°）。
在东北（HMK、JAH、FUT）与北海道（N.TRSH、N.STNH、N.OKEH）共6个代表性弧前、岛弧和弧后台站开展详细对比。
li: Overriding crust and subducting slab anisotropy are excluded from the forward SWS calculations.
Only A-type olivine CPO is modeled, neglecting temperature, stress, or water-induced transitions to B- or C-type olivine in the forearc corner.
Raypaths are simplified as vertical or straight lines through horizontally infinite 1-D columns translated onto a single 2-D transect per region.
D-Rex crystal alignment over-saturation and Silver & Chan (1991) single-layer equivalent fitting (cycle skipping) inflate modeled delay times.
正演计算未包含上覆地壳和俯冲板片内部的各向异性贡献。
全区仅假设A型橄榄石CPO，忽略了温度、应力或水含量导致的B型或C型CPO相变。
射线路径简化为穿过无限宽水平层状一维柱体的垂直或直线路径，且将远离剖面的事件平移至单一二维剖面上。
D-Rex模拟的晶格排列过饱和以及Silver & Chan (1991)等效单层拟合（周跳效应）导致预测延迟时间偏大。

tm.why: The paper explicitly models olivine crystal preferred orientation (CPO) and synthetic shear wave splitting (SWS) parameters and compares them against seismic observations in NE Japan.
The study connects 3-D numerical thermomechanical mantle wedge flow patterns under normal and oblique subduction to seismic anisotropy.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF text, equations/parameters, and all 5 figures were directly inspected and analyzed.

sum: Distinguishing whether deep-mantle chemical heterogeneities observed in ocean island basalts (OIBs) reflect preserved primordial mantle reservoirs or core-mantle exchange remains challenging. Here, the authors use machine learning potentials trained on first-principles data to accelerate path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations, quantifying equilibrium hydrogen isotope (D/H) fractionation between silicate melt and bridgmanite, ringwoodite, and wadsleyite under magma ocean conditions. Incorporating these fractionation factors into a middle-out magma ocean crystallization model demonstrates that mineral-melt fractionation is weak and opposing effects largely cancel out, resulting in a nearly uniform D/H distribution across the primitive mantle. Consequently, magma ocean solidification alone cannot explain the strongly deuterium-depleted signatures (δD as low as −218‰) observed in some OIBs. Combined with elevated 3He/4He and negative 182W anomalies, these extreme δD signatures are best explained by selective leakage of primordial volatiles from Earth's outer core across the core-mantle boundary.
区分洋岛玄武岩（OIBs）记录的深部地幔化学不均一性源于原始地幔储库还是核幔物质交换是一大难题。本研究利用基于第一性原理训练的机器学习势加速路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）模拟，定量计算了岩浆洋条件下硅酸盐熔体与布里奇曼石、林伍德石和瓦兹利石之间的平衡氢同位素分馏系数。将其纳入自中向外的岩浆洋结晶模型……

t: Machine learning potentials trained on DFT calculations via DP-GEN and DeePMD-kit accelerate path-integral molecular dynamics simulations, using the scaled-coordinates estimator to compute D/H β factors and a middle-out crystallization model to track mantle δD.
利用DFT数据训练机器学习势加速路径积分分子动力学模拟，结合缩放坐标估计器计算β因子并建立岩浆洋结晶模型。

DFT-labeled FPMD trajectories for hydrous pyrolite melt, bridgmanite, ringwoodite, and wadsleyite, evaluated via 20-ps PIMD trajectories across 1500–4500 K combined with experimental mineral-melt water partition coefficients.
含水地幔岩熔体、布里奇曼石、林伍德石和瓦兹利石的FPMD构型与1500–4500 K下的20 ps PIMD轨迹。

At 2500–4500 K, bridgmanite-melt 10^3 lnα is −4.9 to −1.6‰; at 2000–2500 K, ringwoodite-melt is −14.0 to −8.5‰ and wadsleyite-melt is +9.0 to +13.2‰, producing a primitive lower mantle only ~3‰ lighter than the initial magma ocean.
布里奇曼石-熔体分馏为−4.9至−1.6‰，结晶后原始下地幔δD仅比初始岩浆洋低约3‰，整体高度均一。

The crystallization model assumes a closed system without open-system atmospheric degassing or crystal-melt reequilibration, and exact selective transport mechanisms across the core-mantle boundary remain unresolved.
结晶模型假设为封闭系统且未耦合脱气，核源物质跨核幔边界的选择性传输机制仍有待阐明。

First quantitative evaluation of equilibrium D/H fractionation between silicate melt and deep-mantle minerals at magma ocean conditions accounting for nuclear quantum effects via MLP-accelerated PIMD.
首次计入核量子效应，定量约束了岩浆洋极端温压下硅酸盐熔体与深部地幔矿物间的平衡氢同位素分馏。

kc: Quantified equilibrium D/H fractionation factors between hydrous silicate melt and bridgmanite, ringwoodite, and wadsleyite at 2000–4500 K using machine-learning-accelerated PIMD simulations.
Demonstrated that pressure-induced hydrogen bond symmetrization and coordination number increases offset each other, making D/H β factors largely insensitive to pressure.
Showed via a middle-out magma ocean crystallization model that the primitive lower and upper mantle retain a nearly uniform δD distribution within ~3‰ of the initial magma ocean.
Ruled out magma ocean crystallization as the cause of extreme deuterium depletion in OIBs, supporting ongoing selective volatile leakage from Earth's core.
利用机器学习加速的路径积分分子动力学模拟，定量计算了2000–4500 K下含水硅酸盐熔体与布里奇曼石、林伍德石和瓦兹利石之间的平衡D/H分馏系数。
证明压力诱导的氢键对称化（键长增加）与配位数增加效应相互抵消，使D/H的β因子对压力不敏感。
通过自中向外的岩浆洋结晶模型表明，原始上下地幔保持几乎均一的δD分布，与初始岩浆洋差异在~3‰以内。
排除了岩浆洋结晶产生洋岛玄武岩极端贫氘特征的可能性，支持地球外核原始挥发分穿过核幔边界发生选择性泄漏的机制。
me: Machine learning potentials (MLPs) trained iteratively on density functional theory (DFT/GGA-PBE) trajectories using DP-GEN and DeePMD-kit.
Path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations in LAMMPS with 32 ring-polymer beads to capture nuclear quantum and anharmonic effects.
Scaled-coordinates direct estimator (ZSC) to evaluate reduced partition function ratios (β factors) without thermodynamic integration over mass.
Iterative 1D middle-out magma ocean fractional crystallization mass-balance modeling discretized in 10-km depth increments.
基于密度泛函理论（DFT/GGA-PBE）轨迹，利用DP-GEN和DeePMD-kit迭代训练机器学习势（MLPs）。
在LAMMPS中进行包含32个环状聚合物珠子的路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）模拟，以捕捉核量子效应和非谐效应。
采用缩放坐标直接估计器（ZSC）计算约化配分函数比（β因子），避免对同位素质量进行耗时的热力学积分。
以10 km深度步长离散化的一维自中向外岩浆洋分离结晶质量平衡迭代建模。
de: First-principles molecular dynamics (FPMD) configurations for pyrolite melt (Mg30Ca2Fe4Si24Al3NaO92H6), bridgmanite (Mg32Si31O96AlH and Mg31Si32O96H2), ringwoodite, and wadsleyite (Mg15Si8O32H2).
20-ps PIMD trajectories (0.25-fs time step) across magma ocean temperatures (1500–4500 K) and deep-mantle pressures.

Sensitivity tests varying crystallization onset depth (1000, 1500, 2000 km), initial water content (0.07 and 0.346 wt %), initial δD (−60, −80, −100‰), and bridgmanite-melt water partition coefficients.
针对地幔岩熔体（Mg30Ca2Fe4Si24Al3NaO92H6）、布里奇曼石（Mg32Si31O96AlH和Mg31Si32O96H2）、林伍德石及瓦兹利石（Mg15Si8O32H2）的第一性原理分子动力学（FPMD）构型数据集。
涵盖岩浆洋温度（1500–4500 K）和深部地幔压力的20 ps PIMD轨迹（时间步长0.25 fs）。
改变结晶起始深度（1000、1500、2000 km）、初始水含量（0.07和0.346 wt%）、初始δD（−60、−80、−100‰）及布里奇曼石-熔体水分配系数的敏感性测试。
li: The magma ocean crystallization model treats the mantle as a closed system, neglecting open-system atmospheric degassing and late chondritic accretion.
Other minor hydrous phases and further solid-melt isotopic reequilibration after crystal segregation are neglected in the crystallization model.
The exact physical or chemical transport mechanism transferring core volatiles across the core-mantle boundary without enriching HSEs remains unmodeled.
岩浆洋结晶模型将地幔视为封闭系统，未直接耦合开放系统大气脱气过程和晚期球粒陨石增生。
结晶模型忽略了其他次要含水矿物相以及晶体分离后的固-液同位素再平衡。
在不造成强亲铁元素富集的前提下，地核挥发分穿过核幔边界的具体物理化学传输机制仍有待进一步定量建模。

tm.why: The paper models magma ocean crystallization, primitive mantle hydrogen isotope evolution, and core-mantle volatile exchange across the core-mantle boundary, connecting deep-mantle chemical heterogeneities to LLSVPs and ULVZs.

ev.notes: Full 7-page Science Advances article PDF was analyzed, including abstract, introduction, results, discussion, materials and methods, equations (1)–(8), and Figures 1–3.

sum: Deep learning in planetary and environmental seismology is often bottlenecked by scarce labeled data, opaque latent spaces, and sensitivity to time-frequency representation (TFR) hyperparameters. This paper introduces Spec2VEC, a dataset-agnostic framework that transforms 1-D/2-D spectral representations into an interpretable, high-dimensional vector space without requiring massive training loops. Spec2VEC extracts three feature classes: global statistical moments, 1-D sequential texture metrics (e.g., permutation entropy, Lempel-Ziv complexity, DFA) computed by mapping 2-D spectrograms intolocality-preserving 1-D sequences via Hilbert space-filling curves, and 2-D spatial connectivity metrics derived via Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification (PDFSI) and Gray Level Size Zone Matrices. Validated across synthetic heterogeneous wavefields, synthetic volcano-seismic signals, Brady Hot Springs DAS data, and the Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC), Spec2VEC achieves ~98% accuracy on synthetic textures and outperforms self-supervised Siamese networks on ESEC (79.6% balanced accuracy), while providing an objective metric to rank competing TFR parameterizations.
针对行星与环境地震学中标签稀缺及深度学习黑箱问题，本文提出Spec2VEC可解释特征提取框架。该方法无需大规模训练，从时频谱中提取三类特征：统计矩、通过希尔伯特空间填充曲线将二维谱映射为一维序列后计算的信息论纹理特征（如排列熵、分形维数），以及利用概率分布拟合信号识别（PDFSI）和灰度大小区域矩阵……

t: Spec2VEC extracts statistical moments, 1-D information-theoretic texture metrics via locality-preserving Hilbert space-filling curves, and 2-D spatial connectivity features using Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification (PDFSI) and Gray Level Size Zone Matrices.
通过希尔伯特曲线提取一维信息论纹理特征，结合PDFSI和GLSZM提取二维空间特征及统计矩。

Validated on four benchmarks: jWave synthetic acoustic wavefields in fractal/Gaussian media with a colored noisebank, 150 synthetic geophysical signals across 6 classes, an 8,721-channel PoroTomo DAS dataset, and the IRIS Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC).
采用四类基准数据：jWave异质介质合成波场、6类合成地球物理信号、PoroTomo DAS数据及ESEC目录。

Spec2VEC texture features achieve ~98% Random Forest accuracy on synthetic noise textures (vs. ~65% for statistical moments), 98% accuracy on clustered synthetic signals, and 79.6% balanced accuracy (0.78 macro F1) on ESEC, outperforming a SimSiam ResNet-18 model.
合成纹理分类准确率达98%（统计特征仅65%），ESEC测试平衡准确率达79.6%，优于SimSiam模型。

Catastrophic initial TFR hyperparameters that smear transient signals into noise prevent detection, extreme low-SNR diffuse noise can inflate entropy metrics, and GMM mode selection requires bounded heuristics.
极端错误的初始时频参数会导致信号漏检，极低信噪比和GMM模态选择仍存在启发式依赖。

Treats spectrograms as textured surfaces and probability distributions, combining Hilbert curve 2D-to-1D unwrapping with adaptive PDFSI noise-residual GMM segmentation to create corpus-independent, physically interpretable embeddings.
将时频谱视为纹理表面与概率分布，结合希尔伯特展开与PDFSI自适应分割构建跨数据集可解释嵌入。

kc: Introduces Spec2VEC, a corpus-independent, physics-informed feature extraction framework that maps 1-D/2-D time-frequency representations into an interpretable vector space.
Applies Hilbert space-filling curves to unwrap 2-D spectrograms into locality-preserving 1-D sequences, enabling spatially resolved information-theoretic and fractal texture metrics.

Develops Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification (PDFSI) using differential evolution and Gaussian Mixture Models to dynamically separate coherent signal modes from stochastic noise.
Proposes a dimensionless 'Distance from Noise' quality score to objectively rank and select optimal STFT and CWT hyperparameters.

Demonstrates superior classification and clustering performance over traditional statistical features and self-supervised deep learning (SimSiam) on synthetic wavefields, DAS arrays, and the ESEC catalog.
提出Spec2VEC，一种独立于数据集的物理启发式特征提取框架，将一维/二维时频表示映射到可解释的向量空间。
利用希尔伯特空间填充曲线将二维时频谱展开为保持局部性的一维序列，从而计算空间分辨的信息论和分形纹理指标。
开发了基于差分进化和高斯混合模型的概率分布拟合信号识别（PDFSI）算法，动态分离相干信号模态与随机背景噪声。
提出无量纲的“噪声距离”质量评分，用于客观排序和选择最优的STFT与CWT超参数。
在合成波场、DAS阵列和ESEC目录上证明了其分类和聚类性能优于传统统计特征和自监督深度学习（SimSiam）。
me: 2-D to 1-Dlocality-preserving mapping using recursive Hilbert space-filling curves.
Information-theoretic and fractal sequential analysis (Permutation Entropy, Lempel-Ziv Complexity, Detrended Fluctuation Analysis, Rényi and SVD entropies).
Probabilistic Distribution Fitting for Signal Identification (PDFSI) via differential evolution optimization and kurtosis-refined Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) segmentation.
Spatial coherence quantification using Gray Level Size Zone Matrix (GLSZM) descriptors (e.g., Small/Large Area Emphasis, Size Zone Non-Uniformity).
Supervised classification with Random Forests (interpreted via SHAP) and unsupervised hierarchical clustering with Ward linkage.
使用递归希尔伯特空间填充曲线进行保持空间局部性的二维到一维映射。
信息论与分形序列分析（排列熵、Lempel-Ziv复杂度、去趋势波动分析、Rényi熵和奇异值分解熵）。
通过差分进化优化和峰度精化高斯混合模型（GMM）分割实现的概率分布拟合信号识别（PDFSI）。
利用灰度大小区域矩阵（GLSZM）描述符（如大/小区域强调、区域大小非均匀性）量化空间相干性。
结合SHAP可解释性分析的随机森林监督分类与基于Ward连接的无监督层次聚类。
de: Benchmark 1: 2-D acoustic wavefields simulated with jWave in fractal and Gaussian heterogeneous media, plus a synthetic noisebank of colored noise and porous media textures (200 realizations per category).
Benchmark 2: 150 synthetic 60-s geophysical waveforms across 6 classes (impulsive earthquakes, volcanic tornillos, surface wave dispersion, T-phases, strombolian explosions, hybrid eruptions).
Benchmark 3: Real-world 30-s Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) record across 8,721 channels at Brady's Hot Springs (PoroTomo) capturing a local earthquake.
Benchmark 4: Curated Exotic Seismic Events Catalog (ESEC) waveforms (lahars, rockfalls, rock/ice avalanches, snow avalanches) augmented with 50 tectonic earthquakes from IRIS.
基准测试1：使用jWave在分形和高斯非均匀介质中模拟的二维声波波场，以及包含有色噪声和多孔介质纹理的合成噪声库（每类200个实现）。
基准测试2：涵盖6个类别（脉冲型地震、火山螺钉震颤、面波频散、T相、斯特龙博利式爆炸、混合喷发）的150条60秒合成地球物理波形。
基准测试3：内华达州Brady热泉（PoroTomo）8,721个通道记录的包含地方震到时的30秒真实分布式声学传感（DAS）数据。
基准测试4：来自IRIS的特殊地震事件目录（ESEC）波形（泥石流、落石、岩/冰崩、雪崩）及补充的50个构造地震事件。
li: Relies on the weak form of the TFR input problem: catastrophic initial TFR hyperparameters that completely smear transient signals into the noise floor will cause the signal to remain undetected.
In extremely low-SNR environments, severe diffuse noise can still obscure spatial connectivity and artificially inflate textural entropy metrics if upstream denoising is insufficient.
The PDFSI workflow introduces bounded heuristic hyperparameter choices, such as the number of GMM components and relative kurtosis tolerance.
依赖于时频表示（TFR）输入问题的弱形式假设：若初始超参数选择极差导致瞬态信号完全淹没于噪声中，信号将无法被检测。
在极低信噪比环境下，若前端去噪不足，严重的弥散噪声仍会掩盖空间连通性并人为夸大纹理熵指标。
PDFSI工作流引入了有界的启发式超参数选择，例如高斯混合模型（GMM）分量数量和相对峰度容差。

tm.why: The paper introduces Spec2VEC, an interpretable feature extraction and representation learning framework for classifying and clustering geophysical seismo-acoustic signals.
The framework targets label-scarce planetary environments and is validated on exotic environmental/surficial seismic events (lahars, avalanches, rockfalls) and synthetic volcanic tremors.
A key real-world benchmark applies Spec2VEC to a 8,721-channel DAS dataset from Brady's Hot Springs to detect and isolate local earthquake arrivals.

sum: This study uses numerical simulations to investigate how fault topography and roughness control rupture propagation, stress evolution, and microseismicity. By tracking micro-ruptures and stress states, the authors find that smoother faults maintain concentrated stress at fixed locations, facilitating extensive ruptures and large earthquakes. In contrast, rougher faults exhibit transient, discrete stress concentrations where micro-ruptures initiate but are quickly arrested by re-interlocking. This process leads to higher b-values and a self-locking-rupturing cycle of small, frequent microseismic events. The study establishes a direct mechanistic link between fault roughness and seismicity patterns.
本研究通过数值模拟探讨了断层粗糙度对破裂传播、应力演化及微震特征的控制作用。研究表明，较光滑的断层上应力集中于固定位置，易于形成贯穿整个断层的大型毁灭性地震；而较粗糙的断层则表现出瞬态、空间离散的应力集中带，微破裂在粗糙接触处萌生并因重新锁结而迅速终止，导致较高的b值和频繁的微震循环。该研究建立了断……

t: Numerical simulations tracking the evolution of micro-ruptures and stress states on faults with varying roughness.
追踪不同粗糙度断层上微破裂和应力状态演化的数值模拟方法。
Synthetic fault models with varying degrees of surface topography and roughness.
具有不同表面形貌和粗糙度特征的合成断层模型数据。
Smoother faults promote extensive ruptures, while rougher faults produce transient stress concentrations, smaller ruptures, and larger b-values.
较光滑的断层促进大型破裂，而较粗糙的断层产生瞬态应力集中、较小破裂及更高的b值。

sum: This study investigates the Kamchatka megathrust, focusing on how variable slip on persistent asperities influences seismic and tsunami hazards. By analyzing historical and modern megathrust earthquakes, the authors demonstrate that while asperities remain persistent features, their slip behavior varies across different earthquake cycles, significantly impacting tsunami generation and hazard assessment.
本研究聚焦于堪察加巨型逆冲断层，探讨了持久性凹凸体上的可变滑动对地震和海啸灾害的影响。通过分析历史与现代巨型逆冲地震，研究表明尽管凹凸体在空间上具有持久性，但其在不同地震周期中的滑动行为存在显著差异，这对海啸的产生和灾害评估具有重要影响。

t: The study utilizes seismic slip inversion and numerical tsunami modeling to evaluate the impact of variable slip on persistent asperities.
利用地震滑动反演和数值海啸模拟来评估持久性凹凸体上可变滑动的影响。
Historical and modern seismic, geodetic, and tsunami data from the Kamchatka megathrust region.
来自堪察加巨型逆冲断层区域的历史与现代地震、大地测量和海啸数据。

sum: Continuous subsurface monitoring of fluvial corridors during extreme floods is critical for assessing slope stability and bridge scour, yet remains limited by sparse sensors and non-stationary ambient noise sources. This study demonstrates that traffic-excited highway bridges act as persistent, spatially fixed seismic sources recorded by roadside Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) arrays. Analyzing 10 days of dark-fiber DAS recordings across the 430 m Miho River Bridge in South Korea during a record July 2025 monsoon flood, the authors show that vehicle impacts excite bridge deck flexural resonances. These resonances radiate a discrete 2.6–4.6 Hz spectral comb of Rayleigh waves over 400 m into adjacent riverbanks, filling the ambient noise spectral gap (1–6 Hz). Virtual source gathers converge within 5 minutes of ballistic wave stacking, enabling 1-D shear-wave velocity imaging to bedrock (~56 m) and resolving up to 1.0% seismic velocity drops (dv/v) driven by flood-induced sediment softening.
本研究利用韩国京釜高速公路旁暗光纤的分布式声波传感（DAS）数据，证明交通激发的跨河大桥可作为空间固定的持续震源，用于极端洪水期间的河道走廊地下监测。针对2025年7月暴雨洪水期间430米长的美湖川大桥，车辆冲击激发桥面弯曲共振，向两岸冲积层辐射3–6 Hz的基阶瑞利波离散频谱梳（传播超400米），……

Nine effective days of continuous dark-fiber DAS strain-rate data (4.9 m effective spacing, 4.9 m gauge length, 250 Hz) recorded across the 430 m Miho River Bridge in South Korea during a July 2025 monsoon flood.
2025年7月季风洪水期间，在韩国430米美湖川大桥采集的9天暗光纤DAS连续数据（有效道间距4.9米，采样率250 H…

Bridge deck vibrations radiate a 2.6–4.6 Hz Rayleigh wave comb past 400 m; ballistic correlations converge within 5 min (r=0.98), Vs profiles resolve bedrock at ~56 m, and monsoon flooding drives up to 1.0% dv/v drop.
桥面辐射2.6–4.6 Hz瑞利波频谱梳（超400米）；直达波5分钟叠加收敛（r=0.98）；反演揭示56米深基岩，洪水…
Bridge modal frequencies have low sensitivity to the top few meters, illumination is bounded to ~450 m, and diurnal/weekly traffic variations modulate hourly dv/v estimates.

Exploits traffic-excited highway bridge structures as persistent, spatially fixed mechanical band-pass seismic sources (3–6 Hz) to fill the ambient noise spectral gap for DAS time-lapse river corridor monitoring.
首次利用交通激发的跨河桥梁作为持续固定的窄带震源（3–6 Hz），填补频谱空白并实现河道DAS时移监测。

kc: Demonstrated that traffic-excited multi-span bridges function as persistent, spatially fixed mechanical band-pass filters radiating discrete 2.6–4.6 Hz Rayleigh wave combs up to 450 m into riverbanks.
Achieved rapid virtual shot gather convergence (coherence > 0.98 within 5 minutes for ballistic waves) that bridges the 1–6 Hz spectral illumination gap along highway corridors.
Inverted fundamental-mode Rayleigh dispersion (3–10 Hz) to resolve 1-D shear-wave velocity profiles of the alluvial aquifer down to the bedrock interface at ~56 m depth.
Tracked hourly relative velocity variations (dv/v) across a major monsoon flood, resolving up to a 1.0% velocity drop consistent with hydrological softening of riparian sediments.

在强季风洪水期间以小时分辨率追踪相对波速变化（dv/v），观测到高达1.0%的波速下降，反映了河岸沉积物的水文软化。

Frequency-wavenumber (f-k) and calibrated power spectral density (PSD) analysis to separate quasi-static vehicle loads, guided deck waves, and radiated ground surface waves.
Phase-shift dispersion analysis and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) inversion to retrieve 1-D shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles.

对1–30 Hz连续DAS应变率记录进行时域一比特归一化与互相关地震干涉处理。
利用频率-波数（f-k）和标定功率谱密度（PSD）分析，分离准静态车辆荷载、桥面导波及辐射地表波。
采用相移法提取频散曲线，并结合粒子群优化（PSO）反演一维横波速度（Vs）剖面。

AP Sensing interrogator recording at 1,000 Hz (decimated to 250 Hz), 1.225 m channel spacing (spatially averaged to 4.9 m), and 4.9 m gauge length.
Meteorological hourly precipitation (peaking at 51 mm/h) and Miho River stage records during a major monsoon flood event.

Seismic interferometry and cross-correlation of traffic-excited bridge vibrations and vehicle noise are used to extract virtual source gathers, Rayleigh wave dispersion, and dv/v time-lapse variations.
The study focuses on hydrogeophysical monitoring of a fluvial corridor during an extreme monsoon flood event, tracking alluvial saturation and river-groundwater exchange.

sum: Generative Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used in geophysical inversions to parameterize complex geological priors within a low-dimensional latent space. However, because true Earth structures are not intrinsically low-dimensional and training sets are imperfect, standard latent space inversion restricts solutions to an inaccurate generative manifold. To overcome this fundamental limitation, this paper introduces an 'escaping prior' defined in the full model space, which uses GNN autoencoders (VAE, AAE, DAAE) as a structural guide while permitting off-manifold solutions. A hierarchical Bayesian Metropolis-within-Gibbs MCMC algorithm dynamically estimates the prior-strength hyperparameter a posteriori based on consistency with observed data. Tested on 2D analytical problems and synthetic nonlinear seismic travel-time tomography using MNIST digits and SedSimple sedimentary process models, the escaping prior successfully recovers off-manifold structures (e.g., vertical strata when trained on horizontal strata) and provides realistic uncertainty quantification, outperforming both standard latent space and uniform prior inversions.
生成式神经网络（GNN）常用于地球物理反演，在低维潜空间中参数化先验地质信息。但真实地球结构并非低维且训练存在误差，标准潜空间反演将解严格限制在不准确的生成流形上。本文提出全模型空间中的“逃逸先验”，利用自编码器（VAE、AAE、DAAE）作为引导，同时允许寻找流形外的解。通过层次贝叶斯MCMC算法……

t: Defines a Gaussian 'escaping prior' centered on autoencoder manifold reconstructions in model space, using hierarchical Metropolis-within-Gibbs MCMC to jointly sample model parameters and the prior-strength hyperparameter.
在模型空间定义以自编码器流形重构为中心的“逃逸先验”，用层次MCMC联合采样模型和超参数。
Tested on 2D analytical manifolds, 10x10 nonlinear travel-time tomography using MNIST digits ('7' and 'Z'), and 20x20 geological velocity models simulated with SedSimple software.
采用二维解析函数、MNIST数字（7和Z）10x10走时模型及SedSimple模拟的20x20地质速度模型。

When true models lie outside the GNN manifold (e.g., 'Z' shape or vertical strata), latent space inversion fails with high relative error, whereas the hierarchical escaping prior lowers prior precision α and accurately recovers off-manifold structures.
当真实模型在流形外（如Z形或垂直层）时，逃逸先验能自动降低先验权重并准确恢复结构，优于潜空间反演。
Assumes a single global scalar hyperparameter α for isotropic prior variance across all dimensions, and relies on computationally expensive MCMC sampling.
假设所有维度共享单一全局各向同性方差超参数，且高维MCMC随机采样计算成本高。
Formulates a fully Bayesian model-space escaping prior with hierarchical posterior estimation of manifold precision, enabling GNN-guided inversion beyond the generator's range.
提出全贝叶斯模型空间逃逸先验及流形精度的层次后验估计，实现突破GNN生成范围的反演。

kc: Formulates an 'escaping prior' distribution in model space that uses trained GNNs (VAE, AAE, DAAE) to guide Bayesian inversion without restricting solutions strictly to the generative manifold.
Implements a hierarchical Bayesian Metropolis-within-Gibbs algorithm with an exponential hyperprior to automatically adapt the prior-strength hyperparameter a posteriori.

Demonstrates through synthetic travel-time tomography on MNIST and realistic SedSimple geological models that the escaping prior recovers off-manifold features and avoids the overconfidence and structural hallucinations of latent space inversion.
在模型空间提出了“逃逸先验”分布，利用训练好的GNN（VAE、AAE、DAAE）引导贝叶斯反演，而不将解严格限制在生成流形上。
实现了结合指数超先验的层次贝叶斯Metropolis-within-Gibbs算法，在反演中后验地自适应调整先验强度超参数。
通过在MNIST和SedSimple地质模型上的合成走时层析成像证明，逃逸先验能有效恢复流形外特征，避免了潜空间反演的过度自信和结构幻觉问题。
me: Generative Neural Networks: Variational Autoencoder (VAE), Adversarial Autoencoder (AAE), and Denoising Adversarial Autoencoder (DAAE) trained to map models onto a generative manifold.
Escaping prior formulation based on the L2 distance between a model parameter vector and its autoencoder reconstruction on the generative manifold.
Hierarchical Bayesian inversion sampled via Metropolis-within-Gibbs Markov chain Monte Carlo (MH-MCMC) to jointly infer model parameters and prior precision.
生成式神经网络：训练变分自编码器（VAE）、对抗自编码器（AAE）和去噪对抗自编码器（DAAE），将模型映射到生成流形。
逃逸先验构建：基于模型参数向量与其在生成流形上的自编码器重构模型之间的L2距离定义高斯先验。
层次贝叶斯反演：采用Metropolis-within-Gibbs马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MH-MCMC）采样，联合推断模型参数和先验精度超参数。
de: Illustrative 2D analytical problems with a 1D non-linear polynomial-trigonometric manifold and unimodal/multimodal likelihoods.
Synthetic 2D nonlinear seismic travel-time tomography on 10x10 velocity grids using MNIST digit '7' as prior training set and '7' or 'Z' as true velocity models.
Synthetic 2D travel-time tomography on 20x20 velocity grids using SedSimple 3D sedimentary process simulations (horizontal and vertical cross-sections).
二维解析测试问题：包含嵌入在二维空间中的一维非线性多项式-三角函数流形以及单峰/多峰似然函数。
简单合成二维非线性地震走时层析成像：在10x10网格上使用MNIST数字“7”训练GNN，反演“7”字形和流形外的“Z”字形真实速度模型。
地质模型合成二维走时层析成像：在20x20网格上使用SedSimple三维沉积过程模拟生成的水平和垂直速度切片进行训练与反演测试。
li: MCMC random sampling in high-dimensional model space is computationally expensive compared to optimization-based variational inference.
Uses a single scalar hyperparameter for global isotropic prior variance, rather than an anisotropic full covariance matrix across different model dimensions.
VAE latent space discontinuities can cause clustering of escaping prior samples unless KL divergence weights are carefully tuned.
高维模型空间中的MCMC随机采样计算成本高昂，效率低于基于优化的变分推断方法。
使用单一全局标量超参数表征各向同性先验方差，尚未引入跨不同模型维度的各向异性全协方差矩阵。
VAE潜空间的不连续性会导致逃逸先验样本出现局部聚集，需要对KL散度权重进行精细调优。

tm.why: The paper introduces a hierarchical Bayesian inversion framework with an escaping prior to quantify uncertainty and overcome generative neural network manifold constraints.
It evaluates Variational Autoencoders, Adversarial Autoencoders, and Denoising Adversarial Autoencoders for parameterizing prior geological information in seismic travel-time tomography.
The core contribution addresses fundamental mathematical limitations of low-dimensional latent space parameterization in nonlinear physical inverse problems.

sum: This study analyzes tectonic low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs) in Shikoku, Japan, using a modified epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) model that incorporates a reference region to account for spatial interactions. The authors find that the background fraction (the ratio of background to total seismicity rate) is relatively high at both the shallower (up-dip) and deeper (down-dip) ends of the LFE source region, indicating a nonmonotonic depth dependency. At the down-dip end, triggering is suppressed by ductile deformation, whereas at the up-dip end, proximity to the locked megathrust zone inhibits stress propagation. These findings suggest that spatial variations in temperature-pressure conditions and frictional properties nonmonotonically influence LFE activity along the dip direction.
本研究利用改进的流行病类型余震序列（ETAS）模型，分析了日本四国地区的构造低频地震（LFE）。该模型引入了参考区域以处理空间相互作用。研究发现，LFE源区浅部（沿倾角向上）和深部（沿倾角向下）边界的背景地震比例（背景率与总地震率之比）均较高，呈现非单调的深度依赖性。在深部，剪切触发受韧性变形抑制；……

t: An epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) model modified by incorporating a reference region surrounding the target region to account for spatial interactions.
通过引入目标区域周围的参考区域来改进流行病类型余震序列（ETAS）模型，以考虑空间相互作用。
Tectonic low-frequency earthquake (LFE) seismicity data from Shikoku, Japan.
日本四国地区的构造低频地震（LFE）地震活动数据。
The background fraction of LFEs is relatively high at both the shallower and deeper ends of the source region, indicating nonmonotonic along-dip variations in triggering.

Discovered a nonmonotonic along-dip variation in the background fraction of LFEs in Shikoku, with higher background fractions at both shallow and deep ends.
Proposed physical mechanisms for triggering suppression: ductile deformation at the down-dip end and proximity to the locked megathrust zone at the up-dip end.

sum: This study investigates whether tectonic tremor accompanied slow-slip events (SSEs) in the Lower Cook Inlet (LCI) segment of the Alaska–Aleutian subduction zone from 2015 to 2017. Using continuous data from 34 broadband stations, the authors applied envelope cross-correlation and single-station frequency tracking. Neither method detected conclusive tectonic tremor. Synthetic simulations of tremor-like signals showed that while basin noise might obscure visual identification, cross-correlation methods should still have detected tremor if present. The absence of tremor in the LCI, contrasting with its presence in the Upper Cook Inlet, suggests that differences in subduction geometry, thermal state, or sediment load control tremor generation, demonstrating that coupled episodic tremor and slip is not globally ubiquitous.
本研究探究了2015至2017年阿拉斯加-阿留申俯冲带下库克湾（LCI）慢滑移事件期间是否存在构造震颤。利用34个宽频带台站的连续数据，研究采用了包络互相关和单台频率追踪两种方法，均未检测到确凿的构造震颤。震颤类信号的合成地震图模拟表明，尽管盆地噪声会干扰视觉识别，但互相关方法仍应能检测到震颤。LC……

t: Envelope cross-correlation across a 34-station array and single-station frequency tracking were used to search for tectonic tremor.
采用34个台站阵列的包络互相关和单台频率追踪方法搜寻构造震颤。
Continuous seismic waveform data from 34 broadband stations in the Lower Cook Inlet, Alaska, from 2015 to 2017.
使用2015至2017年间阿拉斯加下库克湾34个宽频带台站的连续地震波形数据。
No conclusive tectonic tremor was detected, and synthetic tests showed that basin noise would not completely mask tremor from cross-correlation methods.
未检测到确凿的构造震颤，合成测试表明盆地噪声不会完全掩盖互相关方法的检测能力。
High ambient noise and basin effects could potentially obscure extremely weak or highly localized tremor signals.
高环境噪声和盆地效应可能会掩盖极微弱或高度局限的震颤信号。
First systematic search for tremor in the Lower Cook Inlet, demonstrating that slow-slip events there occur without accompanying tremor.
首次在下库克湾系统搜寻震颤，证实该区域的慢滑移事件发生时并无伴随震颤。

kc: Conducted the first systematic search for tectonic tremor in the Lower Cook Inlet (LCI), Alaska, during the 2015–2017 slow-slip events.
Applied two independent detection methods (envelope cross-correlation and single-station frequency tracking) to continuous broadband data.
Performed synthetic simulations to evaluate the masking effects of basin noise on tremor detection.
Provided evidence that episodic tremor and slip (ETS) is not globally ubiquitous, highlighting regional geological controls on tremor generation.
首次针对阿拉斯加下库克湾（LCI）2015-2017年慢滑移事件期间的构造震颤进行了系统性搜寻。
将包络互相关和单台频率追踪两种独立检测方法应用于连续宽频带数据。
进行了合成地震图模拟，以评估盆地噪声对震颤检测的掩盖效应。
提供了幕式震颤与慢滑移（ETS）并非全球普遍共存的证据，突出了区域地质构造对震颤产生的控制作用。
me: Envelope cross-correlation across a 34-station broadband array to identify coherent seismic event clusters.
Single-station frequency tracking to monitor relative changes in spectral content over time.
Synthetic seismogram modeling of tremor-like signals to assess the impact of basin noise and site effects on detection limits.
利用34个宽频带台站阵列进行包络互相关，以识别相干的地震事件群。
利用单台频率追踪方法监测频谱内容随时间的变化。
对震颤类信号进行合成地震图模拟，以评估盆地噪声和场地效应对检测极限的影响。

Synthetic tremor-like signals simulated within the LCI basin environment to test detection algorithm sensitivity.
来自阿拉斯加下库克湾34个宽频带台站、跨越2015至2017年的连续地震波形数据。
在LCI盆地环境中模拟的合成震颤类信号，用于测试检测算法的灵敏度。
li: High ambient noise levels and basin effects in the LCI may still obscure very weak or highly localized tremor signals.
The study is limited to the 2015–2017 time window and may not capture tremor from other periods.
LCI中较高的环境噪声水平和盆地效应可能仍会掩盖极微弱或高度局限的震颤信号。
研究局限于2015-2017年时间窗口，可能无法捕获其他时段的震颤。

tm.why: The paper investigates the occurrence of tectonic tremor during slow-slip events in the Alaska subduction zone.

sum: This study analyzes the tidal modulation of seismicity in the Ridgecrest, California area from 2008 to 2024, spanning the 2019 Mw 7.1 earthquake. Combining machine-learning-enhanced earthquake catalogs with a novel tidal modulation characterization method, the authors find that seismicity in the Ridgecrest fault zone shifted around 2014–2015 from a stress-controlled to a stress-rate-controlled regime. Additionally, the tidal modulation strength increased prior to the mainshock, a behavior not observed in the neighboring Coso volcanic field or Garlock fault. This shift is interpreted as a decrease in the fault's characteristic frictional time scale relative to the tidal period, indicating an increased loading rate and potentially reduced effective normal stress, representing a preparation phase before the major earthquake.
本文分析了加州Ridgecrest地区2008-2024年的地震潮汐调制。结合机器学习地震编目与新型分析方法，发现断层带地震在2014-2015年从应力控制转为应力变化率控制，且在2019年Mw 7.1地震前调制强度显著增加。这表明断层摩擦时间尺度缩短、加载率增加，可能反映了大震前的准备阶段。

t: A novel statistical methodology combined with machine-learning-enhanced earthquake detection and location to characterize the temporal evolution of tidal modulation of seismicity rates.
结合机器学习增强的地震检测定位与新型统计方法，表征地震活动率潮汐调制的时间演化。
An earthquake catalog from 2008 to 2024 covering the Ridgecrest fault zone, Coso volcanic field, and Garlock fault in California.
覆盖加州Ridgecrest断层带、Coso火山区和Garlock断层的2008至2024年地震目录。

Seismicity in the Ridgecrest fault zone shifted from stress-controlled to stress-rate-controlled tidal modulation around 2014-2015, with modulation strength increasing before the 2019 Mw 7.1 earthquake.
Ridgecrest断层带地震在2014-2015年转为应力率控制调制，且在2019年大震前调制强度增加。
The interpretation of frictional time scale changes is based on theoretical and experimental models, requiring further validation in diverse tectonic settings.
摩擦时间尺度变化的物理机制解释基于理论和实验模型，需在更多构造背景下验证。
First observation of a temporal shift from stress to stress-rate controlled tidal modulation and precursory modulation strength increase prior to a major earthquake.
首次观测到地震潮汐调制从应力向应力率控制的时间转变以及大震前的调制强度增强先兆。

kc: Identified a temporal shift in tidal modulation of seismicity from stress-controlled to stress-rate-controlled in the Ridgecrest fault zone around 2014–2015.
Observed an increase in the strength of tidal modulation specifically within the Ridgecrest fault zone prior to the 2019 Mw 7.1 earthquake.
Proposed a physical mechanism linking these changes to a shortened frictional nucleation time scale and increased loading rate, representing an earthquake preparation phase.
识别出Ridgecrest断层带地震潮汐调制在2014-2015年左右从应力控制向应力变化率控制的时间转变。
观测到在2019年Mw 7.1地震前，仅在Ridgecrest断层带内出现了潮汐调制强度的增加。
提出了将这些变化与摩擦成核时间尺度缩短和加载速率增加联系起来的物理机制，代表了大震准备阶段。
me: Machine-learning-enhanced earthquake detection and location to build a high-resolution catalog.
A novel statistical methodology to characterize and quantify the tidal modulation of seismicity rates.
利用机器学习增强的地震检测与定位技术构建高分辨率地震目录。
采用一种新型统计方法来表征和量化地震活动率的潮汐调制特征。
de: Seismicity catalog in the Ridgecrest, California area spanning 2008 to 2024, including the Coso volcanic field and Garlock fault.
跨越2008至2024年加州Ridgecrest地区（包括Coso火山区和Garlock断层）的地震活动目录。
