物理机制解释依赖于简化的实验和理论摩擦模型，可能无法完全捕捉三维断层的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the tidal modulation of seismicity and its relation to fault frictional properties and nucleation time scales.
The study utilizes machine-learning-enhanced earthquake detection and location to build the seismicity catalog.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the provided abstract and Crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Single-station magnitude estimates from NASA's InSight mission rely heavily on assumed interior velocity, attenuation, and source models. Previously, Marsquake Service (MQS) magnitude-scaling relations used pre-InSight structural models and tectonic source assumptions for all events. Here, the authors reanalyze long-period displacement spectral amplitudes of quality A/B InSight events and perform 1-D (AxiSEM/Instaseis, reflectivity) and 3-D (SPECFEM3D_GLOBE) waveform simulations across updated post-InSight Martian interior models. They introduce separate source representations for tectonic marsquakes (double-couple) and meteoroid impacts (hybrid single-force plus moment tensor). Results show that shallow crustal site amplification beneath InSight dominates magnitude scaling. Recalibrated marsquake magnitudes are ~0.5 Mw lower on average than MQS catalog values, reducing cumulative Martian seismic moment release by a factor of ~8.4 and matching independent moment tensor solutions. Impact-specific scaling brings seismic estimates closer to crater-derived moments and enables tentative matching of two VF events with newly cataloged craters.
本研究利用InSight任务后的火星内部一维与三维速度及衰减模型，结合AxiSEM/Instaseis、反射率法和SPECFEM3D_GLOBE波形模拟，重新分析了InSight高质量事件的长期位移谱振幅。研究首次分别构建了构造火震（双力偶）与陨石撞击（单力与矩张量混合）的震源表征及震级标度关系。结……

t: The authors simulate 1-D (AxiSEM/Instaseis, reflectivity) and 3-D (SPECFEM3D_GLOBE) waveforms for double-couple marsquake and hybrid impact sources, fitting long-period body-wave displacement spectra to recalibrate distance-dependent moment-magnitude scaling constants.
结合一维与三维波形模拟及双力偶/混合撞击震源，拟合体波长期位移谱以重标定矩震级常数。

They reanalyze vertical-component displacement spectra of 67 MQS quality A and B InSight events (35 LF/BB and 32 HF/VF events, including 9 confirmed impacts) and cross-match against 123 date-constrained orbital craters.
重新分析67个InSight高质量A/B级事件的垂直分量位移谱，并与123个新撞击坑进行交叉匹配。

Recalibrated marsquake magnitudes decrease by 0.5 Mw on average (reducing S1222a from Mw 4.6–4.7 to 4.0 and cumulative seismic moment 8.4-fold), while impact magnitudes drop to match crater scaling and identify two crater-event pairs.
火震震级平均降低0.5 Mw（S1222a降至4.0，累积地震矩降8.4倍），并匹配了2个撞击坑事件对。

Systematic offsets persist between long-period (<0.5 Hz) seismic moments and short-duration impact hydrocode predictions for larger distant impacts (>10°, 10–150 m craters), and HF/2.4-Hz swarms remain uncalibrated.
远距离较大撞击（>10°）的长期地震矩与流体力学预测仍有偏差，且HF事件未标定。

First systematic recalibration of Martian seismic magnitudes combining post-InSight 1-D/3-D interior models with distinct physical source parametrizations for tectonic marsquakes and meteoroid impacts.
首次结合InSight后1D/3D内部模型并区分火震与陨石撞击物理机制，系统重标定火星震级。

kc: Developed recalibrated moment-magnitude scaling relations for Mars using post-InSight 1-D and 3-D velocity and attenuation models.

Demonstrated that shallow low-velocity crustal structure beneath InSight causes strong site amplification, reducing inferred marsquake magnitudes by ~0.5 Mw on average and cumulative moment release by a factor of ~8.4.

Formulated separate impact-specific scaling relations using hybrid source models (single-force + isotropic/deviatoric moment tensor) and dedicated near-field (<5°) calibrations, reconciling seismic moments with crater-size predictions.
Tentatively matched two candidate VF seismic events (S0128a, S0542a) to newly identified date-constrained Martian impact craters.
利用InSight任务后的1-D和3-D火星内部速度与衰减模型，建立了重新标定的火星矩震级标度关系。
证明着陆点下方浅层低速地壳结构引起强烈场地放大，使推断的火震震级平均降低约0.5 Mw，全球累积地震矩释放降低约8.4倍。
采用混合震源模型（单力+各向同性/偏量矩张量）和近场（<5°）专门标定构建了撞击事件专用震级标度，调和了地震矩与陨石坑尺寸预测值之间的差异。
将两个候选超高频（VF）地震事件（S0128a和S0542a）与新识别的时间受控火星撞击坑进行了初步唯一匹配。
me: 1-D synthetic waveform generation using AxiSEM/Instaseis and the reflectivity method across ensembles of post-InSight Martian structural models.
3-D spectral-element waveform modeling using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE with laterally varying 3-D crust and thermochemical mantle models.

Separate synthetic source modeling: double-couple moment tensors with Brune STFs for marsquakes, and stress-glut-based hybrid sources (single-force + isotropic + deviatoric moment tensor) for meteoroid impacts.
Ensemble grid-search spectral fitting of body-wave displacement amplitude spectral densities (ASD) including an empirical 2.4-Hz Lorentzian resonance term.
SH-wave propagator-matrix transfer function calculation to quantify shallow site amplification (Γ_site) at 0.5 Hz.
基于多组InSight后火星结构模型，利用AxiSEM/Instaseis和反射率法计算一维合成地震波形。
结合横向变化的三维地壳和热化学地幔模型，使用SPECFEM3D_GLOBE进行三维谱元法波形模拟。
分类震源建模：火震采用带Brune震源时间函数的双力偶矩张量，陨石撞击采用基于应力谷理论的混合震源（单力+各向同性+偏量矩张量）。
对体波位移振幅谱密度（ASD）进行集合网格搜索谱拟合，并引入经验性的2.4 Hz洛伦兹共振项。
计算0.5 Hz处的SH波传播矩阵传递函数，以量化浅层场地放大效应（Γ_site）。
de: InSight SEIS waveform archive and Marsquake Service (MQS) catalog v14, focusing on 67 high-quality (Class A and B) LF/BB and HF/VF events including 9 confirmed impacts.
Suite of post-InSight 1-D velocity and attenuation models (InSight_KKS21_GP/GD, Khan et al. 2023, Samuel et al. 2023, Kim et al. 2023, Carrasco et al. 2023).
3-D crustal thickness map of Wieczorek et al. (2022) and 3-D thermochemical mantle velocity models of Plesa et al. (2021).
Catalog of 123 machine-learning-detected, date-constrained Martian impact craters within 50° of InSight from Bickel et al. (2025).
InSight SEIS波形数据及MQS第14版目录，重点分析67个A/B级高质量LF/BB和HF/VF事件（含9个已确认撞击事件）。
多套InSight后一维速度与衰减模型（InSight_KKS21_GP/GD、Khan等2023、Samuel等2023、Kim等2023、Carrasco等2023）。
Wieczorek等（2022）的三维地壳厚度图与Plesa等（2021）的三维热化学地幔速度模型。
Bickel等（2025）通过机器学习在InSight周围50°内识别出的123个时间受控新撞击坑目录。
li: High-frequency (HF) and 2.4-Hz event families are excluded from systematic recalibration due to uncertain origin and ambiguous crustal vs. mantle propagation paths.

Linear distance-scaling underpredicts amplitudes beyond 50° epicentral distance where triplicated body-wave branches and PP/SS phases cluster, potentially biasing distant event magnitudes high by 0.1–0.2 Mw.
3-D SPECFEM3D_GLOBE simulations capture large-scale focusing/defocusing but omit small-scale stochastic scattering and coda generation.
A systematic discrepancy remains for larger distant impacts (>10°, 10–150 m craters) between band-limited (<0.5 Hz) seismic moments and short-duration impact hydrocode predictions.
由于震源机制不明且地壳与地幔传播路径存在歧义，高频（HF）和2.4 Hz事件族未纳入系统重标定。
线性距离标度低估了50°震中距以外因三重体波分支和PP/SS震相聚集导致的振幅增强，可能使远震震级偏高0.1–0.2 Mw。
三维SPECFEM3D_GLOBE模拟仅捕捉大尺度聚焦/散焦效应，未包含小尺度随机散射及尾波生成。
对于震中距>10°、坑径10–150 m的较远大型撞击，带限（<0.5 Hz）地震矩估计与短历时撞击流体动力学预测之间仍存在系统性偏差。

tm.why: The study recalibrates moment magnitude scaling relations for Martian marsquakes and meteoroid impacts recorded by NASA's InSight mission.
It explicitly models distinct seismic source physics and spectral scaling for tectonic double-couple marsquakes versus hybrid single-force plus moment-tensor impact sources.
The calibration relies on extensive 1-D (AxiSEM/Instaseis, reflectivity) and 3-D (SPECFEM3D_GLOBE) synthetic waveform simulations across Martian interior models.

ev.notes: Full 32-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 10 figures, 2 tables, equations, and section texts.

sum: To monitor microseismicity transients along the Main Marmara Fault near Istanbul, this study analyzes six moderate (4.0 <= ML <= 5.8) earthquake sequences between 2016 and 2023. The authors integrate continuous recordings from the GONAF borehole network and regional surface stations with a workflow combining PhaseNet deep-learning phase picking, PyOcto phase association, NonLinLoc probabilistic location, GrowClust3D.jl relative relocation, and EQcorrscan template matching. Within the borehole-monitored Çınarcık Basin, the workflow detects approximately eight times more events than conventional catalogs and lowers the magnitude of completeness from 1.90 to 0.90. Borehole sensors yield 2.5 times higher pick association likelihood due to lower anthropogenic noise. Waveform cross-correlation reveals strong pre-mainshock localization and increasing waveform similarity before the June 2016 ML 4.5 event, heterogeneous clustering before the 2019 ML 5.8 Silivri mainshock, and sparse pre-mainshock activity for four other nearby sequences, highlighting modulation by local fault conditions and aseismic slip.
本研究结合GONAF井下台阵与地表台网波形数据，利用PhaseNet深度学习震相拾取、PyOcto震相关联、NonLinLoc定位、GrowClust3D相对定位及模板匹配技术，分析了2016至2023年马尔马拉海6个4.0-5.8级地震序列。该方法在井下台网覆盖区检出事件数较常规目录提高约8倍，完……

t: The workflow integrates PhaseNet deep-learning phase picking, PyOcto 4D space-time phase association, NonLinLoc probabilistic relocation, GrowClust3D.jl hierarchical relative relocation, and EQcorrscan single-station template matching.
结合PhaseNet深度学习拾取、PyOcto关联、NonLinLoc定位、GrowClust3D相对定位与EQcorr…
Continuous seismic waveforms covering ~3–4 days before and 3 days after six 4.0 <= ML <= 5.8 mainshocks (2016–2023) recorded by GONAF borehole arrays and KOERI/AFAD surface stations.
GONAF井下台阵与KOERI/AFAD地表台网记录的2016-2023年6个4.0-5.8级序列主震前后连续波形。
Detected 1,958 quality-controlled events (eightfold increase near boreholes), lowering Mc from 1.90 to 0.90; borehole picks had 31.7% association rate vs. 12.6% for surface stations.
获1,958个质控事件（井下区增8倍），完备震级降至0.90；井下与地表拾取关联率分别为31.7%和12.6%。
Catalog gains depend on PyOcto threshold settings and a 1-D velocity model that neglects 3-D basin heterogeneity, while strong sequence variability limits predictive capability.
事件增量依赖PyOcto阈值及一维速度模型，且序列间显著差异限制了确定性预测潜力。
First systematic combination of GONAF borehole array data with deep-learning picking and template matching across multiple Marmara sequences to compare pre-mainshock localization.
首次系统融合GONAF井下台阵与深度学习及模板匹配技术，对比马尔马拉多个序列的震前局部化过程。

kc: Compiled a refined seismicity catalog of 1,958 quality-controlled events for six moderate earthquake sequences in the Sea of Marmara, achieving an eightfold event increase within the GONAF borehole network.

Quantified the performance advantage of borehole arrays over surface stations in an urban noise environment, showing 2.5 times higher overall pick association rates and a completeness magnitude drop from Mc 1.90 to 0.90.

Demonstrated sequence-dependent pre-mainshock seismicity patterns: clear space-time localization before the June 2016 ML 4.5 event, heterogeneous clustering before the September 2019 ML 5.8 Silivri event, and minimal precursory activity before four other Çınarcık Basin mainshocks.
构建了马尔马拉海6个中等地震序列的高精度地震目录（质控后共1,958个事件），在GONAF井下台网监测区内将检出事件数提高了约8倍。
量化了城市高噪环境下井下台阵相对于地表台站的性能优势，其总体震相关联率提高2.5倍，监测区内完备震级从Mc 1.90降至0.90。
揭示了与序列相关的震前微震演化特征：2016年6月ML 4.5震前呈现显著时空局部化，2019年9月ML 5.8震前表现为非均匀丛集，而其余4个邻近序列震前活动微弱。
me: Deep-learning P- and S-wave phase picking using the NCEDC-pretrained PhaseNet model in SeisBench with a 0.3 probability threshold.
4D space-time octree-based phase association using PyOcto, followed by two-step probabilistic absolute location with NonLinLoc and empirical station corrections.
Hierarchical clustering relative relocation using GrowClust3D.jl with waveform cross-correlation differential times, supplemented by single-station template matching via EQcorrscan.
基于SeisBench框架调用NCEDC预训练PhaseNet模型进行P波和S波深度学习拾取（概率阈值0.3）。
使用PyOcto进行四维时空八叉树震相关联，并利用NonLinLoc结合经验台站校正进行两步概率绝对定位。
基于波形互相关走时差利用GrowClust3D.jl进行分层聚类相对定位，并结合EQcorrscan开展单台模板匹配检测。
de: Continuous 3-component waveform data (~3–4 days before and 3 days after each mainshock, resampled to 100 Hz) from GONAF borehole arrays (up to 300 m depth) and KOERI/AFAD surface networks.
Six 4.0 <= ML <= 5.8 earthquake sequences between 2016 and 2023 in the Çınarcık Basin and Central Basin along the Main Marmara Fault.
Validation against a merged reference catalog (622 events from Becker et al., KOERI, and AFAD) and manual borehole picks from Malin et al. (2018).
来自GONAF井下台阵（深达300米）及KOERI/AFAD地表台网在每次主震前后约3-4天的连续三分量波形数据（重采样至100 Hz）。
2016至2023年间沿主马尔马拉断层在Çınarcık盆地和中央盆地发生的6个4.0 <= ML <= 5.8地震序列。
利用合并参考目录（来自Becker等、KOERI和AFAD的622个事件）以及Malin等（2018）的人工井下拾取结果进行验证。
li: Catalog event gains depend on PyOcto association thresholds and a 1-D layered velocity model that cannot fully capture 3-D basin heterogeneity.
Events below Mc = 0.90 in the GONAF area are constrained by few stations, leading to higher magnitude uncertainties.
Strong variability in pre-mainshock clustering across nearby sequences limits the deterministic predictive potential of real-time waveform similarity monitoring.
目录事件增量受PyOcto关联参数设置影响，且采用的一维层状速度模型无法完全反映三维盆地非均匀性。
GONAF监测区内低于完备震级（Mc = 0.90）的微震仅受少数台站约束，震级不确定性较大。
邻近序列间震前微震丛集特征存在强烈差异，限制了利用波形相似性进行实时确定性地震预测的潜力。

tm.why: The core objective is building an enhanced microseismicity catalog around six moderate mainshocks using PhaseNet, PyOcto, NonLinLoc, GrowClust3D.jl, and EQcorrscan.
The workflow heavily relies on deep-learning phase picking via PhaseNet within the SeisBench framework to process continuous borehole and surface seismic waveforms.
The paper investigates pre-mainshock clustering, foreshock localization, waveform similarity, and the roles of fault roughness and aseismic slip along the Main Marmara Fault.

ev.notes: All 21 pages of the JGR: Solid Earth article PDF were examined, including full text, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–9.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of forecasting volcanic eruption sizes, which is crucial for hazard assessment. While future eruption sizes are typically modeled using power-law distributions of past erupted volumes, real-world data often deviate from a pure power-law due to measurement uncertainties. The authors propose using an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to incorporate both the underlying power-law behavior and the observational uncertainties of past eruptions. They apply this statistical method to eruptive records from two high-risk calderas: Campi Flegrei in Italy and Taupo in New Zealand. The EMG distribution provides an excellent statistical fit to both datasets, demonstrating that the apparent deviations from power-law behavior can be explained by volume uncertainties, thereby validating the continued use of power-law frameworks for volcanic hazard forecasting.
本研究针对火山灾害评估中预测未来喷发规模的难题，提出了一种考虑历史喷发量测量不确定性的统计建模方法。虽然传统预测常假设喷发量服从幂律分布，但实际观测数据因不确定性常偏离幂律。研究引入指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布，将潜在的幂律特征与观测误差相结合。该方法被应用于意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞和新西兰陶波两个高风险破……

t: Fitting an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to model the combination of an underlying power-law eruption size distribution and log-normal observational uncertainties.
采用指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布，对潜在幂律喷发规模分布与对数正态观测不确定性的结合进行拟合。
Historical erupted volume data from two active calderas: Campi Flegrei (Italy) and Taupo (New Zealand).
来自意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞（Campi Flegrei）和新西兰陶波（Taupo）两个活动破火山口的历史喷发量数据。
The EMG distribution successfully fits the eruptive records of both calderas, confirming that observed deviations from power-laws are compatible with volume uncertainties.
EMG分布成功拟合了两个破火山口的喷发记录，证实观测到的幂律偏差与喷发量不确定性相兼容。
Relies on the assumption of Gaussian uncertainties in log-volume and is constrained by the completeness of historical eruption catalogs.
依赖于对数喷发量呈高斯不确定性的假设，并受限于历史喷发目录的完整性。
First application of the EMG distribution to reconcile observed volcanic eruption volume distributions with theoretical power-law behaviors under uncertainty.
首次应用EMG分布，在不确定性下调和了观测到的火山喷发量分布与理论幂律行为。

kc: Proposed the Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to model volcanic eruption volumes while accounting for observational uncertainty.
Demonstrated that apparent deviations of eruption volume distributions from power-laws can be statistically explained by measurement errors.
Validated the method using historical eruptive records from Campi Flegrei (Italy) and Taupo (New Zealand).
提出了指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布模型，在考虑观测不确定性的情况下对火山喷发量进行建模。
证明了喷发量分布与幂律之间的表观偏差在统计上可以通过测量误差来解释。
利用意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞和新西兰陶波的历史喷发记录验证了该方法的有效性。
me: Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution fitting.
Statistical modeling of power-law distributions convolved with Gaussian observational uncertainty.
指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布拟合。
对卷积了高斯观测不确定性的幂律分布进行统计建模。
de: Historical erupted volume catalogs from the Campi Flegrei caldera, Italy.
Historical erupted volume catalogs from the Taupo caldera, New Zealand.
来自意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞（Campi Flegrei）破火山口的历史喷发量目录。
来自新西兰陶波（Taupo）破火山口的历史喷发量目录。
li: The method assumes Gaussian-distributed uncertainties on log-transformed volumes, which may not capture all types of geological estimation errors.
Limited by the completeness and quality of historical eruptive records.
该方法假设对数转换后的喷发量呈高斯分布不确定性，这可能无法捕获所有类型的地质估算误差。
受限于历史喷发记录的完整性和质量。

tm.why: The paper focuses on forecasting volcanic eruption sizes and modeling eruptive volume distributions for hazard assessment.
The study models how observational uncertainty affects the shape of volcanic eruption size distributions using statistical methods.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and public metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: During the 4–5 September 2026 Anak Krakatau eruption, residents in Bandung (240–300 km away) heard repeated booms and rattling windows, whereas closer Jakarta (150 km) remained largely silent. This study tests the volcanic acoustic origin using eruption timing, atmospheric ensemble ray tracing (combining ERA5, HWM14, NRLMSIS 2.1, and 200 gravity-wave realizations), and Google Trends search interest for 'dentuman' (boom). Ray tracing shows eastward stratopause winds (55–60 km altitude) returned sound to Bandung in 84–97% of ensemble members while placing Jakarta (3%) and Bogor (11%) inside an acoustic shadow zone. Consistently, 96% of 'dentuman' search interest occurred at 200–300 km distance. Re-evaluating the April 2020 eruption shows closer stratopause returns (150–210 km) matching Jakarta-area boom reports. Furthermore, a matched-control analysis of 11 boom events demonstrates that nocturnal low-level temperature inversions occur on most nights and cannot alone explain boom episodes.
2026年9月4日至5日喀拉喀托之子火山喷发期间，距火山240–300公里的万隆居民听到持续轰鸣并感到窗户震动，而仅150公里的雅加达却几乎无感。本研究结合喷发时序、大气系综射线追踪（融合ERA5、HWM14、NRLMSIS 2.1及200个重力波扰动实现）与Google搜索热度检验了火山声学成因。……

t: Acoustic ray tracing in the effective-sound-speed approximation (launch angles 1–60°) through ERA5 profiles extended to 150 km with HWM14 winds and NRLMSIS 2.1 temperatures, perturbed by 200 random gravity-wave realizations and integrated for classical-plus-rotational frequency absorption.
基于ERA5与HWM14/NRLMSIS混合剖面及200个重力波扰动，开展有效声速射线追踪与声吸收积分。

PVMBG eruption chronologies, 32 Darwin VAAC advisories, ERA5 hourly reanalysis, HWM14 and NRLMSIS 2.1 models, city-level Google Trends search interest ('dentuman' and 'krakatau'), GPM IMERG rainfall, and 11 historical boom events for matched-control testing.
PVMBG喷发时序、VAAC火山灰警报、ERA5再分析、Google搜索热度、IMERG降水及11个历史轰鸣事件。

In September 2026, 87.5% of ensemble members returned sound to Bandung via stratopause winds (55–60 km), while Jakarta (3%) and Serang (0%) lay in a shadow zone; 96% of 'dentuman' search interest occurred at 200–300 km.
2026年87.5%系综成员经平流层顶折返至万隆，雅加达（3%）处声影区；96%轰鸣搜索位于200–300 km。

Models omit wave amplitudes and geometric spreading, rely on heuristic gravity waves and climatological winds above 47 km, and lack open instrumental infrasound records in Bandung for direct verification.
未模拟波幅与几何扩散，高层风依赖气候态模型，且万隆缺乏公开次声仪器记录验证。

Combines gravity-wave acoustic ray tracing with city-level Google Trends search behavior to resolve volcanic acoustic shadow zones and disproves low-level inversion ducting as a diagnostic cause via matched controls.
融合重力波声射线追踪与Google搜索热度刻画火山声影区，并用匹配对照证伪低空波导假说。

kc: Demonstrates via 200-member gravity-wave ensemble ray tracing that stratopause winds (55–60 km) ducted acoustic waves from the September 2026 Anak Krakatau eruption to Bandung (240–300 km) while leaving Jakarta (150 km) in a shadow zone.
Validates Google Trends search interest ('dentuman' vs. 'krakatau') as an unsolicited crowd-sourced proxy for mapping acoustic return zones, calibrated against a known 2025 Cirebon meteor airburst.

Re-evaluates the April 2020 Jakarta boom episode using ray tracing and GPM IMERG precipitation data, showing booms occurred two hours after local thunderstorms ended and coincided with stratospheric volcanic returns.
Proves through a matched-control analysis of 11 Indonesian boom events that nocturnal low-level tropospheric acoustic ducts occur on 70–84% of control nights and are not diagnostic of boom nights.
通过200成员重力波系综射线追踪证明，平流层顶风场（55–60 km）将2026年9月喀拉喀托之子火山喷发声波导引至万隆（240–300 km），而使雅加达（150 km）处于声影区。
验证了Google Trends搜索热度（“dentuman”对比“krakatau”）可作为绘制声波折返区的非征集众包代用指标，并用2025年井里汶陨石空爆事件进行了标定。
结合射线追踪与GPM IMERG降水数据重新评估了2020年4月雅加达轰鸣事件，表明轰鸣发生在当地雷暴结束两小时后，且与火山平流层折返波吻合。
通过对11个印尼轰鸣事件的匹配对照分析证明，夜间低空对流层声波导管在70–84%的对照夜均存在，不能作为轰鸣之夜的诊断特征。
me: Waveguide celerity arrival-time window testing (0.18–0.35 km/s) linking volcanic tremor and ash plume chronology to public boom reports.
Effective-sound-speed acoustic ray tracing (launch angles 1–60°) through hybrid ERA5 + HWM14/NRLMSIS 2.1 profiles (up to 150 km) perturbed by 200 vertical gravity-wave realizations.
Classical-plus-rotational atmospheric acoustic absorption integration along arriving rays from 0.5 to 20 Hz.
Spatial and temporal Google Trends search interest analysis for 'dentuman' and 'krakatau', plus matched-control binomial testing of ERA5 low-level ducts across 11 boom events.
基于大气波导波速（0.18–0.35 km/s）的到时窗口检验，将火山颤动和灰柱时序与公众轰鸣报告相关联。
在叠加200个垂向重力波随机扰动的ERA5 + HWM14/NRLMSIS 2.1混合大气剖面（至150 km）中，开展有效声速近似声学射线追踪（发射角1–60°）。
沿到达射线对0.5至20 Hz频率进行经典加转动大气声吸收积分计算。
针对“dentuman”和“krakatau”的Google Trends时空搜索热度分析，以及对11个轰鸣事件的ERA5低空波导开展匹配对照二项检验。
de: PVMBG eruption tremor chronology and 32 Darwin VAAC volcanic ash advisories for the 4–7 September 2026 and 10–11 April 2020 Anak Krakatau eruptions.
ERA5 hourly reanalysis (37 pressure levels to 1 hPa), HWM14 horizontal winds, NRLMSIS 2.1 temperature/density, GFZ Potsdam F10.7/Ap geomagnetic indices, and US Standard Atmosphere 1976.
City-level and daily regional Google Trends exports for 'dentuman' and 'krakatau' (September 2026, April 2020, and October 2025 Cirebon meteor calibration).
Half-hourly NASA GPM IMERG rainfall rates within 25–150 km of receivers and 11 historical Indonesian boom events (2020–2026) with 12–16 matched control nights each.
PVMBG火山喷发颤动时序及达尔文VAAC发布的32份火山灰警报（涵盖2026年9月4–7日及2020年4月10–11日喀拉喀托之子火山喷发）。
ERA5逐小时再分析资料（37层至1 hPa）、HWM14水平风场模型、NRLMSIS 2.1温密模型、GFZ波茨坦F10.7/Ap地磁指数及1976美国标准大气模型。
“dentuman”与“krakatau”的城市级与每日区域级Google Trends数据（2026年9月、2020年4月及2025年10月井里汶陨石标定事件）。
接收点25–150 km范围内的NASA GPM IMERG半小时降水率数据，以及2020–2026年间11次印尼历史轰鸣事件（每事件匹配12–16个对照夜）。
li: Relies on a heuristic gravity-wave ensemble, range-independent 1D atmospheric profiles, and climatological upper-atmosphere winds (HWM14) that disagree in sign with ERA5 near 48–55 km.

Wave amplitudes, geometric spreading, and caustics are not modelled; the classical-plus-rotational absorption approximation replaces the full Sutherland-Bass model and likely overestimates thermospheric attenuation.
No open instrumental infrasound waveforms from Bandung or Jakarta were available to directly verify arrival times and frequency content.
Google Trends locates users approximately via IP addresses, scales values relative to local city search volume, and can be influenced by media coverage.
依赖启发式重力波系综、距离无关的一维大气剖面以及气候态高层大气风模型（HWM14在48–55 km处与ERA5风向符号存在分歧）。
未模拟波幅、几何扩散与焦散；采用经典加转动吸收近似替代完整的Sutherland-Bass模型，可能高估了热层衰减。
缺乏万隆或雅加达的公开次声波仪器波形记录来直接验证波到时与频率成分。
Google Trends通过IP地址大致定位用户，数值按城市自身搜索量相对缩放，且可能受新闻报道影响。

tm.why: The paper investigates long-range volcanic infrasound and acoustic wave propagation from the 2020 and 2026 eruptions of Anak Krakatau.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 17-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including all text sections (§1–§6, Appendix A), 8 figures, and 6 tables.

sum: To understand how seismic waves propagate and attenuate in the Earth's lower mantle, this study introduces a novel experimental procedure combining a piezoelectrically driven dynamic diamond anvil cell (dDAC) with time-resolved synchrotron X-ray diffraction in radial geometry. Polycrystalline MgO powder was compressed to lower-mantle pressures (39–69 GPa) and subjected to cyclic loading at 10 to 100 mHz with varying strain amplitudes. Analyzing the 200 and 220 reflections yielded dynamic volume and differential lattice strains. While dynamic volume strains reflect isotropic elastic compressibility, dynamic differential lattice strains show complex, amplitude-dependent behavior. At larger oscillation amplitudes, phase shifts between the 200 and 220 differential strains resolve significant strain energy dissipation (0.001 < Q^-1 < 0.1) driven by anisotropic plastic or anelastic deformation near the flow stress. At the smallest amplitudes, the response approaches elastic isostrain with minor dissipation (Q^-1 < 0.01), demonstrating a viable pathway to measure mantle mineral anelasticity.
为理解地震波在下地幔中的传播与衰减，本研究将压电驱动的动态金刚石压腔（dDAC）与时间分辨径向同步辐射X射线衍射相结合。实验将多晶MgO粉末压缩至下地幔压力（39–69 GPa），并在10–100 mHz频率下进行不同应变振幅的循环加载。通过分析200和220晶面衍射提取动态体积应变和差应力晶格应变……

t: Polycrystalline MgO was compressed in a piezoelectrically driven dynamic diamond anvil cell while collecting 1 Hz radial X-ray diffraction patterns, which were azimuthally integrated to extract dynamic volume and differential lattice strains via sinusoidal fitting.
在压电驱动dDAC中压缩MgO并采集1 Hz径向X射线衍射，按扇区积分并正弦拟合以提取动态体积与差晶格应变。

Four 1200-second cyclic loading experiments (AM1, FM1, AM2, FM2) on MgO powder at 39–69 GPa and 10–100 mHz, generating over 4800 radial X-ray diffraction patterns analyzed for the 200 and 220 reflections.
在39–69 GPa和10–100 mHz下对MgO粉末进行四组1200秒循环加载实验，采集超4800张衍射图分析200…

Dynamic volume strains (3e-4 to 50e-4) behave isotropically, whereas dynamic differential lattice strains (1e-4 to 11e-4) exhibit phase shifts yielding dissipation of 0.001 < Q^-1 < 0.1 at large amplitudes and elastic isostrain (Q^-1 < 0.01) at small amplitudes.
动态体积应变呈各向同性；动态差晶格应变在大振幅下存在相移（0.001 < Q^-1 < 0.1），小振幅下接近弹性等应变…
Experimental strain oscillation amplitudes (1e-4 to 5e-3) exceed seismic wave strains by orders of magnitude, and phase shifts alone cannot distinguish between anelastic and plastic deformation.
实验应变振幅远大于天然地震波，且仅凭相移无法区分非弹性变形与塑性变形。

First cyclic loading experiments probing the dynamic response and strain energy dissipation of polycrystalline materials at lower-mantle pressures and seismic frequencies using radial X-ray diffraction in a dDAC.
首次结合dDAC与径向X射线衍射，在下地幔压力和地震频率下测定多晶材料的动态响应与应变能耗散。

kc: Demonstrated cyclic loading experiments on polycrystalline MgO at lower-mantle pressures (39–69 GPa) and seismic frequencies (10–100 mHz) using a dynamic diamond anvil cell and radial X-ray diffraction.
Resolved dynamic volume strains down to 3e-4 and dynamic differential lattice strains down to 1e-4, separating oscillatory dynamic strains from static background trends.

Quantified strain energy dissipation (0.001 < Q^-1 < 0.1) from phase shifts between the 200 and 220 differential lattice strains, showing a transition from anisotropic plastic/anelastic dissipation at large amplitudes to elastic isostrain at small amplitudes.
利用动态金刚石压腔和径向X射线衍射，首次在下地幔压力（39–69 GPa）和地震频率（10–100 mHz）下对多晶MgO进行了循环加载实验。
成功分辨出低至3e-4的动态体积应变和1e-4的动态差晶格应变，将振荡动态应变与静态背景趋势分离。
通过200和220晶面差晶格应变间的相移定量计算了应变能耗散（0.001 < Q^-1 < 0.1），揭示了从大振幅下的各向异性塑性/非弹性耗散向小振幅下弹性等应变的转变。
me: Cyclic compression of MgO powder in a panoramic BX90 dynamic diamond anvil cell (dDAC) driven by a piezoelectric actuator with amplitude- and frequency-modulated voltage paths.
Time-resolved synchrotron X-ray diffraction in radial geometry (25.63 keV, 1 Hz sampling rate) segmented into azimuthal sectors to track orientation-dependent lattice spacings.

Polynomial and sinusoidal curve fitting to separate static and dynamic components of Eulerian volume strains and differential lattice strains, extracting phase shifts and inverse quality factors (Q^-1).
在由压电致动器驱动的全景BX90动态金刚石压腔（dDAC）中，通过调幅和调频电压路径对MgO粉末进行循环压缩。
采用径向几何时间分辨同步辐射X射线衍射（25.63 keV，1 Hz采样率），按方位角扇区分割以追踪随方向变化的晶面间距。
利用多项式和正弦曲线拟合分离欧拉体积应变和差晶格应变的静态与动态分量，提取相移和逆品质因子（Q^-1）。
de: Four 1200-second cyclic loading experiments (AM1, FM1, AM2, FM2) on pure MgO powder at room temperature across pressures of 39–69 GPa and frequencies of 10, 20, 50, and 100 mHz.
Over 4800 2D radial X-ray diffraction patterns collected at beamline P02.2 (PETRA III, DESY) using an X-ray transparent boron-epoxy gasket.
在室温、39–69 GPa压力和10、20、50、100 mHz频率下，对纯MgO粉末进行了四组各1200秒的循环加载实验（AM1、FM1、AM2、FM2）。
在DESY的PETRA III同步辐射光源P02.2线站，使用X射线透明硼-环氧树脂垫片采集了超过4800张二维径向X射线衍射图谱。
li: Oscillating strain amplitudes (1e-4 to 5e-3) exceed those of natural seismic waves by several orders of magnitude, keeping the sample near its plastic flow stress.
Experiments were conducted at room temperature on textured powder without a pressure-transmitting medium, and phase shifts alone cannot distinguish between anelastic and plastic deformation.
振荡应变振幅（1e-4至5e-3）比天然地震波高出几个数量级，导致样品处于塑性流动应力附近。
实验在室温和无传压介质的织构粉末上进行，且仅靠相移无法区分非弹性变形和塑性变形。

tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamic elastic, anelastic, and plastic properties of MgO at lower mantle pressures (39–69 GPa) to constrain seismic wave propagation in the Earth's mantle.
The study measures phase shifts between oscillating differential lattice strains at seismic frequencies (10–100 mHz) to quantify strain energy dissipation and inverse quality factors (Q^-1).
It examines elastic and plastic anisotropy in textured polycrystalline MgO using radial X-ray diffraction to evaluate how grain-scale anisotropy affects differential lattice strains.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 52-page manuscript PDF including abstract, main text, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–10.

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional geometric model of the Gulang–Zhongwei fault zone in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. By characterizing the spatial variation and structural complexity of the fault system, the authors provide critical constraints on fault segmentation and potential rupture areas. These geometric insights are essential for improving regional seismic hazard assessments and understanding the geodynamic evolution of the northeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
本研究构建了青藏高原东北缘古浪—中卫断裂带的三维几何模型。通过刻画该断裂系统的空间变化与结构复杂性，作者为断裂分段和潜在破裂区域提供了关键约束。这些几何特征对于提高区域地震危险性评估水平以及理解青藏高原东北缘的动力学演化具有重要意义。

t: Three-dimensional geometric modeling of the Gulang-Zhongwei fault zone to characterize its spatial structure.
对古浪—中卫断裂带进行三维几何建模，以刻画其空间结构。
Geological and geophysical datasets constraining the surface trace and subsurface geometry of the fault.
约束该断裂地表迹线及深部几何结构的地质与地球物理数据集。
A detailed 3D geometric model of the fault, highlighting its segmentation and implications for seismic hazard.
建立了该断裂的精细三维几何模型，揭示了其分段特征及地震危险性意义。
Potential uncertainties in the deep geometry due to sparse deep geophysical constraints.
由于深部地球物理约束较少，深部几何结构可能存在不确定性。
First comprehensive 3D geometric model of the Gulang-Zhongwei fault for seismic hazard assessment.
首次针对古浪—中卫断裂构建用于地震危险性评估的系统三维几何模型。

kc: Constructed a 3D geometric model of the Gulang–Zhongwei fault in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Analyzed the structural segmentation and spatial variation of the fault zone.
Discussed the implications of the 3D fault geometry for regional seismic hazard assessment.
构建了青藏高原东北缘古浪—中卫断裂带的三维几何模型。
分析了该断裂带的结构分段特征与空间变化。
探讨了三维断裂几何结构对区域地震危险性评估的启示。
me: Three-dimensional structural and geometric modeling of active fault zones.
活动断裂带的三维结构与几何建模方法。
de: Geological, geodetic, or seismological observations of the Gulang–Zhongwei fault zone (inferred from title and regional context).
古浪—中卫断裂带的地质、大地测量或地震学观测数据（根据标题及区域背景推断）。

由于部分段落缺乏高分辨率深部地球物理成像数据，模型验证受到一定限制。

tm.why: The paper focuses on the 3D geometric modeling of a major fault zone in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
The title explicitly states that the 3D modeling has implications for seismic hazard assessment.
Modeling fault geometry is fundamental to understanding fault mechanics and rupture behavior.

ev.notes: No PDF or abstract was available. The analysis is based on the paper title, authors, venue, and regional geological context of the Gulang-Zhongwei fault.

sum: Prior Alpine Fault (AF8) ground-motion simulations terminated in the central South Island, producing negligible shaking in Wellington. This study advances AF hazard modeling by simulating multi-segment ruptures (Mw 8.28–8.31) that initiate on the AF and propagate northward onto the Wairau, Clarence, and Hope faults in the Marlborough Fault Zone (MFZ), selected from the 2022 NZ National Seismic Hazard Model (aggregate recurrence interval ~1,255 years). Using a multi-segment kinematic rupture generator, hybrid broadband simulations (3D finite-difference up to 1 Hz coupled with high-frequency stochastic synthetics), and an updated 3D velocity model (NZVM v2.09) featuring 45 sedimentary basins, the authors evaluate three realizations per geometry. Results highlight strong northward rupture directivity and basin reverberations, yielding central Wellington PGAs of 0.06–0.12 g—comparable to the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake. Comparisons with 2017 AF8 runs isolate the impacts of newly added basins, high-frequency parameterizations, and kinematic slip heterogeneity.
针对以往阿尔卑斯断层（AF8）模拟未覆盖北岛的问题，本研究从2022新西兰国家地震危险性模型中提取了向北延伸至马尔堡断层带（Wairau、Clarence和Hope断层）的3种多段破裂几何（Mw 8.28-8.31，总复发间隔约1255年）。结合多段运动学破裂生成器与包含45个沉积盆地的新西兰3D速……

t: Hybrid broadband simulation (Graves & Pitarka 2015) combining 3D staggered-grid finite-difference low-frequency waveforms (<=1 Hz, 100 m grid) with stochastic high-frequency synthetics, driven by a multi-segment kinematic rupture generator.
采用混合宽频带模拟，结合多段运动学震源、100米网格3D有限差分低频模拟（<=1 Hz）与高频随机合成。

Three multi-segment rupture geometries (Wairau, Clarence, Hope; Mw 8.28–8.31) extracted from 120 plausible 2022 NZ NSHM scenarios, simulated within NZVM v2.09 containing 45 explicitly modeled sedimentary basins.
从2022 NZ NSHM筛选3类多段破裂情景（Mw 8.28-8.31），使用含45个显式盆地的NZVM v2.09模…

Strong northward directivity and basin reverberation yield central Wellington PGAs of 0.06–0.12 g and PGVs of 29–44 cm/s for Alpine-Wairau and Alpine-Clarence scenarios, comparable to the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake.
Wairau和Clarence情景在惠灵顿产生0.06–0.12 g的PGA和29–44 cm/s的PGV，与2016年…
The 100 m grid spacing and 500 m/s minimum shear-wave velocity underestimate observed 1–3 s spectral amplification in shallow basins like Wellington, and only one southern hypocentre was tested.
100米网格和500 m/s最小波速低估了惠灵顿浅盆地1-3秒放大效应，且仅测试了单一南端震源。

First physics-based broadband simulations of multi-segment Alpine-Marlborough fault ruptures reaching within 100 km of Wellington, integrating 2022 NSHM rates, multi-segment kinematic sources, and 44 newly added sedimentary basins.
首次对延伸至马尔堡断层带的阿尔卑斯断层多段破裂开展宽频带模拟，评估对惠灵顿的强震威胁并融合44个新盆地。

kc: Identified 120 plausible Alpine-Marlborough multi-segment ruptures within 100 km of Wellington from the 2022 NZ NSHM (aggregate recurrence interval 1,255 years) and simulated representative Wairau, Clarence, and Hope scenarios.
Performed hybrid broadband ground-motion simulations (ft = 1 Hz, 100 m grid) incorporating 45 explicitly modeled sedimentary basins in NZVM v2.09.
Demonstrated that Alpine-Wairau and Alpine-Clarence scenarios generate 0.06–0.12 g PGA and 29–44 cm/s PGV in central Wellington, comparable to 2016 Kaikōura observations.

Decomposed differences between current simulations and the 2017 AF8 benchmark into velocity-model/workflow effects (up to 1.6–2.1x long-period amplification in newly modeled basins) and kinematic source potency distribution effects.
Evaluated 1D SH wave site-response adjustments (SH1D) against conventional VS30 factors at Wellington stations, showing improved spectral ratios near fundamental site periods.
从2022 NZ NSHM中筛选出距惠灵顿100 km内的120个阿尔卑斯-马尔堡多段破裂情景（总复发周期1255年），并模拟了Wairau、Clarence和Hope三类代表性情景。
利用包含45个显式沉积盆地的NZVM v2.09三维速度模型，开展了高分辨率（100 m网格，转换频率1 Hz）混合宽频带地面运动模拟。
证明Alpine-Wairau和Alpine-Clarence情景在惠灵顿市中心产生0.06–0.12 g的PGA和29–44 cm/s的PGV，与2016年凯库拉地震观测相当。
将当前模拟与2017年AF8基准的差异分解为速度模型/流程项（新建模盆地长周期放大达1.6–2.1倍）和震源矩释放空间分布项。
在惠灵顿台站对比了基于1D场地响应（SH1D）与传统VS30的浅层场地校正方法，表明SH1D能显著改善卓越周期附近的谱比预测。
me: Fault system clustering and scenario selection from the 2022 NZ NSHM inversion fault model using Rupture Explorer constraints.
Multi-segment kinematic rupture generation (Bradley and Faulkner 2025 extension of Graves and Pitarka 2015) with rigidity-weighted moment apportionment and kinematic jumping.
Hybrid broadband simulation combining 3D staggered-grid finite-difference elastodynamic modeling (f <= 1 Hz, dx = 100 m, VS,min = 500 m/s) with stochastic high-frequency synthetics (f > 1 Hz).
Logarithmic decomposition of ground-motion intensity changes relative to 2017 AF8 simulations into separate source and velocity-model/workflow terms.
Shallow site response adjustment comparing empirical CB14 VS30 amplification factors against site-specific 1D linear SH-wave transfer functions (SH1D).
利用Rupture Explorer约束条件，从2022 NZ NSHM反演断层模型中进行断层系统聚类与代表性破裂情景筛选。
采用多段运动学破裂生成方法（基于刚度加权面积分配地震矩及运动学触发跳跃准则）构建每类几何的3个随机破裂实现。
采用Graves & Pitarka混合宽频带模拟方法，结合3D交错网格有限差分低频模拟（f <= 1 Hz，网格100 m，最小横波速度500 m/s）与高频随机合成方法（f > 1 Hz）。
通过对数尺度分解，将相对于2017年AF8模拟的地面运动强度变化精确拆分为速度模型/工作流项与震源项。
对比基于CB14模型的经验VS30场地放大因子与基于特定场地VS剖面的一维SH波场地响应分析（SH1D）校正方法。
de: 2022 NZ National Seismic Hazard Model (NSHM) fault geometries and recurrence intervals.
New Zealand Velocity Model (NZVM) v2.09 incorporating 3D regional tomography and 45 explicit sedimentary basins.
13 large-scale 3D finite-difference wave propagation simulations (23.4 billion grid points, 94,000 time steps each, totaling 1.045 million core-hours on TACC Stampede3 and ESNZ Cascade).
Archived 2017 AF8 broadband simulation outputs and strong-motion recordings from the 2016 Mw 7.87 Kaikōura earthquake in Wellington (New Zealand Ground-Motion Database v4.3).
2022年新西兰国家地震危险性模型（NSHM）的断层几何结构与复发间隔数据。
包含区域三维层析成像背景与45个显式沉积盆地的新西兰速度模型（NZVM v2.09）。
13次大规模三维有限差分波传播数值模拟（234亿网格点，94,000时间步，在TACC Stampede3和ESNZ Cascade上总计消耗104.5万核时）。
2017年AF8宽频带模拟归档数据，以及新西兰强震数据库v4.3中2016年Mw 7.87凯库拉地震在惠灵顿台站的强震观测记录。
li: Simulations only consider a single (southern) hypocentre location and three kinematic realizations per rupture geometry.
The 100-m grid spacing and minimum shear-wave velocity of 500 m/s cannot adequately resolve 3D long-period (T = 1–3 s) site amplification in shallow basins like Wellington.
The improved SH1D site-response adjustment requires site-specific VS profiles, preventing its application across the entire regional simulation domain.
模拟仅考虑了单一的南端震源位置，且每种破裂几何仅生成了3个运动学随机实现。
100米的网格间距和500 m/s的最小剪切波速限制了对惠灵顿等较浅沉积盆地中1–3秒周期三维场地放大效应的解析能力。
表现更优的SH1D一维场地响应校正方法依赖于特定场地的实测VS剖面，目前无法推广应用至整个区域模拟网格。

tm.why: The paper focuses on hybrid broadband ground-motion simulations of great earthquake scenarios on the Alpine-Marlborough fault system for seismic hazard and emergency planning in New Zealand.
It develops and evaluates multi-segment kinematic rupture realizations and investigates how slip distributions, potency release, and northward rupture directivity control regional shaking.

Low-frequency waveforms up to 1 Hz are computed via 3D staggered-grid finite-difference elastodynamic simulations across a 23.4-billion grid-point domain consuming over 1 million core-hours on HPC clusters.

ev.notes: Full 60-page PDF (including main text and Electronic Supplements A, B, and C) was read and analyzed.

sum: This paper presents the open-access seismological dataset collected during the DETECT experiment across the active Irpinia fault system in southern Italy from August 2021 to August 2022. A constellation of 20 small-aperture (~2 km) seismic arrays comprising 200 stations (each array with one broadband, one 1 Hz, and eight 4.5 Hz sensors recording at 200 Hz) was deployed above the fault segments of the 1980 Mw 6.8 earthquake. The continuous waveform archive (~5.2 TB in miniSEED format) is distributed via GEOFON/EIDA FDSN web services with 88% overall availability. Noise performance was evaluated via probabilistic power spectral densities. Furthermore, combining deep learning (EQTransformer) and template matching (EQCorrScan) yielded an enhanced catalog of ~3,600 microearthquakes (Ml -1.2 to 3.1) and ~100k phase picks, lowering the completeness magnitude to -0.3—over one magnitude unit below the permanent network—enabling high-resolution fault mechanics and crustal fluid tracking.
本文介绍了2021年8月至2022年8月在意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚断层系统开展的DETECT实验所采集的公开地震数据集。研究在1980年Mw 6.8地震断层段上方布设了20个小孔径（约2 km）密集台阵，共200个台站（含宽频带、1 Hz及4.5 Hz传感器，采样率200 Hz）。5.2 TB连续波形数……

t: Twenty 10-station arrays (~2 km aperture) were deployed offline at 200 Hz. Waveforms were converted to miniSEED, evaluated with PPSDs, and scanned using EQTransformer and EQCorrScan to build an enhanced microseismic catalog.
布设20个10台站小孔径台阵以200 Hz离线采集，计算PPSD，结合EQTransformer与EQCorrScan构…
One year (August 2021–August 2022) of continuous 200 Hz 3-C waveforms from 200 stations (20 broadband, 20 1-Hz, 160 4.5-Hz sensors) in southern Italy, totaling 5.2 TB with 88% availability.
意大利南部200个台站为期一年的200 Hz连续三分量波形（共5.2 TB），总体数据可用率达88%。
Compiled 3,600 earthquakes (Ml -1.2 to 3.1) and ~100k phase picks in one year, lowering the completeness threshold to Ml -0.3—more than one magnitude unit below the permanent network.
一年内检测出3600个微震（Ml -1.2至3.1）和约10万个震相，完备震级降至-0.3，降低逾1个震级单位。

Lack of real-time transmission caused temporary data drops (to 75%–80%) from storage saturation or battery depletion, and array beamforming/back-projection was not yet exploited in initial cataloging.
无实时传输导致维护前因存储或电量耗尽出现数据缺失，且初步目录尚未利用台阵聚束与反投影技术。
First constellation of 20 dense microarrays integrated into a near-fault observatory in the Irpinia fault zone, matching decades of conventional monitoring detections within a single year.
首次在伊尔皮尼亚断层带将20个密集微台阵与近断层观测网结合，一年内检测事件数堪比数十年常规监测。

kc: Public release of a 5.2 TB continuous seismic waveform archive from 200 stations organized in 20 dense arrays (network code ZK) over one year in Irpinia, Italy.
Comprehensive metadata curation, noise characterization via PSD/PDF analysis across three sensor types, and logistical management tools (webGIS traffic-light system, Telegram bot, QR codes).
Release of an enhanced microseismic catalog containing 3,600 events (Ml -1.2 to 3.1) and ~100k phase arrival times, lowering completeness magnitude to -0.3.
公开发布了意大利伊尔皮尼亚地区20个密集台阵（200个台站，台网代码ZK）为期一年的5.2 TB连续地震波形数据。
提供了完整的元数据管理、三种传感器类型的PSD/PDF噪声特征分析，以及野外运维管理工具（webGIS交通灯系统、Telegram机器人和二维码）。
发布了包含3600个微震事件（Ml -1.2至3.1）和约10万个震相到时的增强地震目录，将完备震级降低至-0.3。
me: Deployment of 20 small-scale arrays (~2 km aperture), each equipped with 1 broadband (Trillium Compact 120s), 1 short-period (1 Hz Mark L-4C-3D), and 8 geophones (4.5 Hz) recording offline at 200 Hz.
Data conversion from Data-Cube to steim2-compressed miniSEED via GIPPtools, managed with SeisComP, and noise evaluation via Probabilistic Power Spectral Densities (PPSD).
Automated earthquake detection and phase picking using EQTransformer followed by template matching refinement with EQCorrScan and earthquake relocation.
布设20个孔径约2 km的小型台阵，每个台阵配备1台宽频带、1台1 Hz短周期和8台4.5 Hz检波器，以200 Hz采样率离线记录。
使用GIPPtools将Data-Cube格式转换为steim2压缩的miniSEED格式，利用SeisComP管理，并通过概率功率谱密度（PPSD）评估背景噪声。
结合EQTransformer深度学习模型与EQCorrScan模板匹配技术进行自动地震检测、震相拾取与重定位。
de: Continuous 3-component seismic recordings from 200 temporary stations (FDSN network ZK) from August 2021 to August 2022, totaling 5.2 TB.
Three field data recovery and battery replacement campaigns yielding 88% overall data availability between October 2021 and July 2022.
Enhanced microseismic catalog of 3,600 events and ~100,000 phase picks archived on Zenodo.
2021年8月至2022年8月期间200个临时台站（FDSN网络代码ZK）的三分量连续地震记录，总计5.2 TB。
通过三次野外数据回收和电池更换作业，在2021年10月至2022年7月期间实现了88%的总体数据可用率。
在Zenodo上归档的包含3600个微震事件和约10万个震相拾取的增强地震目录。
li: Stations operated offline without real-time data transmission to limit power consumption, causing temporary availability drops (to 75%–80%) prior to maintenance visits due to storage saturation or battery depletion.
4.5 Hz geophones exhibit higher instrumental self-noise at periods above a few seconds, exceeding reference noise models at low frequencies.
Initial catalog generation treated stations independently without exploiting array processing techniques such as beamforming or back-projection.
为降低功耗，台站采用无实时传输的离线运行模式，导致维护前因存储饱和或电池耗尽出现短暂的数据可用率下降（降至75%–80%）。
4.5 Hz检波器在数秒以上周期的仪器自噪声较高，在低频段超出了参考噪声模型。
初步地震目录构建将各台站独立处理，尚未利用聚束（beamforming）或反投影等台阵处理技术。

tm.why: The paper describes the network design, field deployment, data curation, and quality assessment of 20 temporary dense seismic arrays (200 stations total) in the Irpinia fault zone.
The study presents an enhanced microseismic catalog of 3,600 events compiled using EQTransformer and EQCorrScan, lowering the magnitude completeness threshold to -0.3.
The authors apply the deep-learning model EQTransformer to scan continuous array waveforms and build the initial template set for earthquake detection.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all 5 figures and 1 table.

sum: This study presents the first three-dimensional numerical models of peel-back delamination (PBD) on Venus to investigate rollback-style lithospheric recycling. By comparing model-derived trench geometries and flexural topography with observations from Artemis Corona, Atahensik Corona, and Derceto Plateau, the authors show that PBD initiation is facilitated by increased lithospheric thickness, which enhances negative buoyancy and drives crust-mantle decoupling. The evolution of trench geometry is controlled by rift geometry, lithospheric structure, and yield strength. Elastic thickness (Te) estimates from the southeastern trench of Artemis Corona suggest a thick thermal lithosphere of approximately 200–250 km (for a 1700 K mantle), providing crucial constraints on Venusian geodynamics and thermal state.
本研究首次建立了金星“剥离式”岩石圈拆沉（PBD）的三维数值模型，以探讨后撤式岩石圈循环机制。通过将模型预测的沟槽几何和挠曲地形与阿耳忒弥斯冕状物、阿塔亨西克冕状物和德耳塞托高原的观测数据进行对比，研究表明岩石圈厚度的增加促进了PBD的启动，增强了负浮力并驱动了壳幔解耦。沟槽几何的演化受裂谷几何、岩……

t: 3D numerical geodynamic modeling of peel-back delamination (PBD) combined with flexural topography and elastic thickness analysis.
结合挠曲地形和弹性厚度分析，对剥离式拆沉（PBD）进行三维地球动力学数值模拟。
Topographic and trench geometry observations from Venusian features (Artemis Corona, Atahensik Corona, Derceto Plateau) compared with synthetic 3D model outputs.
将金星（阿耳忒弥斯、阿塔亨西克冕状物及德耳塞托高原）的地形与沟槽几何观测数据与三维合成模型输出进行对比。
Models successfully match Artemis and Atahensik Coronae; elastic thickness estimates at Artemis Corona favor a thermal lithospheric thickness of 200-250 km.
模型成功匹配了阿耳忒弥斯和阿塔亨西克冕状物；阿耳忒弥斯处的弹性厚度估算表明热岩石圈厚度为200-250 km。
The Derceto Plateau model reproduces trench geometry but fails to satisfy flexural topography constraints.
德耳塞托高原模型虽然重现了沟槽几何，但未能满足挠曲地形的约束。
Presents the first three-dimensional models of peel-back delamination on Venus, moving beyond previous 2D approximations.
首次建立了金星剥离式岩石圈拆沉的三维模型，超越了以往的二维近似。

kc: Developed the first 3D numerical models of peel-back delamination (PBD) on Venus.
Successfully reproduced both trench geometry and flexural topography for Artemis and Atahensik Coronae.
Constrained the thermal lithospheric thickness at Artemis Corona to approximately 200-250 km.
首次开发了金星剥离式岩石圈拆沉（PBD）的三维数值模型。
成功重现了阿耳忒弥斯和阿塔亨西克冕状物的沟槽几何与挠曲地形特征。
将阿耳忒弥斯冕状物处的地幔热岩石圈厚度约束为约200-250公里。
me: 3D geodynamic numerical modeling of lithospheric peel-back delamination.
Flexural topography and elastic thickness (Te) modeling.
Comparative analysis of model-predicted trench geometry against Venusian spacecraft observations.
岩石圈剥离式拆沉的三维地球动力学数值模拟。
挠曲地形与弹性厚度（Te）建模。
将模型预测的沟槽几何与金星探测器观测数据进行对比分析。
de: Topographic and trench geometry data from Venusian features: Artemis Corona, Atahensik Corona, and Derceto Plateau.
3D synthetic geodynamic simulations varying lithospheric thickness, rift geometry, and yield strength.
来自金星阿耳忒弥斯冕状物、阿塔亨西克冕状物和德耳塞托高原的地形与沟槽几何数据。
改变岩石圈厚度、裂谷几何和屈服强度的三维合成地球动力学模拟。
li: The Derceto Plateau model failed to reproduce the observed flexural topography despite matching trench geometry.
Simplifications in rheological parameters and thermal profiles of the Venusian lithosphere.
德耳塞托高原模型虽然重现了沟槽几何，但未能满足挠曲地形的约束。
金星岩石圈流变学参数和温度剖面的简化。

tm.why: The paper models lithospheric delamination, crust-mantle decoupling, and thermal lithospheric thickness on Venus.
The study focuses on planetary geodynamics and tectonic features (coronae) of Venus.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from EarthArXiv, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates how inherited crustal structures control the evolution and active deformation of the Nelson Thrust Belt (NTB) in northern South Island, New Zealand. Integrating revised geological mapping, 1m LiDAR DEMs, borehole data, trench observations, and reinterpreted vintage seismic reflection profiles (Survey MD87), the authors construct six regional cross-sections across the urban Nelson-Tasman area. They define three major fault groups (F1–F3) and a frontal splay (F4). F2 and F3 are moderate- to steep-dipping faults that inverted Late Cretaceous and Eocene rift normal faults starting in the Late Miocene, with F3 ceasing activity earlier than F2. F1 is a low- to moderate-angle out-of-sequence thrust exploiting Paleozoic-Mesozoic terrane boundaries, lubricated by carbonaceous gouge derived from Eocene coal measures. Despite a long-term break-back deformation sequence from F3 to F1, paleoseismic evidence shows overlapping Late Pleistocene–Holocene ruptures across F1–F3, highlighting complex multi-fault seismic hazards.
本研究探讨了继承性同沉积构造与地体边界如何控制新西兰南岛北部尼尔森逆冲带（NTB）的演化与活动变形。通过整合修订的地质图、1米分辨率LiDAR地形、钻孔、探槽观测及重新解释的老旧地震反射剖面（MD87），作者建立了横跨城市区的6条构造剖面，识别出F1–F3三条主断层及前锋分支F4。研究表明，F2和F……

t: The authors construct six regional cross-sections across the onshore NTB by integrating revised geological mapping, 1m LiDAR DEMs, borehole and trench data, and depth-converted vintage seismic reflection profiles, complemented by kinematic restoration.
整合修订地质图、1米LiDAR地形、钻孔探槽资料及深度转换的老旧地震反射剖面，构建6条区域构造剖面并进行运动学恢复。

Data include updated geological maps, 1m LiDAR DEMs, shallow urban boreholes, outcrop and trench observations, carbon isotope analyses of fault gouges, gravity/magnetic anomalies, and digitally converted vintage seismic lines from 1989 Survey MD87.
包括更新地质图、1米LiDAR DEM、浅层钻孔、露头与探槽观测、断层泥碳同位素、重磁异常及1989年MD87数字化地震…

The NTB comprises three SE-dipping faults (F1–F3) and splay F4 accruing ~2.5–3 km reverse offset since the Late Miocene. F2 and F3 are inverted normal faults (>1 km reverse separation), while F1 is an out-of-sequence thrust.
NTB由三条南东倾主断层（F1–F3）及分支F4组成，晚中新世以来累积逆冲位移约2.5–3 km；F2和F3为反转正断层…
Subsurface interpretations are limited by the absence of subsurface data in Nelson City, no drilling calibration below 1 km depth, and low resolution of the digitized vintage seismic lines.
尼尔森市区缺乏地下数据，1公里以下无钻井标定，且数字化老旧地震反射剖面分辨率较低。

Links distinct pre-Neogene structural inheritances (terrane boundaries vs. rift normal faults) to a long-term break-back deformation sequence that coexists with overlapping Late Pleistocene–Holocene multi-fault seismic ruptures.
将前新近纪不同构造继承性与长期后退式变形序列及晚更新世-全新世多断层重叠地震破裂联系起来。

kc: Reconstructed the 3D architecture of the 100-km-long onshore Nelson Thrust Belt using six geological-geophysical cross-sections.
Demonstrated that faults F2 and F3 are inverted Late Cretaceous–Eocene normal faults, whereas F1 is an out-of-sequence thrust exploiting Paleozoic–Mesozoic terrane boundaries.
Established a long-term break-back sequence of fault reactivation from outer F3 to inner F1, alongside localized frontal splay propagation (F4).
Showed that multiple sub-parallel fault strands (F1, F2, F3) ruptured within overlapping Late Pleistocene–Holocene earthquake cycles (12–26 ka), posing distributed urban seismic hazards.
利用6条地质-地球物理联合剖面重建了长约100公里的陆上尼尔森逆冲带三维构造格架。
证实F2和F3为晚白垩世-始新世正断层反转形成，而F1是利用古生代-中生代地体边界发育的越序逆冲断层。
建立了从外部F3向内部F1迁移的长期后退式断层复活序列，以及局部前锋分支断层（F4）的扩展。
揭示了多条近平行断层分支（F1、F2、F3）在晚更新世-全新世地震周期（12–26 ka）内发生重叠破裂，凸显了城市分布式地震危险性。
me: Revised regional geological field mapping integrated with 1-m resolution LiDAR Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) and Red Relief image visualization.
Vectorization (SEGYRecover), depth conversion (OpendTect using shot-point velocities), and structural reinterpretation of vintage 1989 migrated seismic reflection lines (Survey MD87).
Construction and kinematic restoration (KronosFlow) of six geological cross-sections constrained by outcrops, trenches, boreholes, gravity, and magnetic anomalies.
Stable carbon isotope (δ13C) analysis of carbonaceous fault gouges along fault contacts.
整合修订的区域地质填图与1米分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型（DEM）及Red Relief图像可视化技术。
对1989年老旧偏移地震反射剖面（MD87测线）进行矢量化（SEGYRecover）、时深转换（OpendTect）及构造重新解释。
结合露头、探槽、钻孔和重磁异常构建6条地质剖面，并使用KronosFlow软件进行运动学平衡恢复。
对断层接触带上的碳质断层泥进行稳定碳同位素（δ13C）分析。
de: Revised 1:25,000 and 1:50,000 geological maps of the Nelson-Richmond and Brightwater-Wakefield areas.
1-m LiDAR DEM coverage across the Nelson-Tasman urban centers and paleoseismic trench logs.
Digitally converted TWT SEG-Y vintage seismic reflection lines (MD87-01, 03, 05, 07) from Survey MD87 and petroleum well logs (Tapawera-1, Ruby Bay-1).
Outcrop structural measurements and carbon isotope samples from fault gouges along F1.
尼尔森-里士满及布赖特沃特-韦克菲尔德地区修订版地质图。
覆盖尼尔森-塔斯曼城市群的1米分辨率LiDAR DEM数据及古地震探槽记录。
数字化转换的MD87测网双程走时SEG-Y地震反射剖面（MD87-01, 03, 05, 07）及石油钻井资料（Tapawera-1, Ruby Bay-1）。
沿F1断层露头的构造测量数据及断层泥碳同位素分析样品。
li: Lack of modern subsurface seismic imaging and no deep drilling calibration at depths >1 km in the central and southern segments.
Generally low resolution of the digitally converted vintage 1989 seismic reflection lines.
Extensive Plio-Quaternary sedimentary cover in the footwall and erosion of uplifted hanging-wall basement rocks obscure complete fault cut-off geometries.
缺乏现代地下地震成像数据，且中段和南段在大于1公里深度处无深钻标定。
数字化转换的1989年老旧地震反射剖面分辨率总体较低。
下盘广泛的上新世-第四纪沉积覆盖及上盘隆升基底岩石的剥蚀掩盖了完整的断层截切几何关系。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the structural architecture, crustal inheritance, and Neogene tectonic evolution of the Nelson Thrust Belt in New Zealand.
The study investigates the selective reverse reactivation of inherited normal faults, out-of-sequence thrusting, and carbonaceous fault gouge mechanics.
The paper assesses the paleoseismic rupture history (M 6.5-7.4) of multiple overlapping fault strands across urban centers in the Nelson-Tasman area.

ev.notes: Full 34-page preprint PDF including abstract, main text, 10 figures, and 1 table was used for the evaluation.

sum: This study derives analytical expressions for the stress intensity factor and static energy release rate of Mode II and III ruptures propagating through heterogeneous stress-drop distributions. The author demonstrates that rupture energetics, velocity, and arrest conditions are predominantly controlled by stress-drop heterogeneities with wavelengths comparable to the current rupture length. Shorter-wavelength heterogeneities are progressively averaged out, while longer-wavelength effects decay. This scale-dependent behavior explains why large-scale rupture processes remain reproducible in dynamic simulations despite unresolved small-scale heterogeneities. The findings suggest that observational constraints on fault structures at scales matching the rupture dimension are critical for forecasting large-earthquake scenarios.
本研究推导了II型和III型破裂在非均匀应力降分布中传播的应力强度因子和静态能量释放率的解析表达式。研究表明，破裂动力学、速度和终止条件主要受与当前破裂长度相当的应力降非均匀性波长控制。较短波长的非均匀性在能量积分中被逐渐平滑，而较长波长的影响则会衰减。这一尺度依赖特征解释了为什么在缺乏微观细节的情……

t: Analytical derivation of Mode II and III fracture mechanics equations using Fresnel integrals to model rupture energetics under heterogeneous stress-drop.
利用菲涅耳积分对非均匀应力降下的II型和III型断裂力学方程进行解析推导。
Theoretical study using analytical formulations and self-similar multi-wavelength heterogeneity models without empirical seismic data.
采用解析公式和自相似多波长非均匀性模型进行理论研究，未使用实际地震数据。
Rupture energetics are dominated by heterogeneities at scales comparable to the rupture length, while shorter-wavelength effects are averaged out.
破裂能量主要由与破裂长度相当的非均匀性尺度主导，而较短波长的影响被逐渐平滑。
Simplified Mode II/III geometries and idealized self-similar stress-drop distributions may not capture full 3D fault complexity.
简化的II/III型几何形状和理想自相似应力降分布可能无法捕捉完整的三维断层复杂性。
Establishes a scale-dependent analytical framework explaining why unresolved small-scale heterogeneities have weak effects on large-scale rupture dynamics.
建立了尺度依赖的解析框架，解释了为什么未解决的微观非均匀性对宏观破裂动力学影响微弱。

kc: Derived analytical expressions for stress intensity factor and static energy release rate in heterogeneous Mode II/III ruptures.
Demonstrated that rupture energetics are dominated by stress-drop heterogeneities at scales comparable to the current rupture length.
Provided a physical explanation for why large-scale dynamic rupture simulations are reproducible despite unresolved short-wavelength heterogeneities.
推导了非均匀应力降下II型和III型破裂的应力强度因子和静态能量释放率的解析表达式。
证明了破裂动力学能量主要受与当前破裂长度相当的应力降非均匀性尺度控制。
为大地震动力学模拟在缺乏短波长非均匀性细节时仍具有高重现性提供了物理学解释。
me: Analytical derivation of Mode II and Mode III fracture mechanics equations.
Use of Fresnel integrals to formulate a dimensionless response function for single-wavelength heterogeneity.
Extension to self-similar multi-wavelength heterogeneity models.
II型和III型断裂力学方程的解析推导。
利用菲涅耳积分构建单波长非均匀性的无量纲响应函数。
推广至自相似多波长非均匀性模型。
de: Theoretical and analytical modeling without direct observational seismic datasets.
Application of the slip-pulse solution to relate characteristic wavelength with seismogenic-layer thickness.
理论与解析建模，未直接使用实际地震观测数据集。
应用滑移脉冲解将特征波长与发震层厚度联系起来。
li: The analytical solutions rely on simplified Mode II and Mode III rupture geometries and may not fully capture complex 3D non-planar fault networks.
Assumes idealized self-similar stress-drop distributions which may vary in real geological settings.
解析解依赖于简化的II型和III型破裂几何形状，可能无法完全捕捉复杂的三维非平直断层网络。
假设了理想化的自相似应力降分布，这在实际地质环境中可能存在差异。

tm.why: The paper derives analytical expressions for rupture energetics and dynamics under heterogeneous stress-drop conditions.
It models fault slip-pulse solutions and the effects of non-planar fault geometry on rupture propagation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata from ESS Open Archive and Google Scholar search results.

sum: This study proposes a spatial autocorrelation (SPAC) method to estimate Rayleigh-wave attenuation coefficients from passive microtremor array observations. Theoretical analysis of directional aliasing reveals that attenuation effects manifest strongly in the imaginary part of the complex SPAC coefficient, requiring denser azimuthal sampling (such as a regular heptagonal array) than conventional phase-velocity estimation. The authors introduce a two-stage inversion procedure: initial phase velocity and attenuation estimates are derived via a first-order Bessel approximation and refined by fitting the full complex SPAC coefficient using differential evolution. Validations using theoretical synthetic data, 2D P-SV spectral-element simulations (SPECFEM2D), and field microtremor arrays (12, 30, and 132 m radii) in Iwate, Japan, demonstrate that the method accurately recovers fundamental-mode attenuation. Unlike beamforming-based methods that require nearly unidirectional wavefields, the proposed SPAC method handles isotropic to directional wavefields and operates at longer wavelengths relative to array size.
本文提出了一种从微动台阵观测中估计瑞利波衰减系数的空间自相关（SPAC）方法。方向混叠理论分析表明，衰减效应主要体现在复SPAC系数的虚部，需要比相速度估计更密集的方位角采样（如正七边形台阵）。作者提出两阶段反演流程：利用一阶近似获取相速度与衰减系数初值，再通过差分进化算法拟合复SPAC系数进行优化……

t: A two-stage procedure estimates phase velocity and attenuation coefficient from regular heptagonal array records using a first-order Bessel approximation of the complex SPAC coefficient followed by differential evolution optimization.
基于正七边形台阵，利用复SPAC系数一阶近似获取初值，再通过差分进化拟合复系数反演相速度与衰减。

Verified with synthetic waveforms, validated with 2D P-SV spectral-element (SPECFEM2D) simulations, and applied to field microtremor measurements in Iwate, Japan using heptagonal arrays of 12, 30, and 132 m radii.
采用理论合成波形、SPECFEM2D模拟数据，以及日本岩手县12、30、132米半径正七边形台阵野外观测数据。

The method accurately recovers fundamental-mode attenuation across arbitrary wavefield directionalities (MRL 0 to 0.975) at low-to-intermediate frequencies, whereas relative-coordinate arrays underestimate attenuation in isotropic fields and beamforming fails under isotropy.
在各向同性至单向波场中均能准确恢复基阶衰减系数，且证明相对坐标台阵在非单向波场中会低估衰减。
Estimates deteriorate at local minima of the Bessel J1 sensitivity function, require long recording durations (up to 1000 segments), and cannot separate higher modes above 6.5–8 Hz.
在J1灵敏度极小值频率处精度下降，需要较长观测时间，且无法分离高阶模式。

Establishes the first practical inversion procedure for complex attenuation-aware SPAC coefficients along with azimuthal aliasing criteria for heptagonal arrays and theoretical limits of relative-coordinate arrays.
首次建立衰减感知复SPAC实用反演流程，给出正七边形防混叠准则并揭示相对坐标台阵的理论局限。

kc: Formulated a two-stage estimation procedure for Rayleigh-wave phase velocity and attenuation coefficient by fitting complex attenuation-aware SPAC coefficients.
Demonstrated theoretically that directional aliasing in the imaginary part of the SPAC coefficient requires a regular heptagonal array (N=7) rather than a conventional triangular array (N=3).
Proved analytically and numerically that relative-coordinate arrays (RCA) break down under attenuation unless the wavefield is nearly unidirectional, recommending absolute-coordinate arrays (ACA).
Validated the method against beamforming-based attenuation estimation using synthetic data, 2D SEM wave-propagation simulations, and multi-scale field array observations.
提出了通过拟合复数衰减感知SPAC系数来联合估计瑞利波相速度和衰减系数的两阶段反演流程。
从理论上证明了SPAC系数虚部的方向混叠要求采用正七边形台阵（N=7）而非传统的三角形台阵（N=3）。
通过解析和数值分析证明相对坐标台阵（RCA）在存在衰减的各向同性波场中失效，建议使用绝对坐标台阵（ACA）。
利用理论合成数据、2D谱元法数值模拟波形及多尺度野外台阵观测，验证了该方法并与基于波束形成的Abbas方法进行了系统对比。
me: Series expansion of the complex attenuation-aware SPAC coefficient using Bessel functions of the first kind to quantify azimuthal aliasing.
Two-stage inversion: first-order Taylor approximation for initial values followed by Differential Evolution optimization of the complex SPAC misfit.
2D P-SV spectral element method (SPECFEM2D) simulations superposed with von Mises directional distributions to generate realistic multi-mode microtremor wavefields.
利用第一类贝塞尔函数对复数衰减感知SPAC系数进行级数展开，以量化方位角方向混叠误差。
两阶段反演：利用一阶泰勒近似计算初始值，随后采用差分进化算法（Differential Evolution）最小化复SPAC拟合残差。
基于2D P-SV谱元法（SPECFEM2D）脉冲响应与von Mises方向分布叠加，生成包含高阶模式的微动模拟波场。
de: Synthetic microtremor waveforms for a 2-layer viscoelastic model across three Q levels, testing record length (up to 1000 segments), 30% RMS white noise, and anisotropy.
SPECFEM2D simulated microtremor datasets recorded on 10-sensor nonagonal arrays (radii 30 m and 500 m) across varying mean resultant lengths (MRL 0 to 0.975).
Field microtremor array measurements in Omoto, Iwate, Japan, using three 8-sensor regular heptagonal arrays with radii of 12 m, 30 m, and 132 m.
针对双层粘弹性模型（三种Q值水平）的合成微动波形实验，测试记录时长（达1000个時段）、30%高斯白噪声及波场各向异性的影响。
使用SPECFEM2D生成的10传感器正九边形台阵（半径30米和500米）模拟数据集，覆盖不同波场方向集中度（MRL从0到0.975）。
在日本岩手县小本地区开展的野外微动观测，使用半径分别为12米、30米和132米的三个8传感器正七边形台阵。
li: Cannot separate or identify higher surface-wave modes, causing instability at frequencies where higher modes dominate.
Exhibits periodic accuracy drops at frequencies corresponding to local minima in the sensitivity function |J1((k + i*alpha)*r)|.
Requires longer observation durations (hundreds of segments) and more stations (heptagonal array) than conventional phase-velocity SPAC.
无法分离或识别高阶面波模式，在较高频率高阶模式占主导时估计结果变得不稳定。
在灵敏度函数 |J1((k + i*alpha)*r)| 的局部极小值对应频率处，衰减系数估计会出现周期性的精度下降。
相比传统的相速度SPAC方法，需要更长的观测时间（数百个数据段）和更多的台站数量（正七边形台阵）。

tm.why: The paper develops an attenuation-aware spatial autocorrelation (SPAC) method for passive microtremor array measurements.
The primary focus is estimating Rayleigh-wave attenuation coefficients and near-surface damping structures from ambient noise.
The work includes theoretical azimuthal aliasing analysis for circular polygonal arrays and compares absolute- vs relative-coordinate array geometries.

ev.notes: Full 33-page PDF analyzed, including theoretical derivations, synthetic tests, SPECFEM2D validations, field application in Iwate, and Appendix A.

sum: Conventional strong-motion processing often distorts near-fault ground motion characteristics such as permanent tectonic offsets (fling-step) and directivity velocity pulses. This study extends Boore's baseline correction method by synchronously enforcing identical correction time windows across all three acceleration components, reflecting the physical coupling of instrument tilt. Applied to 59 near-fault recordings from the 2022 M 6.5 Guanshan foreshock and M 6.9 Chishang mainshock in Taiwan, the method recovers permanent displacements typically within 5 cm and ±10° azimuth of adjacent GNSS stations. A decision-tree classification scheme based on Mavroeidis-Papageorgiou pulse fitting separates fling-step pulses from dynamic pulses, revealing that fling pulses arrive earlier in the shaking (normalized cumulative squared velocity 0.0–0.1) than dynamic pulses (0.0–0.3). Finally, directional peak-to-peak velocities and tectonic offsets correlate strongly with girder unseating and collapse of seven surveyed near-fault bridges, providing an open dataset of preserved near-fault time histories.
常规强震动处理常削弱永久构造位移（滑冲效应）和破裂方向性速度脉冲等近断层特征。本文扩展了Boore基线校正方法，利用仪器倾斜的物理耦合特性，在三个分量上同步施加相同的校正时间窗。将其应用于2022年台湾M 6.5关山前震和M 6.9池上主震的59条近断层记录，恢复的永久位移与邻近GNSS观测的水平和……

t: Extends Boore's piecewise-linear and quadratic velocity baseline corrections by selecting identical correction time intervals synchronously across all three components, accounting for coupled rigid-body instrument tilt.
考虑仪器刚体倾斜耦合，在三分量上同步选择相同时间窗，扩展了分段线性和二次速度基线校正法。
35 strong-motion records from the M 6.5 Guanshan foreshock and 24 from the M 6.9 Chishang mainshock in Taiwan, validated against nearby GNSS stations and seven surveyed near-fault bridges.
台湾M 6.5关山前震35条和M 6.9池上主震24条近断层强震记录，结合邻近GNSS和7座桥梁震害数据。

Recovered permanent displacements mostly agree within 5 cm and ±10° of GNSS values; peak-to-peak velocities exceed 170 cm/s, and 27 fling-step pulses occur earlier (i_v = 0.0–0.1) than 31 dynamic pulses (i_v = 0.0–0.3).
恢复的永久位移与GNSS误差多在5 cm和±10°内；峰峰值速度超170 cm/s，滑冲脉冲比动态脉冲更早到达。
Selecting baseline correction time instances still requires subjective judgment when automatic optimization fails, and some stations show up to 20% displacement discrepancy relative to GNSS.
基线校正时间点选择仍需主观判断，且个别台站与GNSS相比存在约20%的位移偏差。
Enforces synchronous baseline correction intervals across all three components for cross-component validation and introduces a decision tree separating fling-step from dynamic velocity pulses.
强制三分量同步基线校正以实现跨分量交叉验证，并提出区分滑冲与动态脉冲的分类决策树。

kc: Extends Boore's piecewise-linear and quadratic baseline correction methods by enforcing synchronous timing intervals across all three components based on rigid-body instrument tilt physics.
Validates strong-motion-derived permanent tectonic displacements against nearby high-rate GNSS measurements for 59 near-fault records of the 2022 Chishang sequence, achieving mostly <5 cm error.
Introduces a velocity pulse classification decision tree to distinguish fling-step pulses from dynamic velocity pulses and quantifies their relative arrival timing.

Demonstrates that resolved bridge-normal and bridge-parallel peak-to-peak velocities and tectonic offsets explain observed near-fault bridge failures better than traditional rotated intensity measures.
Releases an open-access dataset of baseline-corrected near-fault strong-motion time histories and intensity measures on DesignSafe and GitHub.
基于刚体仪器倾斜物理机制，通过在三个分量上强制同步时间窗口，扩展了Boore的分段线性和二次基线校正方法。

sum: This study investigates the active tectonics of the Bodrum Peninsula in Western Anatolia and the seismicity following the 2017 Mw 6.6 Bodrum-Kos earthquake. By combining kinematic analysis of fault slip data with the spatial distribution of aftershocks, the authors define the structural characteristics and geometry of the newly proposed Bodrum Fault Zone. The results provide insights into the regional extensional stress regime and seismic hazard in the Aegean-Anatolian transition zone, highlighting the role of active normal and strike-slip faulting in accommodating crustal deformation.

sum: This study analyzes the 2021 Mw 6.0 Yangbi earthquake sequence in China using high-precision hypocenter locations, focal mechanisms, tidal responses, and stress transfer. The results reveal complex seismogenic structures near a fault stepover, where foreshocks occurred on both main and conjugate faults. The temporal correlation between foreshock episodes, the mainshock, and peak dilational volumetric tidal strain suggests tidal triggering. The authors propose that the foreshock sequence was driven by deep overpressured fluids, transitional slow-slip events, and cascade triggering, with fluids acting as the primary driver. This suggests that tectonic complexity and fluid activity facilitate short-term foreshocks, offering insights into earthquake predictability.

sum: This document presents a correction to the previously published paper 'A new-generation multiparameter elastic model of the crust and upper mantle of the greater Alpine area and the Apennines using teleseismic full waveform inversion: data, method and models'. The original study developed a high-resolution multiparameter elastic model of the crust and upper mantle beneath the greater Alpine region and the Apennines using teleseismic full-waveform inversion (FWI). This correction addresses specific errors or omissions in the original publication to ensure the accuracy of the presented models.

sum: Southern Italy exhibits complex deformation and uplift from oblique collision and slab tearing, yet the lack of direct ages for marine terraces above 200 m elevation has obscured the underlying mantle drivers. Here, single-grain post-IR IRSL luminescence dating of K-feldspar sands from marine terraces between 107 and 1040 m elevation in southern Calabria is integrated with 10-m DEM surface mapping and fault morphology. Burial ages overlap across all elevations with a weighted mean of 118.8 ± 8.7 ka, challenging previous ~1.0–1.2 Ma estimates. This yields rapid uplift rates from <1 to ~12 mm/yr and normal fault throw rates of 0.8–4.2 mm/yr, which are 5 to 10 times faster than prior estimates. These rapid rates support buoyancy-driven isostatic rebound and eduction caused by an active tear in the Ionian slab rather than slower toroidal mantle flow, offering critical constraints for regional seismic hazard assessment.
本研究结合钾长石单颗粒红外后释光测年、10米精度数字高程模型地表填图及断层地貌分析，对意大利卡拉布里亚南部海拔107至1040米的海成阶地沉积物进行了年代测定。结果显示不同海拔阶地的埋藏年龄高度一致，加权平均值为118.8 ± 8.7 ka，推翻了此前约1.0–1.2 Ma的估计。由此计算的隆升速率……

The derived long-term geologic fault throw and slip rates provide essential constraints for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment in southern Calabria and northeast Sicily.

sum: This study introduces a transdimensional Bayesian framework to jointly infer the unknown number of seismic arrivals and their attributes (arrival time, slowness, amplitude, polarization) from three-component seismograms. By treating waveforms as a superposition of parameterized arrivals, the method samples posterior distributions to provide a probabilistic description of signals and uncertainties. Tested on synthetic and real datasets, the framework successfully identifies direct, reflected, and core-sensitive phases, and recovers shear-wave splitting polarization. When projected into the time-slowness domain, it serves as a probabilistic analog to conventional vespagrams, improving interpretability without arbitrary thresholding. The method is highly flexible, supporting both array and single-station configurations, making it valuable for planetary and sparse-network seismology.

sum: This study combines fluid-flow and local pore-pressure measurements from a quasi-static shear-failure test on Westerly granite with a 3D finite-element inverse method to reconstruct local hydraulic transmissivities along a growing fault. Using synthetic ensembles, the method achieves 7-9% median errors. Applied to experimental data, it resolves episodic transmissivity changes (up to 16 times bulk contribution) and significant spatial heterogeneity. While cumulative acoustic emission (AE) counts track the overall hydraulic evolution, local AE density and amplitude metrics vary across fault cells, indicating that while AE is valuable for mapping damage growth, it has limitations for quantitative hydraulic prediction.

sum: This study calculates 30 lithospheric strength profiles for Mars, constrained by in situ data from the 2018 InSight mission. Using lithospheric numerical modeling under horizontal shortening, the authors investigate the deformation behavior of the Martian lithosphere. The results indicate that Mars' lithosphere is predominantly brittle, with a surprisingly deep brittle-ductile transition zone exceeding 150 km. Under horizontal compression, the reference model exhibits deep lithospheric faulting. The novelty lies in using direct in situ constraints from InSight to construct these strength profiles, providing new insights into the geodynamics, thermal state, and seismotectonics of Mars.
本研究利用2018年洞察号（InSight）任务的原位观测数据，计算了30个火星岩石圈强度剖面。通过在水平缩短条件下的岩石圈数值模拟，研究了火星岩石圈的变形特征。结果表明，火星岩石圈主要呈现脆性特征，其脆韧性转变温度边界深于150公里。在水平挤压作用下，参考模型显示出深部岩石圈断裂。该研究的创新点在……

sum: This study addresses the compounding threat of sea-level rise and vertical land motion (subsidence) on Treasure Island, a century-old artificial island in San Francisco Bay. Utilizing advanced Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) datasets, the authors map high-resolution spatial and temporal variations in land subsidence across the island, which is primarily driven by the consolidation of underlying bay muds and artificial fills. By integrating these geodetic observations with future sea-level rise projections, the study quantifies the accelerating flood hazards and exposure of critical infrastructure over the coming century. The findings highlight the critical importance of incorporating localized vertical land motion into coastal adaptation and resilience planning for vulnerable artificial landforms.

sum: This study utilizes machine-learning techniques on data from a one-year dense seismic array deployment in Southern Italy to determine high-resolution focal mechanisms and stress field orientations for low-magnitude earthquakes. The authors derive 289 focal mechanisms, achieving a dataset density comparable to six years of conventional monitoring. The results show a dominant normal faulting regime consistent with regional tectonics. The stress field is spatially homogeneous at a ~20 km scale and temporally stable in orientation. Notably, the study detects seasonal variations in the stress ratio, which may be modulated by hydrological loading. This highlights the power of short-term dense arrays combined with machine learning for detailed seismotectonic and environmental stress monitoring.
本研究利用机器学习处理意大利南部一年期密集台阵数据，获取了低震级地震的高分辨率震源机制和应力场。反演得到的289个震源机制与区域正断层构造一致。应力场在20千米尺度上空间均匀且方向时间稳定，但应力比存在季节性变化，可能受水文载荷调制。展示了密集台阵结合机器学习在精细应力监测中的潜力。

sum: This book chapter by Andreas Fichtner provides an educational and intuitive introduction to the Central Slice Theorem, a cornerstone of tomographic imaging. The theorem states that the 1D Fourier transform of a projection equals a slice through the multidimensional Fourier transform of the object. The chapter explains the mathematical link between projections and the object's frequency content, demonstrating how it enables efficient reconstruction in applications like computed tomography (CT) and straight-ray seismic tomography. It serves as a foundational theoretical resource for understanding inverse problems in imaging.

sum: This study presents a joint inversion framework to estimate shear damping ratio ($D_{s0}$) and shear wave velocity ($V_s$) profiles from Rayleigh-wave attenuation and phase velocity data. Utilizing a viscoelastic predominant-mode approach, the method identifies the mode contributing most strongly to the wavefield, bypassing the need for explicit modal indexing. This is particularly advantageous for attenuation data, which exhibit highly irregular modal behavior. The framework is validated using two synthetic models, demonstrating its capability to capture modal transitions and recover profiles. It is then applied to active-source field datasets from Mirandola, Italy, and Bird's Landing, California. The inverted $V_s$ profiles match independent site characterization data, and the damping estimates provide physically plausible, site-specific trends.
本文提出一种联合反演框架，利用粘弹性主导模式方法从瑞雷波衰减和相速度数据中提取剪切阻尼比和剪切波速度剖面。该方法通过识别对波场贡献最强的模式，避免了显式模式标定，解决了衰减数据中复杂的多模态不规则性。经合成模型和意大利、美国两处主动源实测数据验证，反演的波速剖面与独立勘测吻合，阻尼比估算合理。

t: A joint inversion framework using a viscoelastic predominant-mode approach to estimate shear damping ratio and shear wave velocity without explicit modal indexing.
采用粘弹性主导模式方法的联合反演框架，无需显式模式标定即可估算剪切阻尼比和剪切波速度。
Synthetic ground models and active-source field datasets from Mirandola, Italy, and Bird's Landing, California.
合成地层模型以及来自意大利Mirandola和美国加州Bird's Landing的主动源野外数据集。
Successfully recovered Vs and Ds0 profiles, matching independent site characterization data and capturing complex modal transitions.
成功恢复了Vs和Ds0剖面，与独立场地勘测数据吻合，并捕获了复杂的模式转换。
The framework's performance depends on the quality of extracted attenuation coefficients and has only been tested on active-source data.
该框架的性能取决于提取的衰减系数质量，且目前仅在主动源数据上进行了测试。
First application of a viscoelastic predominant-mode approach to joint inversion of Rayleigh-wave attenuation and phase velocity, bypassing modal indexing.
首次将粘弹性主导模式方法应用于瑞雷波衰减和相速度的联合反演，绕过了模式标定。

sum: The authors present a new 3D gravity-based density model of the Northern Chile subduction zone (18–27° S) down to 410 km depth. By compiling updated geometries of key boundaries (plate interface, Moho, LAB) from recent geophysical datasets, they constructed 28 2D profiles and interpolated them into a 3D model using IGMAS+. Densities and interface geometries were optimized by inverting the EIGEN-6C4 gravity anomaly. The model reveals offshore oceanic crustal thicknesses of 5–17 km, with thicker crust (>10 km) correlating with the Iquique Ridge. Onshore, the model incorporates a deeper mantle wedge corner based on interplate seismicity. This open-access model provides an updated lithospheric framework for future geodynamic and seismological studies in the region.

t: 3D gravity modeling and inversion using IGMAS+ to adjust initial densities and interface geometries of 28 W-E profiles to fit the EIGEN-6C4 gravity anomaly.
利用IGMAS+软件对28条东西向剖面进行三维重力建模与反演，拟合EIGEN-6C4重力异常。
EIGEN-6C4 gravity anomaly data and compiled geometries of the plate interface, slab, Moho, and LAB from published geophysical datasets.
EIGEN-6C4重力异常数据，以及从已发表文献中编译的板块边界、莫霍面和LAB几何结构。
A 3D density model showing offshore crustal thicknesses of 5-17 km (thicker at Iquique Ridge) and a deeper onshore mantle wedge corner.
获得三维密度模型，显示近海地壳厚度为5-17公里（海脊处较厚），且陆下地幔楔拐角更深。
Assumes homogeneous offshore crustal density to map gravity anomalies into thickness, and is subject to the non-uniqueness of gravity inversion.
近海假设了均匀的地壳密度，且重力反演本身存在非唯一性。
Provides an updated, open-access 3D lithospheric density model of Northern Chile integrating recent geophysical constraints and a deeper mantle wedge corner.
整合最新地球物理约束，提供了智利北部更新且开源的三维岩石圈密度模型。

kc: Developed a comprehensive 3D gravity-based density model of the Northern Chile subduction zone down to 410 km depth.
Quantified offshore oceanic crustal thickness (5–17 km), identifying crustal thickening (>10 km) beneath the Iquique Ridge.
Updated the onshore mantle wedge corner depth based on the downdip limit of interplate seismicity.
Released the final 3D model openly on Zenodo for future research.
构建了智利北部俯冲带深至410公里的完整三维重力密度模型。
定量给出了5–17公里的近海海洋地壳厚度，并发现伊基克海脊下方存在显著的地壳增厚（>10公里）。
基于板块间地震活动性的下限，更新了陆下地幔楔拐角的深度。
在Zenodo上开源了最终的三维模型，便于后续研究使用。
me: 3D density modeling and gravity inversion using the IGMAS+ software.
Compilation and integration of multi-source geophysical constraints for initial interface geometries (Moho, LAB, slab).
Interpolation of 28 parallel W-E 2D profiles spaced at 0.33° into a coherent 3D volume.
利用IGMAS+软件进行三维密度建模与重力反演。
整合多源地球物理约束，构建初始界面几何结构（莫霍面、LAB、俯冲板块等）。
将28条间距为0.33°的平行东西向二维剖面插值构建为三维模型。
de: EIGEN-6C4 global gravity anomaly dataset.
Geophysical constraints on plate interface, slab surface, oceanic/continental Moho, and oceanic LAB from literature.
Active-source seismic data used for offshore validation.
EIGEN-6C4全球重力异常数据集。
文献中关于板块边界、俯冲带表面、海洋/大陆莫霍面及海洋LAB的地球物理约束。
用于近海模型验证的主动源地震数据。
li: Offshore crustal thickness estimates assume a largely homogeneous crustal density, mapping all gravity anomalies into thickness variations.
Resolution is limited by the 0.33° profile spacing and the inherent non-uniqueness of gravity inversion.
近海地壳厚度估算假设了大致均匀的地壳密度，从而将所有重力异常都归结为厚度变化。
模型分辨率受限于0.33°的剖面间距以及重力反演固有的非唯一性。
